episodesList.title: Fulfilling Wishes, Finding Love
episodesList.summary: Reena breaks down after an exhaustive day at work. Ravi fulfils Jagan's last wish. An impressed Anitha kisses Ravi, leaving him confused.

episodesList.title: Doubts in Diagnosis
episodesList.summary: Ravi's confrontation leaves Anitha upset. Teju wins an opportunity to assist Radhi in a complicated surgery. However, was Radhi right in her diagnosis?

episodesList.title: Unmasking the Threat
episodesList.summary: Reena's first surgery is a success. She reprimands Arjun after discovering the truth about him. Radhi learns about the unknown enemy, a threat to her hospital.

episodesList.title: House Party
episodesList.summary: The doctors gather at Reena's house for a party. Some uninvited guests join in to multiply the fun. Rocky tries to woo Reena. But is she interested?

episodesList.title: Healthcare Urgency
episodesList.summary: Radhi decides to investigate more about MNM Hospital. Arjun tries to help during an emergency case at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Looming Danger
episodesList.summary: Teju learns about the looming threat to the hospital. Reena has to reflect on her abandoned childhood to help a teenager take the right step.

episodesList.title: Stealth Mission
episodesList.summary: Radhi has to relive her past trauma as she convinces Vinusha's father to forgive his daughter. The interns help Arjun to do the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Battlefront Courage
episodesList.summary: The unknown enemy has shown his face. But can he win against the spirit of the doctors at RK Hospital?

episodesList.title: New Alliance
episodesList.summary: Madan has a new ally while Arjun starts getting involved in hospital management. Arjun has a squabble with Reena over their relationship.

episodesList.title: Alzheimer's Mystery
episodesList.summary: Teju begins her game as she gives a piece of advice to Arjun. Reena drops an Alzheimer’s patient home and is surprised to learn his identity.

episodesList.title: Hopeful Hearts
episodesList.summary: Anitha is shocked when Ravi reveals a secret. When Arjun seeks RK's permission to get involved in the hospital's activities, he feels hopeful about their relationship.

episodesList.title: Heartbreaks and Favours
episodesList.summary: Anitha has a heartbreak. RK seeks a favour from Radhi. Both Radhi and Arjun aim to protect the hospital but are they on the same team?

episodesList.title: CEO's Rise
episodesList.summary: Amidst internal doubts and external threats, RK Hospital faces a pivotal decision. Will Radhi thwart Arjun's rise to CEO, or will RK's plan secure the hospital's future?

episodesList.title: Paths to Leadership
episodesList.summary: Dev gets caught between defending his children and facing a harsh reality. Amidst personal and professional challenges, Radhi attempts to mentor Arjun as RK Hospital's potential CEO.

episodesList.title: Preparing for Destiny
episodesList.summary: As Radhi prepares Arjun for a pivotal task, personal and professional worlds collide as secrets unravel at the hospital, friendships are tested, and unexpected connections emerge.

episodesList.title: Comedy and Chaos
episodesList.summary: A furious Anitha seeks revenge. As Radhi juggles Teju's interference, Arjun's revelation leads to a game-changing conference at RK Hospital. Meanwhile, love is in the air.

episodesList.title: Rekindled Connections
episodesList.summary: Arjun rekindles the relationship with his father as they go on a fun outing. Reena's childhood friend pays a surprise visit to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Insights
episodesList.summary: Radhi feels defeated as Arjun's pitch gets approved by the board. Dev helps a frustrated Radhi comprehend the situation. Rocky becomes a guest in his dinner plan with Reena.

episodesList.title: Complimented Impact
episodesList.summary: Radhi acknowledges Arjun's work. Anitha sets clear boundaries for Ravi. As RK opens his heart out to Reena, his compliment shocks her.

episodesList.title: Breaking Barriers
episodesList.summary: Reena confronts RK about his compliment. Arjun gets closure as he gathers the courage to talk to RK about Pallavi. The well-guarded secret of Radhi and Reena starts to crack.

episodesList.title: Protecting the Past
episodesList.summary: Sarada, the landlady, gets restless and tries to learn about Reena's past. Naveen makes a blunder that would put his career at risk, but Teju takes a drastic step to protect him.

episodesList.title: Heartbeat Moments
episodesList.summary: Ravi asks Guna and Rocky for a favour. Sarada invites Dev's family for dinner. While Rocky struggles to convince a patient's family for surgery, things get tense between Guna and Naveen.

episodesList.title: Hope In Recovery
episodesList.summary: Rocky manages to convince the tribals for surgery, but they have a condition. RK uses his experience to save Naveen's patient. Will Naveen get a second chance?

episodesList.title: The Perfect Plan
episodesList.summary: Sarada executes her plan to perfection, making both Radhi and Reena restless. A confused Reena tries to get out of the complex situation.

episodesList.title: Midnight Mischief
episodesList.summary: Radhi and Reena feel overwhelmed when the latter joins Radhi and her family for dinner. Sid and Divi make Reena part of their midnight mischief.

episodesList.title: Heart-to-Heart Conversations
episodesList.summary: Arjun proposes a celebration for the hospital's 20th anniversary. Anitha decides to talk to Ravi after her chat with Bharathi. Reena gets cornered by the interns about her night out.

episodesList.title: Ethnic Elegance
episodesList.summary: The hospital wears a festive look on the day of its anniversary. The doctors turn up in ethnic wear. However, the happiness is short-lived as tragedy strikes RK Hospital.

episodesList.title: Memories of a Mentor
episodesList.summary: The hospital mourns the demise of RK. Everybody reminisces their pleasant memories with him. Anitha feels flustered when Ravi opens up about his marriage.

episodesList.title: Clear Waters, Clear Words
episodesList.summary: Radhi takes care of Reena when she falls ill. Reena learns about Sarada's lie and confronts her. As Ravi and Anitha are back to being best friends, Bharathi encounters Anitha.

episodesList.title: Emotional Tokens
episodesList.summary: Anitha is irked as Ravi steals her thunder. Radhi orders Naveen to assist Aruna who obliges. As Reena bids goodbye to Radhi's family, Sid's gift makes them emotional.

episodesList.title: Journey of Healing
episodesList.summary: Reena compels Arjun to go out with her to help get him out of mourning. Anitha's frustration grows as Ravi gets credit for her hard work.

episodesList.title: The Art of Persuasion
episodesList.summary: Arjun comes back to the hospital and announces his arrival with a speech. The power dynamic gets interesting as Radhi approves Ramanathan's request despite Arjun rejecting it.

episodesList.title: Power Play
episodesList.summary: Sid and Divi ask Reena for a favour. Laya bids goodbye to Rocky. When Arjun confronts Radhi for overruling him, she firmly states that he is not the CEO of the hospital.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Revelations
episodesList.summary: The team is shocked to learn about Guna's father. Arjun gets irked when Reena tries to defend Radhi. Ravi confronts Anitha and she informs him about Bharathi's feelings.

episodesList.title: Clash of Egos
episodesList.summary: Ravi scolds Bharathi, but Anitha decides to move on. Arjun tries to prove a point, and Radhi puts him down with facts. Things turn ugly between Ravi and Anitha.

episodesList.title: Corporate Twist
episodesList.summary: Reena helps Sid get into the football team. The race for the post of the CEO takes an interesting turn when Madan makes a grand entry into the hospital.

episodesList.title: Team Dynamics
episodesList.summary: Radhi announces that two interns will become resident doctors by the end of the year and explains how they will be evaluated. She makes it clear to Madan that she is not his ally.

episodesList.title: Mentor Rivalry
episodesList.summary: Ravi and Anitha get competitive as they mentor the interns. Guna is unhappy when a celebrity dancer is admitted to the hospital. Dev grows curious as the kids lie about Reena.

episodesList.title: Privacy Breach
episodesList.summary: Teju reckons that Reena and Guna's diagnosis might be wrong. Jennifer tries to spend time with Guna. Bharathi confronts Anitha for revealing her secret to Ravi.

episodesList.title: Rivalry Victorious
episodesList.summary: Dev confronts Reena about her visit to the kid's school. As Teju cracks the case and takes it over from Reena and Guna, Ravi feels victorious.

episodesList.title: Strife and Solidarity
episodesList.summary: Reena argues with Radhi regarding a case. Charu seeks Rocky's help to plan a party. While Madan fails to manipulate Arjun, the group reunites as Guna and Naveen bury the hatchet.

episodesList.title: Emotional Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Dev runs into Ganesh and realises that Reena lied to him. In the hospital, Reena breaks down as she fails to save the baby. Radhi consoles her and gives her some advice.

episodesList.title: Social Tensions
episodesList.summary: The interns manage to get Radhi's permission to attend the party. Ravi rants to Arjun as things get tense with Anitha and Bharathi. As everyone is having fun, Naveen ends up in a spot.

episodesList.title: Babysitting Chaos
episodesList.summary: Dev tells Radhi about the lies of Reena and the kids. Reena and Arjun babysit Divi and her friends. As Radhi and Dev look for Divi, the situation goes out of hand in the pool.

episodesList.title: Tensions Rise
episodesList.summary: Radhi gives an ultimatum to the kids. When Ganesh learns of the incident, he confronts Radhi. While Madan and Teju team up again, Ravi apologises to Bharathi.

episodesList.title: Walk Together
episodesList.summary: Upset, Reena opens up to Arjun. While Rocky and Guna fight for a patient, Ravi attends to an ex-military officer. Arjun takes Reena for a walk and tries to comfort her.

episodesList.title: Cop Encounter
episodesList.summary: Guna and Rocky go out of their way to impress Kevin, but land in trouble with the cops. Babloo and Divi make a plan to apologise to Reena.

episodesList.title: Sneak Attempt
episodesList.summary: Radhi and Reena blame each other for what happened. Rocky seeks Reena's help to fulfil Kevin's wish. However, chaos ensues at the girl's hostel, landing them in trouble.

episodesList.title: Hospital Shock
episodesList.summary: Reena falls head over heels for Arjun as he takes her on a surprise date. While Teju is looking for an opportunity, a patient's unexpected death shakes the hospital.

episodesList.title: Chaos Advantage
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Anitha console Bharathi as the police take Ravi for questioning. Madan takes advantage of the entire situation. Divi and the kids outsmart Dev to apologise to Reena.

episodesList.title: Hospital Whispers
episodesList.summary: Jennifer opens up to Guna when he confronts her. Ravi feels low as everyone gossips about him. While Radhi advises Ravi not to handle critical cases, Bharathi gets a lead.

episodesList.title: Desperate Measures
episodesList.summary: Bharathi gets anxious to spot Anitha comforting Ravi. Madan resolves to dismiss Ravi, leaving Radhi feeling helpless. As Arjun is frantic to stop the arrest, Bharathi cracks the case.

episodesList.title: Hospital Politics
episodesList.summary: Ravi ploys to get close to Bharathi. Guna happily bonds with his mother. While Arjun and Madan agree on the need for a CEO in the hospital, a high-profile patient creates an uproar.

episodesList.title: Diagnostic Debate
episodesList.summary: Aruna motivates Naveen when Radhi challenges the interns to find a solution for Meera's case. Naveen comes up with a better course of treatment. What will be Radhi's decision?

episodesList.title: Past Actions, Present Consequences
episodesList.summary: The board seeks nominations for the CEO's role, and Arjun and Madan are shocked to see Radhi in the race. Anitha mocks Ravi for his past actions as she gets credit for a tough surgery.

episodesList.title: Tension in the Ranks
episodesList.summary: Irked with Ravi, Bharathi plays a prank on him. Arjun gets anxious as he learns about Madan's plans. Ravi mocks Rocky as he gets into an awkward situation with Laya and Charu.

episodesList.title: A Surprising Request
episodesList.summary: Reena seeks Rocky's help in her plan to propose to Arjun. While Asha throws tantrums about Jennifer being in Guna's hospital, Naveen gets shocked by Meera's request.

episodesList.title: Unwanted Attention
episodesList.summary: Arjun feels awkward as his past love stories become the central topic during the team's campus visit. Wary about risking his career again, Naveen refuses to comply with Meera's plea

episodesList.title: Failed Attempts
episodesList.summary: Ravi is shocked as Bharathi gets her visa. Arjun tries to make peace with Radhi but in vain. Naveen manages to confide in Radhi about Meera's case, but how will she react to him?

episodesList.title: Picture Mystery
episodesList.summary: Dev asks Radhi about a kid's photo in the closet. Teju figures out why Madan is in a hurry to take over the hospital. As Reena decides to propose to Arjun, he learns a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Shattered Hopes
episodesList.summary: Arjun breaks up with Reena, leaving her shattered. Naveen thanks Radhi for trusting him and apologises for his mistake. Reena opens up about her past to Rocky.

episodesList.title: Accusations and Regrets
episodesList.summary: Teju confirms her theory about Madan with Kishore's help. Ravi is unhappy about Bharathi going abroad. Arjun blames Reena when Sonia confronts him about his reaction.

episodesList.title: The Missing Piece
episodesList.summary: Teju figures out the missing piece of the puzzle when she overhears Arjun and Anitha. She confronts Madan about it. Arjun is surprised as he gets a crucial piece of information.

episodesList.title: A Battle for Life
episodesList.summary: Dev gets irked as the kids' secret visits to Reena haven't stopped. Arjun confronts Teju, who justifies her actions. Naveen and Reena work towards saving their patients' lives.

episodesList.title: Medical Ethics at Stake
episodesList.summary: Reena and Naveen convince Nirmal's parents to donate his organs to Yazhini. Ravi vows to win over Bharathi before she leaves for the US. Reena scolds Sonia for causing her trouble.

episodesList.title: Hope Amidst Despair
episodesList.summary: Reena decides to save Nirmal after Yazhini succumbs to her illness. Ravi takes Bharathi out to get close to her, but she misunderstands him. Madan faces pressure from his investors.

episodesList.title: Misinterpreted Feelings
episodesList.summary: The entire hospital gathers to honour Yazhini. Ravi confesses his feelings to Bharathi but she gets irked. Guna admits the truth when Asha confronts him about Jennifer.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Encounters
episodesList.summary: Kishore overhears a shocking revelation. Radhi gets anxious after a complaint gets lodged with the medical board. As the interns discuss the leak, Madan has a surprise visitor.

episodesList.title: Awkward Interrogations
episodesList.summary: Naveen confronts Madan for misusing the data he provided. Jennifer asks Reena about her family. The medical board acts in favour of the hospital, but Radhi is curious about the leak.19

episodesList.title: High Stakes Game
episodesList.summary: As Radhi asks the interns to step up in the final month of the competition, Madan tries to up the stakes for Naveen. Guna confronts Teju about the deleted logs.

episodesList.title: Passing Findings
episodesList.summary: Sonia seeks Rocky's help to reunite Reena and Arjun. Reena asks Radhi about her father. The interns pass on their findings to Naveen and help him win the case.

episodesList.title: Fiasco Fallout
episodesList.summary: The hospital enters a crisis mode as all the patients start showing side effects. As the doctors finally figure out the issue, Arjun blames Radhi for the fiasco.

episodesList.title: A confrontation of Hypocrisy
episodesList.summary: Radhi stands her ground when Arjun calls out her hypocrisy. Sonia and Rocky's plan to reunite Arjun and Reena fails. Ravi feels dejected by Bharathi's decision to leave for the US.

episodesList.title: A Starting Revelation
episodesList.summary: Ravi seeks Anitha and Arjun's help to plan the wedding, while Guna makes Reena volunteer from Bharathi's side. Reena confronts Arjun and makes a startling disclosure.

episodesList.title: A Failed Surgery
episodesList.summary: Naveen gets tense as Teju doubts him. Arjun surprises Reena. Naveen fails in Nidhun's surgery, and lashes at the interns. Ravi and Anitha take their relationship to the next level.

episodesList.title: Tracing the Leak
episodesList.summary: Teju gets curious as Radhi seeks Arjun's help to trace the leak. Naveen bids an emotional goodbye to his friends but Radhi has a surprise for him.

episodesList.title: A Web of Lies
episodesList.summary: The interns decide not to help each other in the competition. Radhi confronts Reena if Rocky knows about them. Reena ends up in a tussle with Dev.

episodesList.title: Party Under Pressure
episodesList.summary: The competition gets intense as the interns go all out to win. Teju begins to suspect Madan and Naveen. Arjun gets nervous as the group meets up for Ravi's bachelor party.

episodesList.title: Joy and Jeopardy
episodesList.summary: Anitha calms a nervous Bharathi. The friends cheer as Ravi and Bharathi get married again. One of the intern's family members is admitted to the hospital in a critical condition.

episodesList.title: A Father's Struggle
episodesList.summary: Teju breaks down on seeing her father's critical condition. Ravi bids goodbye to Bharathi as she leaves for the US. The board members announce the date for the election of the CEO.

episodesList.title: The Competition Countdown
episodesList.summary: Radhi, Madan and Arjun analyse their chances of winning the CEO election. Radhi tells the interns that the winner of their competition will be announced in two days.

episodesList.title: Cracking the Case
episodesList.summary: Teju finds a solution to the alcoholic boy's case. Naveen warns Madan when he tries to get help from Teju. Radhi is shocked as Arjun makes a startling revelation.

episodesList.title: Unveiling the Mole
episodesList.summary: Radhi gets anxious as she tries to find out who the mole is. She announces the winner of the competition, but things get tense as she confronts the interns about Arjun's revelation.

episodesList.title: The Final Showdown
episodesList.summary: The D-Day finally arrives. All three CEO contenders present their action plan for the hospital. As things heat up, the big secret gets out in the open.

episodesList.title: Deadlock Drama
episodesList.summary: The board members announce the results, and it's a tie. They suggest a unique solution. Arjun's revelation spreads throughout the hospital, and Reena lashes out at him.

episodesList.title: Lines Drawn
episodesList.summary: Radhi is anxious but doesn't have the courage to open up to Dev. Reena makes her stance clear to Arjun when he tries to explain.

episodesList.title: The Truth Strikes
episodesList.summary: Dev confronts Radhi and creates a scene at Reena's house. Arjun tells Teju about the board's decision regarding her. When she tells Naveen, he makes a startling revelation.

episodesList.title: The Final Encounter
episodesList.summary: Radhi breaks down in front of Reena and begs her to leave. At the railway station, Reena finally meets the person she has been searching for years and makes a decision.

episodesList.title: New Beginnings, Old Wounds
episodesList.summary: Resigned from her job, Radhi tries to find solace at home. Reena, now a senior resident, has a tiff with Arjun, the new CEO. Everyone gears up to welcome a fresh batch of interns.

episodesList.title: A Second Chance
episodesList.summary: Teju, now working in a modest clinic, is firm about not forgiving Naveen. While Radhi struggles to adapt to a new life, a dejected Madan considers suicide.

episodesList.title: Acts of Repair
episodesList.summary: Preetham assigns a high-profile case to Reena with an ulterior motive. Radhi meets Teju when she tries to save a man's life. Divi and Sid plan to reunite their estranged parents.

episodesList.title: Breaking Point
episodesList.summary: Anitha feels slighted when Reena gets control of her patient's case. A long-awaited family outing turns disastrous when Dev publicly lashes out at Radhi.

episodesList.title: Chain Reaction
episodesList.summary: Radhi begins visiting Teju's clinic for an unusual reason. Preetham gets upset with Reena when Arjun confronts him about the unjust work allotment for the nurses.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Visitor
episodesList.summary: Kiran invites Arjun to the party Rocky and Guna are planning to help the juniors bond. At the hospital, Reena is caught off guard when Thyagarajan visits her unexpectedly.

episodesList.title: Messy Favours
episodesList.summary: Thyagarajan asks Reena to drop him home. Radhi remains emotionless and refuses to share her struggles with her father. Reena gets into trouble when she steps in to help Kiran.

episodesList.title: Freshers Party
episodesList.summary: Arjun is surprised to see Reena and Kiran attend the party together. Rocky grows suspicious of Guna's odd behaviour. Arjun tries to speak with Reena, but she refuses to oblige.

episodesList.title: Under Pressure
episodesList.summary: Arjun recovers from the accident. Preetham divides the resident doctors into teams for a case. Teju seeks Radhi's help when a criminal terrorises her to perform his wife's surgery.

episodesList.title: Tensions Within
episodesList.summary: Radhi guides Teju through a tense surgery. Reena is annoyed with Arjun's newly imposed rule. Kiran fights a stranger for Reena. Friction builds as Anitha mocks Guna's abilities

episodesList.title: Under the Knife
episodesList.summary: Reena wins the case, but midway through the surgery, Guna's diagnosis is proven right. Arjun and Reena argue about the change in treatment during surgery and the increased expenses.

episodesList.title: Conjoined Twins
episodesList.summary: Reena encounters Radhi at the market. Complications escalate when conjoined twins are born. Reena admits that only one person is skilled to attempt the life-altering operation.

episodesList.title: Bittersweet
episodesList.summary: Expecting Arjun to get Radhi for the complex surgery, Reena fumes when a new surgeon arrives. Later, she enjoys making dosas for Thyagarajan. As she drops him home, she runs into Dev.

episodesList.title: Lines Crossed
episodesList.summary: Raghav, the new surgeon, misbehaves with Anitha. While Guna is hurt as she does not confide in him, Arjun warns Raghav about his conduct. Madan approaches Arjun for a job.

episodesList.title: Last Resort
episodesList.summary: Reena runs into Teju when they meet with a minor accident. Panic grips the hospital when Raghav disappears after Arjun's warning. With no option left, Arjun turns to Radhi for help.

episodesList.title: Radhi's Comeback
episodesList.summary: Dev and Divi ask Radhi to reconsider her decision. Motivated, she returns to the hospital and successfully takes charge of the surgery. Arjun and Reena try to be friends again.

episodesList.title: The Return Deal
episodesList.summary: Radhi agrees to return to the hospital but on her terms. Sensing a threat to his position, Preetham feels insecure. Teju confronts Radhi for speaking to Arjun on her behalf.

episodesList.title: Power Play
episodesList.summary: Guna gets teary as Jennifer is admitted in critical condition. Radhi rejects the chief doctor's post. She asks Anitha to take over a key case from Reena. Teju returns to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Tension in Scrubs
episodesList.summary: Radhi gets upset as Dev says nothing has changed between them. Tension rises as Preetham prods into Radhi's case and gives tips. Naveen is thrilled to work with Teju on a new case.

episodesList.title: The Last Wish
episodesList.summary: Reena confronts Radhi for taking her off the case. Guna makes a peculiar request to Jennifer. Madan is upset with Arjun for not giving him a job. Later, he gets a surprise visitor.

episodesList.title: Sister Returns
episodesList.summary: Manasa returns and informs Madan she wants the hospital back. Radhi suggests an alternative treatment for Preetham’s patient in his absence. Naveen and Teju visit a patient’s home.

episodesList.title: For The Right Reasons
episodesList.summary: Preetham lashes out at Reena for altering the patient's treatment and clashes with Radhi, making Arjun angry. Reena breaks protocol to ensure the patient gets the correct treatment.

episodesList.title: Nilofers Engagement
episodesList.summary: Feeling overshadowed by Radhi, Preetham vents out on Kamal. Radhi warns Reena against her actions. Kiran and Rocky are dazed when Nilofer makes a shocking statement at her engagement.

episodesList.title: Dinner Party
episodesList.summary: Reena, Rocky, and Arjun feel awkward when Radhi forcibly joins Thyagarajan and the kids for a dinner party they all planned. Teju sees Guna and Anitha sharing an intimate moment.

episodesList.title: Nurses' Strike
episodesList.summary: Radhi lashes out at Thyagarajan for meddling in her life. Chaos erupts at the hospital as the nurses go on strike over the toxic work culture. Manasa reveals her plan to Madan.

episodesList.title: Triple Date!
episodesList.summary: Reena tries to learn about her past from Thyagarajan. Kiran's date plan fails as Nilofer blurts it to Reena. While Manasa plots a meeting with Arjun, Teju tells Guna Naveen's truth.

episodesList.title: Death of a Patient
episodesList.summary: Rathi offers to teach Bharatanatyam to the ladies. Manasa tricks Arjun into believing that she is looking for a job. Preetham gets blamed when a patient dies, but Reena saves him.

episodesList.title: One Date, Many Stories
episodesList.summary: Radhi berates Reena to respect seniority when they clash over a surgery. Arjun feels jealous of Kiran and Reena’s date. Radhi gets emotional seeing Dr Vijay receiving an award.

episodesList.title: Echoes of the Past
episodesList.summary: Reena meets Radhi at the temple, triggering queries about her birth. Manasa reconnects with Arjun. Finally admitting to her fear of the past, Radhi reveals a harsh truth to Reena.

episodesList.title: The Number Chase
episodesList.summary: Resolved to get Thyagarajan’s number, Reena seeks Rocky and Teju's help to steal Radhi’s phone. Selected to the board, Manasa shares a moment with Arjun, leaving Reena rattled.

episodesList.title: A Little Jealous!
episodesList.summary: Naveen confronts Manasa, who mocks him, while Preetham exposes her lies. Reena calls up Thyagarajan for answers. Envy sets in as Reena and Arjun probe each other about their dates.

episodesList.title: The Last Performance
episodesList.summary: At the hospital anniversary, tensions simmer. Dev shocks Radhi with his decision. The women’s performance receives a standing ovation, but the evening turns tragic.

episodesList.title: Strings Attached
episodesList.summary: Dev and Radhi clash over custody, and he moves out. Manasa subtly manipulates Preetham and Arjun into placing Reena under Radhi, causing friction.

episodesList.title: Hungry and Hurt
episodesList.summary: While Radhi investigates Meena's condition, tensions rise. Teju threatens to expose Manasa. Reena cooks for Sid and Divi, but a sudden fainting spell raises an alarm.

episodesList.title: Quiet Instigator
episodesList.summary: Misunderstandings brew between Radhi and Reena over Meena's case, and Preetham quietly celebrates the growing rift. Dev runs into a stranger with whom he opens up about his pain.

episodesList.title: Protective Sister
episodesList.summary: As Meena's surgery unfolds, Radhi's emotional monologue indirectly reaches Reena. When a teacher hits Divi, Reena takes swift action.

episodesList.title: Tough Choices
episodesList.summary: Arjun, Reena, Kiran, and Manasa navigate a complex dinner situation. Divi gets upset when Dev asks to choose between her parents. An injured Amaya requests Abi to work her shift.

episodesList.title: Acting Nurse
episodesList.summary: Reena suspects drug use behind the athletes’ condition. Radhi takes a decision without informing Preetham. Divi’s bond with Reena upsets Radhi. Abi, posing as Amaya, begins her stint.

episodesList.title: The Shady Coach
episodesList.summary: Radhi faces pressure from the coach as the truth about the athletes' drug use surfaces. Misunderstandings rise in the Nilofer–Reena–Kiran triangle. Anitha confronts her insecurities.

episodesList.title: Deaths in the Ward
episodesList.summary: Reena doubts the coach after talking to the athletes. Abi struggles to play the nurse. Tension rises in the hospital as three athletes die. Several people are now under the scanner.

episodesList.title: Under Scrutiny
episodesList.summary: As the deaths make headlines, suspicion brews within the team. While Preetham blames Radhi, the medical council appoints a private doctor to investigate the case.

episodesList.title: Radhi's School Love
episodesList.summary: Thyagarajan takes Reena through Radhi’s past. Teenagers Radhi and Vijay fall madly in love, but an unplanned pregnancy forces them into adult decisions far too early in life.

episodesList.title: Broken Promise
episodesList.summary: Thyagarajan reveals Vijay abandoned Radhi after her pregnancy was exposed. Later, Reena lashes at Kiran for flirting with her. Kamal visits Amaya and is shocked to see her twin sister.

episodesList.title: Return of the Past
episodesList.summary: Preetham demands CEO Arjun’s ouster, accusing him of being biased. Arjun awkwardly asks Reena out. A chance encounter with the investigative doctor at the hospital shocks Radhi.

episodesList.title: Old Flame, New Fire
episodesList.summary: Vijay’s return upsets Radhi. When he insists, she assist him on the athlete case, Radhi removes Reena from the case. Abi warns Kamal that his fear might blow their secret.

episodesList.title: Suspects and Theories
episodesList.summary: Arjun battles his addiction and reaches out to Manasa for help. Vijay begins his investigation into the athlete’s deaths and tensions rise as he suspects foul play in the case.

episodesList.title: Investigation Is On
episodesList.summary: Vijay suspects Abi's identity and competence. Arjun helps Anitha confront her vulnerabilities. Arjun and Radhi are shocked when Vijay reveals that Abi is not Amaya.

episodesList.title: Truth Uncovered
episodesList.summary: Radhi gets irritated with Vijay’s persistent behaviour. Anitha makes her relationship with Guna public. Vijay uncovers disturbing truths, making the coach confess the truth.

episodesList.title: The New Hire
episodesList.summary: Vijay admits he is staying back for Radhi, triggering her fury. Arjun suspends Amaya but faces backlash for his leniency. While Vijay praises Reena, Kiran shows interest in Nilofer.

episodesList.title: Preetham's Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Preetham secretly rallies support to become the hospital CEO. At the temple, Thyagarajan and Ganesh confront Reena and Arjun. Kamal’s attempt to help Amaya meets resistance.

episodesList.title: Checkmate
episodesList.summary: Vijay’s presence unsettles Thyagarajan. Arjun’s counselling with Manasa sparks doubts. Preetham’s bid for the CEO post crumbles as Arjun fires him with unanimous support.

episodesList.title: Radhi's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Charu gets furious with Rocky. While Teju grows suspicious of Manasa, Arjun contemplates stepping down from the CEO's post. Radhi shares her doubts about Vijay with Thyagarajan.

episodesList.title: Upma Memories
episodesList.summary: Vijay tries to recreate the past by making Upma for Radhi. While Thyagarajan warns Reena against Vijay, Manasa asks Arjun to stay away from her. Arjun makes a request to Radhi.

episodesList.title: Unfinished Business
episodesList.summary: Reena gets upset about Anitha. Arjun comes to Kiran’s rescue when goons trouble him. A critical emergency case has Vijay and Radhi clashing over treatment.

episodesList.title: Reena vs Vijay
episodesList.summary: Manasa confesses her love for Arjun. Dev rejects Thyagarajan’s plea to reconcile with Radhi. Reena blames Vijay for a patient’s death. Later, she learns Arjun is drinking on duty.

episodesList.title: Shocking Revelation
episodesList.summary: Vijay tricks Radhi into accepting the chief doctor’s role. While Reena grows doubtful of Vijay’s link with Thyagarajan, Radhi is shocked to learn from Vijay about their baby.

episodesList.title: Lie from the Past
episodesList.summary: Radhi confronts Thyagarajan for lying to Vijay that their baby had died. Tension rises as Reena walks in when Vijay questions Radhi about having moved on in life so easily.

episodesList.title: Need for Closure!
episodesList.summary: Reena tries to make amends with Arjun, only to face rejection. Teju tells Naveen she cannot commit to a relationship. Meanwhile, Vijay decides to stay on until he finds a closure.

episodesList.title: Shadows of the Past
episodesList.summary: Vijay treats a pregnant girl abandoned by her lover, stirring painful parallels for Reena when Teju asks her about Radhi. Arjun grapples with conflicting advice from Manasa and Anitha.

episodesList.title: Badminton Therapy
episodesList.summary: When the grieving parents plead to save their daughter, Vijay asks Radhi if she too went through the same phase. Anitha takes Arjun to play badminton where they meet Vijay.

episodesList.title: Divorce Notice
episodesList.summary: Radhi is shaken as Dev sends another divorce notice. Thyagarajan asks Reena to help reconcile them. Arjun apologises to Manasa for Anitha’s behaviour. Reena refuses Vijay’s offer.

episodesList.title: Seniors vs Juniors
episodesList.summary: Reena manifests a situation where Radhi is forced to let her stay with her. Despite Reena’s objections, Vijay insists that junior interns assist in the appendicitis surgery of an IG.

episodesList.title: A Surgical Slip
episodesList.summary: Reena moves into Radhi’s house. During surgery, Nilofer falters and Vijay asks her to be calm. Later, Vijay finds the IG’s vitals starting to drop. Rocky probes Radhi about her past.

episodesList.title: Scans Don't Lie
episodesList.summary: Reena finds Dev’s diary. As Vijay and the team investigate the complications in the IG’s case, scans reveal a surgical mishap as the cause, leading to Reena clashing with Vijay.

episodesList.title: Power of Sorry
episodesList.summary: The IG’s wife blames Radhi for negligence. Vijay supports Nilofer and earns the IG’s pardon. Vijay tells Radhi she had taught him the power of an apology. Reena seeks Vijay’s help.

episodesList.title: Radhi-Dev Love Story
episodesList.summary: Vijay listens as Dev recounts his love story while Reena and Rocky eavesdrop. Teju and Reena grow suspicious of a pregnant patient’s husband. Arjun and Anitha bond over badminton.

episodesList.title: The Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Radhi brushes aside Teju and Reena’s doubts about Sakshi’s husband. With Thyagarajan and kids’ help, Reena decides to reunite Radhi and Dev. Kiran is elated with Nilofer’s sweet hint.

episodesList.title: Radhi-Dev Reunion
episodesList.summary: Dev and Radhi decide to give their marriage another chance after Reena and Rocky stage a fake accident. While Teju exposes Sakshi’s abusive husband, Manasa proposes to Arjun.

episodesList.title: Crossroads of Truth
episodesList.summary: Arjun informs Manasa that he loves Reena. Radhi debates revealing the truth to Dev and Vijay. Reena thanks Vijay, hinting at uncovering the past. Anitha departs for the US.

episodesList.title: Heart on the Line
episodesList.summary: Vijay comforts Kritika, whose father is declared brain-dead. Reena sees a chance of transplant to save Saradha, who is detected with heart problem, but Vijay insists on protocol.

episodesList.title: Lines That Can’t Be Crossed
episodesList.summary: Radhi insists on protocol and consent when Reena suggests transplanting Kritika’s father’s heart for Saradha. Reena pleads but Kritika refuses to donate the heart.

episodesList.title: When Time Runs Out
episodesList.summary: Kritika agrees to donate, but Ganesh and Reena are shattered as Saradha dies. Teju and Naveen confront their trust issues. Vijay admits to Arjun that Radhi is his ex from school.

episodesList.title: Threads of Truth
episodesList.summary: A grieving Reena returns to work. Abi and Kamal’s bond sparks Amaya’s jealousy. While Vijay arranges for Kritika’s care, Arjun urges Radhi to tell Reena the truth about her father.

episodesList.title: Fault Lines
episodesList.summary: At the party, Vijay and Radhi confront unresolved emotions. A jealous Manasa spikes Reena’s drink. Guna opposes a disoriented Reena for treating a patient in that state.

episodesList.title: Breaking Point
episodesList.summary: After Reena’s misdiagnosis goes viral, Radhi suspends her. Naveen learns that Manasa spiked Reena's drink. Reena breaks down. Later, Vijay and Arjun defend her in a tense meeting.

episodesList.title: Reckonings
episodesList.summary: Reena confronts Radhi about her suspension. Arjun fires Manasa after Naveen reveals her misdeeds. He admits that she is his sister and that he leaked hospital data for his family.

episodesList.title: Enough is Enough
episodesList.summary: After the patient crisis, Radhi makes tough decisions about Naveen and Reena. During Reena's heated argument with Radhi, Vijay notices the identical mannerisms the two women have.

episodesList.title: A Card Battle of Wills
episodesList.summary: Vijay suspects his child may be alive. The interns struggle when the seniors take a step back. Reena refuses to return to work and clashes with Radhi in a card game.

episodesList.title: So Close Yet So Far
episodesList.summary: While Teju and Naveen's relationship deepens, Nilofer and Kiran's develops a crack. Radhi explains her fears to Thyagarajan, but Vijay arrives at Radhi's house for answers.

episodesList.title: Fledgling Bonds
episodesList.summary: Arjun meets his staff and sees financial trouble for the hospital on the horizon. Meanwhile, Vijay and Reena team up for a high-profile surgery despite Radhi's concerns.

episodesList.title: Signature Upma
episodesList.summary: After a comical accident caused by Reena’s driving, Vijay bonds with her over his signature Upma. Their bond makes Radhi insecure. Arjun faces financial pressure at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Live-in Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Nilofer shocks Kiran with a live-in proposal as a compromise. Reena reveals her past in an orphanage to Vijay, deepening their bond. Radhi’s envy intensifies.

episodesList.title: Living Lies, Loving Truths
episodesList.summary: Kamal and Amaya finally unite. Radhi’s prawn Biryani loses to Vijay’s gravy. While Nilofer’s father warily agrees to her shift to Kiran’s house, his family poses new challenges.

episodesList.title: Truths, Tempers and Turning Points
episodesList.summary: Arjun quits his post as the CEO while Nilofer confronts Kiran’s father and gets a shock. Pallavi’s parents take a harsh step. As Radhi tries to reveal Vijay’s truth, Dev returns.

episodesList.title: The Missing Note
episodesList.summary: Dev reconciles with Radhi. Arjun finalises a franchise deal and steps down to protect Radhi’s role. Vijay clashes with Pallavi’s parents for her surgery, but she goes missing.

episodesList.title: Echoes of a Missing Voice
episodesList.summary: Vijay defends his team when Pallavi’s disappearance triggers panic and blame. Dev and Vijay surprise Radhi, stirring emotional tension. Tension rises as Manasa is the new CEO.

episodesList.title: Back to Class
episodesList.summary: Reena joins Arjun as he revisits his college to escape work stress. Jealousy sparks when they meet Vikruthi, Arjun’s college friend. Later, Arjun confesses his feelings to Reena.

episodesList.title: Truth on the Table
episodesList.summary: At Radhi’s anniversary party, Dev accepts Reena as family. Seeing Radhi's joy, Vijay opts to leave. While Arjun and Reena get romantic, Dev confronts Radhi about Reena’s parentage.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Diagnosis
episodesList.summary: A mass food poisoning emergency floods RK Hospital, prompting swift medical action. Vijay’s decision to leave upsets Reena and Radhi. Nilofer treats Raghuvaran, raising doubts.

episodesList.title: Under Arrest
episodesList.summary: Vijay is named a suspect by cops in an organ trafficking case linked to his past NGO work. His arrest shocks Radhi, Reena, and the staff.  Vijay is barred from practicing medicine.

episodesList.title: The Interrupted Confession
episodesList.summary: Radhi tries to reveal Reena’s parentage and Vijay’s past connection while Reena tells Arjun she prefers not to know about her dad. Nilofer slams Rocky for ruining her relationship.

episodesList.title: The Revelation
episodesList.summary: Reena announces her engagement to Arjun. Vijay slaps the NGO suspect and agrees to help the police to clear his name. Reena is stunned as Radhi reveals a shocking truth to her.

episodesList.title: On the Edge
episodesList.summary: Reena is rushed to the ER after a terrible accident. As the team fights to stabilise her amid severe injuries, Rocky explodes with guilt and lashes out at Radhi and Arjun.

episodesList.title: Echoes of a Promise
episodesList.summary: Reena's condition worsens, but Teju stays by her side. Radhi breaks down with guilt for hiding the truth. Vijay seeks help from Raj to save Reena.

episodesList.title: The Failed Surgery
episodesList.summary: Reena swings between life and death when her heart stops mid-surgery. The team then plans a risky procedure, and Radhi suggests that their best neurosurgeon should lead it.

episodesList.title: My Daughter
episodesList.summary: Arjun struggles to keep the hospital afloat and tries to convince Vijay to perform the life-saving surgery on Reena. Will he agree?

episodesList.title: Vijay Reflects on His Past
episodesList.summary: When young Vijay is shaken with the news of his child, his mom encourages him to live and fulfill Radhi’s dream of saving lives. In the present, Vijay prepares for Reena’s surgery.

episodesList.title: No Permission to Operate!
episodesList.summary: A guilty Radhi hesitates to go to the hospital. Sonia and Ganesh get emotional thinking of Reena. Set on saving Reena, Vijay fights for the right to operate her amidst objections.

episodesList.title: Against All Protocol!
episodesList.summary: While Reena’s condition worsens, Vijay faces rejection from police. Arjun pleads with Reena to return. Vijay decides to perform the surgery and face the outcome later.

episodesList.title: Finally, Father-Daughter Unite!
episodesList.summary: Vijay leads critical surgery with interns. Reena recovers and her joy knows no bounds as she shares a long-awaited, emotional union with her father. But will their joy last long?

episodesList.title: Home No More
episodesList.summary: A year after life-changing events, Ravi returns to RK Hospitals only to find everything has changed. Everyone has moved on, but the old bonds are still put to the test.

episodesList.title: Starting Over
episodesList.summary: An unexpected visitor lands at Vijay and Reena's home in Bangalore, causing stress. Back home, a medical emergency triggers conflict between the management and senior doctors.

episodesList.title: No Room for Fear
episodesList.summary: As Dr. Aradhana takes on a chaotic case, her past reveals her fearless spirit. The arrival of new doctors creates fresh dynamics. Reena worries about her abilities.

episodesList.title: Old Scars
episodesList.summary: A sudden health crisis leaves Reena confronting an emotional trauma. Arjun and Reena struggle to move on as old memories and unresolved emotions cast a shadow over their lives.

episodesList.title: Unexpected Connections
episodesList.summary: As Vijay settles into a new routine, an unexpected neighbour begins to change the atmosphere at home. A critical case at RK Hospital pushes the doctors towards a difficult option.

episodesList.title: A Difficult Choice
episodesList.summary: The RK Hospital doctors are forced to confront an impossible decision that tests their values. Elsewhere, Reena fights to prove herself as pressure mounts around an important case.

episodesList.title: Standing Together
episodesList.summary: The aftermath of a risky decision brings unexpected results for RK Hospital doctors. In Bangalore, Reena takes on a challenge, while personal relationships move in new directions.

episodesList.title: New Possibilities
episodesList.summary: An evening out brings unexpected conversations and emotional moments. Meanwhile, unresolved feelings leave several lives standing at an important crossroads.

episodesList.title: Silent Suspicions
episodesList.summary: Reena struggles to move past disturbing memories of the people she left behind. At RK Hospital, growing concerns over unexplained medical cases demand urgent attention.

episodesList.title: Growing Bonds
episodesList.summary: Divi lashes out over the stolen money, revealing her pent-up emotions. Reena suspects a young patient's injuries have a deeper cause, while Aradhana faces haunting flashbacks.

episodesList.title: Hidden Wounds
episodesList.summary: Reena puts on an act to expose the man who misbehaved with Krithika. Meanwhile, something Reena says leaves her father upset, while she agrees to invite Kathir home for dinner.

episodesList.title: False Trails
episodesList.summary: The banned drug investigation at RK Hospital raises new questions. While Reena's growing relationship with Kathir offers new hope, hidden truths remain concealed.

episodesList.title: Unspoken Doubts
episodesList.summary: Reena gets restless after an unexpected call from Arjun. At RK Hospital, the doctors search for answers over suspicious drug procurement. Meanwhile. Arjun and Madhu get closer.

episodesList.title: Unfinished Feelings
episodesList.summary: Reena struggles to deal with memories of Arjun and the past. At RK Hospital, the doctors face a difficult choice. Divi quietly makes a decision that could change everything.

episodesList.title: Vanishing Lines
episodesList.summary: At RK Hospital, search for the person behind the suspicious medicine continues. Sindhu and Rocky’s relationship faces a setback. Divi’s disappearance leaves her family in shock.

episodesList.title: A Sudden Shock
episodesList.summary: Divi’s absence brings her family together. Radhi is set to face the challenges ahead. Rocky and Sindhu visit Reena. Fresh doubts at RK Hospital point toward an unexpected lead.

episodesList.title: Buried Questions
episodesList.summary: Sid's recovery brings relief to Radhi and her family, while Amala's doubts about Kanniyappan's past deepen. Meanwhile, Arjun is forced to face old relationships and choices.

episodesList.title: Breaking Point
episodesList.summary: As the hospital battles financial strain, Radhi steps in to guide Manasa. Reena helps Kiran seek employment while Madhu's troubles push Arjun to act.

episodesList.title: Dangerous Choices
episodesList.summary: Arjun's medical future is at risk after a final warning, while RK Hospital tackles a high-risk triplet pregnancy. Meanwhile, an unexpected moment brings Arjun and Madhu closer.

episodesList.title: Hidden Truths
episodesList.summary: Arjun struggles with his feelings for Madhu, while Amala learns the truth about Kanniyappan. Reena's health sparks new questions as buried secrets from her past resurface.

episodesList.title: Unspoken Questions
episodesList.summary: Reena faces health concerns as Vijay grows increasingly worried. At the same time, Anu questions Vijay's decisions, forcing him to confront the choices he made.

episodesList.title: A Familiar Shadow
episodesList.summary: Radhi grows uneasy when an unexpected encounter raises questions. Aradhana gets a visitor from her past, leaving her to face emotions she has long kept buried.

episodesList.title: Old Ties
episodesList.summary: While Aradhana struggles to deal with her father's unexpected presence, Reena begins questioning the truth behind the organ that changed her life.

episodesList.title: Crossing Lines
episodesList.summary: Aradhana's father's threat forces her into a corner. Just as Madhu and Arjun find themselves drawing closer, Reena sends him a text.

wikiTitle: Har Bahu Ki Yahi Kahani Sasumaa Ne Meri Kadar Na Jaani
summary: Har Bahu Ki Yahi Kahani Sasumaa Ne Meri Kadar Na Jaani (transl. Every Daughter–In–Law Has The Same Story Mother–In–Law Did Not Understand My Importance) also Known  as Sasumaa Ne Meri Kadar Na Jaani  is an Indian drama television series produced by Triangle Film Company and premiered on 23 October 2023 on Dangal. It stars Akshit Sukhija and Anushka Merchande.
plot: Pallavi longs to read more, but her parents forbid it until after marriage. She hopes her future in-laws will be more modern and allow her to pursue her passions. Meanwhile, Babli Devi hopes for a daughter-in-law who will serve her like a maid. Only time will tell whose dreams will come true.

articleSections.text: The series was initially titled as Sasuji Tune Meri Kadar Na Jaani. But Later it was a changed to Har Bahu Ki Yahi Kahani Sasumaa Ne Meri Kadar Na Jaani. The Show Replaced Sindoor Ki Keemat 2.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Akshit Sukhija and Anushka Merchande were signed as the lead.The first promo was released in October 2023 featuring Sucheta Khanna and Anushka Merchande. It was replaced by the television series Deewani on March 19, 2024. The remaining episodes of this serial were aired at the 11:30 PM time slot.

title: Half CA
summary: Half CA is an Indian Hindi-language Inspirational fiction and drama television series produced by The Viral Fever (TVF). The series features Ahsaas Channa, Gyanendra Tripathi, Anmol Kajani, Prit Kamani, Rohan Joshi and Aishwarya Ojha. Its first season premiered on Amazon Mini TV on 25 July 2023. A second season premiered on both Amazon Mini TV and MX Player on 27 August 2025.
plot: The series revolves around the challenges and experiences faced by Chartered Accountancy students in India. It mainly focuses on the lives of Neeraj and Archie and the challenges faced by them as CA students. The new phase of life that Archie and her best friend Vishal face in their B.com and CA journeys and Neeraj who has a pressure of family and constantly failing but the inspiration to never give up with his friend Archie.
reception: Sunidhi Prajapat of OTT Play rated the series 3/5 stars. Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated the series 3.5/5 stars.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The series was announced by The Viral Fever (TVF) for Amazon Mini TV. Ahsaas Channa, Gyanendra Tripathi, Anmol Kajani, Prit Kamani and Rohan Joshi were signed as the lead. Ahsaas Channa collaborated with ClearTax to promote awareness about Income Tax Return (ITR) filing.
Its second season was announced on 1 July 2024 and premiered on 27 August 2025.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Sunidhi Prajapat of OTT Play rated the series 3/5 stars. Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated the series 3.5/5 stars.

title: Hostel Days
summary: Hostel Days is a 2023 Indian Telugu adaptation of the popular Indian Hindi-language comedy drama television miniseries Hostel Daze. The series is directed by Aditya Mandala and produced by Arubabh Kumar. It features an ensemble cast including Darahas Maturu, Akshay Lagusani, Mouli Tanuj Prasanth, Anannyaa Akulaa, Aishwarya Hollakal, and Jaiyetri Makana. The series, written by Akshay Poolla, The first trailer was released on 7 July 2023 and series premiered on Amazon Prime Video on July 13, 2023.

title: Hum Rahein Na Rahein Hum
summary: Hum Rahe Na Rahe Hum is an Indian romantic drama television series that aired from 10 April to 22 September 2023 on Sony TV and streamed on SonyLIV. Produced by Swastik Productions, it is an adaptation of the popular Turkish series İstanbullu Gelin. It stars Tina Datta and Jay Bhanushali.
plot: Surili Ahuja Banerjee is a jovial, care-free, and modern girl from Colaba, Mumbai. She owns and runs the Gramophone cafe ever since her parents died. Shivendra Barot is the eldest prince of Ranakgadh. Mature, dedicated, and responsible, he is tied to the traditions that his mother, Damayanti Barot aka the queen asks all her sons to follow.
reception: Sukarna Mondal of The Times of India praised the series for its fresh pairing and interesting storyline.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Tina Datta as Surili Ahuja Banerjee: Owner of Gramophone Cafe; Surjot and Lalit's daughter; Shiv's wife; Mohit's step-mother * Jay Bhanushali as Shivendra "Shiv" Barot: Owner of Barot Industries; Prince of Ranakgad; Damayanti and Chandrabhan's son; Raghav, Maan and Sam's brother; Samar's half-brother; Surili's husband; Mohit's father

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Hum Rahe Na Rahe Hum is an adaptation of popular Turkish series İstanbullu Gelin, also known as Bride of Istanbul. Announced by Swastik Productions in March 2023, it was initially rumoured to be titled Mere Apne.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Tina Datta, Jay Bhanushali and Kitu Gidwani were cast as Surili Ahuja Banerjee, Shivendra Barot and Damayanti Barot. The show is Datta and Bhanushali's first collaboration in fiction. The two previously participated in the same season of the stunt reality series Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 7.
Datta said yes to the show because she related to the character of Surili who is a modern-day girl from Colaba. She revealed there are a lot of similarities between Surili and herself which made her connect to the character.
Bhanushali returned to a fiction television show after more than a decade. Similarly, Gidwani returned to a daily fiction show after about two decades. She signed Hum Rahe Na Rahe Hum because she found her role interesting, unique and strong to play. In May 2023, Karanvir Bohra was cast as Samar Ahluwalia Barot.
He said he loved the shades of the character which is why he said yes to it. In July 2023, Anita Hassanandani was cast as Roshni.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series is set in Mumbai and the fictional town of Ranakgadh. Filming began in March 2023 and the sets are based in Film City as well as Umargam, Gujarat.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The first promo of the series released on 10 March 2023 and the featured the protagonists. The second promo of Hum Rahe Na Rahe Hum released on 14 March. The promos were well received by the audience, and media.
Datta, Bhanushali and Gidwani appeared on the finale of Indian Idol 13 to promote the show.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Sukarna Mondal of The Times of India praised the series for its fresh pairing and interesting storyline.

plot: ACP Vikram Chauhan, a cop with a tragic past, is accused of an aged woman Leena Thomas's death, where he sets out to prove his innocence with the help of Divya.
reception:

Roktim Rajpal of India Today wrote "Hunter Tootega Nahi Todega features remixed versions of popular Bollywood chartbusters."

episodesList.title: Rang Barse
episodesList.summary: ACP Vikram hunts down missing people as his side job to support his gambling habit. He is asked to track down a certain Leena Thomas, and when she ends up dead, Vikram is the most obvious suspect!

episodesList.title: Pehle Shararat Kisne Ki
episodesList.summary: While on the run from his colleague and nemesis Hooda, Vikram tracks down a journalist Divya who was doing an expose on Leena Thomas. He threatens her to reveal everything she knows. When they get attacked by a sniper, Vikram chases the shooter and recognises him. Hooda informs David that Vikram killed his mother Leena. David orders Hooda to bring him Vikram alive!

episodesList.title: Mere Sapno Ki Rani
episodesList.summary: Vikram’s ex-wife Swati asks him to stay out of her life, as he is just a source of trouble and stress for her. Vikram is heartbroken to learn that she is seeing someone else. Sajid discovers that Leena Thomas had undergone an unlisted organ transplant surgery. Vikram and Divya track down Ankita, the woman who paid Vikram to hunt down Leena Thomas.

episodesList.title: Duniya Ne Humko Diya Kya
episodesList.summary: Enraged by her deception, Vikram tortures Ankita by waterboarding her. Hooda who is still hot on Vikram’s heels, arrives at the scene and captures Vikram. David removes one of Vikram’s kidneys and calls this punishment for killing his mother Leena. Divya manages to escape while Vikram is left for the dead.

episodesList.title: Duniya Se Humne Liya Kya
episodesList.summary: Vikram has a short window to reclaim his kidney from David while an assassin reaches his old house to kill Swati. Hackers Sid and Pallavi steal Leena Thomas’s murder video from the police station. The video leads to a startling discovery. A mysterious biker attacks Vikram.

episodesList.title: Awaara Hoon
episodesList.summary: David makes a revelation about Hooda and hints at an unknown person at the top. Divya informs Vikram that she has been captured by Hooda. Vikram reclaims his kidney and reaches the seedy looking place where he finds a dead body with a severed head. Hooda attacks Vikram who detects a gas leak on the premises.

episodesList.title: Ye Kahani Kahan Se Sunaoon
episodesList.summary: Vikram is alive but his troubles are far from over. The Commissioner charges him with the murder of Ankita. Vikram escapes again and meets Swati, it’s time to face some truths. Sid and Pallavi decide to help Vikram regardless of his repeated intrusions, and trace Divya's whereabouts. The trail takes Vikram to Ranchi.

episodesList.title: Marna Isi Ka Naam Hai
episodesList.summary: The mastermind of the organ trafficking racket is unveiled. Vikram and Divya join hands one last time and return to Mumbai. Pallavi finds a bid for a little girl’s organs on the dark web. Her rare blood group reveals a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Ek Khubsurat Pick Up
episodesList.summary: In Thailand, the Salesman kills Khun and abducts Pooja. In Mumbai, Vikram is forced by the Salesman to steal a package from a secure facility in exchange for his daughter.

episodesList.title: Salesman Ka Plan Kya Hai?
episodesList.summary: Vikram and Guide break into a trap-filled facility, escape CID pursuit, and flee with Aditya, a vegetative man revealed to be the Salesman's son. Vikram recalls a link to someone named Tomar.

episodesList.title: Welcome To Thailand
episodesList.summary: The Salesman forces a monk to reveal Red Wa's location, sacrifices his thumb to gain their support, and abducts Swati. Vikram escapes India with Aditya, leading to a tense face-off in Thailand.

episodesList.title: Hunter Ka Vacation Shuru
episodesList.summary: Vikram kidnaps Tomar for the Salesman, but betrays Red Wa. In a twist, Tomar is a decoy, and the real Tomar arrests the Salesman, who remains eerily unfazed.

episodesList.title: Jail Escape
episodesList.summary: Vikram must break the Salesman out of jail to save Pooja, but faces a brutal choice when both Pooja and Swati are in danger. With time running out, he races to stop the Salesman's final revenge.

episodesList.title: Pooja, Papa Is Coming For You
episodesList.summary: A jet showdown ends with Vikram saving Pooja mid-air.

title: Happy Family: Conditions Apply
summary:
Happy Family: Conditions Apply is a 2023 Indian Hindi language comedy family-based television series for Amazon Prime Video. The series is directed and produced by Jamnadas Majethia and Aatish Kapadia. It stars Ratna Pathak Shah, Raj Babbar, Atul Kulkarni and Ayesha Jhulka.
At the 2023 Filmfare OTT Awards, Happy Family: Conditions Apply received 4 nominations – Best Comedy Series, Best Actress in a Comedy Series (Pathak Shah), Best Actor in a Comedy Series (Kulkarni) and Best Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series (Das).
plot: Revolving around the lives of four generations of the Dholakias, Happy Family shows how most families are dysfunctional, and are a blend of traditional and modern values. The Dholakias are known for their high-spirited personalities and inimitable idiosyncrasies. These quirks land them in situations that are hilarious and quirky.
reception: The trailer was launched on 3 March 2023. During the first screening of the series just before the release of it on 9 March 2023, several actors including Pankaj Kapur, Supriya Pathak, Aanjjan Srivastav, Sarita Joshi, Hussain Kuwajerwala and others were present in the screening in Mumbai, who have praised the series as a leading family comedy series that everyone should watch. Archika Khurrana of Times of India gave it 4 stars out of 5 praising the direction, comedy and performance of the ensemble cast. she stated that this series did not a single dull moment. Nirmal Gayatri of Pinkvilla also gave 4 stars out of 5 praises the Ratna Pathak Shah and in her final conclusion she said "Happy Family: Conditions Apply" is the ideal remedy for your yearning spirit if you want to binge on a weekend show during the workweek. News18 gave the series 3.5 out of 5, and said it includes much comedy like Sarabhai vs Sarabhai and Khichdi, which were directed by Jamnadas Majethia and Aatish Kapadia. Happy Family puts an upper-middle-class Gujarati family's lives in focus, all while being relative. Tushar Joshi of India Today rated the series 3.5/5 and wrote "The biggest USP of the show is the writing and the direction. Keeping the scenes as real and relatable as possible, you get drawn into the lives of these characters. Their fights, worries, wins and defeats suddenly seem to be all yours."

articleSections.title: Main plot
articleSections.text:
Sanjuoy Dholakia is planning to move out with his wife Tisca and their son Aryan. He is anxious to break the news to his father Ramesh, worried how he would react. When Sanjouy is forced to reveal the truth in a game of Truth and Dare, Ramesh is overcome with sadness, and keeps trying to convince Sanjuoy not to move out. As Tisca tells Sanjouy's mother Pallavi that moving out was not her decision, Sanjuoy's grandmother, Hemlata accuses Tisca of wanting to remain in the family just to take advantage of Pallavi as a babysitter for Aryan. As Pallavi feels upset, Hemlata's husband Mansukhlal resolves the conflict, assuring Pallavi that Tisca values her.
Suresh, Hemlata and Mansuhklal's elder son, lives in the US. One day, he calls the family and reveals that he has married Kwamboka, a Kenyan-African woman, much to Hemlata's dismay. However, everybody else is excited to meet her.
Hemlata's gold jewellery, given to her by her mother-in-law, goes missing. Meanwhile, Napoleon, a famous designer, showcases a design that quite resembles one of Tisca's designs. Thus, Hemlata accuses Napoleon of stealing Tisca's design in a post on social media. Hemlata's jewellery thief is found to be their delivery man and her jewellery is recovered, only for her to find out that her mother-in-law had given her fake jewellery. On Tisca's insistence, the Dholakias choose not to press charges, since the thief has a promising future ahead of him.
Tisca freaks out when she sees Hemlata's post, confessing that she was the one who stole Napoleon's design, not the other way round. Tisca apologizes to Napoleon, but he admits that Tisca's version of his design was better than his original design. He thus offers her a job in Delhi. Sanjuoy and Hemlata are against this but the other family members support Tisca. Sanjuoy eventually comes around and admits that he felt jealous. He then supports Tisca in her temporary move to Delhi.
When Suresh and Kwamboka visit the Dholakias, Hemlata is surprised by Kwamboka's sweet nature and her values. Hemlata warmly welcomes her into the family and adores her to the extent that she ends up completely neglecting her elder daughter-in-law Pallavi. Pallavi feels insecure of Kwamboka, but when Hemlata and Kwamboka get into a fight, Pallavi supports and comforts Kwamboka, thus developing a good relationship with her.
Tisca tells Sanjuoy that she would soon be back to Mumbai, as Napoleon is shifting the company headquarters there. But instead of being happy, Sanjuoy gets worried and behaves secretively, leading Mansukhlal to suspect that something is wrong. Meanwhile, Sanjuoy's sister Ayushi tells Pallavi that she is in a casual Friends With Benefits relationship with her friend Timmy. Ayushi's encounter with a prospective groom goes horribly, as he turns out to be extremely sexist.
Tisca finds out that she is pregnant. She and Ayushi decide to surprise Sanjuoy but Ayushi catches him cheating on Tisca with Jacky, the ex-husband of his business partner Diana. Sanjuoy declares that it is not just an affair but that he loves Jacky, and convinces Ayushi to keep this a secret. Mansukhlal, who was suspecting Sanjuoy of having an affair with Diana, finds out the truth. He tells Sanjuoy to choose between Tisca and Jacky.
Pallavi has a sudden heart attack and she is rushed to the hospital. Dr Jatin, husband of Hemlata and Mansukhlal's daughter Falguni, assures the Dholakias that Pallavi will be fine but tells them that Pallavi must rest and reduce her responsibilities. The family steps in to fill Pallavi's responsibilities while she recovers, while Tisca finds out that she is having twins. Sanjuoy and Tisca tell Ramesh that they have chosen not to move out. But surprisingly, Ramesh tells them that Pallavi's heart attack taught him not to neglect himself and his own life, and that he would support Sanjuoy and Tisca whenever they wish to move out.
Sanjuoy asks Jacky to plan the party for Hemlata and Mansukhlal's anniversary. The Dholakias gather at a mall to celebrate, but the mall is hijacked by terrorists. The terrorists publicly make certain demands and threaten to kill the hostages one by one if their demands are not met within ten minutes. Everyone, certain that they are about to die, decide to play one last game of Spin the Bottle to reveal their secrets and unburden themselves before dying. Pallavi reveals that despite claiming to be a pure vegetarian, she secretly eats fish and sneaks it into Hemlata's food too; Mansukhlal and Hemlata reveal that Suresh was adopted and not their biological son; Jatin reveals that he has another wife with whom he also has a child; Falguni, in response, reveals that she had transferred all of Jatin's assets to her name; Ayushi tells Ramesh that she has been sleeping with Timmy; Sanjuoy reveals his affair with Jacky and tells Tisca that he loves him.
As their ten minutes run out, they brace themselves for death but find out that the police have arrived and that they are saved. With everyone's secrets now out in the open, everyone fights amongst themselves. The show concludes with Aryan wondering what will happen next.

title: Half Pants Full Pants
summary: Half Pants Full Pants is a Hindi comedy-drama show that made its debut on Amazon Prime on 16 December 2022. The show is based on Anand Suspi's memoir with the same title, and it was adapted and created by Mani Prasad. Suspi, Prasad, and Gaurav Mishra collaborated on the writing, while V. K. Prakash directed it. The show is produced by OML Studios and features Ashwanth Ashokkumar, Sonali Kulkarni, Ashish Vidyarthi and Kartik Vijan in the lead roles.
reception:
Archika Khurana in her review for The Times of India, describes "Given the abundance of fast-paced content offered by various OTT platforms, Half Pants Full Pants emerges as a calming and blissful trip down memory lane to your bachpan that is unquestionably worthwhile."
The series was given a rating of 2.5 stars out of 5 by Subham Kulkarni from Koimoi. In his review, he mentioned that "It sets out to be a heart-warming watch but losses its way in the middle. Could have been a show we rejoiced about, but ended up being a surface-level adaptation."

articleSections.title: Overview
articleSections.text: Half Pants Full Pants is a series that originated from Anand Suspi's autobiographical novel of the same name. The adaptation was done by Mani Prasad, with Suspi, Prasad, and Gaurav Mishra contributing to the writing. VK Prakash directed the series. The series plays out in Tweeland, also known as Malgudi, a small town in Karnataka before the age of the internet and mobile phones. The story revolves around the ambitious seven-year-old boy, Anand, also known as Dabba, who lives in this town. Along with his friend, Giddi, they embark on adventures that make audiences nostalgic for the good old days of mischief and innocence.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: The movie stars some actors including Ashish Vidyarthi who portrays the role of Dabba's father and Sonali Kulkarni as her mother. The character of Dabba is played by Ashwanth Ashokkumar.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Amazon's Prime Video announced the premiere of Half Pants Full Pants on 16 December 2022. The series trailer features a little boy named Anand, aka Dabba, who is different from other kids in his town and has many dreams and interests. Despite facing challenges, he sets out to achieve his dreams. Anand is fascinated by trains and journeys, and his father being a rail driver, gets to enjoy it to the fullest.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text:
Archika Khurana in her review for The Times of India, describes "Given the abundance of fast-paced content offered by various OTT platforms, Half Pants Full Pants emerges as a calming and blissful trip down memory lane to your bachpan that is unquestionably worthwhile."
The series was given a rating of 2.5 stars out of 5 by Subham Kulkarni from Koimoi. In his review, he mentioned that "It sets out to be a heart-warming watch but losses its way in the middle. Could have been a show we rejoiced about, but ended up being a surface-level adaptation."

articleSections.title: Awards & Recognition
articleSections.text: Half Pants Full Pants has been shortlisted in two categories at the 2023 Filmfare OTT Awards. Additionally, at the Indian Television Academy Awards, it has made the Jury's Top 5 in seven categories: * Best Series - Comedy (OTT) * Best Director - Comedy (OTT) * Best Actor - Comedy (OTT) * Best Actress - Comedy (OTT) * Best Story (OTT) * Best DoP (OTT) * Best Art Director (OTT)

episodesList.title: Magnet King
episodesList.summary: Dabba is approached by a pair of boys from the nearby convent school to convert their 10-paise coins into magnets. He sees this as an opportunity to become the Magnet King of their small town and begins to dream of the possibilities.

episodesList.title: B D Special
episodesList.summary: At the station, a buzz spreads about the arrival of a new train, the B D Special. Rumors suggest that the train is packed with imported chocolates, causing excitement among the crowd. Dabba, eager to grab his portion, becomes entangled in a plot to steal from the train.

episodesList.title: Best Of Md. Rafi
episodesList.summary: Dabba's father decides to transfer him from the railway school to the convent school. As a result, he meets new acquaintances. Wanting to make amends for his past misbehavior, Dabba does everything he can to save money and purchase a Md. Rafi cassette for his mother's birthday.

episodesList.title: Oh God!
episodesList.summary: Dabba gazes into the toilet and spots some blood. He firmly believes that he is being punished by God for consuming non-vegetarian food and taking money from the temple. Dabba puts all his efforts into pleading for forgiveness from God.

episodesList.title: Dabba Lee
episodesList.summary: After viewing the film Enter The Dragon, Dabba becomes fixated on Bruce Lee and implores his father to allow him to study karate. However, Subbarao declines, prompting Dabba to take matters into his own hands.

episodesList.title: Mystery Five
episodesList.summary: There has been a surge of burglaries in the locality. Subbarao's bicycle and Ashwini's pet dog Timmy have been stolen. In response, Dabba and his companions establish a private investigation firm to track down the group of thieves.

episodesList.title: Detective Drummer
episodesList.summary: Dabba develops an intense passion for drumming and decides to run away from home to join the Sampath Orchestra. Despite his loved ones' frantic search for him, he eventually uncovers the harsh reality behind the troupe. Dabba finds himself stuck with a group of thieves and experiences immense fear for his safety.

episodesList.title: Mr. Prime Minister
episodesList.summary: Dabba feels ashamed when he discovers that his name has been published in the newspaper for being lost. He resolves to do something remarkable to regain his honor. He composes a letter to the Prime Minister. Simultaneously, Subbarao has a chance encounter with a renowned movie director and recognizes that they were childhood pals.

The series stars Juhi Chawla, Ayesha Jhulka, Karishma Tanna, Kritika Kamra, Shahana Goswami and Soha Ali Khan in the lead. reception: ThePrints Tina Das rated the series three out of five stars, writing that Hush Hush "loses steam" after the first four episodes.

articleSections.title: Development

The principal photography of the film started in mid-September 2021. Filming took place in New Delhi, Gurgaon, and Mumbai, before wrapping up in April 2022.

title: Horogouri Pice Hotel
summary: Horogouri Pice Hotel is an Indian Bengali drama television series which premiered on 12 September 2022 on Star Jalsha and also digitally available on Disney+ Hotstar.The show went off air on 26 January 2025 It stars Suvosmita Mukherjee, Rahul Mazumdar and Arnab Banarjee as the leads and Arunava Dey Rahul Banerjee and Surabhi Mallick as main antagonists.
plot:
The plot of the story revolves around a daughter of a rich family, Oishani and a highly educated girl adjusting in a middle-class family after her marriage. She and her husband Shankar then work in their successful hotel where they also face various challenges, mainly caused by the family's widowed daughter-in-law, Mitali.
After overcoming several trials and tribulations, including a misled separation of Oishani and Shankar, well planned by Mitali; the two reunite and expose the latter to the family, throwing her out of the house.
Oishani is pregnant living happily with her family, all set for her due-dates. Soon, she gives birth to a girl child, much neglected by the members of her family, who believe in the virtue of a boy-child creating more stature within society. Soon, all is well and Oishani decides to start focusing on a dream she's always strived to fulfil.
Oishani now undergoes immense training and has emerged as an IPS officer, protecting status of the nation and her family, alongside nurturing her daughter.
Later entire Ghosh family dies in a car accident caused by a business rival.
Dhriti, sole survivor of the accident is now grown up after she was rescued by a man and renamed Gouri.
