episodesList.title: Paakhi Deletes All Her Pictures From Naksh’s Computer
episodesList.summary: The focus is on family tension as Baa strictly reprimands Naksh, causing him to go without food in his room. Meanwhile, Pakhi attempts to navigate her new, complicated life as a tenant in his house, while the central conflict highlights Baa's strictness vs. maternal affection.

episodesList.title: Naksh Threatens to Show Paakhi and Natasha’s Photos to Baa
episodesList.summary: Natasha praises Paakhi for her incredible talent, noting how her voice sounded completely real over the phone.

episodesList.title: Natasha Threatens to Stab Paakhi With a Knife
episodesList.summary: The focus intensifies on Paakhi’s hidden career and the growing suspicion surrounding it. Paakhi continues to work as a dubbing artist for Natasha while trying to keep her secret safe from the Baa and the family. Naksh starts to suspect there is more to Paakhi than what she presents.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Saves Natasha From the Women Commission Members
episodesList.summary: Paakhi continues to balance her secret job as a voice artist for Natasha with her new life as a tenant in Naksh’s house.

episodesList.title: Natasha Physically Assaults Tiara
episodesList.summary: The plot focuses on the aftermath of a voice audition where the main character, Pakhi, impresses Natasha and Akash with her voice, despite their initial harsh treatment.

episodesList.title: Akash Finds Out That Paakhi Had Dubbed for Natasha
episodesList.summary: Akash learns that Paakhi is the girl who had dubbed for Natasha. Later, Naksh meets up with Paakhi and expresses his gratitude to her for sending his pictures to the newspaper company.

episodesList.title: Akash Threatens to Fire Paakhi From Her Job
episodesList.summary: Akash confronts Paakhi and asks her why she kept her identity hidden from him and Natasha. He later threatens to fire her if she does not agree to dub for Natasha.

episodesList.title: Jaanki Is Arrested for Stealing a Necklace
episodesList.summary: With Paakhi out of the house, Naksh realises that he has judged her wrongly and feels strange without her around. Meanwhile, Paakhi and her mother finds themselves in trouble.

episodesList.title: Natasha Had Bribed Two Women to Set Up Jaanki
episodesList.summary: Naksh comes over to the police station and requests the inspector to let Jaanki go. Meanwhile, Natasha reveals to Akash that it was she who framed Jaanki for robbery.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Pretends in Front of the Police Officer That Jaanki Is Unwell
episodesList.summary: The police come over in the morning to Naksh's house to arrest Jaanki. Later, Natasha forces Paakhi to watch the former's seductive video and asks her to dub for it.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Learns About Natasha’s Involvement in Jaanki’s Arrest
episodesList.summary: Naksh tricks two sex workers into revealing that Natasha had bribed them to frame Jaanki for robbery. However, Moushmi records a video of him with the girls and gets excited to show it to Baa.

episodesList.title: Baa Ousts Naksh From Her House
episodesList.summary: After watching the video of Naksh speaking to two sex workers, Baa throws his luggage at him and asks him to leave the house immediately. However, Paakhi steps in and covers for him.

episodesList.title: Baa Allows Paakhi and Jaanki to Stay in Her House for the Night
episodesList.summary: Due to Baa's solid moral compass, Jaanki and Paakhi are allowed to stay in the house for the night. However, she orders them to leave first thing the next morning.

episodesList.title: Baa Gets Angry at Paakhi for Preparing Chinese Food for Bhai Ji
episodesList.summary: Moushmi pretends to have sprained her ankle to distract the family members while her husband implements a vicious plan in the kitchen. Later, Baa reprimands Paakhi for leaving the stove on and causing a gas leak.

episodesList.title: Bhai Ji Agrees to Eat the Food Prepared by Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Bhaiji and his disciples partake of the meal Paakhi prepared and express their content, leaving Baa relieved. Later, Baa scolds Paakhi for intervening in her business matters.

episodesList.title: Naksh’s Desire to Participate in a Photography Competition
episodesList.summary: Paakhi lies to her mother and tells her that the greeting card was sent to her by Naksh. Later, Naksh tells Paakhi about a photography competition that he wants to take part in but needs a huge sum of money to register for.

episodesList.title: Baa Orders Naksh to Work Under Paakhi From the Next Day Onwards
episodesList.summary: Akash presents the contract to Paakhi. Enraged, she burns the contract and orders Natasha and Akash to stop meddling in her affairs.

episodesList.title: Moushmi Leaks a Video of Naksh in the Media
episodesList.summary: Paakhi reluctantly throws a bucket of cold water over Naksh on Baa's instructions, leaving him furious. Later, when Paakhi answers Natasha's video call, she sees the latter trying to hang herself.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Defends Naksh in Front of Baa
episodesList.summary: When the reputation of Baa's catering business is threatened because of Naksh, she furiously scolds him. Enraged, Naksh accuses Paakhi of showing Baa the video on purpose to turn her against him.

episodesList.title: Baa Gets Angry at Paakhi for Not Doing Her Job Properly
episodesList.summary: Pinky fools Jaanki and takes her to his house, after which Natasha begins to blackmail Paakhi to do her bidding. Later, when Paakhi hands the account papers to Moushmi, the latter decides to use it to cause trouble.

episodesList.title: Naksh Is Unable to Participate in the Photography Competition
episodesList.summary: Jaanki and Paakhi are left utterly shocked after learning about the money they owe Baa. Later, Baa refuses to give Naksh an off, leaving him disappointed and furious at Paakhi.

episodesList.title: Natasha Attempts to Defame Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Paakhi tries her best to hide from Baa the fact that Ishaan, disguised as Naksh, is working with the former. Later, she finds herself in deep trouble when an unknown man comes below the mansion and yells out her name.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Plots Against Natasha
episodesList.summary: Paakhi finds out from Naksh that she has made it into the photography competition. Later, in an attempt to teach Natasha a lesson she'll never forget, Paakhi conspires against her.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Requests for Some Time to Prove Her Innocence
episodesList.summary: When Baa asks Paakhi and Jaanki to leave her house, a reluctant Paakhi vows to prove that she is innocent. Meanwhile, Nayan tries to attack Naksh.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Learns About Natasha's Plot Against Her
episodesList.summary: Paakhi finds out from Nayan that he was creating trouble for her under Natasha's orders. Later, Paakhi stops Nayan's infuriated wife from attacking Natasha.

episodesList.title: Moushmi Steals Baa’s Valuables
episodesList.summary: Paakhi manages to prevent Baa from finding out about her picture in the newspaper. Meanwhile, Moushmi steals Baa's valuable items.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Accuses Moushmi and Rimjhim
episodesList.summary: Paakhi tries to find the culprit who stole the valuables from Baa's room. Meanwhile, a furious Natasha threatens to file a case against Kapadia.

episodesList.title: Natasha Plots Against Naksh's Family
episodesList.summary: Natasha realises that it is difficult to sign Paakhi as her dubbing artist. She, therefore, resorts to dishonest means and, disguising herself as Baa, puts poison in the sweets meant for the kids at the orphanage.

episodesList.title: Naksh and Paakhi Save the Children
episodesList.summary: Paakhi finds out that Baa did not come to the orphanage and gets suspicious. Later, she gets a call from Akash, who tells her that the sweets have been poisoned.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Attacks Natasha
episodesList.summary: With her mother's help, Paakhi realises that Natasha was the one who had disguised herself as Baa and poisoned the sweets. Later, Natasha blackmails Paakhi into dubbing for her by threatening to release a morphed video of Baa.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Forced to Sign a Contract
episodesList.summary: Natasha mocks Paakhi when the latter goes down on her knees and begs her to delete Baa's video. Paakhi later signs a contract, according to which she will have to change her name to Silk.

episodesList.title: Mamta Slaps Naksh
episodesList.summary: After learning the truth about his father, Naksh gets ready to leave the house to follow his dreams. Later, his mother loses her temper and slaps him for disrespecting Baa.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Steals Naksh's Phone
episodesList.summary: Paakhi finds herself in a dilemma after the recent developments and reminisces about her father. Later, Baa reminds her of her responsibility to convince Naksh to take over the catering business.

episodesList.title: Can Paakhi Convince Naksh?
episodesList.summary: The praises Paakhi receives after the shoot, makes her uncomfortable. Later, Baa is left shocked after she enters Naksh's room and sees his collection of photographs.

episodesList.title: Silk's Voice Mesmerises Naksh
episodesList.summary: Paakhi gets Naksh to work in the kitchen by speaking to him over the phone in Silk's voice. Later, Baa borrows her phone, leaving Paakhi in a fix as Natasha might call her up on that phone.

episodesList.title: Naksh's Life in Danger
episodesList.summary: Don Mani arrives at the set with his goons and disrupts Natasha's shoot, demanding money from Kapadia. Amid the chaos, Naksh arrives there to deliver tiffin boxes.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Saves Naksh
episodesList.summary: Natasha, Paakhi and Akash work together to rescue all the hostages held by Mani's men. In the meantime, the bomb squad arrives to diffuse the bomb on Naksh's body.

episodesList.title: Natasha Plots Against Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Akash calls up Paakhi and expresses his heartfelt gratitude for saving Natasha's life. Later, Paakhi finds herself in a fix as Baa sends Ketan along with the former to deliver the tiffin boxes.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Arrives Home Drunk
episodesList.summary: When Paakhi does not return home on time, Moushmi uses this to her advantage and instigates Baa. Meanwhile, Paakhi realises that she reeks of alcohol and grows apprehensive as she cannot enter Baa's house in an intoxicated state.

episodesList.title: Silk's Suggestion to Naksh
episodesList.summary: Naksh listens attentively as Paakhi teaches him how to make round rotis. Later, when she arrives at the set, the workers make inappropriate comments about her behaviour at the party the previous night.

episodesList.title: Ajit Tries to Molest Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Baa becomes happy when Naksh declares that he will take care of the delivery of the tiffin boxes. Later, Ajit calls Paakhi to his cabin and tries to molest her but Natasha comes to her rescue.

episodesList.title: Baa Happy With Paakhi's Work
episodesList.summary: Natasha calls up Paakhi and tells her that the money is a gift for all her hard work. Just then, Baa comes over to Paakhi's room and gives her a bundle of notes, stating that it is her salary for putting so much effort into the catering business.

episodesList.title: Moushmi Traps Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Chaos ensues on the set when the workers protest against Kapadia for not paying them their salaries. Later, on reaching the cafe where Silk asks him to meet her, Naksh is left shocked to see Rimjim, Moushmi's sister, there.

episodesList.title: Natasha Learns the Reason for the Strike
episodesList.summary: In order to find the fake video of Baa that Natasha possesses, Paakhi makes up an excuse and enters her house. Meanwhile, Naksh asks Rimjim to speak to him in the same voice she would use over the phone.

episodesList.title: Paakhi at Natasha's House
episodesList.summary: When Ketan takes away Naksh's phone, Moushmi intervenes and gives him his phone back. Later, when Paakhi sees Naksh talking to Rimjim, she feels guilty.

episodesList.title: Natasha Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: While speaking to Naksh as Rimjim, Paakhi ends up confessing her true feelings to him. Later, after stealing Natasha's locker, she tries to figure out the password to unlock it.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Learns About Rimjhim's Lies
episodesList.summary: Paakhi finds out that Moushmi and Rimjim have been lying to her all this while about the latter having cancer. Consequently, she decides to tell Naksh the truth.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Tells the Truth
episodesList.summary: Paakhi reveals to Naksh that she is, in fact, Silk. However, Naksh gets infuriated at this and asks her why she has been lying to him all this while.

episodesList.title: Naksh Professes His Love to Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Just as Paakhi and Jaanki are about to leave Baa's house for good, Naksh arrives and stops them. He then volunteers to quit photography and take care of Baa's catering business on the condition that Paakhi and Jaanki are allowed to stay in the house.

episodesList.title: Baa Fixes Naksh's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Naksh and Paakhi are left heartbroken when Baa fixes the former's marriage with Rimjim. Later, Naksh assures Paakhi that he will speak to Baa and convince her to accept their relationship.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Hides a Truth From Naksh
episodesList.summary: Paakhi tells Naksh that she does not want to be the reason his family breaks apart and assures him that she will figure out a way to win Baa's heart. Later, Paakhi decides to tell Naksh about her job as Natasha's dubbing artist.

episodesList.title: Naksh and Rimjhim to Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: The entire family gathers to select a ring for Naksh and Rimjim's engagement. Later, Baa gives Paakhi the responsibility of decorating the house for the engagement ceremony.

episodesList.title: Naksh Saves Rimjhim
episodesList.summary: On the day of Naksh and Rimjim's engagement, Naksh and Paakhi also plan to get engaged to each other in secrecy. Later, Natasha deliberately delays the shoot to torture Paakhi, who has to reach home before seven.

episodesList.title: Naksh and Paakhi Secretly Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Paakhi is left crestfallen after seeing Naksh and Rimjim getting engaged. However, Naksh informs her that he is not really engaged to her.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Brings a Prospective Match for Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Rimjim tells Moushami that she plans to get Naksh and Paakhi to expose themselves in the presence of the family. Later, Naksh is left shocked on hearing Paakhi's reply to her suitor's family.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Accepts Rimjhim's Challenge
episodesList.summary: The family is left astonished when Paakhi's potential groom turns down the proposal and storms out of the house. The next day, Baa and the family begin preparing for Rimjim and Naksh's sangeet ceremony.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Saves Baa
episodesList.summary: During Naksh's sangeet, Baa declares that she liked Rimjim's dance performance more than Paakhi's, leaving the latter disappointed. Later, Rimjim and Moushmi set the storeroom on fire, creating an uproar in the house.

episodesList.title: Baa Learns About Paakhi and Naksh's Relationship
episodesList.summary: A teary-eyed Baa embraces Paakhi and declares that she owes the latter her life. Later, while Naksh and Paakhi spend some romantic moments together, Baa walks into the room.

episodesList.title: Baa Accuses Paakhi of a Misdeed
episodesList.summary: While Naksh tries to stand up for Paakhi, Baa continues to say hurtful things about her. Later, Naksh declares that he will marry Paakhi at all costs.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Slaps a Man
episodesList.summary: Natasha taunts Paakhi, stating that she seduced Naksh because of his wealth. When Paakhi later returns home, Baa, too, ends up humiliating her.

episodesList.title: Baa Plots to Separate Naksh and Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Baa asks Rimjim to trust her and promises to get her married to Naksh under all circumstances. Later, during the haldi ceremony, Rimjim's family members arrive at the house and threaten Naksh.

episodesList.title: Baa Refuses to Accept Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Rimjim puts forth a tempting offer in front of Paakhi so that the latter abandons Naksh. However, Paakhi and Naksh take an oath to marry each other despite the hurdles Baa throws at them.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Trapped in Rimjhim's Plot
episodesList.summary: Even after Baa's repeated attempts to warn Naksh, he remains adamant on making Paakhi his wife. However, Rimjim implements her plan to stop their wedding.

episodesList.title: Will Naksh Agree to Rimjhim's Condition?
episodesList.summary: Paakhi finds out that Moushmi has slipped into a coma. Meanwhile, when Naksh asks Rimjim to withdraw her police complaint against Paakhi, she puts forth a startling condition.

episodesList.title: Can Paakhi Stop Naksh's Marriage?
episodesList.summary: While Paakhi is devastated in prison, Rimjim calls her up at police station and mocks her. Later, Moushmi regains consciousness and proves that Paakhi is innocent.

episodesList.title: Natasha Arrives at Paakhi and Naksh's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Baa and the other family members refuse to believe that Rimjim could harm her own sister Moushmi. Later, Jaanki takes matters into her hands and locks Rimjim in a room to prevent her from causing any more trouble for Naksh and Paakhi.

episodesList.title: Naksh Learns Paakhi's Secret
episodesList.summary: Natasha interrupts Paakhi and Naksh's wedding rituals and hands a letter to the latter advising him to read it immediately. Later, Naksh is left devastated on learning about Paakhi's connection to Natasha.

episodesList.title: Naksh Breaks His Relationship With Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Paakhi tries to explain to Naksh that she was blackmailed into being Silk, but he refuses to believe her. Later, Paakhi's uncle walks into the room to testify against her.

episodesList.title: Baa Slaps Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Naksh declares that he has decided to marry Rimjim instead of Paakhi, leaving Baa overjoyed. Meanwhile, Akash yells at Natasha for ruining Paakhi's marriage and states that he cannot support her in her career anymore.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Marries Naksh
episodesList.summary: Paakhi interrupts Naksh and Rimjim's wedding rituals with a gun in her hand, threatening to shoot herself. Consequently, seeing no other way out of the mess he's in, Naksh gets married to Paakhi.

episodesList.title: Naksh Doesn't Accept Paakhi as His Wife
episodesList.summary: Utterly disappointed in Paakhi for her actions, Jaanki asks Naksh for forgiveness. Naksh, in turn, requests Jaanki not to reveal to his family that Paakhi used to work for Natasha.

episodesList.title: Naksh Pretends to Accept Rimjhim
episodesList.summary: When Naksh declares that he hates Paakhi, Rimjim arrives at the scene to mock and challenge her. Later, during a post-wedding ritual, Paakhi is about to have a fall but Naksh catches her in time.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Fails to Get Rimjhim Arrested
episodesList.summary: Paakhi files a FIR against Rimjim but her plan backfires, leaving Baa and Naksh even more furious than before. Later, Rimjim injures herself and claims that she was assaulted by Paakhi.

episodesList.title: Baa Angry at Naksh's Stubbornness
episodesList.summary: Paakhi loses her cool when she sees Rimjim holding Naksh's hands in his room. She creates a huge scene in front of the family members, but Baa intervenes and explains to Naksh that Rimjim cannot stay with him in the same room.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Brings Moushmi Back Home
episodesList.summary: Rimjim gets extremely worried when she sees the nurses bringing an unconscious Moushmi into the house. Her hired goon later sneaks into Moushmi's room to kill her.

episodesList.title: Will Paakhi Dub for Natasha Again?
episodesList.summary: Following Rimjim's instructions, the goon confesses that he was the one who poisoned Moushmi. Naksh later tends to Paakhi's wounds.

episodesList.title: Baa Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Holding a knife to Natasha's neck, Paakhi secretly records a video of the former declaring that she tried to poison the kids at the orphanage and planned to frame Baa for it. However, her attempts to expose Natasha fail miserably.

episodesList.title: Will Akash Help Paakhi?
episodesList.summary: Natasha and Rimjim team up to ruin Paakhi's attempts to prove her innocence. Later, when Paakhi returns home, the family members accuse her of framing Baa and getting her arrested.

episodesList.title: Baa Released From Jail
episodesList.summary: Baa returns home on being released from prison after her innocence is proved. Later, Natasha is left shocked and heartbroken after learning about Akash's feelings for her.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Decides to Expose Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Paakhi gathers the neighbours and reminds them of Baa's kind nature, dissuading them from believing the things that were said about her in the news. Later, Naksh thanks her for saving Baa's reputation but states that he still cannot trust her.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Exposed
episodesList.summary: Rimjim plays a move to expose Paakhi's connection to Natasha and succeeds marvellously. A distressed Baa holds herself responsible for the humiliation her family has had to face and blackens her face, after which Naksh follows suit.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Held at Gunpoint
episodesList.summary: Natasha reprimands Rimjim for revealing to everyone that Paakhi was the former's dubbing artist, but Rimjim silences her. Later, miserable over Baa's condition, Naksh holds a gun to his head and compels Paakhi to sign the divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Baa Punishes Paakhi
episodesList.summary: When Naksh gives Baa the signed divorce papers, she shocks the family by burning them to ashes. Stating that only Paakhi should be punished for the family's humiliation, she asks Paakhi to give up her voice by undergoing an operation.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Plots Against Paakhi
episodesList.summary: When Paakhi refuses to team up with her, Natasha grows determined to save the former's voice at all costs. She later arrives at the house to reveal the truth to the family members but gets knocked unconscious by Rimjim.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Plots to Kill Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Rimjim is left horrified when she learns that Moushmi has regained consciousness. The doctor soon reveals that though Moushmi is unable to talk for the time being, she will recover quickly.

episodesList.title: Will Natasha Be Able to Save Paakhi?
episodesList.summary: Rimjim waits for the right moment to put her plan into motion and get rid of Paakhi once and for all. Later, Pinky knocks the goon unconscious and rescues Natasha.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Successfully Executes Her Plan
episodesList.summary: When the lights come back on, Paakhi is found dead on the floor with blood flowing from her head. When Natasha accuses Rimjim of killing Paakhi, the family refuses to believe her.

episodesList.title: Paakhi's Shocking Return
episodesList.summary: Just as Rimjim is about to inject Moushmi with a harmful chemical, Paakhi arrives at the scene and stops her, leaving the former shell-shocked. Later, Paakhi exposes Rimjim's true colours in the presence of the family.

episodesList.title: Naksh Marries Paakhi Again
episodesList.summary: Naksh pours his heart out to his mother, stating that he feels extremely guilty for ill-treating Paakhi. Later, the family arranges for Paakhi and Naksh's marriage for the second time.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Kidnaps Paakhi
episodesList.summary: The entire family is left anxious when they learn that Rimjim has escaped from prison. She soon abducts Paakhi and gives Naksh a call, asking him to meet her at a designated location.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Puts Forth a Condition Before Naksh
episodesList.summary: After being tricked by Rimjim, Naksh returns home and finds her holding his entire family captive. She proceeds to put forth a condition for him to fulfill in exchange for Paakhi's life.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Organises a Dangerous Game
episodesList.summary: While Rimjim tries to get romantic with a frustrated Naksh, Paakhi manages to free herself. She soon arrives in time and stops Naksh from giving in to Rimjim's demand.

episodesList.title: Naksh Saves Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Rimjim compels Naksh to shoot Paakhi, but he threatens to shoot himself instead. The police soon arrive at the scene and arrest Rimjim and her hired goons.

episodesList.title: Jaanki and Mamta Slap Natasha
episodesList.summary: Natasha arrives at the house with gifts and bundles of cash for Paakhi, to get her to resume dubbing for her. However, Paakhi gives her a fitting reply, leaving her furious and humiliated.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim Hits Naksh
episodesList.summary: A vengeful Natasha tells Rimjim that she wishes to kill Paakhi. Consequently, Rimjim disguises herself as a maid and enters the house.

episodesList.title: Naksh Loses His Memory
episodesList.summary: When Naksh regains consciousness, the family learns that he has lost his memory and is under the impression that Rimjim is his wife. Later, Moushmi apologises to Paakhi for bringing Rimjim into the house.

episodesList.title: Mamta's Plot Against Rimjhim
episodesList.summary: Mamta plays a move to prevent Naksh and Rimjim from spending the night together in the same room. Later, Paakhi vows to send Rimjim back to prison.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim to Separate Paakhi and Naksh
episodesList.summary: The doctor informs Paakhi of a way to help Naksh regain his memories. In the meantime, Rimjim is determined to separate Naksh and Paakhi for good and comes up with an evil plan.

episodesList.title: Rimjhim's Plan Comes to Fruition
episodesList.summary: Paakhi prepares mocktails for the family but Rimjim mixes alcohol in one of the glasses and gives it to Naksh. Later, an intoxicated Naksh mistakes Rimjim for Paakhi.

episodesList.title: Naksh Regains His Memory
episodesList.summary: The doctor informs the family that Naksh's condition has gotten worse after his fall. Later, crying bitterly, Paakhi blames herself for all of Naksh's problems.

episodesList.title: Paakhi Suspects Naksh
episodesList.summary: Paakhi informs Moushmi that she suspects that Naksh has regained his memories. Later, Paakhi confronts Naksh and asks him what he's hiding from her.

episodesList.title: Naksh Pretends to Be Unconscious
episodesList.summary: When Paakhi confronts Naksh and asks him to swear that he hasn't regained his memories, he pretends to faint to avoid lying to her. Moushmi later teams up with Paakhi to find out the truth.

episodesList.title: Naksh Reveals the Truth to Paakhi
episodesList.summary: Naksh reveals to Paakhi that he has regained his memories, following which they team up against Rimjim. On the other hand, Rimjim continues to blackmail Naksh with pictures of them getting intimate with each other.

episodesList.title: Paakhi and Naksh Fool Rimjhim
episodesList.summary: Mamta slaps Naksh after getting her hands on a few pictures of him getting intimate with Rimjim. Later, Mamta, Paakhi and Naksh decide to work together and get rid of Rimjim.

episodesList.title: Naksh and Paakhi Succeed in Their Plans
episodesList.summary: Paakhi and Naksh outsmart Rimjim and acquire evidence against her. They then inform the police and get her arrested, following which the family offers prayers to god.

plotHtml:
It is an interesting story of a young, street-smart girl, Paakhi, who does what it takes to get her way. She uses her silky voice quality to entice her cheating uncle who had duped her dead dad. He has also taken over their house, making her mom slog like a slave. Cut to the other lead, we have B-Grade actress, Natasha. However her biggest drawback is her husky voice which puts paid to her efforts to get launched by big film producer, Kapadia. The latter clearly tells Natasha's manager, Akash, that he can sign her only if they get a sexy voice to dub for her. Accordingly, they hold an RJ competition where a desperate for a job Paakhi also turns up. Here too, she pulls a fast one to get ahead in the long line of wannabe contestants (reverses her token number from 221 to 122).
As Akash and Natasha insult her regarding the racy audition lines, she puts up a perfect act, but then walks out. Natasha and Akash love her voice but she is nowhere to be found. The real 121 had a bad voice. As fate is to have it, Paakhi finds a job as personal assistant with Natasha, who entrusts her with the job of finding the missing voice. Pakhi is adamant on not helping Natasha out, but needs her salary, so plays along. The male lead is budding photographer, Naksh, who is being forced by his eccentric granny, Baa, to give up his passion and take over the family catering business. Natasha's car crashes into Naksh's set of wheels, and Pakhi uses that to curry favour with the actress. Paakhi keeps bumping into Naksh, who she again uses (calls him her husband to get a car for Natasha). To make matters worse, she and her mother become tenants in his house by impressing Baa. Natasha pulls every trick in the book to force Kapadia's hand, even hires women to smear ink on her in an attempt to get publicity.
Paakhi unknowingly scuttles the plan, but then helps get more media mileage, courtesy a well-orchestrated drama at the press conference, which the fourth estate very easily swallows. Unable to wait any longer, Kapadia chooses another talent. Upon hearing this, a very enraged Natasha drops in at his office and manhandles the new gal. The assault video goes viral and an angry Kapadia reads Akash the riot act. By then, the penny has dropped on Akash about the token change, but even here Paakhi moves a step ahead, dropping ink on the register, so her name is not legible. In the meantime, Paakhi who was fooling Naksh, helps him win a competition. Akash finally finds out the truth about Paakhi. Akash tells Natasha that Paakhi is the girl who have that voice that Natasha wanted. Paakhi refused to dub for Natasha. After that Natasha blackmails Paakhi by showing an edited video made by Natasha in which Baa pours poison in orphan children's food. Then Paakhi dubs for Natasha. After that Naksh and Paakhi fall in love with each other. But Baa arranges Naksh's marriage with Rimjhim, Mousami's sister. But Naksh doesn't like her. Then Natasha tells the truth of Paakhi to Naksh that Paakhi dubs for her. Finally Naksh knows the truth. The twist ends up Paakhi marrying Naksh. However, Naksh hates Paakhi due to her truth (which Natasha had twisted and told him). Soon, Mousami faces an accident, conducted by Rimjhim and slips into coma. However, soon she wakes up, but is unable to speak for while. Baa's health detriotes and she goes to an ashram.
On Navratri, Rimjhim plans to kill Paakhi and succeeds. Fearing that Mousami's recovery will expose her, Rimjhim tries to kill her but is stopped by Paakhi, who turns out to be alive and gets Rimjhim arrested. But Rimjhim escapes and tries to create problems for Paakhi and Naksh, but fails and is sent to jail. After this Paakhi and Naksh are united.
tagline: It is an interesting story of a young, street-smart girl, Paakhi, who does what it takes to get her way.

title: Hostages
summary:
Hostages is an Indian Hindi-language crime thriller series for Hotstar Specials, which is an official remake of an Israeli series of the same name. Written by Nisarg Mehta, Shiva Bajpai and Mayukh Ghosh, the series is directed by Sudhir Mishra. Starring Tisca Chopra, Ronit Roy, Parvin Dabas, Aashim Gulati, Mohan Kapoor, Dalip Tahil, with Malhaar Rathod, Sharad Joshi, Aashim Gulati, Surya Sharma and Anangsha Biswas in supporting roles. The series is about a renowned surgeon who is scheduled for a routine operation on the chief minister was ordered to assassinate him in the process, in order to save family being captivated.
Sameer Nair of Applause Entertainment brought the rights for the adaptation in April 2018, followed by the principal shooting which started in May 2018 and completed in March 2019. Marked as Sudhir Mishra's digital debut, the series was eventually premiered on Disney+ Hotstar on 31 May 2019. The series received mixed response, and although the writing was criticised, critics praised the performances of Ronit Roy and Tisca Chopra. The actors eventually won two awards at the Gold Awards (an award ceremony for television-based content) for their performances. The series was also broadcast on StarPlus in April 2020.
A second season was officially announced on 16 October 2019. The narrative of the second season eventually follows a week after the events of the first season, with the retired cop, kidnaps the chief minister for a bone marrow transplant to save his wife's life. Production of the second season began in October 2019 and ended in July 2020, despite production delays due to COVID-19 pandemic. The new season is directed by Sachin Krishn, replacing its predecessor Sudhir Mishra, who also worked on the second series. It premiered through Disney+ Hotstar on 9 September 2020.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
In April 2018, Sameer Nair, CEO of Aditya Birla Group's content studio Applause Entertainment, announced their collaboration with Armoza Formats, in order to adapt the Israeli series Hostages, La Famiglia and Honey Badgers. Sameer Nair initially slated that he has been a fan of Israeli content, due to a close cultural affinity and stated that the series have incredibly universal appeal. The team planned of filming of the series after the completion of the writing and casting process. In May 2018, the production house officially announced the details of the cast and crew members, with Sudhir Mishra being assigned to direct the series, and Ronit Roy, Tisca Chopra and Parvin Dabas were roped in for the principal cast.
For the second season, Sudhir Mishra eventually roped in Sachin Krishn, the cinematographer of the first season as well as Sudhir's previous films. In October 2020, Sachin announced that there will be a third season.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Ronit Roy who plays the role of Prithvi Singh, a retired cop, initially accepted the script stating that the original series being hugely appreciated all over the globe. In an interview with Indo-Asian News Service, he stated "My character in the series is very intriguing. I constantly strive to keep my audiences engaged and entertained with each of my performances." The supporting characters include Malhaar Rathod, Sharad Joshi, Aashim Gulati, Surya Sharma and Anangsha Biswas.
With Ronit being retained for the second season, Dino Morea, Shibani Dandekar, Divya Dutta and Shweta Basu Prasad, were the new addition for the cast. Some of the old members like Dalip Tahil, Surya Sharma, Aashim Gulati, Anangsha Biswas and Mohan Kapur are still a part of the series.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The series' digital distribution rights were brought by Hotstar. On 15 January 2019, the streaming platform announced that the series will be released under the label Hotstar Specials, with the production house Applause Entertainment collaborated with Hotstar to release it through first set of their original contents in March 2019. A poster which released on 13 May 2019, features Ronit Roy, taking Tisca Chopra as a hostage. But Rohit claimed that it was a suspense. On 15 May 2019, a 30-second trailer was unveiled through social media platforms, receiving positive response. The first season of the series was released on Hotstar on 31 May 2019, in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali and Marathi languages.
In April 2020, Star Plus announced for a premiere of the web series, as the shooting of television shows were affected due to the COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in India, eventually halting the premiere of new episodes in television. The series consisting of 10-episodes was premiered at the channel in the 10:30 p.m. IST slot, which eventually belonged to the paranormal thriller Nazar 2, for the same channel. With this, Hostages became the first Hotstar Specials series to be premiered directly on television. Commenting on this Ronit Roy stated, "The good part is that people get it to watch it for free. If they enjoy it, they might subscribe to Hotstar. The section of people, who only watch traditional TV, who do not have access to OTT platforms, will get to watch the show. If they like it, some of them might go to OTT to watch the second season. Its a win-win situation in both ways." On 31 August 2020, the official trailer of the second season was released through social media platforms, receiving positive response from fans. The series premiered through Disney+ Hotstar on 9 September 2020.

episodesList.title: Threat
episodesList.summary: A night before the operation of the Chief Minister of Haryana, Dr. Mira Anand, his surgeon, is held hostage along with her family by three masked men.

episodesList.title: Sabotage
episodesList.summary: It's not a usual day at the hospital. While the clock is ticking, she desperately searches for a way to buy time. It is revealed that the kidnappers have a fourth team member.

episodesList.title: Complications
episodesList.summary: At work, Mira has to deal with her old mentor's suspicion. Meanwhile, an angry neighbor shows up at the house.

episodesList.title: Gatecrasher
episodesList.summary: A new challenge presents itself and Prithvi must tie up the loose ends. As Mira and Sanjay debate over her kids' safety, an unannounced visitor arrives.

episodesList.title: Falling Apart
episodesList.summary: As Mira struggles to help a wounded Sanjay, Prithvi takes a gamble to save the day. Meanwhile, suspicion creeps into the kidnappers' team.

episodesList.title: Pieces of the Puzzle
episodesList.summary: A sudden order to be present at the station leaves Prithvi concerned. On her way to the hospital, Mira begins to penetrate Prithvi's identity.

episodesList.title: Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Mira doesn't know whom to trust, especially after she discovers the truth about Sanjay. Meanwhile, Aditya (Shaina's boyfriend) hatches a plan to escape with Shovan and Shaina, with help from Mira.

episodesList.title: Escape
episodesList.summary: Prince and Aman chase Aditya and the kids into the jungle. Aditya meets with an accident and the kids are separated. Shaina calls the number provided by Mira earlier and reaches Subramaniam, the CM's Chief of Security. At home, Sanjay does the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Endgame
episodesList.summary: Piecing together the clues, Mira is now following a new person. Elsewhere, Sanjay and Shovan take a risk to escape while Prithvi and Subramaniam end up in a clash after it is revealed that Subramaniam had recruited Prithvi.

episodesList.title: A Matter of Choice
episodesList.summary: Prithvi has to contend with a mutiny from his crew, while Mira manages to turn the game around. Soon, she is faced with another choice, the one which was presented to her at the very beginning of the story.

episodesList.title: From frying pan to the fire
episodesList.summary: After kidnapping Handa, Prithvi and his team are off to Nepal. However plans go awry when Handa escapes, Saba's health worsens and Subramaniam finds them.

episodesList.title: No Visual
episodesList.summary: With cops and reporters swarming the abandoned mansion, Prithvi scrambles for time. Ayesha Khan brought in as hostage negotiator, establishes a communication line.

episodesList.title: The trade off
episodesList.summary: Prithvi is forced to make a tough decision and demands the release of a Tihar Jail inmate, Ashgar Nabi, who's a former surgeon. But Ayesha has a card up her sleeve.

episodesList.title: Caught off guard
episodesList.summary: While Prithvi helps Ashgar setup for the bone marrow transplant, Desai gets an unwelcome guest. Elsewhere Shikha smells a rat in a so-called open-and-shut case.

episodesList.title: Plan B
episodesList.summary: With Ashgar completing his task, Prithvi plans an exit strategy. On the other side, Shikha pays the price for going against orders. Later Handa and Saba form a bond.

episodesList.title: Cat and Mouse
episodesList.summary: When Sarah helps Prithvi, she catches unwanted attention. Meanwhile, Kanika meets an unexpected informant and Shikha comes across some crucial evidence.

episodesList.title: Sneak in, Sneak out
episodesList.summary: As Peter begins to crack under the hostage crisis, an intruder breaks into Sarah's house. On the other end, Shikha and Rohan decide to spy on Isha Andrews.

episodesList.title: Beginning of the end
episodesList.summary: The situation worsens when Prithvi receives a heart-stopping phone call about his daughter. Meanwhile, Handa tries to manipulate Peter into helping him.

episodesList.title: Connecting the Dots
episodesList.summary: A mysterious journalist, Arjun Bhasin, arrives to cover CM Handa's funeral. Back at the mansion, Handa sheds light on his questionable deals and Ayesha keeps a close eye on Dutt.

episodesList.title: Old Friends reveal themselves
episodesList.summary: As Prithvi reconnects with his old comrade, he plans to outwit Ranbir. On the other end, Arjun has an interesting encounter with a political extremist.

episodesList.title: Inching Closer
episodesList.summary: When Aman and Saba struggle to escape, Prithvi joins Dutt to clear out the mansion. Rohan finds a critical lead as the conspiracy unravels more.

episodesList.title: Against the clock
episodesList.summary: It's a race against time for Prithvi to save his daughter. Ayesha finds something amiss and goes with her gut feeling, and Shikha finally puts it all together.

title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
summary: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan (transl. Happu's Weird Life) is an Indian Hindi-language sitcom television series that premiered on 4 March 2019 on &TV. Produced under Edit II Productions, it is a spin-off of Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!. Apart from the character Happu Singh, the show features his mother, wife, and nine children.
plot: Happu Singh is a corrupt police officer in the city of Kanpur. The story revolves around the misadventures of Happu Singh and his large family- his wife; Rajesh Singh, mother Katori and his nine children. He is constantly troubled by the rivalry between his wife and mother and the antics of his best friend; Beni and his nine children who are Katori 'Kat', Mallai ‘Mallaika’, Ranbir, Hritik, Chamchi, Ayushman and three other kids who are infants.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Initially titled Happu Ke Chappu, it was later changed to Happu Ki Ultan Paltan.
Talking about the series, producer Sanjay Kohli said, "Happu Singh has been a favorite among viewers ever since the inception of the character in the hugely popular Bhabiji Ghar Par Hai. This huge fan following for Happu encouraged us to come up with a show revolving around his life at home and it’s sure to entertain the audience. Happu Ki Ultan Paltan will capture the hilarious situations that will take place in Happu’s home with his dabang wife, nagging mother and his nine pesky kids, with helpless Happu in the centre of all their madness. We are positive that viewers will love this show and laugh along".

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh and his wife Rajjo’s time together is often interrupted by their nine kids and his Amma, mother, a cunning lady who claims to communicate with her dead husband. Stressed due to taking care of her large brood, Rajjo wishes for a holiday in Agra to de-stress. Throwing a wrench in their plans, Amma informs them about the imminent arrival of Happu’s uncle, Adveer. While Rajjo is adamant about going to Agra, Amma warns Happu with dire consequences if he and Rajjo leave.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 2 - March 05, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh cribs about his marital woes to his friend, Beni Prasad. When Rajesh invites her mom to Kanpur for her treatment, Amma tries to discourage her. When Rajesh doesn’t relent, she calls Happu to stop his mother-in-law’s visit as it will coincide with her brother’s. Poor Happu gets stuck between doing right by his wife as well as his mother. He asks his fashionista-cum-English-obsessed daughter, Katori a.k.a Kat, to help him, while his other daughter, Chamchi, eavesdrops.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 3 - March 06, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Chamchi informs Amma about Happu and Kat’s conspiracy to stop Rajesh’s mother as well as Adveer's Mama’s visit. Hrithik, Happu’s son, who overhears Amma and Chamchi, informs Rajesh about Happu’s plan. As per Happu’s plan, Kat tells Amma and Rajesh that a crowded house will prevent her from studying for her exams. In front of Kat, Amma and Rajesh falsely agree to postpone their respective relatives from coming to Kanpur. However, they have no plans of following through on their promise.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 4 - March 07, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: When Amma confidently informs Chamchi of Adveer’s arrival, Hrithik listens in and informs the same to Rajesh. Hearing this, Rajesh also confirms her mother’s visit to Kanpur. Knowing that a battle awaits him at home, Happu is reluctant to return. Malaika, Happu’s wrestling-obsessed daughter, helps him scale the wall of their house, but Happu falls down and injures himself. The next morning, Happu is stunned upon knowing that Amma and Rajesh lied about their respective relative’s visit.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 5 - March 08, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Happu about her wish to celebrate her upcoming birthday lavishly. Though Happu agrees momentarily, he worries about Amma’s reaction as Pitaji, Happu’s father, died on the same day as Rajesh’s birthday. The next morning, Happu approaches Amma for permission to celebrate Rajesh’s birthday. But, before Happu could say anything, Amma puts forth her wish to organise a prayer meeting for her husband on his death anniversary.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 6 - March 11, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Rajesh becomes angry on Happu for failing to take permission to celebrate her birthday from Amma. Stuck between Rajesh’s wish to celebrate her birthday and Amma’s desire to hold a prayer meeting on Pitaji’s death anniversary, Happu asks Beni for help. Beni tells Happu to sneak out from the temple during Pitaji’s prayer meeting to celebrate Rajesh’s birthday. Amma, who comes to know of Happu’s plan to throw Rajesh a birthday party, vows to ruin it.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 7 - March 12, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Amma uses cunning tactics to ensure Happu agrees to organise a prayer meeting for her husband’s death anniversary. Hrithik, who had eavesdropped on their conversation, reiterates everything to Rajesh. To convince an angry Rajesh, Happu promises to hold the prayer meeting as well as the celebration for her birthday. Happu informs his kids to keep Rajesh’s birthday celebration a secret from Amma and Chamchi. Finally, the day of Rajesh’s birthday and Pitaji’s death anniversary arrives.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 8 - March 13, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: By entrusting Beni with the responsibility of arranging the birthday cake and snacks, Happu leaves for work to arrange gifts for Rajesh without Amma’s interference. During the prayer meeting, Amma catches Beni sneaking in with Rajesh’s birthday cake, but Happu handles the situation tactfully. While Amma becomes engrossed in the prayer meeting, Rajesh and Happu sneak out to celebrate her birthday. Soon, their children and friends join the celebration as well.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 9 - March 14, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Leaving Amma and Chamchi, Happu, Rajesh, their kids and friends begin celebrating Rajesh’s birthday. When Amma notices their absence, Happu makes excuses to distract Amma and re-joins the celebrations. Feeling suspicious, Chamchi peeps in the house through the window and sees everyone dancing and celebrating. She takes Amma inside, effectively putting an end to the merriment. Amma soon realises her mistake and herself joins in the celebrations for Rajesh’s birthday.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 10 - March 15, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Happu make plans to celebrate the upcoming festival of ‘Holi’. Speaking with Pitaji’s ghost, Amma reminisces about their past ‘Holi’ celebrations. While celebrating ‘Holi’ early, Happu’s younger kids drench Beni with water and make fun of his romantic feelings towards Rajesh’s sister – Vimlesh. When Amma and Rajesh get into an argument, it escalates to the level that Amma puts a ban on celebrating ‘Holi’. Happu’s attempts to mediate the dispute between them fails.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 12 - March 19, 2019 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: In a game of truth and dare, Chamchi dares Ranbir to play ‘Holi’ with her. The kids secretly enjoy the festival away from Rajesh’s and Amma’s prying eyes, but Malaika catches them in the act. To outwit Amma and Rajesh, Happu suggests them to allow the family to celebrate ‘Diwali’ instead of ‘Holi’. Though Amma and Rajesh initially dismiss Happu’s idea, they agree in the end. Finally, the day of ‘Holi’ arrives and Happu’s family makes preparations to celebrate ‘Diwali’ instead.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - Episode 13 - March 20, 2019 - Full Episode
