episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Karishma parks her car in the lane near Happu’s house and gives the keys to Rajesh before her Kerala trip. Rajesh hits a man on the way to buy groceries with Karishma’s car. An astrologer tells Beni to walk on burning coals to win Vimlesh’s love.

episodesList.title: Happu learns that Rajesh hit the commissioner with Karishma’s car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets nervous thinking about the repercussions of the accident Rajesh caused. The commissioner orders Happu to find the culprit who had hit him with a car. Happu is left shocked on learning that Rajesh is the culprit.

episodesList.title: Amma tries to mollify the commissioner’s ire towards his culprits-Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner’s arrival at their home makes Rajesh nervous. Amma tries to mollify the commissioner’s ire towards his culprits. Beni prepares to walk on burning coals as per the astrologer’s suggestion.

episodesList.title: Rajesh once again hits the commissioner with Karishma’s car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner learns that the car which hit him is parked in Happu’s neighbourhood and leaves a message with Rajesh for Happu to nab the culprit. On the way to hide the car in the jungle, Amma and Rajesh once again hit the commissioner.

episodesList.title: The commissioner forgives Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh fear the repercussions of hitting the commissioner twice with the car. The entire matter unravels in front of the commissioner on Karishma’s arrival and he decides to forgive Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh burns Amma’s favourite saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh wishes to wear Amma’s favourite saree to her friend Seema’s wedding. While giving the saree to Rajesh, Amma tells her to not let any damage come to it. However, a distracted Rajesh burns the saree while ironing it.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh gets Amma’s saree repaired - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh fears telling Amma that she had burnt her favourite saree. Much to Rajesh’s relief, Kamlesh gets the saree repaired. Meanwhile, the commissioner orders Happu to apprehend the thief who stole his chain.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh loses Amma’s saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh loses Amma’s saree. When Amma asks for her saree back, Rajesh lies to distract her. Beni suggests a way for Happu and Rajesh to save themselves from Amma’s anger.

episodesList.title: Helping Rajesh lands Beni in trouble - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni steals Rajesh’s necklace which Amma is wearing, but gets caught by the commissioner. To help Rajesh, Hrithik stops the laundryman from coming to their house. Assuming Beni to be the real thief, the commissioner gets Happu to beat him up.

episodesList.title: Rajesh confesses to having burnt Amma’s saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika learns that Kat and Kamlesh had left Amma’s saree in the movie theatre. In the police station, Beni tells the commissioner why he stole the necklace. Later, Rajesh confesses before Amma to having burnt her saree.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh enter into a poetic war - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni listens to Amma recite a poetry and falsely praises her. Amma discredits Rajesh’s understanding of the poetry and Rajesh complaints about her to Happu. Later, Amma and Rajesh argue with each other through the use of poetry.

episodesList.title: Happu tries his hand at poetry - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Happu tries his hand at poetry but fails to impress the commissioner. Beni promises to introduce Amma and Rajesh to his friend who is a publisher. The idea of getting their poetries published in a book grips Amma and Rajesh, while it worries Happu.

episodesList.title: Amma finds Pitaji’s diary - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the poetic war between Amma and Rajesh continues. Kat and Kamlesh’s antics irritate Malaika. Sorting through some old items, Amma and Happu find Pitaji’s diary. The contents of it come as a surprise to Amma.

episodesList.title: Will Amma take Beni’s hint? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh ask Beni to invite his publisher friend for a ‘mushaira’ session, where they both vow to outdo each other. Beni tries to discourage Amma’s poetic aspirations.

episodesList.title: The ‘mushaira’ begins - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh refuse to give up on the idea of getting their poems published. Beni welcomes his publisher friend Hararat Bukhari to the ‘mushaira’, and the session begins with Chamchi reciting her poetry, followed by Hrithik and Malaika.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh’s dreams crash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh fail to impress Hararat Bukhari with their poetries. Later in the night, Happu tries to spend some quality time with Rajesh, but is interrupted by his kids. During a ‘puja’, Amma hints at Rajesh being blessed with the boon of motherhood.

episodesList.title: Is Rajesh pregnant? - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh calls Happu at work and tells him that she is pregnant. She tries to hide the news from Amma, but Amma learns the truth from Chamchi and chides the couple for adding to their already large brood.

episodesList.title: Amma wins an exciting prize - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a priest visits Amma and foretells that she will go abroad soon. She is overjoyed, but Rajesh bursts her bubble and what Amma says next hurts her. Later, Amma wins a contest and receives an exciting prize.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s ultimatum to Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma is excited for her upcoming London trip and promises to return with lots of gifts for all. Rajesh pesters Happu to send her for a trip abroad as well. Fed up with Amma’s taunts, she gives an ultimatum to Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu plans a party - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Amma that she will also be going to London. They ask Kamlesh and Kat to teach them English. Happu and Beni plan a get-together with their friends in their absence. Amma tells Happu to pay INR 20,000 as taxes for her travel and stay.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh learn Western etiquettes - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh teaches English to Amma and Rajesh. Imagining Kamlesh to be a British official named Colonel Peterson, Malaika thrashes him. Kat teaches Amma and Rajesh to eat food with knives and forks. Later, they flaunt their western outfits.

episodesList.title: Amma’s dreams crash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh and Amma pack for their London trip. The trip gets cancelled because of a news delivered by Nargis. Soon after, Happu’s friends arrive for the party, which lands him in trouble.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni’s friendship troubles Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, while Happu is at Beni’s house, everyone back home awaits him for dinner. Later, an angry Rajesh taunts Beni and Happu’s friendship. Undaunted, Happu lies to Rajesh and visits Beni again at night.

episodesList.title: Amma’s suggestion - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, when Rajesh calls Happu, he lies to her about being busy with an important case. Rajesh discovers Happu’s lie which leads to an argument between the two. Amma suggests Rajesh to become Happu’s friend so he stops visiting Beni for company.

episodesList.title: Rajesh becomes Happu’s friend - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh promises Happu that she will be a good friend to him. She and Happu join Beni for some drinks, but they leave when Beni and Happu get into an argument. The next morning, Rajesh’s brazen and overfriendly behaviour before the family disturbs Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh breaks Happu and Beni's bond - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu fights with Beni on Rajesh's instigation. Beni gets upset when he sees Happu having drinks with Rajesh at night. Happu overhears Amma and Rajesh's conversation and learns that they had deliberately created a rift between him and Beni.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s plan backfires - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu pacifies Beni and tells him about Amma and Rajesh’s ploy. To teach Rajesh a lesson, Happu teases her friend Karishma. Later, an upset Rajesh complains about Happu to Amma.

episodesList.title: Rajesh teaches Happu a lesson - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh overhears Beni and Happu’s conversation. Her ploy to get back at Happu endangers his job. Happu apologises to Rajesh for his mistake and promises to spend more time with family.

episodesList.title: Happu’s uncle tells him a secret - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma stops Rajesh from giving away an old basket. Happu’s uncle from Agra pays him a visit at the police station and tells him a secret. Meanwhile, Kamlesh tells Amma to become a brand ambassador of an NGO supporting orphans.

episodesList.title: Happu devastated - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi comes across a letter which makes her think she is an orphan. Beni consoles Happu who is upset after learning about being an orphan. Happu and Rajesh’s loving behaviour towards her leaves Amma in doubt.

episodesList.title: Happu is depressed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik and Ranbir take advantage of a vulnerable Chamchi. Beni gives a bottle of alcohol to Happu to alleviate his sorrows. The commissioner sympathises with Happu and shares his own unfortunate story. Happu wishes to meet his biological parents.

episodesList.title: Amma reveals a secret - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, under a misconception, Happu assumes Tiwari, a vegetable seller, to be his biological father. Malaika teaches Hrithik and Ranbir a lesson. Later, Amma tells Happu the secret about the basket.

episodesList.title: Happu’s family welcomes Gunjan - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner agrees to let his niece, Gunjan, stay with Happu’s family to experience the joys of family life. When Gunjan arrives, Amma and Rajesh learn why she is averse to marriage. During dinner, Rajesh and Amma end up quarrelling before Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh quarrel before Gunjan - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu advises Amma and Rajesh to not quarrel before Gunjan. The next day, Amma and Rajesh pretend to be caring towards each other. Later, Gunjan gets happy when she sees them quarrelling and tells Happu about it.

episodesList.title: Happu sings false praises of his family - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni and Happu end up fighting when the former complains about the latter’s children. Tired of Amma and Rajesh’s conflicts, Happu once again tries to reason with them. Later, he sings false praises of his family before Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Gunjan agrees to get married - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner tells Happu that Gunjan has refused to marry upon witnessing the fights at his home. Later, Gunjan changes her mind on seeing Amma and Rajesh’s loving behaviour. Moreover, Happu and Beni resolve their differences.

episodesList.title: Happu gets frightened on seeing ghosts - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu teases Rajesh for getting scared of a mouse. To teach Happu a lesson, the kids and Kamlesh come up with a plan. At night, the light goes out and Happu gets frightened on seeing the ghosts.

episodesList.title: Amma’s suggestion to Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh fights with Happu for not giving time to the family. Amma gives a suggestion to Happu. Kamlesh tells Happu that due to Kat’s low attendance, he has been called to the college. Being busy with work, Happu refuses to go to the college.

episodesList.title: Happu’s leave request denied - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s kids complain about him not spending time with the family. The commissioner turns down Happu’s leave request. Amma comes up with an idea to get Happu some time off from work.

episodesList.title: Happu gets suspended - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, due to Amma and Rajesh, the commissioner suspends Happu from duty for seven days. Happu plays with his kids and spends some quality time with Rajesh. Happu openly romancing Rajesh irks Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu irritates everyone - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, on Beni’s suggestion, Happu narrates a story to his children to mingle with them. Happu gets angry when the children fall asleep. Irritated with Happu’s antics, everyone complaints about him to Amma.

episodesList.title: The commissioner remains stubborn - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh request the commissioner to cancel Happu’s suspension, but he refuses to budge. With Hrithik’s idea, everyone teaches Happu a lesson. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu for one more week.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s demand for a maid - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Happu to find a maid for her to help in the household chores. Happu asks Beni and Manohar to help him find one. When Happu returns home without a maid, he is faced with everyone’s ire.

episodesList.title: Rajesh gets a maid - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh hires a maid named Dimple to help her around the house. Dimple impresses everyone with her cooking. Rajesh suggests Karishma to hire a maid as well. A homeless Kamlesh finds shelter at Beni’s house.

episodesList.title: Dimple threatens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Dimple considers Kamlesh to be a servant when she sees him washing clothes at Beni’s house. The next morning, Happu and Rajesh chide Dimple for waking up late. Further, Dimple threatens to send Happu to jail on charges of molestation.

episodesList.title: Dimple’s increasing demands - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, under Dimple’s threats, Happu, Amma and Rajesh take care of the household chores. Beni manipulates Kamlesh into doing errands for him. Kamlesh mocks Happu who is washing clothes. Dimple’s increasing demands trouble everyone.

episodesList.title: A shocking revelation - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu shares his woes with Beni. Later, Beni confronts Dimple and tries to scare her with his tactics. Soon after, Happu’s friend arrives and reveals that Dimple is his wife and he did everything to take revenge from Happu.

episodesList.title: Hrithik lies to the Principal - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik and Ranbir decide to teach Kamlesh a lesson for taunting them. Later, Hrithik lies to his school Principal about Happu meeting with an accident to escape punishment. The Principal meets Happu and tells him about Hrithik’s lie.

episodesList.title: What happened to Hrithik? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, hearing the Principal’s complaints against Hrithik, Happu and Rajesh decide to give him a good hiding. Rajesh gets worried when Hrithik and Ranbir do not return from school. Ranbir brings Hrithik home and gives a bad news to the family concerning him.

episodesList.title: Hrithik’s memory loss saddens everyone - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu blames Kamlesh for Hrithik’s memory loss and thrashes him. Despite the doctor’s efforts, Hrithik is unable to gain his memory back and his condition worries everyone in the family. Amma sings a lullaby for Hrithik in the hope that he recovers.

episodesList.title: Chamchi becomes suspicious of Hrithik - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma’s fails to help Hrithik get his memory back. Happu starts blaming himself for Hrithik’s condition. Meanwhile, Chamchi suspects that Hrithik is pretending to have lost his memory and vows to prove it.

episodesList.title: Hrithik’s lie exposed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, to bring back Hrithik's memory, Rajesh gives an advice to Happu. In order to cure Hrithik, the commissioner agrees to get slapped by Happu. Chamchi overhears Hrithik and Ranbir’s conversation and exposes Hrithik's pretence.

episodesList.title: The priest's prediction - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Fakirchand complains to Happu that Hrithik has beaten his son Bansuri. Happu punishes Hrithik, but Hrithik feels that Happu has done wrong by punishing him. The priest makes a prediction about Amma, which makes her very happy.

episodesList.title: Did Amma kill Kamlesh? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu advises Rajesh and Amma to be alert of the thieves. Amma mistakes Kamlesh to be a thief and attacks him. Amma worries that she may have killed Kamlesh when the latter pretends to die.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh hide Kamlesh’s corpse - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets terrified on thinking about getting punished for killing Kamlesh. Further, Rajesh and Amma hide Kamlesh's corpse in the cupboard. Later, Happu asks Amma about Babuji's walking stick, and Amma tells him that it is kept in the cupboard.

episodesList.title: Happu to save Amma from punishment - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma confesses to killing Kamlesh before Happu, and he promises to save her from punishment. Kamlesh’s father arrives at Happu’s house looking for Kamlesh. Whereas, the commissioner decides to stay at Happu's house.

episodesList.title: Amma saved from going to jail - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a hungry Kamlesh goes into the kitchen but Amma mistakes him for a ghost and gets scared. Meanwhile, Kamlesh’s father threatens Happu. Happu’s family tries to dispose of Kamlesh’s body. To save his life, Kamlesh puts an end to his pretence.

episodesList.title: Happu ends up hurting Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma begins to feel that Happu does not love her. Nargis tells Amma of a way through which she could test the depth of Happu’s love. Whereas, Rajesh chides Happu for hurting Amma.

episodesList.title: Amma gets herself kidnapped - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, in need of money, Beni pretends to kidnap Amma on her request. Then, he calls Happu and asks for ransom. The news of Amma’s kidnapping leaves everyone worried.

episodesList.title: Beni threatens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner gives an advice to Happu. Beni threatens to kill Amma when Happu fails to pay him the ransom. Kamlesh clicks pictures of everyone in the house on Amma’s request and gets scared on seeing one of the pictures.

episodesList.title: Beni and Kamlesh get jailed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu arrives at the place suggested by Beni with the ransom. Malaika catches Kamlesh and Beni red-handed. Since Amma has lost her voice, she is unable to reveal the truth to the family members. Happu locks Beni and Kamlesh in jail and thrashes them.

episodesList.title: The truth finally comes out - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the doctor informs that Amma has lost her voice permanently. An incident restores Amma’s voice and she confesses to getting herself kidnapped. A guilty Happu profusely apologises to Beni and helps him financially.

episodesList.title: Malaika instigates Kat against Kamlesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika complains to Rajesh that Kamlesh is a bad influence on Kat. She then comes up with an idea to keep Kat away from Kamlesh. Later, she instigates Kat against Kamlesh, and Kat gets angry at him.

episodesList.title: Amma ousts Kamlesh from the house - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi tells Amma that Kamlesh’s father had badmouthed Kat before them. On Amma’s behest, Malaika kicks Kamlesh out of the house. Later, when Kamlesh tries to sneak in through the bedroom window, Kat pushes him from the ladder on Malaika’s instigation.

episodesList.title: Rajesh confesses the truth - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Happu why she orchestrated the events that led to a fight between Kat and Kamlesh. Kat tells Happu that she aspires to be an air hostess and not a doctor. Rajesh confesses her wrongdoings before Kat.

episodesList.title: Happu’s family demands for gifts - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family demands presents from him on ‘Dussehra’. Gulab Singh, an acquaintance of the commissioner, arrives at the police station to file a complaint for his missing dog. Whereas, Kat and Kamlesh rehearse for a play.

episodesList.title: Gulab Singh gets attracted to Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Gulab Singh visits Beni’s house and leers at Rajesh. He is left stunned on learning that Rajesh is Happu’s wife. Happu gets angry when he hears Rajesh praising Gulab Singh. The next day, Gulab Singh brings presents for everyone in Happu’s family.

episodesList.title: Gulab Singh gives a love letter to Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh gets Gulab Singh’s love letter along with his gift, which makes Happu angry. Meanwhile, the priest tells Amma that she will face something catastrophic in her life. Later, Gulab Singh plots to create suspicion in Rajesh’s mind against Happu.

episodesList.title: Gulab Singh accepts Malaika’s challenge - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, by telling Rajesh about Gulab Singh’s ploy, he clarifies her misunderstanding. On Malaika’s provocation, Gulab Singh agrees to fight a boxing match with Happu. Happu fears losing at Gulab Singh’s hands but Malaika assures him that she will train him.

episodesList.title: The boxing match begins - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika wakes Happu early in the morning to make him exercise. Happu’s family tries to motivate him to win the match. Later, the boxing match between Happu and Gulab Singh begins.

episodesList.title: Happu defeats Gulab Singh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Gulab Singh's beating leaves Happu breathless. With his family’s encouragement, Happu succeeds in defeating Gulab Singh. Further, Happu gets trapped in the fight between Amma and Rajesh over their rights at home.

episodesList.title: Amma gets the house’s ownership - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu stops Rajesh from leaving the house. The next day, Beni reads Pitaji’s will and declares that Amma is the rightful owner of the house. Later, Beni reveals a secret about the will to Happu and Rajesh overhears their conversation.

episodesList.title: Happu’s house gets divided - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh is declared the owner of the house as per Pitaji’s new will, but Amma refuses to accept it. Beni suggests that the house be divided to solve Amma and Rajesh’s conflict. Happu and the children follow through on Beni’s suggestion.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh’s feud continues - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, moved by the children’s plight, Amma and Rajesh allow them to use their sections of the house. Later, Happu tries to reason with Amma and Rajesh but they refuse to end their feud.

episodesList.title: Happu to keep a fast for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, due to the recent upheavals, Happu vents his anger on the family members. He also gets into an argument with Beni when the latter calls Amma selfish. Later, with Beni’s suggestion, he unites the family and decides to keep a fast for Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh finds Amma’s mother-in-law’s letters - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma taunts Rajesh for not being an obedient daughter-in-law. Further, Rajesh finds letters written by Amma's mother-in-law Savitri, in which she has criticised Amma. Amma tells Rajesh to prepare for a ‘puja’ for her mother-in-law's death anniversary.

episodesList.title: Rajesh acts like Amma’s mother-in-law - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, during the ‘puja’, Rajesh starts speaking like Amma's mother-in-law, Savitri. Amma feels that Savitri’s soul has possessed Rajesh and becomes scared of her. Meanwhile, Kat tries a trick to change Malaika's angry nature.

episodesList.title: Amma learns about Rajesh’s pretence - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh orders Amma to prepare breakfast. Kamlesh is left surprised by Malaika's generosity. Pitaji tells Amma a secret related to Savitri's letters. When Amma realises that Rajesh is pretending to be possessed, she resolves to teach her a lesson.

episodesList.title: Amma’s false story - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma’s false story scares Rajesh. She tells Happu that Amma is a murderer and is about to kill her. To save themselves, Happu and Rajesh try to escape from the house with their children.

episodesList.title: Happu fasts for Rajesh on ‘Karwa Chauth’ - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma taunts Happu for keeping the ‘Karwa Chauth’ fast for Rajesh. Everyone celebrates ‘Karwa Chauth’ together. Hrithik insists on getting firecrackers for ‘Diwali’. Later, Happu and Rajesh bicker over their jobs and Kamlesh shares a good news with Kat.

episodesList.title: Happu’s hurtful words upset Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu criticises the breakfast prepared by Rajesh. In a fit of rage, he says that he regrets marrying her. The commissioner reprimands Happu before Beni. Kamlesh’s uncle, Bittu offers to hire Kat as an air hostess for his airline.

episodesList.title: Rajesh becomes an inspector - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner exposes Happu’s lies before Amma and Rajesh. Later, he suspends Happu and gives his job to Rajesh to teach him a lesson. Over a few drinks, Happu shares his woes with Beni, and gets irritated when Kamlesh and Kat interrupt him.

episodesList.title: Happu struggles with the household chores - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu blames Rajesh for his woes. The next morning, Amma tells Happu to takeover Rajesh’s household duties. When Happu calls Rajesh for assistance, she dismisses him and tells him to manage on his own. Beni mocks Happu when he sees him washing clothes.

episodesList.title: KD Pathak threatens Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets lunch for Rajesh at the police station. The next morning, a smuggler named KD Pathak visits Rajesh and tells her to release the trucks she had seized. He threatens her with dire consequences when she refuses to relent.

episodesList.title: KD Pathak kidnaps Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, KD Pathak gets Happu kidnapped to force Rajesh into doing his bidding. Along with the commissioner and Manohar, Rajesh arrests KD Pathak and frees Happu. After patching up their differences, Rajesh and Happu celebrate ‘Diwali’ with their family.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s behaviour worries Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh gets embarrassed before Amma and the kids due to Happu. Rajesh’s disinterest in him bothers Happu and he confides in Amma. Meanwhile, Kamlesh overhears Malaika and Kat’s conversation and decides to use the knowledge to impress the latter.

episodesList.title: Happu poses as his twin Pappu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Happu to pose as his fictional twin brother Pappu to impress Rajesh. The next morning, Happu tells Rajesh that in his absence, Pappu will handle his household chores. Happu undergoes a makeover and arrives at the house as Pappu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh impressed with Pappu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh becomes impressed with Pappu. Kamlesh’s new look displeases Kat. Rajesh praises Pappu in front of Happu, making the latter angry. Further, Rajesh and the children rejoice at their plan to fool Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s infidelity saddens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, seeing Rajesh’s growing attachment towards Pappu, Happu thinks that she doesn’t love him at all. Meanwhile, Kat doesn’t like Kamlesh’s new look. Believing Rajesh to be unfaithful towards him, Happu gets sad.

episodesList.title: Happu tests Rajesh’s love - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Happu to test Rajesh’s love. Further, Rajesh agrees to elope with Pappu and her children help her with the same. Eventually, Happu reveals the truth about Pappu to everyone.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s cousin to pay her a visit - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh is unhappy with the news of Adveer’s impending visit to Kanpur. Later, she learns about the arrival of her cousin, Laila. Beni decides to become a partner in Kat and Kamlesh’s new business. Rajesh plots to stop Adveer from coming to Kanpur.

episodesList.title: Amma sees Happu in Laila’s embrace - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu brings Laila home. To get some tea, Laila goes to the kitchen at night and takes Happu along. Amma sees Laila hugging Happu and misunderstands the situation. The next day, Amma inaugurates Beni, Kat and Kamlesh's new hotel.

episodesList.title: Kat tells Rajesh about Laila's behaviour - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Laila to maintain distance from Happu. The commissioner tells Happu his secret. Later, Happu takes Laila to Beni's restaurant for dinner. Laila's behaviour surprises Kat and she tells Rajesh the whole truth.

episodesList.title: Laila, the theif - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh catches Happu red-handed. After Laila leaves the house, the family members learn about the theft and the real Laila makes an entry. Happu narrates the incident to Beni. Later, a nightmare leaves Rajesh scared.

episodesList.title: Rajesh tells Amma about her nightmare - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma hides a truth about her past from Happu. Rajesh tells Amma about her nightmare. At night, a drunk Happu falls over a pile of garbage. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu indefinitely.

episodesList.title: Happu is left upset after losing his job - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family feel embarrassed on seeing a news about him on TV. Rajesh gets terrified on spotting a moneylender outside the house. Happu goes to Beni’s house and drowns his sorrows in alcohol. His condition leaves Amma and Rajesh worried.

episodesList.title: Amma resumes her old job - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi think of a way to get Happu his job back. Rajesh looks for a job to cover the household expenses. Amma resumes her former profession to take care of the family, and Beni learns the truth about it.

episodesList.title: Happu learns the truth about Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Ranbir, Hrithik and Chamchi curse the commissioner at the police station. The commissioner agrees to hire Happu back if he succeeds in nabbing a pickpocket. Happu agrees to the commissioner’s condition but gets shocked on learning the pickpocket’s name.

episodesList.title: Rajesh ousts Happu from the house - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu is unable to arrest Amma. The commissioner revokes Happu’s suspension. Later, Rajesh ousts Happu from the house after a fight. Beni refuses to accommodate Happu at his house due to Amma’s threat.

episodesList.title: Rajesh invites the commissioner for a party - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu starts staying in a tent outside the house. Rajesh speaks about the delicious food she had cooked to make him jealous. Later, she invites the commissioner for her faux birthday party and tells him to not get Happu along.

episodesList.title: Happu estranged from his family - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets upset on seeing everyone enjoying themselves at Rajesh’s faux birthday party. Hiding from everyone, Amma gives ‘roti’ to Happu. The next day, Happu’s ill health worries Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh resolve their differences - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu feigns illness to get back into the house, but gets caught by Rajesh. He badmouths Rajesh before Beni and Kamlesh, unaware that Rajesh is overhearing their conversation. Later, Rajesh and Happu patch up because of Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu buys a gold necklace for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh demands a gold necklace from Happu. Happu gets INR 1.5 lakhs in a property case. Further, he employs a homeless Kamlesh as a security guard at his house. Later, he buys a gold necklace for Rajesh from the money he got.

episodesList.title: Happu gives the necklace to Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gives the necklace he bought for Rajesh to Amma. Due to this reason, Rajesh gets insulted before her friends and gets angry at Happu. Happu goes to sleep at Beni’s house at night and tells him the reason behind Rajesh’s anger.

episodesList.title: Happu promises to get a necklace for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets happy on wearing the necklace and dances with Happu. To pacify Rajesh, Happu promises to get her a necklace like Amma’s. However, when the goldsmith’s artisan refuses to make another one, Happu comes up with an idea to fulfil his promise.

episodesList.title: Happu commits theft for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh and Pitaji see Happu stealing Amma’s necklace, which he later presents to Rajesh. Amma informs that her necklace was stolen. Rajesh discerns that Happu was the one who stole it. She flaunts it before Amma to make her jealous.

episodesList.title: Happu to steal the necklace once again - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Pitaji tells the name of the thief to Amma. Happu tells Amma the reason he stole the necklace. She tells him to steal it back from Rajesh. Happu decides to steal at night but unbeknownst to him, his kids lay out a trap for the thief.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh reminisce about the past - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, unaware that the thief is Happu, the children beat him up. The next day, Happu sees a lipstick stain on his handkerchief and chides Rajesh for it. Rajesh reminisces about the past. Later, Happu regales Beni with the stories of his and Rajesh’s past.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh’s plan to watch a movie fails - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu and Rajesh plan to go for a movie and Chamchi tells Amma about it. Due to Amma and the kids, Rajesh is unable to go to the movie theatre. Meanwhile, Happu, who is waiting for Rajesh, gets angry when she does not turn up.

episodesList.title: Happu tells Rajesh about Amma and the kids’ act - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu learns about the act staged by Amma and the kids. Inadvertently, he ends up telling Rajesh about the act as well. Later, Amma and the kids apologise to the couple and they get to spend some quality time together.

episodesList.title: Happu gets in trouble trying to romance Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the children watch the news of a theft incident on TV. Happu secretly comes to meet Rajesh to relive their memories. Mistaking him for a thief, Amma and the children beat him up. Regretting their mistake, they promise to not trouble the couple anymore.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Happu spend quality time together - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma slips and gets injured. At Amma’s behest, the children do not alert Rajesh and Happu about her injury when they return from their outing. Eventually, Happu and Rajesh learn the truth and get emotional on seeing Amma and kids' love towards them.

episodesList.title: Hrithik’s report card infuriates Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets angry on seeing Hrithik’s report card. He blames Rajesh for spoiling him. Rajesh agrees to help Happu reform Hrithik. Later, Pitaji wishes Amma on her birthday.

episodesList.title: Hrithik records a video of Amma dancing - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu scolds Hrithik who is playing cricket. Later, Amma sees Rajesh dancing at her birthday party and gives her an earful. At night, while Amma is dancing with Pitaji, Hrithik records the scene. The next day, he uses the video to blackmail Amma.

episodesList.title: Hrithik blackmails Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma chides Chamchi and slaps Beni on being blackmailed to do so by Hrithik. Rajesh calls Happu and tells him about Amma’s changed behaviour. Hrithik refuses to delete the video despite Amma’s request and continues to do as he pleases.

episodesList.title: Amma’s behaviour upsets Chamchi - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi gets upset with Amma’s changed behaviour towards her. Amma regrets her actions and apologises to Beni but also slaps him again. Later, she gets Hrithik’s favourite food prepared, which angers other family members.

episodesList.title: Rajesh puts forth a condition in front of Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik gets delighted as Amma beats Happu. Rajesh and Happu come to know that Hrithik is the one who has Amma's dance video and he is blackmailing her. Amma apologies to Rajesh who then puts forth a condition before Amma to forgive her.

episodesList.title: Amma finds a suitable groom for Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a priest predicts Kat’s future and advises Amma to get her married soon. The news saddens Kamlesh but he pretends to be happy before Kat. However, his pretence leaves Kat heartbroken. Further, Amma finds a suitable match for Kat.

episodesList.title: Rajesh selects a prospective groom for Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh chooses a collector’s son as a match for Kat. She and Amma insist on getting Kat married to the boy of their choosing. Their squabble over the matter annoys Happu. Later, Kamlesh professes his feelings to Kat through the story of his novel.

episodesList.title: Kat’s question upsets Kamlesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh taunt each other during breakfast. The commissioner jokes with Happu at the police station. A question asked by Kat upsets Kamlesh and leaves him in tears. Later, he faints near Beni’s house.

episodesList.title: Prospective grooms come to meet Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh comes to Happu’s house to help with the chores. Collector Rajveer Singh and his son Bunty come to meet Kat. Seeing Bunty and Kat talking upsets Kamlesh. Before Bunty and his father could leave, the commissioner arrives with his son.

episodesList.title: Kat and Bittu’s alliance doesn’t get fixed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajveer and Bunty leave Happu’s house in a huff. Amma agrees to not fix Kat’s alliance with Bittu. The commissioner threatens Happu when he turns down the alliance with his son. Later, a court order leaves the commissioner shocked.

episodesList.title: Happu confides in Beni about his problem - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu confides in Beni about his health condition. Meanwhile, Karishma gives an idea to Rajesh to solve her problem. Later, Beni takes Happu to a hakim for treatment. Happu gets shocked on seeing Commissioner Resham Pal there as well.

episodesList.title: Rajesh tells Happu that she is pregnant - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the hakim gives some medicines to Happu for his condition. Later, Happu jumps with joy when Rajesh tells him that she is pregnant again. Beni senses something is fishy when Happu shares this news with him.

episodesList.title: Happu doubts Rajesh’s character - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma takes care of Rajesh. Meanwhile, Happu doubts Rajesh’s character as he feels she is carrying someone else’s child. Later, Amma and the children think of names for the baby. Their conversation saddens Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni get into a tussle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu questions Rajesh about her pregnancy. A conversation with Hrithik convinces Happu that Rajesh is pregnant with Beni’s child. While Happu and Beni get into a tussle, Amma prepares for Rajesh’s baby shower.

episodesList.title: Happu gets happy when the truth unfolds - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu pacifies Beni and shares his plight with him. During the baby shower, Happu tells Amma that he is not the father of Rajesh’s child. Later, he gets delighted when the truth unfolds.

episodesList.title: Happu buys a car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, everyone blackens their faces to convince Happu to buy a car. Happu returns home and on learning that he has bought a car, everyone leaps with joy. Later, Malaika dislikes a dress gifted by Kamlesh to Kat.

episodesList.title: Happu’s love for his car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu forbids Amma and Rajesh from taking the car to the market as he fears them causing damage to it. Karishma runs into Amma and Rajesh and the duo requests her to drop them to their home. Later, the family members get upset due to Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu’s car gets damaged - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh promises Beni that she will get him married to Vimlesh in the new year. After the new year celebrations, Happu’s kids and Kamlesh secretly take the car out for a drive. When the car gets a dent, they try to keep Happu from learning about it.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh suggests an idea - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Ranbir and Chamchi tell Rajesh about the damage to the car. A mechanic takes the car away for repair. Kamlesh suggests an idea to keep Happu in the dark about it. Kamlesh's uncle Kripal Singh files a missing complaint for his car at the police station.

episodesList.title: Happu’s car gets sold - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu learns that his car got damaged. Recalling a past instance, he forgives the kids. After the mechanic returns the car, Makwana buys it from Happu and sells it to another person. The person’s identity leaves Happu shocked.

episodesList.title: Happu’s childhood incident - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu beats Kamlesh on Malaika’s provocation. Karishma tells Rajesh about the antics of their friends’ philandering husbands, making Rajesh angry. Amma tells Chamchi about the incident when Happu had lost his memory.

episodesList.title: Rajesh becomes suspicious of Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a woman tries to get close to Happu at the police station. Due to a misunderstanding, Rajesh suspects Happu and fights with him. While Happu clears her misunderstanding, Rajesh later finds a strand of woman’s hair on his sweater.

episodesList.title: Happu loses his memory - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu runs to escape from an angry Rajesh. He loses his memory after falling from the stairs. He addresses himself as Micchu Phupha and mistakes the others for servants and berates them. Later, Amma blames Rajesh for Happu’s condition.

episodesList.title: Happu pretends to be Micchu Phupha - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu tells everyone to leave the house. Further, he tells Beni why he is pretending to be Micchu Phupha. Continuing with the charade, he behaves inappropriately with Rajesh. Meanwhile, Kat and Kamlesh come up with an idea to get Happu’s memory back.

episodesList.title: Amma puts on an act - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kat and Kamlesh’s plan to help Happu regain his memory backfires. Rajesh learns about Happu’s pretence and tells Amma about it. Amma puts on an act to force Happu to come clean.

episodesList.title: Happu upset on not getting the carrot pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family, on Makar Sankranti, indulge themselves in kite flying. Happu refuses to have dinner when he doesn’t get the pickle made out of black carrot and goes to Beni’s house instead. To appease Happu, Amma and Rajesh decide to make the pickle.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Amma argue over making the pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh and Amma argue over making a pickle of black carrots for Happu. Malaika gives a suggestion to Happu to resolve their differences. Further, Amma and Rajesh begin with the preparations for making the pickle. Malaika blackmails Kat using a picture.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh plan to spoil the other’s pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh plan to spoil each other’s pickle. Later, Amma and Rajesh both prepare the pickle and leave it in the sunlight. Meanwhile, Hrithik and Chamchi learn that Malaika has been blackmailing Kat.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh keep a watch over their pickles - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi and Hrithik blackmail Kamlesh by showing him the photograph. On their behest, Kamlesh comes to spoil Amma and Rajesh’s pickles but Happu and Beni beat him up. Later, Amma and Rajesh brave the cold to watch over their pickles.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh regret making the pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh bring Happu home from the police station using threats. Chamchi blindfolds him and makes him taste the pickles made by them. Stuck in a tight spot, Happu puts up an act which makes Amma and Rajesh regret making the pickle.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh fight over onions - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma chides Rajesh for making onion pakoras as they are expensive. An upset Rajesh vents out her anger at Happu. Having overheard their conversation, Chamchi tells Amma about it. Fed up with Amma and Rajesh’s quarrels, Happu gives Beni an advice.

episodesList.title: Rajesh accepts Amma’s challenge - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh accepts Amma’s challenge of managing the household expenses on a budget. Happu invites the commissioner for a meal and the latter makes a request. Hrithik gets upset on not getting his favourite food, but Rajesh finds a way to fulfil his wish.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s idea to manage the household expenses - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu asks Rajesh for money to pay for the commissioner’s feast. On Rajesh’s behest, Beni fills the bottle with cheap liquor. When the commissioner comes home, Happu serves him the liquor. Beni fears that his actions will come to light.

episodesList.title: The commissioner falls sick - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner falls sick upon drinking the cheap liquor. Rajesh gives Happu a suggestion while Amma plans to make the commissioner drink the cheap liquor again. The next day, Happu apologises to the commissioner and invites him again for a treat.

episodesList.title: Amma teaches Rajesh budget management - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma swaps the liquor bottle. The commissioner again falls sick upon drinking cheap liquor. Amma gives him a lesson and he promises to never consume alcohol. Amma tells Rajesh her reason behind swapping the bottle and Rajesh realises her mistake.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s brother Cheetar to visit her - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu enquires with the kids about their studies. Rajesh’s brother Cheetar tells her about him coming to meet her. When Amma objects to his visit, Happu manages to convince her. Later, the commissioner shares his woes with Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu flatters Cheetar - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh does not pay heed to Amma and prepares food of Cheetar’s choice. Cheetar is given a grand welcome but his sense of humour displeases Amma. Later, Happu and Beni flatter Cheetar for selfish purposes.

episodesList.title: Happu is annoyed due to Cheetar - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Cheetar brings a pack of cards and bothers Rajesh and Happu. The next morning, Happu is forced to go in the woods to relieve himself because of Cheetar. For this, the commissioner fines Happu. Later, Happu is infuriated with Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Is Cheetar eyeing Amma's trunk? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma doubts Cheetar’s intentions when he questions her about the trunk. Happu, too, grows suspicious of Cheetar. Cheetar asks Happu for INR 20 lakhs. Mistaking him to be a terrorist, Makwana and the commissioner thrash Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Cheetar gets exposed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma agrees to give Happu a sum of INR 20 lakhs. Happu and others talk to Cheetar about how to get promoted. Just as Cheetar walks away with the money, everyone learns that he is a fraud. Later, Amma makes a revelation.

episodesList.title: Hrithik announces his decision of becoming an actor - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
episodesList.summary: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu chides Hrithik for bunking school and going for a movie instead. Hrithik informs him that he wants to be an actor. Pitaji tells Amma that he too aspired to be an actor. The commissioner’s son runs way from home to become an actor.

episodesList.title: Happu Lays down a Condition Before Kamlesh
episodesList.summary: Beni suggests Happu an idea to separate Kat and Kamlesh. The family learns that both of them were pretending to be married. Happu lays down a condition before Kamlesh to let Kat and Kamlesh stay.

episodesList.title: Kat and Kamlesh finally reveal the truth
episodesList.summary: Rajesh makes Kat do the household chores, while Kamlesh struggles to run his food stall. When the family tries to get them married in a traditional way, Kat and Kamlesh reveal the truth to everyone.

episodesList.title: Rajesh belittles Amma’s brother Atbir
episodesList.summary: Rajesh boasts about her brother Dumar’s affluence and belittles Amma’s brother Atbir. Later, Dumar calls Rajesh and asks her to help him with INR 50,000, leaving her speechless.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s Business Idea Irks Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and the kids decide to start a catering business and excitedly inform Amma about the same. But, Amma instigates Happu against Rajesh, and they both argue about Rajesh’s new venture.

episodesList.title: Amma Learns Rajesh and Dumar’s Truth
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and the kids discuss about the menu and the brochure and hire Kamlesh as the delivery boy. Later, Amma overhears Rajesh and Dumar’s conversation and reveals the truth to Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu and Amma Devise a Plan
episodesList.summary: Rajesh makes Kat accompany Kamlesh to deliver the tiffin. As per Amma’s instructions, Happu asks Manohar to stop them, but he lets them go after taking a bribe, leaving Amma furious.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Is Baffled on Learning the Truth
episodesList.summary: Amma and Happu devise a plan to stop Rajesh’s business, but their plan backfires. Rajesh chides Amma for conspiring against her but later apologises to Amma when Chamchi reveals the entire truth.

episodesList.title: An Upset Amma Decides to Leave the House
episodesList.summary: Amma tries to narrate a story about her and Pitaji but is left heartbroken to realise that nobody has time to talk to her. She later decides to permanently shift to Baba Mokshanand’s ashram with Beni.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Decision Shocks Everyone
episodesList.summary: Resham Pal tells Happu how his father’s decision to shift to Baba Mokshanand’s ashram has disturbed him. Amma too announces her decision of shifting to the same ashram, leaving everyone shocked.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Actions Upset Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Amma takes back the necklace from Rajesh and gives her a pair of earrings. But, at Pitaji’s insistence, she takes back the earrings too. Meanwhile, the kids decide to stop Amma from leaving the house.

episodesList.title: Will Rajesh and Happu Brainwash Amma?
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Happu think of ways to stop Amma from going to the ashram. Beni forbids Amma from having non-veg food. But, provoked by Vimlesh’s letter, he eats non-veg food and gets slapped by Amma.

episodesList.title: Will Amma go to the Ashram?
episodesList.summary: Happu’s efforts to stop Amma from going to the ashram fail. Beni learns about the kids’ conspiracy. Unable to see her family in tears, Amma takes an unexpected decision.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Height Embarrasses Him
episodesList.summary: Happu’s family gathers for a photoshoot. The kids mock Happu for being shorter than Rajesh. Later, when Rajesh’s friends, Sanju and Mohini, visit them, Happu’s height leaves him further embarrassed.

episodesList.title: Happu Lies about His Height
episodesList.summary: Rajesh, Sanju, and Mohini’s conversation revolves around taller men, leaving Happu upset. Later, when Rajesh apprises Happu of the competition's criteria, he lies to her about his height.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Foils Happu’s Plans
episodesList.summary: As per Beni’s advice, Happu wears high-heeled shoes to look taller than Rajesh in the competition. However, Rajesh foils his plans as she too buys high-heeled sandals, leaving Happu annoyed.

episodesList.title: Chamchi Plans to Help Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu avoids the competition inspector. Later, Rajesh informs Happu about Sanju and Mohini inviting them for dinner at their place. Chamchi decides to help Happu and executes her plan.

episodesList.title: Amma Teaches Happu a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Rajesh overhears Chamchi's confession about stealing the sandals at Happu’s behest. Happu’s patriarchal thoughts irk Amma, who gives him an earful. A guilt-ridden Happu apologises to her and Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Falls for Hrithik’s Lies
episodesList.summary: The principal informs Happu and Rajesh about Hrithik failing in all subjects. Hrithik puts up an act and lies about wanting to become a doctor. Everyone vows to make his dream come true.

episodesList.title: Happu Brings Resham Pal Home
episodesList.summary: Resham Pal tells Happu that he wishes to settle in the Himalayas and give away his entire property to a big, loving family. Happu brings him home, where Amma, Rajesh, and the kids put up a charade.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Family’s Emotional Act
episodesList.summary: Happu and his family continue to put up an emotional charade before Resham Pal to compel him to give away his property to them. Beni too joins in, but to their dismay, Resham Pal remains unmoved.

episodesList.title: A Plan to Oust Resham Pal
episodesList.summary: Amma, Happu, and Rajesh realise that Resham Pal doesn’t intend to give them anything, and decide to oust him. Later, Beni arrives to demand INR 10 lakh from Happu in Resham Pal's presence.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh’s Conspiracies
episodesList.summary: Resham Pal is shocked to see Amma and Rajesh conspiring against each other. Later, when Happu and Resham Pal reveal the truth about their charades, Hrithik’s lies are exposed before everyone.

episodesList.title: Gopal’s Truth Comes to Light
episodesList.summary: Bala beats up Gopal to learn the truth and takes him captive. He also finds the man harassing Bhim. Later, Gopal’s father reveals Sarvagya Maharaj’s plan to Bala and his family.

episodesList.title: Resham Pal’s Advice to Happu
episodesList.summary: Amma successfully keeps Happu away from Rajesh by pretending to fall sick. Resham Pal advises Happu on how to remain young and healthy. Later, Beni gives Happu a solution to his problem.

episodesList.title: Resham Pal’s Advice to Happu
episodesList.summary: Amma successfully keeps Happu away from Rajesh by pretending to fall sick. Resham Pal advises Happu on how to remain young and healthy. Later, Beni gives Happu a solution to his problem.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s Pregnancy Angers Amma
episodesList.summary: Amma tells Rajesh and Happu about her dream, and they assure her that they don’t plan to have any more babies. The next day, Rajesh learns about her pregnancy, and Amma decides to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Amma Tries to Learn the Truth
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Happu argue over informing Amma about Rajesh’s pregnancy. Resham Pal cancels Happu’s promotion on learning about him becoming a father again. Amma devises new plans to learn Rajesh’s truth.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Kids Blackmail Him
episodesList.summary: The kids threaten to divulge the truth to Amma and blackmail Happu and Rajesh into fulfilling their demands. Later, Amma loses her cool on learning the truth about Rajesh’s pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Happu Lies to the Principal
episodesList.summary: Amma feels at peace to learn that Rajesh is not pregnant. She suggests Amma a plan to make Happu get rid of his habit of lying. Meanwhile, he saves his kids from punishment by lying to the principal.

episodesList.title: Happu Vows to Speak the Truth
episodesList.summary: Beni warns Happu of dire consequences if he reveals the truth. However, Happu vows to always speak the truth for Amma. Malaika tells Kat to ask Kamlesh as well to vow to speak the truth.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh Batter Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu’s decision to speak only the truth puts him in trouble, and Amma and Rajesh beat him black and blue. Kat makes Kamlesh promise that he will never lie to her, and his words leave her heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Amma Gives an Order to Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Beni that Rajesh will never get Vimlesh married to a loser like him. Amma tells Happu that he doesn’t need to speak the truth henceforth. Kamlesh’s harsh words leave Kat heartbroken.

episodesList.title: A Shocking Remedy for Happu
episodesList.summary: When Amma narrowly escapes an accident, Happu decides to speak only the truth and even gets his kids dismissed. A pundit suggests a shocking remedy for Happu, but Pitaji saves him from the torture.

episodesList.title: Will Rajesh Catch Happu Red-Handed?
episodesList.summary: Happu and Manohar reassure Haseena. A suspicious Rajesh arrives at the hotel with Amma where the manager lies to her. Happu asks Haseena to show him a place to hide.

episodesList.title: Haseena’s Lies Put Happu in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh catch Happu red-handed with Haseena in a room. Haseena lies to them to save Happu, but he still lands in trouble. Later, Rajesh decides to test Happu to learn the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Refuses to Recognise His Kids
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh's kids arrive at the hotel. Amma and Beni suggest Rajesh an idea. When Happu refuses to recognise his own kids, Rajesh asks Beni for his help and makes a promise to him.

episodesList.title: Haseena Stops Happu from Confessing the Truth
episodesList.summary: Happu treats Beni as a stranger. Later, Happu gets upset when his kids cry. Haseena stops Happu from telling the truth to Rajesh. The manager provokes Rajesh against Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Tricks to Find the Truth
episodesList.summary: Amma tests Happu when he refuses to recognise them. Rajesh feels that Happu has cheated on her. She tries another trick when Happu doesn't speak out the truth even after being taught a lesson.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh's Honeymoon
episodesList.summary: Happu confesses the truth after seeing Rajesh and the hotel manager's engagement. Later, Manohar allays Hasina's worries. A few days later, Happu takes Rajesh back to the hotel for a honeymoon.

episodesList.title: Kat Visits a Hotel with Kamlesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Happu see Kat and Kamlesh arriving at the hotel. The manager informs Happu that Kat and Kamlesh are going to get married at the temple. Amma arrives at the hotel with Chamchi and Malaika.

episodesList.title: Beni, Ranbir and Hrithik at the Hotel
episodesList.summary: Kat meets Kamlesh after feeling scared, but his stories scare her even more. Amma, Malaika and Chamchi hide when they see Beni, Ranbir and Hrithik at the hotel. Happu calls Amma to find out the truth.

episodesList.title: All the Lies Come to the Fore
episodesList.summary: The hotel manager accidentally activates the fire alarm. Everyone comes out and their lies are exposed. Later, Rajesh waits for Happu in a garden. Meanwhile, Happu sits with Beni to drink.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Fights with Happu
episodesList.summary: Angry on seeing Happu drinking alcohol with Beni, Rajesh gets into a fight with Happu. Amma suggests an idea to reconcile Rajesh and Happu. Later, Hrithik gives a letter to Happu.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Seeks Happu's Help
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh reconcile when they go on a dinner date. Later, the commissioner seeks help from Happu's family for his sister-in-law Rusha's marriage alliance and introduces them to her.

episodesList.title: Kat Agrees to Help Rusha
episodesList.summary: Kat agrees to help break Rusha’s alliance. Happu greets the suitor’s family. Beni shares his idea with Kat and Rusha. He assumes a disguise and tells a false story to Happu and the Commissioner.

episodesList.title: Happu and Resham Pal Are Scared
episodesList.summary: Chamchi blackmails Hrithik and Ranbir. Kamlesh, disguised as Kalpana Shaitani, appears in front of Happu and Resham Pal. Luchcha Shaitani reveals a fact that scares Happu and Resham Pal.

episodesList.title: Kat Slaps Praful
episodesList.summary: Rusha, along with Kat, visits Praful. Kat slaps Praful, and Resham Pal apprises Happu of Kat's actions. Happu asks Kat for an explanation. Surprisingly, Kat behaves strangely and slaps Manohar.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan Gets Foiled
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Rusha and Praful to spend time together. Kat arrives there and slaps Praful. The commissioner gets upset with Happu due to Kat's actions. Later, Kat refers to herself as Kalpana Shaitani.

episodesList.title: The Hotel Bill Shocks Happu
episodesList.summary: Rusha's marriage alliance breaks up. Manohar apprises Resham Pal of Rusha and Kat's plan. Resham Pal apologises to Rusha. Later, Resham Pal and Happu are shocked to see the hotel bill.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Moves to Her Maternal Home
episodesList.summary: Rajesh moves to her maternal house after an argument with Happu. Later, Happu does not allow Kamlesh to stay and Kat comes up with an idea. Resham Pal's wife asks Happu for his help.

episodesList.title: Amma Meets a Woman in a Temple
episodesList.summary: Kat brings Kamlesh, disguised as Kamli, home. Happu's kids request him to get Rajesh back. Amma and Nargis meet a woman in a temple, who pretends to be in misery. Nargis gives Amma a piece of advice.

episodesList.title: Amma Lands in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Amma brings Chandni home. Happu complains to Amma about Chandni. Later, Amma tells Chandni to leave the house, but she threatens Amma and demands INR two lakhs.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Rid of Chandni
episodesList.summary: Amma tells Happu about Chandni’s threat. Malaika learns that Kamlesh is posing as Kamli. Later, Kamlesh apologises to Happu, while Happu gets rid of Chandni due to Beni’s idea.

episodesList.title: Dumar Fails to Send the Mangoes
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Dumar to send mangoes to the house before Atbir. Later, Amma and Rajesh argue about ordering mangoes. When Dumar fails to send the mangoes, Rajesh gives a task to Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Atbir Delivers the Mangoes
episodesList.summary: A disguised Kamlesh brings mangoes and states that Dumar has sent them. The kids criticise the mangoes. Later, Atbir sends some mangoes and Rajesh employs a trick to prevent Amma from eating them.

episodesList.title: Amma Yearns to Eat Mangoes
episodesList.summary: Rajesh deprives Amma of mangoes. Later, the commissioner threatens to transfer Happu, who fails to provide two boxes of mangoes to him. Meanwhile, Rajesh tempts Amma by eating a mango in front of her.

episodesList.title: Happu Steals the Mangoes
episodesList.summary: Rajesh refuses to give Happu two boxes of mangoes for the commissioner. At night, Happu tries to steal the mangoes from Rajesh’s room. Chamchi and Kamlesh arrive as well to steal the mangoes.

episodesList.title: Amma Relishes the Mangoes
episodesList.summary: Amma learns that she is not diabetic and discerns Rajesh’s ploy. Later, she puts on an act with the doctor. Rajesh apologises to Amma for her mistake and feeds her the mangoes.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner’s Accusation on Happu
episodesList.summary: When Dumar is arrested for possessing fake certificates, Happu refuses to get him released. Later, Happu gets into trouble when the commissioner accuses him of getting the job with a fake degree.

episodesList.title: Happu Worries about the Exams
episodesList.summary: Happu worries about the exams and confides in Beni. Later, Happu forcefully feeds the commissioner his favourite sweet. Miffed, the commissioner threatens to ask tough questions during the exams.

episodesList.title: Happu Bribes Manohar
episodesList.summary: Happu bribes Manohar and seeks his help to pass the exam. Beni tells Amma and Rajesh why Happu is worried. Later, Happu’s trick to pass the exam falls through.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Gets Caught Stealing
episodesList.summary: At Happu’s behest, Kamlesh goes to the commissioner’s house to steal the question paper but gets caught. As Happu fears losing his job, Hrithik and Ranbir suggest some tricks to him to pass the exam.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner’s Wife’s Revelation
episodesList.summary: The commissioner catches Happu cheating during the exam. The commissioner’s wife makes a revelation, which Happu uses to save his job. Later, Rajesh punishes Happu for not helping Dumar.

episodesList.title: Manohar Calls Rajesh Unlucky
episodesList.summary: Rajesh wakes up Happu. Later, Amma burns her tongue and begins to lisp. When Happu’s day at the police station goes bad, Manohar comments that Rajesh’s face is unlucky for him.

episodesList.title: Happu Incurs a Loss of INR Five Hundred
episodesList.summary: Happu sees Rajesh’s face upon waking up. At Rajesh’s behest, the kids apologise to Happu, while Kat connects with Kamlesh through a video call. Later, Happu incurs a loss of INR five hundred.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Suspends Happu
episodesList.summary: The commissioner suspends Happu for 15 days. This leads Happu to believe that Rajesh’s face is unlucky for him. Meanwhile, Kamlesh decides that Kat is unlucky for him and doesn’t meet her.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Hides Her Face
episodesList.summary: Rajesh overhears Happu telling Amma that her face is unlucky for him. Meanwhile, Malaika thrashes Kamlesh for calling Kat unlucky. The events lead Rajesh to hide her face from Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Realises His Mistake
episodesList.summary: Despite not seeing Rajesh’s face, Happu loses his job and gets beaten up. Rajesh decides to leave the house, while Happu realises his mistake. Later, Amma shares a piece of good news with Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu and Kamlesh Kill a Serpent
episodesList.summary: Amma tells Happu that he is going to be in trouble. Inadvertently, Happu and Kamlesh end up killing a shape-shifting serpent. Later, Happu gets scared when the serpent’s mate comes seeking revenge.

episodesList.title: Happu and Kamlesh Seek Help
episodesList.summary: Happu’s kids try to scare him with a fake snake. Kamlesh gets scared due to the shape-shifting serpent and confides in Happu. At the police station, Happu and Kamlesh seek help from a snake charmer.

episodesList.title: Happu Develops a Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Kat burn their tongues. The snake charmer reveals the identity of the serpent. Happu misunderstands Rajesh and the kids, while the snake charmer gives a ‘been’ to Happu and Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Slapped by the Commissioner
episodesList.summary: The commissioner slaps Happu when he plays the ‘been’. Happu assumes that Amma is the serpent, but as his misunderstanding resolves, he tells the truth to everyone. Later, the serpent gets caught.

episodesList.title: The Snake Charmer Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Happu sees the serpent once again. The snake charmer suggests Happu to perform a yagna. Rajesh becomes suspicious of the snake charmer and exposes him through her plan.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Dreams of Happu Going Bald
episodesList.summary: A bad dream prompts Rajesh to declare that she will divorce Happu if he ever goes bald. Meanwhile, Pitaji tells Amma about a rule of ‘Mrityalok’, and she decides to prevent Happu from going bald.

episodesList.title: Happu Suffers from Hair Fall
episodesList.summary: Happu gets nervous as he suffers from hair fall and seeks Beni’s help. Kamlesh suffers from hair fall as well and worries about Kat ending their friendship. Later, he dons a cap and goes to meet Kat.

episodesList.title: Amma Shares a Remedy for Hair Fall
episodesList.summary: Pitaji tells Amma that Happu is suffering from hair fall. Later, Amma shares a remedy with Happu and Hrithik overhears their conversation. Meanwhile, Chamchi and Ranbir extort money from Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu’s Hair Fall
episodesList.summary: Happu and Kamlesh fight to obtain the cow dung. Beni applies the cow dung on Happu’s hair and Rajesh overhears them. Kat learns about Kamlesh’s hair fall, while something troubles Amma and Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Why Is Happu Suffering from Hair Fall?
episodesList.summary: Happu’s family ousts him from the house as he suffers from hair fall. Happu and Kamlesh visit the doctor and learn the reason behind their condition. Later, Kamlesh thrashes Janeman Jalebiwala.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Suspects Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh has a bad dream, while Kamlesh hides black money behind Happu’s house. The commissioner suspects that Happu has black money. Happu shares his problem with Beni, who gives him an idea.

episodesList.title: An IT Officer Raids Happu’s House
episodesList.summary: Along with Manohar and the commissioner, the IT officer raids Happu’s house. Rajesh is interrogated when some jewellery is found in the kitchen. The officer also finds a lot of money during the raid.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Troubles Multiply
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh argue, while money is found from the kids’ room. Happu’s woes multiply when the commissioner gets his hands on Amma’s money and jewellery. Kamlesh tries to retrieve the black money.

episodesList.title: A Trunk Is Found in Happu’s House
episodesList.summary: A trunk is found in Happu’s house during the raid. Happu gets angry at Rajesh and inadvertently reveals a startling truth. Later, Happu seeks help from Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu Evades Arrest
episodesList.summary: The income tax officer, Inder, finds the black money buried in Happu’s garden. Later, Manohar arrives to arrest Happu. However, Happu evades arrest because of Pitaji.

episodesList.title: Amma to Tell the Importance of 15th August
episodesList.summary: Happu and his kids plan on how to spend the 15th August holiday. Amma decides to explain to them the significance of 15th August. She convinces the children to obey her by luring them with money.

episodesList.title: The Family Members Become Amma's Slaves
episodesList.summary: Amma appears as Colonel Katori and makes the family members her slaves. She turns the house into a central jail. When Beni shares an idea with Amma on how to celebrate 15th August, she beats him up.

episodesList.title: Colonel Katori's Atrocities
episodesList.summary: Colonel Katori wakes up Happu, Rajesh and the kids early in the morning. She orders Happu and the kids to clean the house and Rajesh to cook a meal. Beni tells Happu a trick to step out of the house.

episodesList.title: Colonel Katori Enslaves Beni
episodesList.summary: Colonel Katori gets her slaves to starve. Happu and Rajesh try to step out of the house with Beni's help. However, Colonel Katori catches them and enslaves Beni to punish him.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Honours Independence Day
