episodesList.summary: Reshampal visits Happu, and Colonel Katori enslaves him. Amma's attempt to explain the meaning of independence to the family is successful. Later, everyone celebrates Independence Day together.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Lie Infuriates Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Rajesh about his friend, Kavita. In retaliation, Rajesh tells him about her friend, Rahul. Later, Kamlesh comes up with a business idea while Rajesh gets angry at Happu’s lie.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Meets Her Friend
episodesList.summary: Rajesh meets her friend, Rahul, and invites him for a meal at her house. Happu tells Beni that Rajesh has gone somewhere in anger. When Rajesh returns home in a cheerful mood, Happu feels jealous.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Rahul Recall the Past
episodesList.summary: Amma and the kids leave the house for some work. At the police station, Happu worries about Rahul’s arrival in the absence of his family members. Later, Rajesh and Rahul reminisce about the past.

episodesList.title: Happu Feels Jealous of Rahul
episodesList.summary: When Happu returns home, Rajesh introduces him to Rahul. Rahul impresses Amma and Happu’s kids with expensive gifts. Happu feels jealous of Rahul and Manohar gives him an idea.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Gives a Fitting Reply to Rahul
episodesList.summary: Happu and Manohar’s plan backfires. Amma discerns Rahul’s intentions and ousts him from the house after reprimanding him. Later, Rajesh gives a fitting reply to Rahul when he offers to marry her.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Alcohol Addiction
episodesList.summary: On seeing Amma’s liquor bill, Happu tells Rajesh that Amma has an alcohol addiction. Later, Amma promises Happu that she will stop drinking alcohol, while the commissioner gives a task to Happu.

episodesList.title: A Trick to Curb Amma’s Addiction
episodesList.summary: Amma is unable to restrain herself and consumes alcohol. Happu seeks an idea from Rajesh to curb Amma’s addiction. Later, Beni tells Amma about Happu’s bad habit.

episodesList.title: Pitaji Gives an Advice to Amma
episodesList.summary: Amma gets worried on seeing Happu gambling. Pitaji gives an advice to Amma. The commissioner sees a photo in which Happu is gambling and suspends him. Later, Amma scolds Rajesh for shopping.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Shares Her Woes with Amma
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Amma that the family members developed bad habits in order to curb her addiction. The commissioner gives a final warning to Happu on seeing him gambling. Later, Amma confides in Pitaji.

episodesList.title: Beni Shares His Plight with Happu
episodesList.summary: The kids give up their bad habits on Amma’s insistence. Pitaji overhears Beni sharing his plight with Happu and tells Amma. Later, Happu and Amma talk to Rajesh about Beni and Vimlesh’s alliance.

episodesList.title: Happu Secretly Meets a Girl
episodesList.summary: Rajesh fights with Happu over a trivial matter and Happu believes that no one loves him. Rajesh gets upset on learning about her friend Joginder’s plight. Meanwhile, Happu secretly meets a girl.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu’s Affair
episodesList.summary: Rajesh shares her worry with Amma. The duo sees Happu meeting Rusha and fears that he will abandon their family for her. Later, Beni gives an idea to Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Tries to Please Him
episodesList.summary: Happu arrives home and everyone tries to please him. Happu learns the reason behind the family's sudden care towards him and tells the truth to Beni. Later, Happu continues his pretence.

episodesList.title: Happu's Rules for the Family
episodesList.summary: Rajesh narrates the incident of last night to Amma. Amma and Rajesh overhear Happu and Rusa's dangerous plan. Amma confronts Happu and he makes some rules for the family. Rajesh asks him for a chance.

episodesList.title: Happu Accepts Rajesh’s Conditions
episodesList.summary: Rajesh accepts Happu’s rules. Later, Rajesh and the commissioner learn the truth about Happu’s act. Rajesh teaches a lesson to Happu and asks him to accept her conditions to earn her forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Kat Wishes to Go to London
episodesList.summary: Kat wishes to pursue modelling in London. To elevate her standing amongst her friends, Rajesh demands that Kat be sent to London. However, Happu refuses to give in to her demands.

episodesList.title: Happu Refuses to Send Kat to London
episodesList.summary: Amma convinces Happu to send Kat to London. Kamlesh gets a bad dream after learning about Kat’s impending trip. Later, Happu learns about the fee amount and refuses to send Kat to London.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries to Raise Money
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh tries to stop Kat from going to London with his trick. Happu seeks the commissioner’s help to get a loan, but he refuses. Both Amma and Rajesh wish to accompany Kat and get into a fight.

episodesList.title: Hrithik and Chamchi Take Revenge
episodesList.summary: Hrithik and Chamchi avenge their insult. Kamlesh advises Kat to become a ‘swadeshi’ and not go to London. Happu gets upset when he is unable to raise the money for Kat’s fees.

episodesList.title: Amma Decides to Sell the House
episodesList.summary: Amma decides to sell off the house for Kat's trip to London. Kamlesh gets beaten up while trying to save Happu's house from being sold. Kat suddenly changes her mind and Kamlesh comes with a news.

episodesList.title: Beni’s Plight Moves Amma
episodesList.summary: Hrithik, Ranbir, and Chamchi strike a deal with Beni. They overhear Rajesh’s conversation with Vimlesh and tell Beni about it. Moved by Beni’s plight, Amma urges Rajesh to get him married to Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Beni Misbehaves with the Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Beni misbehaves with the commissioner. Happu tells Beni how to impress Rajesh’s father, Gabbar Singh. Gabbar Singh visits Happu’s house, where the commissioner arrives to complain about Beni.

episodesList.title: Beni Tries to Commit Suicide
episodesList.summary: Amma stops Gabbar Singh from leaving. Instead of impressing Gabbar Singh, Beni annoys him. Later, Rajesh takes a decision to stop Beni from committing suicide.

episodesList.title: Beni Gets Married to Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: Beni and Vimlesh get married. Before the couple’s wedding night, Rajesh gives an advice to Vimlesh, while Happu helps an anxious Beni. Later, Vimlesh plays a prank on Beni and scares him.

episodesList.title: Beni Spends the Night Outside His House
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh reminisce about their wedding night. The next morning, Happu rebukes Beni on seeing him sleeping outside his house. Later, Beni and Vimlesh spend some quality time together.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Insists on Going for a Honeymoon
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh tells Beni to take her abroad for their honeymoon. Happu’s kids tell Amma about their wish to visit Switzerland. Later, Beni asks Happu for an idea to avoid going on a honeymoon.

episodesList.title: Beni’s Mother’s Wish
episodesList.summary: Beni lies to Vimlesh and refuses to take her on a honeymoon. Happu and Beni decide to foil Rajesh’s trick upon getting some information from the kids. Nargis reveals Beni’s mother’s wish.

episodesList.title: Beni Puts On an Act
episodesList.summary: Happu agrees to take Rajesh to Switzerland for their honeymoon. Later, Beni sprains his back. The doctor lies to Vimlesh and dashes her hopes to go on a honeymoon.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Grants Leave to Happu
episodesList.summary: At Rajesh’s request, the commissioner grants leave to Happu for 10 days. The pandit predicts that Amma will travel abroad. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi give a solution to Vimlesh to cure Beni’s sprain.

episodesList.title: Beni and Vimlesh’s Honeymoon
episodesList.summary: Amma and the children too demand to go to Switzerland with Happu. Later, Amma expresses a wish. Beni explains to Vimlesh how helpless he is and just then, they receive a piece of good news.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Demands a Gift from Happu
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh tells Rajesh about Beni’s gift, leading Rajesh to demand a gift from Happu. Hrithik, Chamchi and Ranbir find a way to get their demands fulfilled. Meanwhile, the commissioner punishes Happu.

episodesList.title: Kat’s Demand
episodesList.summary: Happu brings slippers for Rajesh. Amma and Vimlesh tell Rajesh to demand an expensive gift from Happu. On getting blackmailed from Chamchi, Hrithik and Ranbir, Kat makes a demand from Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Expresses Her Wish to Beni
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh fulfils Kat’s demand. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi convey their next demand to Kat. Happu buys a pashmina shawl for Rajesh, who shows it to Vimlesh and Amma. Vimlesh expresses her wish to Beni.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s Secret Trick
episodesList.summary: Rajesh demands a diamond necklace from Happu. She shares her secret to get gifts from husbands with Amma and Vimlesh, and Happu overhears her. Amma complains to Pitaji for never giving her gifts.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Rein in Their Wives’ Demands
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh demands a diamond necklace from Beni. Kat blackmails Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi. Later, Happu and Beni try a trick to rein in their wives’ demands with Manohar's help.

episodesList.title: Happu Gives His House on Rent
episodesList.summary: The commissioner tells Happu about his leave. Kat tells Happu to give their house on rent to earn extra money and Rajesh agrees with her. Happu’s family’s plan gets foiled due to Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Family Stays at the Police Station
episodesList.summary: Happu’s family goes to stay at the police station. Manohar nabs a thief but Happu refuses to imprison him. Happu’s family sleeps in the jail and Rajesh tells Happu to spend quality moments with her.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Family in the Lock-Up
episodesList.summary: The commissioner returns when his leaves get cancelled. On learning about this, Happu gets worried. To save his job, he locks up his family in the jail and lies to the commissioner.

episodesList.title: The Tenants Refuse to Vacate Their House
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni’s tenants refuse to vacate their house. Happu’s tenant, Pramod, puts forth a condition before offering refuge to Happu in his own house. Meanwhile, Kamlesh learns that Kat is in jail.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells the Truth to the Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh works on his plan to get Kat out of the jail. The commissioner puts a criminal, Shakaal, in the lock up with Happu’s family. Happu confesses the truth to commissioner, who makes a revelation.

episodesList.title: The Negative Effect on Happu’s Kids
episodesList.summary: Happu takes his kids to witness Ram Leela. On seeing the kids’ behaviour, Amma tells Happu to lead them on the right path. Rajesh worries for the kids, while Kat seeks the commissioner’s help.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Regrets Helping Kat
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni try a trick to get the kids on the right path. The commissioner suffers the consequences of helping Kat. Happu’s kids tell him to give up honesty for a life of luxury.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Arrested for Stealing
episodesList.summary: To bring the kids on the right path, Happu robs Beni’s house. The CID officer arrests Happu for stealing. Later, Rajesh seeks Beni’s help, and he talks to Manohar.

episodesList.title: Beni Fails to Get Happu Released from Jail
episodesList.summary: Beni and Manohar get into trouble while trying to free Happu from the jail. Kat tells the commissioner about Happu’s arrest. The commissioner once again gets into trouble while helping Kat.

episodesList.title: Happu's Kids Learn a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: Tekamal’s Prediction about Kat
episodesList.summary: Rajesh vents her anger at everyone. Astrologer Tekamal makes a shocking prediction about Rajesh. Kamlesh angers Tekamal with his antics and to take revenge on him, Tekamal gives a suggestion to Kat.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s Terror
episodesList.summary: Happu tells the commissioner and Beni about Tekamal’s prediction. Later, Happu, Beni and Amma become fearful of Rajesh. When Kat makes an effort to stay away from Kamlesh, the latter threatens her.

episodesList.title: A Fearful Happu Runs Away from Rajesh
episodesList.summary: At Amma’s behest, the kids hide all the sharp tools. When Rajesh finds the knife missing from the kitchen, she gets angry. Later, Happu spots the gun in Rajesh’s hands and runs to the police station.

episodesList.title: Happu Fears Rajesh and Makes a Plan
episodesList.summary: Happu fears Rajesh’s anger and makes a plan. However, his plan gets foiled due to Beni. Later, Happu overhears Rajesh talking to Joginder and develops a misunderstanding.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Divulges the Truth
episodesList.summary: Happu tells the commissioner about Rajesh's plan to kill everyone. Along with Happu, the commissioner arrives to arrest Rajesh. Later, Rajesh tells everyone about the plan she devised with the pandit.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells Rajesh a False Story
episodesList.summary: Joginder, who visits Rajesh's house for dinner, taunts her and leaves. Happu tells Rajesh a false story to avoid her anger. Later, the news of Happu encountering aliens spreads like fire.

episodesList.title: The Aliens Keep an Eye on Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu boasts about his bravery in an interview while a few aliens keep an eye on him. His family is happy to see his photo in a newspaper. Kat distances Kamlesh when she finds a new friend.

episodesList.title: Happu to Get the Reward on a Condition
episodesList.summary: Rajesh, Amma and the kids take advantage of Happu’s fame. Later, a scientist from the Alien Research Institute visits Happu’s house. Later, he promises to reward INR 50 lakh to Happu on a condition.

episodesList.title: The Fake Proof Lands Happu in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Happu about the reward money. Happu gets greedy and tells Manohar the truth to get his help. Later, he shows the fake proof to the researcher and gets into trouble.

episodesList.title: Happu's Lies Come to the Fore
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Rajesh the truth. The family puts on an act in front of the researcher, but they are exposed. Happu soon tells the researcher the truth. Later, Happu and Beni actually see an alien.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Get Busy with Gambling
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni plan to gamble. The family members demand gifts on Diwali from Happu. Rajesh and Vimlesh wait for Happu and Beni to go for shopping, but the duo gets busy with gambling.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Get Caught while Gambling
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh learn about their husbands’ lie. Beni uses foul means to defeat the commissioner while gambling. Rajesh and Vimlesh see Beni and Happu gambling, and Amma gives them an idea.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Try Their Hand at Gambling
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh pretend to gamble in front of their husbands. Later, Happu and Beni take the duo along to gamble with them. However, the commissioner raids the gambling den.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Loses Happu while Gambling
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh and Rajesh lose their husbands when they put them on stake while gambling. Amma rejoices at her plan, while Manohar and Dr Udaas enslave Happu and Beni. Manohar makes Happu clean his shoes.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Diwali Gifts for His Family
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni's condition worsens due to being enslaved by Manohar and Dr Udas. Amma makes them realise that gambling is bad. Later, Happu gives gifts to his family and everyone celebrates Diwali.

episodesList.title: Chappu Arrives at Happu’s House
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Beni about his ex-lover, Sulochana. A boy named Chappu arrives and introduces himself as Happu and Sulochana’s son. Happu requests Rajesh to give him four days’ time to expose the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Looks for Sulochana
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Beni about Chappu. Amma accepts Chappu as her grandson. Chappu blackmails Kat and Kamlesh and prevents them from meeting. Later, Happu tells Manohar to locate Sulochana.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Plan to Learn Chappu’s Truth
episodesList.summary: Manohar fails to find Sulochana. The commissioner promises to get justice for Rajesh and threatens Happu. To learn the truth about Chappu, Happu makes a plan and seeks Beni’s help.

episodesList.title: Manohar Poses as Sulochana
episodesList.summary: Happu’s plan to learn Chappu’s truth fails, while Chappu troubles the kids. Manohar shares an idea with Happu and the commissioner overhears them. Happu brings Manohar home disguised as Sulochana.

episodesList.title: Chappu Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Beni arrives to bail out Happu. The commissioner tells them to provide the proof of Happu’s loyalty and releases him. Later, Chappu’s mother Leena arrives and tells the truth to everyone.

episodesList.title: Happu Insults Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Happu insults Rajesh. Rajesh overhears Happu and Beni’s conversation and decides to punish Happu. Later, Amma and Rajesh seek Dr Udaas’ help and he hires Rajesh as a nurse.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Poses as a Nurse
episodesList.summary: Posing as a nurse, Rajesh comes to Dr Udaas’ clinic and shares the plan with him. Later, Rajesh and Dr Udaas put on an act before the commissioner. The commissioner gives a piece of bad news to Happu.

episodesList.title: Beni’s Words Hurt Happu
episodesList.summary: The kids and Amma put on an act in front of Happu. Happu tells Beni what the commissioner told him about Rajesh. Rajesh and Dr Udaas act in front of Beni as well. Beni relates the events to Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s Disloyalty Hurts Happu
episodesList.summary: A bad dream scares Happu and he reaches Dr Udaas’ clinic to find the truth. Rajesh and Dr Udaas put on an act in front of him. Later, an upset Happu returns home and relates the events to Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu Realises Rajesh’s Value
episodesList.summary: Rajesh decides to leave the house for Dr Udaas. Happu apologises to Rajesh and Amma makes him realise Rajesh’s value. Later, Happu learns about Amma’s ploy.

episodesList.title: An Argument Between Happu and Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Amma concocts a tale about herself and her father, causing a quarrel between Happu and Rajesh. Rajesh accepts Happu's challenge. Later, Happu goes to Beni's house, and Vimlesh goes to Rajesh's house.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni’s Mutton Party Gets Ruined
episodesList.summary: Hrithik conveys a plan to Rajesh and Vimlesh and goes to stay with Happu and Beni. Later, Hrithik ruins Happu and Beni’s Mutton party. Rajesh prepares a chicken-based dish and makes Happu jealous.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plight Delights Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Happu's sleep gets disturbed due to Beni. The next morning, Happu chides Beni when he drinks the tea made by him, while Rajesh and Vimlesh rejoice. The commissioner stops Happu from eating outside.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Plot against Their Wives
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh suggests Rajesh that they should patch up with their husbands, but Rajesh refuses. Happu and Beni decide to teach a lesson to their wives. Later, Rajesh and Vimlesh spot them with two women.

episodesList.title: The Couples Resolve Their Differences
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh tell Amma about seeing Beni and Happu with other women. As advised by Amma, Rajesh and Vimlesh patch up with their husbands. Later, Happu and Beni divulge their plan.

episodesList.title: Kat Gets a Boon
episodesList.summary: Kat gets a boon from god, while Happu and Beni give gifts to their wives. Later, Kat’s dream turns into reality, and Chamchi tells Happu and Rajesh about this.

episodesList.title: Kat’s Dreams Come True
episodesList.summary: Kat’s dreams come true. The family members refuse to believe Chamchi’s words. Happu mistakes a man for the leader of the Chutki gang and imprisons him. Later, Kat sees a bad dream about Beni.

episodesList.title: Kat’s Dreams Worry Everyone
episodesList.summary: Despite Kat’s warning, Happu goes to the police station, where the commissioner insults him. Everyone worries on realising that Kat’s dreams are coming true. Malaika comes up with a solution.

episodesList.title: Kat’s Dream Troubles Happu
episodesList.summary: Kat tells Happu that she saw Rajesh and Vimlesh killing and burying her in the dream. Happu reads the love letter that arrived for Rajesh. Later, Kat gets scared on seeing Vimlesh digging a grave.

episodesList.title: Kat Gets Rid of the Boon
episodesList.summary: Due to Kat’s dream, everyone assumes that Rajesh and Vimlesh have killed Happu. Later, everyone breathes a sigh of relief when Kat gets rid of the boon. However, Ranbir sees a bad dream about Happu.

episodesList.title: Amma to Test Rajesh and Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: Gabbar asks Amma a question. To answer it, Amma decides to test Rajesh and Vimlesh. Malaika tells Kat a way to identify a real friend. Later, Kat tests Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Competition
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh argue over being an ideal daughter-in-law. Hrithik and Chamchi place a bet. Later, Rajesh and Vimlesh strive to fulfil Amma's demand to achieve the ideal daughter-in-law's title.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Fierce Fight
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh order fritters and feed it to Amma, for which, she gives them points. Happu and Beni make a futile attempt to reason with them. Later, Amma gives Rajesh and Vimlesh a task.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Defeats Rajesh in the Competition
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh defeats Rajesh in the match by cheating. Hrithik and Chamchi argue over who will win between Rajesh and Vimlesh. While Vimlesh falls in love with Beni, Rajesh feels jealous of Happu.

episodesList.title: Who Becomes Amma’s Best Daughter-In-Law?
episodesList.summary: Amma demands a diamond ring from Vimlesh and Rajesh. Happu gets a diamond ring, which Rajesh gives to Amma. Later, Amma puts an end to Rajesh and Vimlesh’s fight by making them realise their mistake.

episodesList.title: A Troubled Mamera Visits Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh’s brother Mamera approaches her with his problem. Amma gives an advice to Mamera. Rajesh gives an idea to Happu who is worried about his promotion. Later, Kat conveys her wish to Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Mamera Elopes with Rashmita
episodesList.summary: Happu invites the commissioner to his house for a meal. Rajesh hides Mamera from Happu’s eyes. Later, Kat elopes with Kamlesh, while Mamera elopes with Rashmita and brings her to Happu’s house.

episodesList.title: Rashmita’s True Identity Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Happu and the others learns that Rashmita is Rusa. Amma decides to get Mamera and Rusa married, while the commissioner tells Happu to find Rusa. Later, Manohar and the commissioner arrest Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner’s Threat Scares Everyone
episodesList.summary: Manohar beats up Kamlesh. The commissioner arrives at Happu’s house and Rusa hides on seeing him. The commissioner’s threat scares everyone. Rajesh and Vimlesh tell Mamera to drop Rusa at her house.

episodesList.title: Mamera Doesn’t Marry Rusa
episodesList.summary: The family members confess the truth to the commissioner. Happu’s job is put in jeopardy when Rusa and Mamera elope. Mamera refuses to marry Rusa on learning the truth about her.

episodesList.title: Santa’s Letter for Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu’s kids make a plan to celebrate Christmas. The commissioner tells Happu and Manohar about his wish to spread cheer amongst people during Christmas. Later, Happu gets a letter from Santa Claus.

episodesList.title: A Wishlist of Gifts to be Asked from Santa
episodesList.summary: The prospect of getting gifts from Santa delights everyone. Happu believes that the commissioner is going to pose as Santa and tells it to Rajesh and Beni. The elders make a long wishlist of gifts.

episodesList.title: The List of Gifts Shock the Kids
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Kids Stage a Robbery
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: The Truth about Secret Santa Is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh arrives to rob Beni’s house, but gets caught and Happu locks him up in the jail. Later, the kids reveal the truth when the elders get disappointed with Santa’s gifts.

episodesList.title: A Fight Ensues between Amma and Rajesh
episodesList.summary: The commissioner gives a piece of good news to Happu, while Amma and Rajesh fight. Kamlesh confides in Kat about his trouble and seeks help from Happu. Later, Rajesh complains to Happu about Amma.

episodesList.title: Amma Leaves the House
episodesList.summary: Happu gets into trouble when Amma leaves the house. Rajesh and Vimlesh take the kids along to watch a movie. When Amma doesn’t return home by night, everyone gets worried.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Helps Amma
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Happu get restless when Amma is nowhere to be found. To teach them a lesson, Amma seeks the commissioner’s help. On learning that Happu had cheated him, Kamlesh devises a plan.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Dominate Their Husbands
episodesList.summary: Happu insults Rajesh in front of Vimlesh. Later, Rajesh dominates Happu in front of Vimlesh. Thereafter, Vimlesh too dominates Beni when he scolds her in front of Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Whose Husband Will be Oppressed?
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh challenge each other to prove that their husbands always obey them. Later, they humiliate their husbands in front of everyone. Amma tells Happu and Beni to restrain their wives.

episodesList.title: Amma Tries to Reason with Rajesh and Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh’s and Vimlesh’s behaviour with Happu and Beni upsets Amma. She tries to reason with them but fails. Later, Kat develops a misunderstanding on seeing Rajesh with the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s Apology to Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu assumes that Rajesh is cheating on him when she dances with the commissioner. Upset, Happu decides to leave the house. Rajesh clears his misunderstanding and apologises for her behaviour.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Family Wants to Stay in a Flat
episodesList.summary: Happu’s family demands to stay in a flat. Kamlesh informs Kat about joining his father’s business. Later, Happu decides to take a huge share from the bribe collected by Resham Pal.

episodesList.title: Happu Blackmails Resham Pal
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gives his kids the good news of moving to a new flat. Pitaji narrates his grief to Amma and she takes a decision. Happu and Beni blackmail Resham Pal to arrange money for the flat.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Decision Angers Everyone
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets angry at Amma when she refuses to shift to the flat. Happu tries to change Amma’s decision. Later, Happu plans to extort money from the commissioner and lands in trouble.

episodesList.title: Happu Gives a Task to Kamlesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and the kids are excited to visit the flat and don’t obey Amma. Happu tells the family members that he is not buying the flat. Later, he threatens Kamlesh and gives him a task.

episodesList.title: Everyone Decides against Shifting to the Flat
episodesList.summary: To help buy the flat, Amma gives her jewellery to Rajesh. However, everyone decides against shifting to the flat. The commissioner clears Happu and Manohar’s doubts, and Lohri celebration takes place.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Lie to Their Wives
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni plan to watch Kittu Kamsin’s show. Rajesh and Vimlesh ask the duo to accompany them to a restaurant, but they come up with a lie. Meanwhile, Kat’s friend Rahul asks her to meet him.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni to Watch Kittu Kamsin’s Show
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh is left heartbroken on seeing Kat and Rahul together. Happu ditches his night duty to watch Kittu Kamsin’s dance with Beni. The commissioner arrives to watch the show as well.

episodesList.title: Happu Lies to the Commissioner
episodesList.summary: The commissioner spots Happu and Beni dancing with Kittu Kamsin. Later, Kat lies to Kamlesh to prevent him from learning that she had ice-cream with Rahul. Meanwhile, Happu lies to the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Amma Lies to Save Happu’s Job
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh get angry when Happu and Beni’s lie gets exposed. The commissioner visits Happu’s house to meet Tappu. Happu confides in Amma, and she lies to the commissioner to save Happu’s job.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Pretence Lands Him in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni pacify their angry wives, while Kamlesh uncovers Kat’s lie. Happu’s pretence about being Tappu lands him in trouble with the commissioner. Rajesh tells the truth to the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Keeps a Paying Guest at the House
episodesList.summary: Happu and Amma refuse to buy an expensive saree for Rajesh. Later, Happu’s kids insist on visiting a foreign country. To raise money, Rajesh keeps a paying guest at the house without informing Happu.

episodesList.title: The Paying Guest Lands Rajesh in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Vicky Jholar arrives at Happu’s house to stay as a paying guest. Happu procures ‘churan’ from a ‘baba’ and gives it to Beni. Later, housing the paying guest lands Rajesh in trouble.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Suspends Happu for a Week
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh sees Vicky sleeping on Kat’s lap and gets upset. Rajesh lies to Happu to prevent him from learning about the paying guest. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu for one week.

episodesList.title: Happu Comes Face-to-Face with Vicky
episodesList.summary: Happu returns home and tells everyone about his suspension. Vimlesh refuses to help a troubled Rajesh. When Happu meets Vicky, Rajesh lies to prevent him from learning the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Ousts Vicky from the House
episodesList.summary: Rajesh’s aunt Seema gives a piece of bad news to Happu, who assumes that Vicky is a ghost. He brings a tantric home to perform exorcism. On learning the truth, Happu ousts Vicky from the house.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Pitaji’s Death
episodesList.summary: When Rajesh gets angry at Happu, he manages to pacify her using Beni’s trick. Kamlesh tells Kat that he will set an example of their friendship. Pitaji tells Amma a secret associated with his death.

episodesList.title: Happu to Nab Pitaji’s Killer
episodesList.summary: Pitaji gives Amma a clue to identify his killer. Amma conveys the same to the family members and Happu decides to nab the killer. Meanwhile, Kamlesh promises Kat that he will locate the killer.

episodesList.title: Who Killed Happu's Father?
episodesList.summary: Gabbar comes to Happu’s house. To test her friendship with Kamlesh, Kat tells him to avenge her father. Amma tells Happu the name of his fathers’ killer. Happu insults Gabbar.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries to Get the Truth from Gabbar
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Rajesh that he will catch Gabbar as soon as he gets his hand on evidence. Happu apologises to Gabbar to get him to stop from leaving. To get the truth out, Happu and Beni get Gabbar drunk.

episodesList.title: Gabbar's Innocence
episodesList.summary: While arguing with Rajesh, Happu comes up with an idea. He appears in front of Gabbar posing as Pitaji. Gabbar falsely confesses killing Pitaji out of fear. Pitaji tells Amma that Gabbar is innocent.

episodesList.title: Who Has the Talent for Cooking?
episodesList.summary: Kat is jealous as her friend Kanchan is selected in the Master Cook competition. Reshampal and Manohar tell Happu that he has no talent. Pitaji tells Amma about his talent.

episodesList.title: Kat To Partake in the Cooking Competition
episodesList.summary: Pitaji tries to make Amma’s drawing. Benny gives a piece of good news to Happu. Rajesh puts up an act to be excused from work. Kat decides to participate in the Master Cook competition.

episodesList.title: Happu Supports Kat's Talent
episodesList.summary: Happu expresses his sadness to Benny and cries. Kat tells Rajesh and Happu about her taking part in the Master Cook competition, which makes Happu happy. Kamlesh gives Kat’s dish to the Master Cook.

episodesList.title: Kat Cooks Food for Everyone
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Amma about Kat's talent. At Kamlesh's behest, Dr Udas visits Happu's house posing as Garden Ramsingh, the judge of the cooking competition. Kat cooks food and serves it to everyone.

episodesList.title: The Truth about Kat’s Talent Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: The commissioner and Manohar arrive at Happu’s house for a meal to encourage Kat. Kat learns that she was not selected for the Master Cook Contest. Later, Pitaji shows Amma the picture that he made.

episodesList.title: Will Happu Decide to Be a Manager?
episodesList.summary: Rajesh’s uncle offers the position of manager to Happu and Beni after listening to Rajesh, Amma and Vimlesh. Rajesh and Amma talk to Happu about it. Kamlesh informs Kat about leaving for Canada.

episodesList.title: Happu Accepts Mamaji’s Offer
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni accept Mamaji’s offer of a manager’s job due to Rajesh and Vimlesh. Mamaji interviews the duo and employs them. Later, the commissioner gives a piece of good news to Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Stages an Attack on Himself
episodesList.summary: Beni suggests a way for Happu to get the government compensation. They both turn down Mamaji’s offer. A disguised Kamlesh beats up Happu, and Beni shows the video of the incident to the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Greed Lands Him in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Happu’s family demands compensation from the commissioner. Kamlesh lands in trouble by helping Happu. Beni goes to collect the compensation’s cheque, and Happu encounters trouble due to his greed.

episodesList.title: Happu Reaps the Fruit of His Greed
episodesList.summary: Inspector Ghadiyal exposes Happu’s act and puts forth a condition to forgive him. Kat reveals the truth when Manohar nabs Kamlesh. Later, Happu reaps the fruit of his greed.

episodesList.title: Hrithik and Ranbir Rob Kamlesh
episodesList.summary: Rambhopal Verma decides to cast Hrithik and Ranbir in his movie. Beni is left shocked upon seeing Vimlesh on Happu’s lap. At Rambhopal’s behest, Hrithik and Ranbir rob Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Lodges a Complaint on Getting Robbed
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh lodges a complaint on getting robbed. Happu mistakes Vimlesh for Rajesh and embraces her and Beni arrives at the scene. Later, the commissioner gives a tough task to Hrithik and Ranbir.

episodesList.title: Hrithik and Ranbir Run Away from the House
episodesList.summary: Hrithik and Ranbir don disguises and rob Happu, leading to his embarrassment. Masuma threatens Kamlesh as she’s not able to find her dress. Ranbir and Hrithik leave a note and run away.

episodesList.title: Hrithik and Ranbir Get Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh gets upset when she is blamed for Hrithik and Ranbir running away. Beni develops a misunderstanding when Happu consoles Vimlesh. Later, Happu learns about Hrithik and Ranbir’s kidnap.

episodesList.title: Rambhopal Blackmails Happu
episodesList.summary: Beni tells Rajesh that Happu and Vimlesh are having an affair. On getting blackmailed by Rambhopal, Happu agrees to obey him and lands in trouble. Hrithik and Ranbir sense Rambhopal’s intentions.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Pretends to Be Sick
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Rajesh an idea to get some private time with her. Later, Happu asks the commissioner for a leave. Happu's children prepare to attend a wedding. Rajesh pretends to have fallen sick.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Spoils Happu and Rajesh's Romance
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh's plan bears fruits as the family heads to the wedding, leaving them alone. Kat asks Kamlesh to look after Rajesh. Later, Kamlesh interrupts and spoils Happu and Rajesh's romance.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh's Plan Fails
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh shares some bad news with Kat. The family returns without attending the wedding and foils Happu and Rajesh's plans for romance. Later, Happu tells Beni about it and asks him for help.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh's Wish Remains Unfulfilled
episodesList.summary: Beni shares Happu and Rajesh's problem with Vimlesh. Vimlesh relays it to Amma. Beni takes the family to the wedding but they return again, leaving Happu and Rajesh's wishes unfulfilled.

episodesList.title: An Evil Eye Looms on Happu and Beni's Houses
episodesList.summary: Businessman Ajit Singh Chhabra eyes Happu and Beni's houses. He asks Happu and Beni to sell them to him, but they refuse. Amma replaces the name plates on both the houses with new ones.

episodesList.title: Ajit Threatens Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni tell their wives about Ajit's offer. Later, Ajit threatens Happu and Beni. On getting panicked, Happu locks Ajit in the jail.

episodesList.title: A Clash Lands Happu and Beni in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Rajesh decides to get the house whitewashed. Happu releases Ajit Singh Chhabra from jail, but clashing with him backfires on him and Beni. Happu and Beni approach a minister for help.

episodesList.title: Happu's Idea to Save the House
episodesList.summary: The minister refuses to help Happu and Beni. Listening to the children's horror story, an idea strikes Happu. Later, everyone performs a play in front of Ajit Singh Chhabra.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan to Save the House Succeeds
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh, posing as a ghost, pretends to kill Rajesh to scare Ajit. He reaches the police station in horror, where Kamlesh arrives in an occultist's disguise. Later, all three scare him together.

episodesList.title: Malaika Thrashes Rocky
episodesList.summary: The commissioner introduces his nephew to Happu. The priest tells Rajesh a solution for Malaika. Malaika beats Rocky. The commissioner orders Happu to arrest the girl who beat Rocky.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Malaika for a Promise
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Malaika to promise him never to beat anyone. On Malaika's advice, Ritik gets into a fight with Buzo and falls in trouble. The priest gives Rajesh a ritual offering but Amma eats it.

episodesList.title: Malaika Denies Help to Ritik
episodesList.summary: Buzo arrives at Ritik's house but Malaika doesn't help him. Rajesh learns that the priest's prasad has been eaten by someone and gets upset. Later, Amma asks the priest for a solution.

episodesList.title: Kat Hides Malaika in the Room
episodesList.summary: Happu doesn't arrive at the police station and the commissioner visits him with Rocky. Kat hides Malaika in the room. Later, Chamchi falls into trouble because of Hrithik, and Malaika saves her.

episodesList.title: Happu Withdraws His Promise
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh are robbed by some goons. Malaika thrashes the goons after Happu retracts his promise. Later, the commissioner learns that Malaika had beaten up Rocky.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Arranges Bhang for Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: Amma invites Gabbar for Holi celebration. Kamlesh arranges bhang for Happu and Beni, and Happu grants him permission to bring Kat to the celebration. Hrithik invites Preeti home to celebrate Holi.

episodesList.title: Happu Mixes Bhang in the Thandai
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh arrives to take Kat to the party and Malaika whips him. Happu mixes bhang in the thandai and Amma, Gabbar and Kat drink it. Later, everyone sings, dances and celebrates holi.

episodesList.title: Amma Elopes with Gabbar
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni realise that theirs is a lacklustre Holi without bhang. Under bhang's influence, Amma elopes with Gabbar, much to everyone's worry. Manohar informs Happu about Amma's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Gabbar and Amma Return in Wedding Attire
episodesList.summary: Rajesh's friend shares some news about Amma with her. Everyone worries as they suspect that Amma and Gabbar have gotten married. Amma and Gabbar return wearing a wedding attire.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Receives the News of Dharmesh's Arrival
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Happu about her friendship with Dharmesh, making Happu jealous. Later, Vimlesh clears Happu's misunderstanding. Dharmesh shares the good news of his visit with Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Dharmesh's Death Traumatises Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh instigates Amma. A man abducts Dharmesh and shares the fake news of his death with Rajesh. Rajesh blames Vimlesh for Dharmesh's death. Later, the trauma deteriorates Rajesh's health.

episodesList.title: Dharmesh's Spirit Visits Rajesh
episodesList.summary: The driver who abducted Dharmesh visits Happu's house. He proclaims to be Dharmesh's spirit in a stranger's body, who has come to meet Rajesh. Everyone gets scared, but Rajesh fulfils all his wishes.

episodesList.title: The Driver's Plan to Con Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Happu gets annoyed with Dharmesh's spirit. The children also complain to Amma about Rajesh. The driver furthers his act by asking Rajesh for INR 10 lakh. Rajesh asks Happu to arrange the money.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh and Kat Rescue Dharmesh
episodesList.summary: Happu lies to Chamanlal and asks him for INR ten lakh. Later, Kamlesh and Kat learn about the driver's intentions. They rescue Dharmesh, bring her home, and get the driver arrested.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh Argue
episodesList.summary: Amma taunts Rajesh as there is more salt in the food, and Rajesh agrees with her. Happu tells Kamlesh to stay away from Kat as she fails in her exams. Vimlesh hears Amma speaking to Pitaji.

episodesList.title: The Solution to Amma and Rajesh's Quarrel
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Taunts Amma as a Mother-in-Law
episodesList.summary: Rangeela unveils a secret from Amma and Rajesh's past life and suggests a solution for their conflict. Later, Rajesh poses as a mother-in-law and taunts Amma. Happu thrashes Kamlesh on visiting Kat.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Children Learn Vimlesh’s Secret
episodesList.summary: Happu’s children learn about Vimlesh’s secret and blackmail him to get their work done. Gabbar gets furious with Rajesh as he misbehaves with Amma. Kamlesh gets beaten up because of Kat.

episodesList.title: Amma Realises Rajesh's Value
episodesList.summary: Tired of doing the household chores, Amma realises Rajesh's importance. Rajesh feels bad about disrespecting Amma as well. Vimlesh reveals the truth and Hrithik's act also comes to an end.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Remain Devoid of Romance
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni share their problems with each other. They try to bring romance in their married lives but fail in doing so. Happu advises Beni to meet Rocky to find a solution to his problem.

episodesList.title: Rocky Advises Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: The commissioner makes Manohar the chief of the 'Anti Laila-Majnu' Squad. Happu and Beni tell Rocky about their problem, and on his advice, ask their wives out for a candle-light dinner.

episodesList.title: The Wives' Behaviour Upsets the Husbands
episodesList.summary: Their wives' unromantic behaviour at the romantic dinner upsets Happu and Beni. Manohar gives some work to Kamlesh. Rajesh and Vimlesh overhear their husbands and decide to act as their girlfriends.

episodesList.title: Romance Lands Happu and Beni in Jail
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh meet their husbands, posing as girlfriends, at the park. Kamlesh and Kat spot them and inform Manohar about it in exchange for money. Manohar puts Happu and Beni in jail.

episodesList.title: The Husbands Regret Their Mistake
episodesList.summary: Amma learns about Happu and Beni's doing and slaps them. They request Amma to turn their wives back to normal. The family peforms an act and Amma teaches a lesson to her sons and daughters-in-law.

episodesList.title: Happu to Nab Raka
episodesList.summary: Chamanlal baits Happu and Manohar with promotion and challenges them to catch the vicious killer Raka. Later, Raka appoints Beni as his lawyer. Amma experiences a nightmare that leaves her scared.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Beni for Raka's Whereabouts
episodesList.summary: Upon learning about Amma's dream, the family plans to stop Happu from nabbing Raka. Happu asks Beni about Raka's location. Kat suggests to Kamlesh, a way to lift his reputation in front of the family.

episodesList.title: Happu Catches Kamlesh Instead of Raka
episodesList.summary: Amma asks Kamlesh to do something for her. Happu nabs a disguised Kamlesh instead of Raka and hands him over to Raka. When the truth comes forth, Happu's job falls in danger.

episodesList.title: Raka Slips Past Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh's threat causes Kamlesh to resume roaming in disguise. Happu nabs him again, mistaking him for Raka. Upon learning the truth, Happu asks Chamanlal for a final chance to catch Raka.

episodesList.title: Raka Fires a Gun at Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh plans to make Happu leave his job. Happu mistakes Chamanlal's brother-in-law, Raka, for Bittoo and nabs him. Chamanlal then fires Happu. Later, Raka visits Happu and fires a gun at him.

episodesList.title: Shakal Escapes from Happu's Captivity
episodesList.summary: Shakal escapes from Happu's captivity due to Rajesh's interference. Hrithik boasts about Happu's profession in front of Maisha. Kamlesh tries to put Malaika in place but gets beaten up by her instead.

episodesList.title: Reshampal and Happu Become Constables
episodesList.summary: Senior official Suresh Chatwal appoints Reshampal and Happu as constables and makes Manohar their senior. Maisha expresses her wish to meet Happu. Hrithik relays it to Happu, who pleads with Manohar.

episodesList.title: The Family Learns about Happu's Demotion
episodesList.summary: The family learns about Happu's demotion. Kamlesh ends his friendship with Kat. Happu blames Amma and Rajesh for his demotion. Amma and Rajesh get into another argument about the food menu.

episodesList.title: Chatwal Visits Happu's House
episodesList.summary: At the police station, the new commissioner, Chatwal punishes Happu. On Beni's advice, Happu invites Chatwal to his house for dinner. Chatwal, with bad intentions, offers a job to Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes an Inspector Again
episodesList.summary: Rajesh arrives at the police station as an inspector and Chatwal eyes her maliciously. Later, Happu and the commissioner get their former positions back with Beni's help. Kamlesh apologises to Kat.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Fall in Roma's Trap
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh call their friend Roma. Reshampal gives Happu and Manohar the task of finding the gold smugglers. Rajesh and Vimlesh deliver Roma’s parcel to a man and find themselves in trouble.

episodesList.title: Roma Blackmails Rajesh and Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: Benny brings alcohol for Happu, who’s working at the blockade. Roma blackmails Rajesh and Vimlesh. Happu tells Rajesh that he has been assigned the work of catching the smugglers, which worries her.

episodesList.title: Roma Meets Rajesh and Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh cooks ‘Halwa’ for Ritika, but Roma calls Rajesh and Vimlesh to meet her. Ritika feels more upset. Commissioner loses his cool at Happu. Roma tells Rajesh and Vimlesh to deliver the parcel.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Smuggle Gold
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh fool Happu. Kamlesh spots the duo smuggling gold and gets into trouble. Beni shares his suspicion with a worried Happu, that an insider is colluding with the gold smugglers.

episodesList.title: Roma Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: At night, Happu and Beni follow their wives and spot them smuggling. Rajesh and Vimlesh reveal the truth to the family. Happu arrests Roma and Rajesh reveals her ploy.

episodesList.title: Gabbar Flirts with Amma
episodesList.summary: Gabbar arrives to give his daughter's wedding invitation and flirts with Amma. Kamlesh sets up a namkeen stall. Everyone shops for the wedding and rejoices. Kat sees Kamlesh selling namkeen.

episodesList.title: Beni and Happu Suffer from Constipation
episodesList.summary: To take revenge on Kamlesh, a man spikes his namkeen and Happu takes it. Happu and Beni eat the namkeen and get constipated. Happu suspects that the namkeen was spiked.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Suffer from Constipation
episodesList.summary: Malaika warns Kamlesh to stay away from Kat. Happu and Beni suffer from constipation and refuse to go to Kusum’s wedding. After learning about this, Gabbar calls Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Decides to Not Attend the Wedding
episodesList.summary: Dr. Udaas recommends surgery to treat Happu's constipation. Rajesh and Vimlesh assume that their husbands are putting on an act and quarrel with them. Happu decides to not attend the wedding.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Seek Revenge from Kamlesh
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni consume a powdered substance to treat their constipation, but it worsens. Gabbar calls Rajesh and shares some bad news with her. Later, Happu and Beni take revenge from Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Urvashi's Reunion with Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: One of Happu and Beni's old friends, Urvashi, calls them and they lie to their wives in order to meet her. Kamlesh tells Kat about his friend Sapna and Kat feels jealous.

episodesList.title: What did Happu and Beni Do wiith Urvashi?
episodesList.summary: In their drunken stupour, Happu and Beni go to drop Urvashi home. Urvashi tells them about their doings, once they are sober. Kat calls Kamlesh after she sees him with Sapna, but he lies to Kat.

episodesList.title: Urvashi Blackmails Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: On reaching home, Happu and Beni lie to their wives. Kamlesh introduces Kat to Sapna and Sapna tells her that she is Kamlesh's first girlfriend. Urvashi blackmails Happu and Beni for money.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Steal Rajesh's Saree
episodesList.summary: Urvashi visits Rajesh and Vimlesh, and spots Rajesh's expensive saree. Happu and Beni give Urvashi money, but she demands Rajesh's saree as well. Later, Happu and Beni steal Rajesh's saree.

episodesList.title: Urvashi Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Urvashi blackmails Beni and Happu again. Bittu's police complaint gets Urvashi arrested. Rajesh and Vimlesh learn the truth. Kamlesh turns down Sapna's love for the sake of Kat.

episodesList.title: Happu Gifts Rajesh a Fake Necklace
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu for a diamond necklace, but he decides to give her a fake necklace. Kamlesh gifts Kat a box of sweets. Later, Happu distributes gifts to the family. The necklace leaves Rajesh happy.

episodesList.title: Happu Reveals the Necklace's Truth to Amma
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Amma that he gave a fake necklace to Rajesh. Vimlesh asks Beni for a necklace like Rajesh's. Kat asks Kamlesh for an expensive gift. Later, Happu reveals the necklace's secret to Beni.

episodesList.title: Gabbar Asks Rajesh and Vimlesh for Money
episodesList.summary: Happu advises the commissioner to gift his wife a fake necklace. Beni gifts Vimlesh a necklace. Gabbar approaches Rajesh and Vimlesh for financial help and they consider pawning off their necklaces.

episodesList.title: The Truth about Happu's Gifts Comes Forth
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Amma about having purchased the land. An injured commissioner reaches the police station and blames Happu for his condition. Later, the family learns that their gifts are fake.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Act Causes Happu to Admit His Fault
episodesList.summary: Rajesh fakes her abduction and death with Gabbar, Kamlesh, and the children's help. Due to this, Happu realises his mistake and admits that the necklace was fake. Kamlesh practices black magic.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes a Courtesan Named 'Happi Jaan'
episodesList.summary: A bad omen leaves Rajesh scared. The commissioner plans to nab the criminal, J.K. Meanwhile, Happu turns into courtesan, Happi Jaan. Kamlesh tells Kat and Malaika about his new business.

episodesList.title: Happu's Suffers from Mental Imbalance
episodesList.summary: Happu and J.K. get into a fistfight and Happu suffers from a head injury, causing mental imbalance. Happu, upon turning into Happi Jaan, mistakes Beni for Kunwar Sa. Pitaji speaks to Amma about Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Dances in front of the Principal
episodesList.summary: Hrithik fights with Bittu at the school. Amma throws a party to celebrate Happu's recovery. After the kids are expelled, Happu visits the principal and again dances in Happy Jaan's disguise.

episodesList.title: Happi Jaan Flirts with Beni
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: Happu Regains His Mental Balance
episodesList.summary: Believing himself to be Happi Jaan, Happu tries to kill Gabbar, assuming him to be Thakur. Happu recovers after being hit on the head by Beni. Rajesh tests whether Happu has recovered or not.

episodesList.title: Happu Renders His Children's Teacher Homeless
episodesList.summary: The children's words delight Happu. Later, he takes a bribe and unknowingly renders his children's teacher homeless. The children offer their home for the teacher's stay. Kamlesh asks Kat for help.

episodesList.title: Beni Poses as the Father of Happu's Children
episodesList.summary: Happu learns about the mistake thet he committed unintentionally. The children's teacher, Vidyadhar, arrives at their home and Happu tries to avoid him. Beni meets Vidyadhar as the children's father.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Hides the Truth from Vidyadhar
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Maganlal to keep Vidyadhar back as a tenant, but he refuses. The commissioner visits Happu's house and the family tries to hide the truth from Vidyadhar. Vimlesh asks Happu to prepare tea.

episodesList.title: Vidyadhar Spots Happu with Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Everyone pretends that Happu is Vimlesh's husband. At night, Vidyadhar gets stunned upon spotting Happu in Rajesh's room and tells Amma about it. Later, Happu asks the commissioner for help.

episodesList.title: Vidyadhar's True Self Stuns everyone
episodesList.summary: Upon learning the truth, Vidyadhar decides to not promote Happu's children to the next standard. A few days later, he brings the report cards and asks Happu for help. Vidyadhar's truth stuns everyone.

episodesList.title: The Danger of Death Befalls Happu
episodesList.summary: A sage tells Happu a way to avoid death. An upset Happu tells Beni about the sage's words. Rajesh heads to the beauty parlour to woo Happu. The family decides to shower Happu with love.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Showered with Love
episodesList.summary: Manohar protects Happu from a man's attack. Happu returns home from the police station and everyone showers him with love. Meanwhile, an upset Beni's behaviour shocks Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Instils Hate for Himself in the Family
episodesList.summary: Beni helps Happu and gets thrashed by Malaika. Rajesh complains about Happu to Amma. Happu deliberately attempts to instil hatred for himself in the family members' minds.

episodesList.title: The Family Begins to Hate Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu instils hatred for himself in the minds of the family members and rejoices over the success of his plan. Rajesh and the kids prepare to leave the house. Amma also plans to accompany them.

episodesList.title: Happu's Children Celebrate Father's Day
episodesList.summary: Beni tells the truth to the family to stop them from leaving. The family pretends to hate Happu. Manohar tells Happu the reality of the sage. Happu's children wish him a happy Father's day.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan to Visit a Museum Backfires
episodesList.summary: The commissioner shares his problem with Happu. Later, Happu takes his kids to a museum, where Hrithik accidentally breaks a 2500-year-old cup, and the manager asks Happu to compensate for it.

episodesList.title: How will the Museum's Damage be Compensated?
episodesList.summary: Happu worries about raising the money to fix the museum's damage. Hrithik vows to stop speaking nonsense. Later, Malaika comes up with an idea to raise money.

episodesList.title: Happu Devises a Plan to Steal
episodesList.summary: Happu devises a plan to steal from Reshampal, but someone else beats him to it. For the sake of money, Rajesh asks Gabbar to marry Kamini. Kamlesh tells Malaika a way to steal from an ATM.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Plan to Collect Money
episodesList.summary: A prisoner assures help to Happu and Happu sets him free. Manohar tells Happu that it is the same prisoner who planned the loot. Rajesh and Vimlesh discuss with Kamini, her marriage to Gabbar.

episodesList.title: The Museum's Manager is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Happu devises a plan to conduct a robbery at the museum and Amma agrees to it. To save Chamchi, Hrithik breaks his vow. Later, the commissioner arrests the museum manager, Pandey.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Demands to Have AC in the Kitchen
episodesList.summary: Happu agrees to get the AC installed in the kitchen for Rajesh, but after talking to Amma, he refuses to get it installed. Vimlesh suggests Rajesh a plan. Kamlesh gets the job of a reporter.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Turns into a Mermaid
episodesList.summary: Troubled by the heat, Rajesh pulls off a pretence. Gabbar lies to the family that Rajesh is a mermaid. Happu arranges a swimming pool for Rajesh at home. Malaika grows suspicious of Rajesh.

episodesList.title: The News of Rajesh Being a Mermaid Goes Viral
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Manohar and Resham Pal that Rajesh is a mermaid. Reporter Kamlesh covers this news and it goes viral. The news on TV makes the family suspect that Rajesh is not a mermaid.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Pretence Lands Happu in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells her family the truth. Resham Pal asks Happu to let Rajesh continue her pretence for a few days. The editor asks Kamlesh to find out about the mermaid's husband and Happu gets in trouble.

episodesList.title: A Few Goons Try to Abduct Happu and Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Happu pretends to be a mermaid just like Rajesh. The goons of an international gang come to abduct them, but Malaika saves them. Resham Pal makes a statement by holding a press conference.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Recieves Her Grandfather’s Umbrella
episodesList.summary: Gabbar gives Rajesh an umbrella of her grandfather. Happu stops Kamlesh from entering the house. Hritik decides to participate in the essay competition. Manohar tells Happu about his stolen umbrella.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Grandfather's Umbrella Gets Stolen
episodesList.summary: Happu takes Rajesh's grandfather's umbrella to Chhajjan's dhaba without informing Rajesh, but it gets stolen. Hrithik writes an essay on the umbrella. Rajesh gets upset after not finding the umbrella.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about the Theft of the Umbrella
episodesList.summary: Rajesh learns that Happu has lost the umbrella. She asks Happu not to come to the house till he gets it back. Amma visits the police station, gives Pitaji's umbrella to Happu, and tells him a trick.

episodesList.title: Happu Gives Rajesh a Fake Umbrella
episodesList.summary: Gabbar is saddened to learn that the umbrella is stolen. Hrithik makes Beni write an essay for the competition. The umbrella given by Amma gets stolen, and Happu brings Rajesh a fake umbrella.

episodesList.title: Happu Catches the Umbrella Thief
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh steals the umbrella from Rajesh's cupboard and takes it away. Soon, Happu catches the umbrella thief, Kamlesh. He listens to Kamlesh and allows him to visit his house on one condition.

episodesList.title: Happu's Kids Pray to God for His Fame
episodesList.summary: Happu's kids pray to God to make him famous. A marriage proposal comes up for Kat. Kamlesh decides to break up that alliance. Happu tells Resham Pal how to become famous.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Makes a Video of Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu eats Parathas made by Amma with great fervour, which later causes a stomach upset. Journalist Dhumal interviews Happu. Kamlesh makes a video of Happu to break Kat's alliance.

episodesList.title: Happu's Video Goes Viral
episodesList.summary: A suitor's family comes to see Kat. Happu's video goes viral, and everyone sees it on their phone, due to which Kat's alliance gets cancelled. Rajesh blames Amma for Happu's stomach being upset.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Saddened by His Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Resham Pal suspends Happu. Moreover, Happu faces humiliation due to his viral video, which disheartens him. Malaika learns that Kamlesh had made Happu's video.

episodesList.title: Happu Earns His Prestige Back
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh asks for a chance to rectify his mistake after apologising to Happu. Happu gets his job back by blackmailing Resham Pal, who helps him regain his lost prestige at a press conference.

episodesList.title: Beni and Vimlesh Meet a Baba
episodesList.summary: Rajesh ousts Happu from the room because of his belching. Beni and Vimlesh visit a baba, who gives them a book of black magic. Beni, Vimlesh and Rajesh perform tantric remedies mentioned in the book.

episodesList.title: A Glitch in the Tantric Practice
episodesList.summary: Owing to a glitch during the tantric practice, the demonic power comes out of the book. Rajesh, Beni and Vimlesh go to Baba to find out who is possessed because of this. Baba suggests them a remedy.

episodesList.title: Someone Is Possessed by the Demonic Power
episodesList.summary: Hrithik devises a plan against Kamlesh. Rajesh tells the remedy suggested by the baba, which reveals that somene is possessed by the demonic power. Rajesh gets scared, and Vimlesh gives her an idea.

episodesList.title: The Baba Gives Rajesh a Powdered Herb
episodesList.summary: Happu's belching scares Rajesh. The Baba gives Rajesh a powdered herb to drive away the demonic power in Happu's body. Kamlesh finds it hard to pretend to be a vampire and tells Malaika the truth.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Beats Happu with His Shoe
episodesList.summary: Worried about Malaika's disguise, Rajesh tells Amma the truth and seeks her help. Later, Rajesh beats Happu with a shoe to drive away the evil force. Manohar comes and reveals the truth to everyone.

episodesList.title: Pathan Demands Money from Beni
episodesList.summary: Pathan asks Beni for his money. Kamlesh gets a job in an insurance company and makes a vow. Happu and Beni lose their invested money. Pathan threatens them and Beni thinks of a plan.

episodesList.title: Beni Tells Vimlesh His Plan
episodesList.summary: A disguised Beni comes to the police station with Happu, who asks Manohar to lock Beni up to save him from Pathan. Kamlesh tells Kat about his actions. Beni tells Vimlesh his and Happu's plan.

episodesList.title: Happu Breaks the News of Beni's Death
episodesList.summary: Happu informs the family about Beni's death. The kids suspect that Happu is lying, and Kat seeks Kamlesh's help to find out the truth. Later, everyone mourns at Beni's condolence meet.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Decides to Get Vimlesh Remarried
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh interrogates Happu. Rajesh decides to get Vimlesh remarried. Kamlesh's and Happu's kids go to the accident site to find out the truth behind the accident. Beni gets thrashed in the lockup.

episodesList.title: Beni Stops Vimlesh from Getting Engaged
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Kamlesh to pass Beni's insurance claim quickly. Beni stops Vimlesh from getting engaged and reveals the truth to everyone. Pathan asks Beni to return his money and gives him the good news.

episodesList.title: Gabbar demands INR 2 Lakh from His Daughters
episodesList.summary: Happu does not provide money for his children's school trips. Atbir returns Amma's money. Gabbar asks for INR 2 Lakh from Rajesh and Vimlesh, and they think of a plan to arrange the money.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Steals Money from Her Own House
episodesList.summary: Happu agrees to give money for his children's school trip. Later, he keeps the money in the storeroom cupboard in front of Rajesh and Amma. When Rajesh steals money from the cupboard, Amma wakes up.

episodesList.title: Happu Learns about the Theft
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gives money to Gabbar. Happu learns that the money has been stolen and decides to find the thief. Rajesh tries to frame Amma for the robbery. Later, Gabbar again asks Rajesh for the money.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Steals the Money Again
episodesList.summary: Due to Vimlesh's threat, Beni fails to tell Happu the truth. Kamlesh gets a job to tarp the cats. He mistakes Gabbar for a cat and catches him. Rajesh again steals the money and gives it to Gabbar.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Admit their Mistake
episodesList.summary: Happu learns that the money has been stolen again. Due to Rajesh's action, Amma gets into a problem. Rajesh and Vimlesh admit their mistake. Gabbar returns the money to Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Chamchi Goes into Depression
episodesList.summary: Chamchi goes into depression on failing to write an essay. Happu learns the reason behind Chamchi’s depression. Hrithik comes up with an idea to help Chamchi.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes Happu Man
episodesList.summary: To please Chamchi, Happu transforms into a superhero and lies to her. Someone smears ink on Reshampal's face and leaves. Chamchi challenges her friends that she will show them Happu's superpowers.

episodesList.title: Happu Man Becomes Famous
episodesList.summary: Lotiya Pehlwan seizes Beni's land, and Happu refuses to help Beni. Happu becomes famous after showing his superpower in front of Chamchi's friends. Later, Happu reveals the truth to Reshampal.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Scared of Lotiya Pehelwaan
episodesList.summary: Happu Man talks to the press reporters. In order to help Beni and Vimlesh, he threatens Lotiya Pehelwaan, but it backfires on him. Hrithik and Ranbir stop Chamchi from putting her life at risk.

episodesList.title: Chamchi Realises Her Mistake
episodesList.summary: Two goons kidnap Happu. Reshampal makes a plan to save Happu. Later, Happu returns home as the goons free him. Chamchi realises her mistake and apologises to Happu. Everyone celebrates Rakshabandhan.

episodesList.title: Happu Keeps His Money with Beni
episodesList.summary: Happu tells the significance of Independence Day to kids. Amma assigns the children the task of cleaning up the trash around the house. Happu receives a bribe of INR 5 lakh, which he keeps with Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Get Into a Fight Over Money
episodesList.summary: Gabbar is moved to tears by Rajesh and Vimlesh's love. Happu asks Beni for his money. Kat and Kamlesh think about making a project on friendship. Happu and Beni get into a fight over money.

episodesList.title: Happu Lodges a Complaint against Beni
episodesList.summary: Gabbar arrives while Rajesh and Vimlesh get into a fight. Happu lodges a complaint against Beni. Kamlesh tells a plan to foster friendship between Happu and Beni. Manohar arrives to investigate Beni.

episodesList.title: Beni Threatens to Sue Reshampal
episodesList.summary: The fight between Happu and Beni heats up. Rajesh and Vimlesh also get into a brawl. Reshampal attempts to help Happu, but Beni threatens to sue him.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni's Misunderstandings are Resolved
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh tell their husbands about Gabbar's wish and celebrate his birthday. Later, envelopes full of money are found in the cupboard. Happu, Beni, Rajesh and Vimlesh realise their mistake.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Decides to Take up a Job
episodesList.summary: Rajesh decides to take up a job and agrees to do the job suggested by her father Gabbar. Reshampal tells Happu that Rajesh is a cunning spy and asks him to unearth the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells a Secret to Amma
episodesList.summary: Happu informs Amma that Rajesh is a Russian spy. Later, he sees Rajesh with a Russian man. Ranbir and Chamchi approach Malaika for assistance. Rajesh's lookalike, Natalia, murders a man.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Tries to Learn the Russian Language
episodesList.summary: Reshampal asks Happu to perform police duties. Happu informs Beni that Rajesh is a spy. Later, Rajesh tries to learn the Russian language. On hearing her words, Happu and Beni have a misunderstanding.

episodesList.title: Beni misidentifies Vimlesh as a Spy
episodesList.summary: Happu suspects Kamlesh is also with Rajesh. Beni misidentifies Vimlesh as a spy. Reshampal rebukes Happu for failing to inform him about Natalia. Later, the children refuse Rajesh to take up the job.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Gives Up on Her Desire to Work
episodesList.summary: Happu refuses to believe Rajesh and Vimlesh and arrests them. Reshampal gives Happu a piece of news and apologises to him. Rajesh relinquishes her insistence on doing a job.

episodesList.title: The News about Kamlesh Surprises Everyone
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh becomes homeless and Happu refuses to house him. Bored with her life, Rajesh decides to try something new. Kamlesh devises a plan, and everyone is surprised to read about him in the newspaper.

episodesList.title: Hero Kamlesh to Stay at Happu's House
episodesList.summary: Despite Malaika's objections, Rajesh and Happu decide to keep Kamlesh in the house. Kamlesh and his fake director move into Happu's house. Later, the fake director casts Kat and Amma in his film.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Fight Due to Their Wives'
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh fight for the roles in the film. Happu and Beni also beat each other in retaliation for their wives' abuse. On learning about this, Kat and Kamlesh get enraged.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: To get a role in the film, a wrestling competition between Rajesh and Vimlesh begins. Reshampal comes to Happu's house with kebabs and exposes Kamlesh. Later, Amma punishes the fake director.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Disturbed by His Room's Leaky Roof
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh's romance is disturbed by the room's leaky roof. Happu then tells Beni about his problem. Malaika beats Kamlesh up due to his actions. Later, Manohar gives Happu an important news.

episodesList.title: The Rain Spoils Happu's Mood
episodesList.summary: Happu wishes to romance Rajesh, but the rain spoils his mood. They go to the children's room and send them to Amma's room. But Amma also drives them away to spend time with Pitaji.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Happu's Romance is Disturbed
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Happu sleep in Kat and Malaika's room, but they are unable to romance there. Amma has a party with Pitaji. Later, Rajesh and Happu go to Beni's house to sleep.

episodesList.title: Happpu Gets the Roof of His Room Repaired
episodesList.summary: Happu frees Ganguram from jail and orders him to repair the roof of his room. As the roof of Amma's room leaks, she sleeps in Happu's room. Later, Happu and Rajesh's romance is disturbed again.

episodesList.title: The Leaky Roof Ruins Happu's Night
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh go to Beni's house, but the roof there also begins to leak. Beni and Vimlesh have a bad night. Happu plans to romance Rajesh at the police station, but their night gets spoiled.

episodesList.title: Amma Gets Embarrassed in front of Nargis
episodesList.summary: Amma shows Nargis the necklace she got during Happu’s wedding. She gets embarrassed when the necklace turns out to be fake. Later, Reshampal goes to keep his money in the bank locker.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh's Chain Turns Out to be Fake
episodesList.summary: The argument between Amma and Rajesh ruins Happu's mood. Happu asks Rajesh to make Gabbar apologise to Amma, but she refuses. The chain given by Gabbar to Vimlesh turns out to be fake.

episodesList.title: Amma Demands INR 15 lakh from Gabbar
episodesList.summary: Gabbar tries to calm down Amma by apologising to her, but she threatens him and demands INR 15 lakh. Rajesh and Vimlesh leave the house despite Happu and Beni's attempts to stop them.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Miss their Wives
episodesList.summary: Kat demands INR 15 lakh from Kamlesh. Happu and Beni miss Rajesh and Vimlesh and go to pick them up, but they refuse to return home. Happu shares a plan with Gabbar to arrange for INR 15 lakh.

episodesList.title: Amma Teaches Gabbar a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni kidnap Reshampal's wife in order to arrange money. Gabbar gives Amma the money, and Amma reveals her plan to teach him a lesson. At the police station, Reshampal interrogates Happu.

episodesList.title: Masterji Complains about the Children
episodesList.summary: Masterji complains to Happu and Rajesh about the children. Amma mocks Rajesh for not paying attention to the children, and Happu grows tired of their squabbles. Kamlesh informs Kat of his new job.

episodesList.title: Happu Pretends to be a Child
episodesList.summary: Happu starts behaving like a child, and his family members get worried on seeing his state. Rajesh's cure for Happu fails. At Kat's behest, Kamlesh takes Happu's responsibility.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Exposed in front of Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Amma taunts Rajesh for not instilling good values in the children. Rajesh devises a plan and exposes Happu. She takes revenge on Amma by blackmailing Happu. Later, Amma slaps Happu.

episodesList.title: The Children Ask Happu to Steal the Money
episodesList.summary: The children ask Happu to steal the money from Rajesh's purse. Happu gets enraged with Rajesh, who then executes her plan. However, the commissioner arrives and Happu gets exposed.

episodesList.title: The Minister Brings Mintu's Proposal for Kat
episodesList.summary: Kat slaps Minister Dayashankar's son Mintu. To fulfil Mintu's wish, Dayashankar brings Mintu's marriage alliance for Kat. Beni advises Happu to not get Kat married to Mintu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Plan to Break Kat's Marriage Alliance
episodesList.summary: Rajesh devises a plan to break Kat's marriage alliance. The family defames Happu in front of the minister. Everyone rejoices when Kat's marriage alliance breaks, but Happu gives them worrisome news.

episodesList.title: Dayashankar to Get Kat and Mintu Engaged
episodesList.summary: Seeking help from Jagwanti gets difficult for Happu. Despite Rajesh and Vimlesh's act, Minister Dayashankar agrees to get Kat and Mintu engaged. Gabbar arrives to meet Amma and Amma stops him.

episodesList.title: Malaika's Plan to Break Kat's Marriage Alliance
episodesList.summary: The minister gets Mintu and Kat engaged. Happu panics on having a nightmare. Malaika devises a plan to break Kat's marriage alliance. Two girls file a police complaint against Mintu.

episodesList.title: Happu To Perform 'Jagrata' for Promotion
episodesList.summary: Reshampal advises Happu on how to get a promotion. Karishma informs Rajesh and Vimlesh of the molestation incident at the passport office. Happu asks his musician friend Hulchul to perform 'Jagrata'.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Slaps Musician Hulchul
episodesList.summary: The family gets happy learning that a 'Jagrata' will be held. Due to a misunderstanding at the passport office, Rajesh slaps Hulchul. Later, Hulchul is shocked to learn that Rajesh is Happu's wife.

episodesList.title: Hulchul Refuses to Perform 'Jagrata'
episodesList.summary: The family invites everyone for 'jagrata' and starts the preparations. Happu tells them that Hulchul has refused to perform 'jagrata' due to Rajesh. Resham Pal threatens Happu that he will demote him.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Slaps Hulchul Again
episodesList.summary: At Happu's behest, Rajesh apologises to Hulchul. But, due to a misunderstanding, she slaps Hulchul again. Happu and Beni concoct a plan to pacify Hulchul, but they end up in trouble.

episodesList.title: Happu Disguises Himself as Hulchul
episodesList.summary: Happu devises a plan after spotting Kamlesh singing on the street. He organises Jagrata, which Reshampal and the DIG attend. Happu, disguised as Hulchul, sings hymns, but the DIG catches him.

episodesList.title: Gabbar and Amma Compete to Become a Special Officer
episodesList.summary: Reshampal makes an announcement on the news channel. Gabbar and Amma compete for the position of a Special Officer. Kat insults a boy, and he vows vengeance. Happu tells Reshampal about his condition.

episodesList.title: Amma Bribes the Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Rajesh that Gabbar cannot be chosen as a Special Officer. Amma bribes the commissioner to get selected. Rajesh and Vimlesh get enraged with their husbands as Gabbar does not get selected.

episodesList.title: Amma Suspends Happu
episodesList.summary: Amma, who has become a special officer, suspends Happu. Rajesh promises to Gabbar that he will make him an officer. Kamlesh is arrested for stealing a watch. Happu is shocked to see Rajesh stealing.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Demands Amma's Resignation
episodesList.summary: Happu is furious at Rajesh for stealing, and Rajesh demands Amma's resignation. As Amma instructs Happu to stop Rajesh, he locks Rajesh in the room. Later, he finds Vimlesh in place of Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Amma Resigns from the Post of a Special Officer
episodesList.summary: Reshampal arrives to arrest Rajesh for stealing from his home. Amma saves Rajesh and resigns from the post of a special officer. On Karwa Chauth, Rajesh and Vimlesh teach their husbands a lesson.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Devises a Plan Against Amma
episodesList.summary: Amma taunts Rajesh and complains to Gabbar about his daughters. An enraged Rajesh devises a plan to teach Amma a lesson. At Rajesh's behest, Happu vows to obey her orders.

episodesList.title: Happu Humiliates Amma in Front of Everyone
