episodesList.summary: Happu is in a dilemma due to the promise made to Rajesh. He humiliates Amma in front of everyone and orders her to do housework. The kids get upset with Happu for his behaviour with Amma.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Gets Amma to Apologise to Gabbar
episodesList.summary: Happu feels upset after insulting Amma. Reshampal orders Happu to arrest everyone who misbehaves with women. Scared of Rajesh, Amma ends up apologising to Gabbar.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Imprisons Happu
episodesList.summary: Reshampal imprisons Happu. Amma and Rajesh come up with a plan and get Happu released from jail. They accept their mistake and reconcile with each other. Later, they get into a fight again.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Gamble for Money
episodesList.summary: The family members ask Happu for expensive gifts. Vimlesh too asks Beni for a gold necklace. To get the money, Happu and Beni end up gambling. Happu’s kids decide to help a poor man, Sonu.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Lose Money in Gambling
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni lose money in gambling and fail to purchase gifts for their families. Kamlesh agrees to help Rajesh with cleaning. Happu tells a lie to Amma, but she learns the truth.

episodesList.title: Manohar Shares a Plan with Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: According to Manohar's plan, Beni and Happu deceive their wives. After discovering Happu's deception, Amma threatens him. While trying to help Happu and Beni, Manohar himself lands into trouble.

episodesList.title: A Plan to Rob Reshampal
episodesList.summary: Happu shows his family a video of him getting robbed. Amma forwards the video to Reshampal, who chastises Happu. Later, Manohar, Happu, and Beni go to rob Reshampal.

episodesList.title: Amma Fulfills Everyone's Demands
episodesList.summary: Reshampal thrashes Happu, Beni, and Manohar while they tell him about their helplessness. On Reshampal's advice, Happu and Beni reveal the truth to the family. Amma fulfills everyone's demands.

episodesList.title: A Drunk Gabbar Reveals a Secret
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gets a love letter written by Pitaji for Sulochana. She tells Vimlesh about the letter and Amma decides to teach them a lesson. Later, a drunk Gabbar reveals a secret to Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni are Shocked to Learn a Secret
episodesList.summary: As per Amma's plan, Kat and Kamlesh disguise themselves and put on an act in front of everyone. Beni and Happu get shocked on learning about Happu's marriage. Later, they get angry at their wives.

episodesList.title: A Way for Happu to Become an ACP
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh, posing as a baba, suggests a way for Happu to become an ACP. Rajesh believes that her marriage is in danger. Amma lies to Happu to persuade him to do the remedy, but Beni objects.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Locks Happu in a Room
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh and Beni complain to Rajesh about Happu. Rajesh ties up Happu and locks him in the room. Later, Pitaji makes Amma realise her mistake. Happu includes his children in his plans.

episodesList.title: Amma Gets Happu Remarried to Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh and Kat are exposed. Happu reveals his plan. Amma apologises to Rajesh and gets Happu remarried with her. Later, Rajesh imposes a few conditions before taking 'Pheras'.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Feeds Everyone Boiled Food
episodesList.summary: Sunaina, Rajesh's friend, teaches everyone about health care. Happu praises Sunaina and insults Rajesh. Later, Rajesh makes nutritious and boiled food for everyone.

episodesList.title: Happu Feels Sad to Eat Boiled Food
episodesList.summary: Amma makes kebabs for the kids as they feel hungry at night, but Rajesh refuses to let them eat. Happu feels sad as he eats boiled food. Beni and Vimlesh bring food for Amma from the food festival.

episodesList.title: Happu Craves Delicious Food
episodesList.summary: Rajesh bans Amma's liquor. At night, she catches Amma, Happu, and the children secretly eating kebabs. Beni and Vimlesh go to the food festival. Later, Happu craves delicious food.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Realises Her Mistake
episodesList.summary: Sunaina visits the police station to file a complaint against her husband. Happu comes up with an idea to teach Rajesh a lesson, and Amma and the kids support him. Later, Rajesh realises her mistake.

episodesList.title: Happu Makes a Promise to the Children
episodesList.summary: Amma has a nightmare. The children ask Happu for gifts on Children’s Day. On Rajesh’s suggestion, Happu decides to take the children to see tigers. Reshampal gives some news to Happu and Manohar.

episodesList.title: Happu Takes His Kids on a Jungle Safari
episodesList.summary: Happu learns that all the tigers of Kanpur have been sent to the jungles of MP. Happu gives an idea to Beni to motivate Vimlesh. Later, he takes the kids on a jungle safari.

episodesList.title: The Lion's Arrival Scares Everyone
episodesList.summary: Kat shoots her modeling photographs in the forest. Beni, who is disguised as a lion, flees on seeing the real lion. The lion's arrival scares everyone. The news on TV shocks Amma, Rajesh, and Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Everyone's Life Is in Danger
episodesList.summary: Everyone's life is in danger. When Amma, Rajesh and Vimlesh argue over going to the forest, an upset Reshampal arrives. Scared at the thought of dying, everyone thinks about their unfulfilled dreams.

episodesList.title: Happu Fights with the Lion
episodesList.summary: Reshampal agrees to go to the forest, but he gets a phone call from his wife. Happu fulfils his last wish and fights with the lion, following which, the lion faints and everyone returns home safely.

episodesList.title: Who Will Win the Lucky Draw?
episodesList.summary: Rajesh buys a lucky draw ticket in which the winner gets a trip to Rishikesh. Reshampal gives Happu a week off. Beni also buys a ticket. Later, the winner of the lucky draw is announced.

episodesList.title: An Argument Over Travelling to Rishikesh
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh argue with Happu over travelling to Rishikesh, so he offers Beni the tickets to Rishikesh. Happu asks Reshampal to cancel his leave, and Reshampal provides a solution to his problem.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan to Cancel the Trip to Rishikesh
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh conspire to defeat each other in the competition. They force Reshampal to eat chhole despite his upset stomach. Happu comes up with a plan to cancel the trip to Rishikesh.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Won't be Able to Travel to Rishikesh
episodesList.summary: Happu fractures his leg to avoid going to Rishikesh. Amma and Rajesh's dream of visiting Rishikesh is shattered. Amma plans to take the entire family, excluding Happu and Beni, on a tour of Rishikesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Visit to Her Maternal House Delights Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu gets delighted as Rajesh goes to her maternal house. Reshampal urges Happu to enjoy himself. Vimlesh takes over Rajesh's responsibility, but the family dislikes the food she prepares.

episodesList.title: Amma Demands Apologies from Her Daughters-In-Law
episodesList.summary: Amma forces Vimlesh to drink alcohol. A drunk Vimlesh tells Amma how much Rajesh disparages her. Amma records it and shows it to Happu. Later, she demands apologies from her daughters-in-law.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Refuses to Apologise to Amma
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh does not apologise to Amma. On learning about Happu's predicament, Reshampal shares a plan with him. Amma makes Kamlesh do housework while training him. Later, she does not talk to Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Start Fighting
episodesList.summary: Beni throws away the bottle of wine bought by Happu, and the duo starts fighting. Amma treats Kamlesh like a servant, and Dr. Udas gives him advice. Later, Reshampal tells another plan to Happu.

episodesList.title: Amma and Vimlesh Make a Revelation
episodesList.summary: After arguing with Happu, Beni decides to leave the house. Happu comes up with a plan to stop Beni. Later, Beni asks Vimlesh to apologise to Amma. Moreover, Amma and Vimlesh make a revelation.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Demands Happu to Buy a Car
episodesList.summary: Rajesh insists on Happu purchasing a car, but Amma opposes her. Malaika allows Kamlesh to stay at her house. Reshampal goes out for a few days and gives the responsibility of his car to Manohar.

episodesList.title: Happu Brings a Car Home
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh makes Rajesh envious with good news. Happu borrows Reshampal's car from Manohar. He lies to the family, and everyone goes for a ride. Reshampal calls Manohar to know the condition of his car.

episodesList.title: Amma Sells the Car
episodesList.summary: The family enjoys riding in the car. When Reshampal returns, he asks Happu and Manohar about his car. Meanwhile, Amma sells the car. Happu returns home and tells everyone the truth about the car.

episodesList.title: Happu Lies to Reshampal
episodesList.summary: Amma tells Happu that she has sold the car. As the car owner refuses to return the car, Happu lies to Reshampal that his car has been stolen. Later, Reshampal threatens Happu. Amma makes a revelation.

episodesList.title: The Children Narrate an Incident to Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: The children plan to party when the new car arrives. They tell Vimlesh about the chariot resort, where Ranbir celebrated his birthday. Everyone decides to go to the Chariot Resort in their new car.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Gets Humiliated
episodesList.summary: Kat tells Happu and Rajesh about her new job. Rajesh receives the parcel, but instead of Pucci sandals, something else arrives. As Rajesh gets humiliated in front of everyone, she threatens Happu.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Demands Pucci Sandals
episodesList.summary: Happu contacts Pucci's customer service. Kat, who works there, dupes Happu and hangs up the phone. Karishma and Vimlesh mock Rajesh. Later, Vimlesh asks Beni for Pucci sandals.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Orders a Dress from Pucci
episodesList.summary: Rajesh orders a dress from Pucci for INR 70,000 to get her refund. When their demands are not fulfilled, the children exact vengeance on Happu. Benni devises a plan to avoid gifting Vimlesh sandals.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Gets Pucci Sandals and a Dress
episodesList.summary: Rajesh again falls prey to an online shopping scam. Kat helps in finding the online fraudster, Johnny Sharma. Later, Happu gifts Rajesh Pucci sandals and a dress.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh to Fight with Each Other
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Amma have an argument and they fight with each other. The kids ask Happu for handcuffs for their school play. Later, Happu decides to judge the contest between Amma and Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan - December 20, 2022
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh Become Greedy
episodesList.summary: Happu notices Amma and Rajesh's handcuffs. Raka expresses his wish to make Amma wear his mother's gold bangles. Happu refuses to let Amma and Rajesh take the bangles, but they become greedy.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh's Handcuffs Are Unlocked
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh take the bangles from Raka. Reshampal learns about Happu's children's antics. Manohar comes with the key, which unlocks Amma and Rajesh's handcuffs. Raka flees from Happu's house.

episodesList.title: Where will Happu's Family Celebrate Christmas?
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh quarrel over going out during the Christmas holidays. Happu doesn't understand who he should support. Later, the family votes on whether to travel to Manali or Jabalpur.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Leave for Manali
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh tells Kat about his new business. Happu votes for Rajesh and plans to celebrate Christmas in Manali. Later, Amma curses everyone, and they leave for Manali.

episodesList.title: Amma's Predictions Come True
episodesList.summary: Happu's family trip to Manali gets cancelled and Vimlesh blames Amma for it. Later, Amma's predictions come true once again, and the family enjoys Manali in Kanpur.

episodesList.title: The Family Members Tape Amma's Mouth
episodesList.summary: The family members tape Amma's mouth, which worsens her health. Rajesh gets terrified of Amma and makes a request to her. Later, Amma speaks something negative about Reshampal.

episodesList.title: Will Happu Win a Lottery of INR 100 Crore?
episodesList.summary: Beni advises Happu, who then decides to take advantage of Amma's situation. He buys a lottery ticket worth INR 100 crore. Later, the family discovers the reason behind Amma's prophecy coming true.

episodesList.title: Happu Eats an Omelette Made of Snake Eggs
episodesList.summary: Manohar accidentally feeds an omelette made of snake eggs to Happu. Naagin follows them to exact revenge. The next morning, Beni talks to Happu, and Malaika finds a snake outside the house.

episodesList.title: Naagin Threatens Happu with Revenge
episodesList.summary: Reshampal summons a snake to help Happu and Manohar. Naagin threatens Happu with revenge. Happu forbids his children from leaving the house and keeps watch over them at night.

episodesList.title: Happu Performs a Dance
episodesList.summary: Happu apologises to Nagin and makes a request to her. However, Nagin makes him dance in front of everyone. Furthermore, Happu, concerned about his family's safety, seeks help from Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Nagin Injects Her Poison into Happu's Body
episodesList.summary: Nagin injects her poison into Happu's body, and he feels scared to shake hands with others. Karishma tells Rajesh that she witnessed Happu with a girl. Kamlesh stops Happu's children from going out.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Proved to be an Idiot
episodesList.summary: Happu's children deceive Kamlesh and go trekking in the forest. Chamchi returns home with bad news. Reshampal's niece Vishu wins the bet by proving Happu to be an idiot.

episodesList.title: Happu Teaches the Children with Beni's Help
episodesList.summary: Happu teaches the children with Beni's help, and Vimlesh tells Rajesh about it. Rajesh reveals Happu's deception and taunts Amma. Later, Amma reprimands Happu and Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan Against Masterji
episodesList.summary: Happu bribes Masterji and he punishes Happu. Amma assigns a task to Manohar. Happu intends to degrade Masterji's character. Later, Kamlesh records Masterji's video.

episodesList.title: Masterji Complains to Reshampal
episodesList.summary: As per Happu's plan, Beni and Kamlesh blackmail Masterji. Later, Masterji and his father complain about them to Reshampal, who arrests Beni and Kamlesh. Happu and the duo are then punished.

episodesList.title: Happu's Children Accept Masterji's Condition
episodesList.summary: Manohar beats up Happu, Beni and Kamlesh. Masterji lays a condition to the children, and Reshampal releases Happu, Beni and Kamlesh. The children study well, take the exam and get their results.

episodesList.title: Gupta Curses Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma talk about their ex-lovers and later the trio gets a call from them. Elsewhere, Gupta curses Happu when the latter imprisons him.

episodesList.title: Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma Meet Their Ex-Lovers
episodesList.summary: Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma meet their respective ex-lovers. Amma sees Rajesh and Vimlesh and tells Happu about them. Later, Rajesh informs Happu about Amma and Bhatia. Happu overhears Kamlesh and Kat.

episodesList.title: Happu asks Gupta to Take Back His Curse
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Gupta to take back his curse. Jayesh and Suresh invite Rajesh and Vilmesh to the park. Amma also agrees to go to the park with Bhatia. Later, Gupta curses the commissioner.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner and Happu Serve Gupta
episodesList.summary: Kat and Kamlesh go camping. Rajesh, Vimlesh and Amma meet Jayesh, Suresh and Bhatia, respectively. Later, Beni warns Happu. The commissioner and Happu serve Gupta and ask him to take back his curse.

episodesList.title: Happu's Misunderstanding Is Cleared
episodesList.summary: Rajesh, Vimlesh and the others arrive at the hotel. Happu too arrives there, and his misunderstanding is cleared. Happu, Beni and Pitaji apologise to their wives. Later, Manohar exposes Gupta’s truth.

episodesList.title: A Secret Mission for Happu and Manohar
episodesList.summary: The commissioner assigns Happu and Manohar the secret mission of catching Johnny Briganza. Happu lies to Rajesh and reaches Munnibai's place with Manohar. Later, Rajesh discovers Happu's deception.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Asks Beni to Spy on Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh informs Amma about Happu's deception. She asks Beni to spy on Happu. Beni follows Happu, who lies to everyone at home and goes to the grave. Meanwhile, Rajesh and Amma watch Happu's video.

episodesList.title: Beni's Plan to Teach Happu a Lesson
episodesList.summary: When Rajesh asks questions, Happu reveals his flaws. Beni tells Rajesh about a plan to teach Happu a lesson. Later, Amma and Rajesh go to Munnibai's place and ask her to join their plan.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Angered on Seeing Rajesh at a Brothel
episodesList.summary: Happu is shocked to see Rajesh at a brothel and later, fight at home. He informs Amma about it but she defends Rajesh. Rajesh and Beni pull off a pretence at the brothel to make Happu jealous.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells Rajesh the Truth about the Mission
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Amma continue the pretence in front of Happu. Reshampal frees Happu from his oath and Happu tells Rajesh the reason behind coming to the brothel. Johnny Briganza escapes the police.

episodesList.title: Pitaji Tells Amma about the Hidden Treasure
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu to accompany her to Goa for her birthday. Pitaji tells Amma about the hidden treasure in the house. Amma informs the family of this secret, and Rajesh cancels her trip to Goa.

episodesList.title: Happu Digs His House for the Treasure
episodesList.summary: Happu starts digging his house with Kamlesh's help. The family tries to hide the treasure's secret from Kamlesh. Happu lies to Reshampal about being ill. Reshampal asks Manohar to find Happu's truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Finds an Urn
episodesList.summary: Happu's children don't let Manohar enter their house. In the excavation of the house, an urn is found. The children lie to Reshampal who arrives home. Later, Amma and Rajesh hear news on the radio.

episodesList.title: Amma Defeats Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Amma defeats Rajesh in the first round and taunts her. Disturbed by Amma and Rajesh's fight, the kids do not go home after school. Happu hurries home after Kamlesh gives him false information.

episodesList.title: Happu Learns about Amma and Rajesh's Act
episodesList.summary: Happu receives a call informing him that the women at his house have been bitten by a snake. He returns home and learns about Amma and Rajesh's act. Happu beats up Beni, who then agrees to help him.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh Realise Their Mistake
episodesList.summary: With the help of Beni and Dr Udas, Happu makes Amma and Rajesh realise their mistake. Masterji tells Happu, Rajesh and Amma about the kids' actions. Ranbir confounds Happu by asking him a riddle.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Health Worsens En Route to Thailand
episodesList.summary: Happu lies to Reshampal to get holidays. Vimlesh also demands that Beni take her to Thailand. Later, Rajesh's health suddenly worsens. Amma overhears Happu calling the hotel to postpone the booking.

episodesList.title: Beni Asks Kansi Chacha to Return Home
episodesList.summary: Kansi Chacha informs Rajesh that he is coming to meet her. To help Happu, Beni asks Kansi Chacha to return home. Amma learns that Kansi Chacha is well and that Rajesh deceived her.

episodesList.title: Kansi Chacha Arrives at Happu's House
episodesList.summary: Rajesh reveals the truth to Amma. Kansi Chacha complains to Reshampal about the threats he is receiving and tells him about his relationship with Happu. Later, Reshampal takes him to Happu's house.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Decides Not to Travel to Thailand
episodesList.summary: Rajesh's health improves when she takes the soup from Kamlesh's cart. She and Happu hide from Reshampal and Kansi Chacha but eventually get exposed. Later, Rajesh decides not to travel to Thailand.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Asks Happu for Help
episodesList.summary: Reshampal asks Happu to let his sister Reshma stay at the latter's place for a few days. Hrithik promises to speak the truth to Alia. Happu tells the family about Reshma's arrival, and a curse ensues.

episodesList.title: The Family Gets Woried about Reshma
episodesList.summary: Happu brings Reshma home and forbids her from talking to the boys. Hritik exposes Ranbir in front of a girl. Reshma's habit of fleeing the house worries her family. Kamlesh collides with Reshma.

episodesList.title: Reshma Threatens Kamlesh to Marry Her
episodesList.summary: Reshma runs into Kamlesh and falls in love with him. Rajesh learns that Reshma has eloped with Kamlesh and informs Happu about it. Later, Reshma threatens Kamlesh to marry her.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Becomes Reshma
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Manohar to find Reshma and bring her home. The commissioner brings Reshma's suitor and his family to Happu's house. Later, Rajesh introduces Vimlesh as Reshma, and Vimlesh slaps the boy.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Escapes from Reshma
episodesList.summary: The commissioner tries to take Vimlesh along after mistaking her for Reshma, but Happu stops him. Kamlesh escapes from Reshma, and the commissioner learns the truth. Later, Reshma flees again.

episodesList.title: A Rule Mandating a Fine for Expressing Anger
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu to take her to Nainital, but he refuses. Masterji falls victim to Hrithik's rage and complains about him to his family. Rajesh puts a fine on everyone who gets angry in the house.

episodesList.title: Happu Keeps Paying the Fine
episodesList.summary: Rajesh reveals her plan in front of the children and Amma. Everyone supports her, and Happu continues to pay the fine. Happu informs this to Beni. Later, Kamlesh tries to make Kat angry.

episodesList.title: Happu Struggles to Keep His Temper in Control
episodesList.summary: Happu struggles to keep his temper in control. Dr. Udaas gives an injection to quell Happu's temper. At the same time, Kat controls her wrath after seeing Kamlesh with Suhani.

episodesList.title: Happu Doesn't Get Angry
episodesList.summary: Happu doesn't get angry at anything. At the same time, Kamlesh enrages Kat. Dr Gupta gives Rajesh medication to drive Happu mad, but Vimlesh suffers the consequences.

episodesList.title: Happu Teaches the Family a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gives Happu milk laced with medicine, which makes him angry at everything. Beni discovers Rajesh's ploy and informs Happu about it. To teach the family a lesson, Happu puts on an act.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Family Plays Holi
episodesList.summary: Kat gets a marriage proposal from Canada. She tells Kamlesh about it and he gets sad. Later, an inebriated Happu misbehaves with someone. The next day, Happu and his family play Holi.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Face a Water Cut on Holi
episodesList.summary: Mishra, a water department official, takes revenge on Happu and Beni. As per their complaint, Resham Pal scolds Mishra, but he faces a water cut in his house too. Happu decides to take Manohar's help.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Yearns for Water
episodesList.summary: Manohar is punished for helping Happu. Beni suspects that someone is keeping Mishra updated. Happu's family yearns for water. Amma asks Happu to apologise to Mishra.

episodesList.title: The Electricity of Beni and Happu's House Gets Cut
episodesList.summary: Due to Kamlesh, the electricity of Happu and Beni’s house goes away. A prospective groom comes to see Kat, but the alliance doesn’t come to fruition. Rajesh and Vimlesh make a request to Mishra.

episodesList.title: Happu Teaches Mishra a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Happu and Manohar thrash Mishra, which worsens the matters. Later, Happu teaches Mishra a lesson by abducting his sister-in-law. Mishra gets Happu's electricity and water back and apologises to him.

episodesList.summary: Happu's kids fail in PT. Rajesh decides to lose weight. Happu hires a coach to teach badminton to his kids. Coach Janardhan comes to Happu's house and falls for Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Asks Permission to Play Badminton
episodesList.summary: Janardan suggests Rajesh play badminton to lose weight. Kamlesh lies to Kat and Malaika about him being a big sportsman. Later, Rajesh asks Amma for permission to play badminton.

episodesList.title: Amma Objects to Rajesh's Dress
episodesList.summary: Happu shares his doubt about Janardan with Beni. Rajesh wears a sports dress and plays badminton, which Amma objects to. Later, Rajesh asks Vimlesh to play badminton too.

episodesList.title: Janardan Quits Coaching Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh complains to Janardan about Happu. Vimlesh too decides to play badminton. Kat learns of Kamlesh's lie. Janardan quits coaching because of Happu’s accusations. Happu appeases Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Proves to Be a Coward
episodesList.summary: Masterji praises Hrithik's bravery while Rajesh taunts Amma. Amma decides to take revenge on Rajesh. To prove his bravery, Happu goes to arrest Mintu but ends up getting beaten up.

episodesList.title: Hritik Gets Exposed in front of Ranbir
episodesList.summary: Masterji praises Rajesh for Hritik's bravery. Vimlesh also praises Beni's bravery. Hritik gets exposed in front of Ranbir. Later, Happu puts on an act to prove himself brave.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Assigned to Find Pandey Sultan
episodesList.summary: Everyone talks about Happu's bravery. Beni gets enraged at Happu for not giving him the credit. Reshampal assigns Happu the task of arresting Bandit Pandey Sultan, leaving him terrified.

episodesList.title: Pandey Sultan Threatens Happu's Life
episodesList.summary: Threatening Pandey Sultan lands Happu in trouble. Happu tells Reshampal and the family members that his video is fake. Ritika’s lie is exposed as well. Later, Pandey Sultan calls Happu.

episodesList.title: Pandey Sultan Is Caught
episodesList.summary: Happu apologises to Pandey Sultan in front of the media. Pandey Sultan arrives at Happu's house and puts a condition in exchange for forgiving him. Happu's children catch Pandey Sultan.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Suffers from a Strange Disease
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Happu about Vimlesh's illness. Karishma invites Rajesh to her sister's wedding. Rajesh instructs Happu to ask Amma for her necklace. Later, Happu offers Beni some advice.

episodesList.title: Amma's Necklace Gets Stolen
episodesList.summary: Happu imprisons the DIG's brother-in-law. Amma lends Rajesh her necklace for the wedding. Pitaji tells Amma an anecdote about the necklace. At the same time, Amma's necklace gets stolen.

episodesList.title: Everyone Conceals the Theft from Amma
episodesList.summary: Happu suspects Vimlesh of stealing the necklace, and Beni searches her purse. The family members conceal the theft of the necklace from Amma. Rajesh tells Vimlesh that she has started stealing again.

episodesList.title: Amma Beats the DIG's Brother-In-Law
episodesList.summary: Amma asks Rajesh about the necklace. Happu brings the DIG's brother-in-law home and introduces him as the jeweller, but Amma beats him up. The DIG asks Reshampal to find his brother-in-law.

episodesList.title: Amma's Necklace Is Found
episodesList.summary: Manohar tells Happu that Salecharan is the DIG's brother-in-law. Rajesh suggests an idea to return Amma's necklace. The thief is found and Amma gets her necklace. Rajesh tells Amma the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Vows to be Honest
episodesList.summary: Happu brings INR 1 lakh of his bribe money to Amma. Rajesh demands a necklace from Happu. Pitaji blames Amma for Happu's habit of taking bribes. Later, Happu vows to be honest.

episodesList.title: An Honest Happu Refuses to Take a Bribe
episodesList.summary: Happu punishes Dhanvantari for offering him a bribe. Pitaji is delighted with Happu's honesty. Later, Happu's children plan to cheat in the exam, and Kamlesh discovers their ploy.

episodesList.title: Happu's Honesty Gets Tested
episodesList.summary: Happu foils his children's plan to cheat in the exam. Reshampal tests Happu's honesty. Later, Happu refuses to help Gabbar, who is in trouble.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrests Gabbar
episodesList.summary: Happu arrests Gabbar for eve-teasing a tenant. Rajesh tries a trick to help Gabbar escape from jail. Beni tries to get Happu to sign a paper by getting him drunk.

episodesList.title: Pitaji Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Gabbar escapes from jail and returns home, but Amma and Rajesh hide him. Manohar tells Happu that Gabbar is innocent. Later, Pitaji gets exposed, and Happu plays an April Fool prank on Beni.

episodesList.title: A Plan to Install a Petrol Pump
episodesList.summary: Happu informs Amma of a government scheme to install a petrol pump. Hritik gives this news to Rajesh, who then puts a condition on Happu. Amma decides to become a Thumri singer to get the petrol pump.

episodesList.title: Happu Files an Application for a Petrol Pump
episodesList.summary: Happu applies for a petrol pump in Amma's name. In school, the children deceive Masterji. Further, Reshampal gives bad news to Happu, and the family decides to put on an act.

episodesList.title: Amma Introduces Herself as a Thumri Singer to Dimant
episodesList.summary: When Dimant arrives home, Happu learns that he is an honest man. Happu stops Beni from talking to Dimant. Amma introduces herself as a Thumri singer to Dimant. Later, Dimant asks her to sing a song.

episodesList.title: Amma Lands Into a Trouble
episodesList.summary: Amma makes excuses to avoid singing in front of Dimant. Kamlesh shares a plan with Happu. While trying to help Happu, Kamlesh gets caught by the police. Reshampal calls Happu to the police station.

episodesList.title: The Dream Of a Petrol Pump Is Shattered
episodesList.summary: The family implements Beni's plan. Meanwhile, a problem arises, but Amma gets the petrol pump. Later, the bad news shatters Happu's family's dream of owning a petrol pump.

episodesList.title: The Dream Of a Petrol Pump Is Shattered
episodesList.summary: The family implements Beni's plan. Meanwhile, a problem arises, but Amma gets the petrol pump. Later, the bad news shatters Happu's family's dream of owning a petrol pump.

episodesList.title: Happu Opens an Account on Social Media
episodesList.summary: On Reshampal's orders, Happu asks his kids to create his account on social media. Kamlesh decides to take revenge on Happu. Rajesh and Vimlesh doubt their husbands, and Amma gives them a challenge.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Open their Social Media Accounts
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni ask the kids to change their names on social media. Rajesh and Vimlesh open their social media accounts with the help of Kat. Kamlesh tells Kat a plan to take revenge on Happu and Beni.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Test their Husbands
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh message Happu and Beni from their fake social media accounts to test their husbands' loyalty. Happu and Beni see the message, but they do not reply. Kamlesh executes his plan.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Hacks Happu and Beni's Accounts
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh oust their husbands, and Kat informs Kamlesh about it. The kids misuse Happu's account. Kamlesh hacks Happu and Beni's accounts and messages Rajesh and Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Doubts are Cleared
episodesList.summary: When Happu and Beni go to the ice cream parlour, Amma comes there and beats them up. They try a ruse to assuage their wives' suspicions. Later, Kamlesh tells them the truth and apologises to them.

episodesList.title: Amma Divides the House
episodesList.summary: The priest advises Amma on how to maintain peace in the house. Amma asks Happu to have a tenth child. When Rajesh refuses, Amma divides the house.

episodesList.title: Happu to Stay at Beni's House
episodesList.summary: Happu fails to choose one between Amma and Rajesh. Vimlesh overhears Beni giving Happu a piece of advice. Later, Rajesh asks Vimlesh to spy on Amma. Happu moves into Beni's house.

episodesList.title: Happu Leaves Beni's House
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh break Happu and Beni's friendship. Happu leaves Beni's house and returns to his, but sets up his tent in the courtyard. Later, he asks Kamlesh to be cautious of the beltman.

episodesList.title: Gabbar Decides to Stay with Happu
episodesList.summary: Under the pretence of suffering a leg sprain, Rajesh calls Happu. Gabbar gets home and decides to stay with Happu. Later, Happu and Beni taunt each other. Rajesh devises a plan with Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Amma Gives Up on Her Stubbornness
episodesList.summary: Amma's health deteriorates, but Happu suspects she is acting and goes to the police station. Rajesh looks after Amma. Later, Amma realises her mistake and gives up on her stubbornness.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Leaves the House
episodesList.summary: Rajesh leaves the house as Happu forgets their anniversary. Even after six months, Rajesh does not return and Amma forces Happu to marry again. Gabbar brings Lachho as a potential partner for Happu.

episodesList.title: Problems Arise when Happu Marries Lachcho
episodesList.summary: Happu asks the children to join his plan to bring Rajesh home. Later, Happu gets married to Lachcho, and his plan fails. Happu discovers Laccho's truth on their first night.

episodesList.title: Lachho Tortures Amma and the Children

episodesList.title: Happu Alleviates Rajesh and Beni's Displeasure
episodesList.summary: Happu conducts another interview, alleviating Rajesh and Beni's displeasure. Masterji threatens to fail Happu's children. Rajesh tells Amma about Happu's interview, making her jealous.

episodesList.title: Happu Makes Amma and Rajesh Happy
episodesList.summary: Happu's efforts to please Amma upset Rajesh again. He then catches Shakal. Although Happu manages to please Amma and Rajesh through the interview, the children are displeased with him.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Masterji sees Happu getting kidnapped and informs his children about it. Kamlesh seeks help from Kat. Happu's doppelganger Muttu Swami, also known as Babu, tells his plan to Happu and threatens him.

episodesList.title: Happu's Doppelganger Takes His Place
episodesList.summary: Muttu Swami comes as Happu to live at the latter's house. Rajesh mistakes him for Happu. Kamlesh asks him to sign the character certificate but due to his behaviour, Kat and Kamlesh get suspicious.

episodesList.title: Muttu Swami Tries to Kill Reshampal
episodesList.summary: Beni suspects Happu’s behaviour. Muttu Swami’s attempt to kill Reshampal goes unsuccessful. Rajesh plans to woo Happu. The real Happu asks for a favour from Gudiya Rani.

episodesList.title: The Children Grow Suspicious of Happu's Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Mutthu Swami's plot to kill Reshmapal fails once again. Rajesh follows Amma's advice to bring Happu back home. The children become suspicious of Happu's behaviour and decide to test him.

episodesList.title: Happu's Doppelganger Is Arrested
episodesList.summary: The family tries to uncover the truth about Happu's doppelganger. The real Happu comes home and the family is shocked to see him. Amma identifies the real Happu, and Happu's doppelganger is arrested.

episodesList.title: A Dog Bites Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu refuses to have a dog at home. Later, Reshampal shares a plan with Manohar and Happu to catch Shakal. On the way, a dog bites Happu, and he starts behaving strangely.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes a Dog
episodesList.summary: Frightened by Happu's dog-like behaviour, Amma and Rajesh rush him to the doctor for an injection. Happu bites Beni, and Ranbir brings a dog belt to wrap around Happu's neck.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Takes Advantage of Happu's Condition
episodesList.summary: Rajesh beats up Happu for his misbehaviour. Reshampal learns about Happu's condition, and he takes advantage of it. Happu finds Shakal and reveals the secret of him becoming a dog.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets a Fake Injection
episodesList.summary: Happu arrests Shakal, and Reshampal talks about his job transfer. Masterji tells Amma that the principal has summoned Happu. The doctor informs Happu's family about the fake injection incident.

episodesList.title: The Family Cures Happu's Condition
episodesList.summary: Happu behaves like a dog in the children's principal's office. Kamlesh's plan to cure Happu backfires. Later, following Dr Udaas's advice, the family cures Happu's condition.

episodesList.title: A Bet between Amma and Nargisariya
episodesList.summary: Dreaded criminal Dassu Dandiya escapes from jail and tells Reshampal tells Happu about it. The children steal a chemical from school to fix a broken family vase. Amma and Nargisiya start a bet.

episodesList.title: Dassu Dandiya Threatens Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu to participate in a Dandiya competition. Dassu Dandiya threatens Happu. Due to the kids' antics, the Dandiya sticks to Happu's hand. Reshampal summons Happu to the police station.

episodesList.title: Dassu Wants to Kill Happu
episodesList.summary: Dassu Dandiya’s threats scare Happu. Rajesh compels Happu to practise ‘dandiya’, and later, Dassu sees Happu practising ‘dandiya’. Thereafter, a pundit predicts that Happu’s life is in danger.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Scared of Dandiya
episodesList.summary: Dassu and his men beat up Happu with 'dandiya' sticks which makes Happu fearful of 'dandiya'. Dr. Udas advises Happu's family, and they attempt to help him overcome his fear.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Plays Dandiya
episodesList.summary: Hrithik tells the family about his plan to help Happu overcome his fear. Dassu tries to beat up Happu, but Hapu beats him instead. The family plays Dandiya at home as the competition gets cancelled.

episodesList.title: Happu Vows to Become Lord Ram
episodesList.summary: Happu vows to become Lord Ram in the Ramleela, organised by the police department. Kamlesh gets the job of becoming the statue of Ravana. Rajesh insists on going on a trip to Himachal with Happu.

episodesList.title: Beni Gets the Role of Lord Rama
episodesList.summary: Hrithik asks Masterji to play the role of Lord Rama in Ramleela. Amma convinces Happu to retake his oath by lying to him. Due to a misunderstanding, Reshampal assigns the role of Lord Rama to Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Beni to Give Him the Role of Lord Rama
episodesList.summary: Rajesh's desire to visit Himachal gets shattered. Reshampal informs Happu that Beni will play Lord Rama's character. Happu asks Beni to give him the role of Lord Rama and Vimlesh overhears them.

episodesList.title: Happu Plans against Beni
episodesList.summary: Beni refuses to give Happu the character of Lord Ram. Masterji gives Ritik the character of Laxman to play in school ‘Ramleela’. Later, Happu devises a plan to get the character of Lord Ram from Beni.

episodesList.title: Amma Organises Ram Leela at Home
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: Happu Vows to Observe 'Karva Chauth' Fast
episodesList.summary: Happu vows to observe 'Karva Chauth' fast for Rajesh. Kat, Malaika, and Kamlesh start the 'Khao-Piyo' catering service. Due to Happu, even Beni observes a fast for Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Amma Learns that Happu Is Observing a Fast
episodesList.summary: Rajesh is delighted as Happu observes a fast for her. Reshampal informs Happu and Manohar that the minister wants to have lunch with them. Amma learns that Happu and Beni are observing a fast.

episodesList.title: Amma's Plan to Break Happu's Fast
episodesList.summary: The Minister arrives at the police station for lunch, and Happu continues to fast. But Beni breaks his fast. Amma asks money from Malaika, Kat and Kamlesh. Amma devises a plan to break Happu's fast.

episodesList.title: Amma's Attempt to Break Happu's Fast Fails
episodesList.summary: Amma's attempt to break Happu's fast fails. With Kat's help, Vimlesh tests Beni. Later, Amma and Rajesh challenge each other. Amma prepares 'Chole Bhature' for Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Completes the 'Karva Chauth' Fast
episodesList.summary: A dispute arises over the division of profits among Kat, Kamalesh, and Malaika. Happu faints due to fasting. Rajesh realises her mistake, but Happu completes his 'Karva Chauth' fast for her.

episodesList.title: Happu Defies the Government's Orders
episodesList.summary: Happu's family plans a Diwali celebration. Reshampal informs Happu about the government's order not to burst firecrackers. Happu grants permission to his children to burn firecrackers before Diwali.

episodesList.title: Happu Confesses to His Crime
episodesList.summary: Happu uncovers that Hrithik's fired rocket had burned Reshampal's wife's hair. Reshampal gets involved in apprehending the culprit, and Happu confesses to his crime. Reshampal punishes Happu.

episodesList.title: Will Beni Take Happu's Blame on Himself?
episodesList.summary: Rajesh shares the news of Happu's arrest with Amma. Later, the duo asks Beni to take the blame on himself to save Happu, and Beni informs it to Kamlesh. Kat shows Kamlesh the 'diyas' made by her.

episodesList.title: Happu Disguises Himself as Hapundari
episodesList.summary: Beni gets imprisoned while attempting to free Happu from jail. Rajesh and Vimlesh drive them out of jail. Happu poses as Hapundari to avoid being arrested, and Reshampal falls in love with her.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Celebrates Diwali without Firecrackers
episodesList.summary: Reshampal falls in love with Hapundari. The kids blackmail Reshampal to save Happu and Beni from being arrested. Happu's family celebrates Diwali without firecrackers and Reshampal makes a revelation.

episodesList.title: Everyone Is Scared of a Lady Killer
episodesList.summary: At night, a lady killer murders a man. Reshampal assigns the task of capturing that killer to Happu. Meanwhile, the kids frighten Kamlesh with the name of the lady killer. Happu gives Rajesh a gift.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Tells Amma about the Lady Killer
episodesList.summary: Rajesh wakes up scared from a dream. Kamlesh follows Rajesh, who goes out of the house and witnesses a murder. He decides to go to Happu's house and informs Amma that Rajesh is the lady killer.

episodesList.title: Happu Learns that Rajesh is the Lady Killer
episodesList.summary: Amma and Kamlesh inform Happu that Rajesh is the lady killer. Upon learning a secret from Gabbar about Rajesh, Happu suspects Rajesh's split personality. Amma prevents Kamlesh from leaving the house.

episodesList.title: The Family Is Frightened of Rajesh
episodesList.summary: At night, Happu and Kamlesh follow Rajesh and witness a murder. Chamchi informs Ranbir about Rajesh being the lady killer. Later, the family, frightened by Rajesh, seeks help from the doctor.

episodesList.title: Manohar Informs about the Lady Killer Being Caught
episodesList.summary: The family tries to rekindle the motherly love within Rajesh. Happu tries a trick and she attempts to kill Happu. Manohar informs about the lady killer being caught, and Rajesh tells the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan for His Mother and Wife's Happiness
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Amma start fighting while trying to resolve Hrithik and Chamchi's argument. Happu aggravates the situation by siding with Rajesh against Amma and vice versa. He advises Manohar.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh to Teach Happu a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh realise Happu's plan. Watching Kumar's acting, they come up with a plan, and seek Kumar's help to teach Happu a lesson. The children also join them in their plan.

episodesList.title: Changu Dev Maharaj Appears in Front of Kamlesh
episodesList.summary: Witnessing Amma transformed into Rajesh and vice versa, everyone is shocked. Happu decides to go to the temple of Changu Dev Maharaj with Beni. Changu Dev Maharaj appears in front of Kamlesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Meets Changu Dev
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Amma rejoice over the success of their plan. Happu meets Changu Dev, who tells him about his curse. Happu speaks negatively about Amma to Rajesh and criticises Rajesh in front of Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu Discovers Changu Dev's Ploy
episodesList.summary: Happu discovers Changu Dev's ploy. Later, he suggests sending Amma to an old age home and decides to divorce Rajesh, leaving them shocked. Rajesh apologises to Happu, who then beats up Changu Dev.

episodesList.title: Kat Worries about Gaining Weight
episodesList.summary: Rajesh calls Happu during the encounter. Happu decides on the home menu, and Kate worries about her weight. Later, Happu and Rajesh are troubled about cooking the children's favourite vegetables.

episodesList.title: Happu's Kids Refuse to Eat Food
episodesList.summary: Reshampal discovers that Manohar is working for Happu instead of being at the police station. Kat prepares her diet plan with Kamlesh. The kids refuse to eat potato-pea curry, which enrages Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Steals Buns from the Bakery
episodesList.summary: Jitu refuses to give Happu the buns from his bakery, showing how close his relationship is with Reshampal. Happu goes to Reshampal for help, but doesn't get any. Later, he steals the buns with Beni.

episodesList.title: The Kids Refuse to Eat Burgers
episodesList.summary: Rajesh makes burgers from the buns stolen by Happu, but the kids refuse to eat them. Kamlesh eats sweet while jogging with Kat. When shooting Shakal, Happu asks Manohar to deliver mutton to his house.

episodesList.title: Happu Realises His Mistake
episodesList.summary: The children request Happu to make Lasagna pasta, leading to a misunderstanding. When the food is not served on time, Amma's health deteriorates. Happu realises his mistake and apologises to Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Worries about the Cold Wave News
episodesList.summary: On hearing the news of a cold wave, Rajesh asks Happu to get a heater and Kamlesh seeks space at Kat's house. Happu is upset due to a shortage of heaters. Amma highlights the benefits of cold weather.

episodesList.title: Happu Plans a Trip to Lucknow with Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Shakal promises to provide heaters to Happu and Reshampal in exchange for his bail. Kamlesh helps Happu with household chores to stay in his house. Later, Happu plans a trip to Lucknow with Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Goes to Get the Heater from Kalpana
episodesList.summary: The doctor arrives to see Amma and demands a heater. Happu and Beni go to get it from Kalpana. Master asks for a heater in exchange for passing Hrithik and Ranbir. Happu and Reshampal learn a truth.

episodesList.title: Amma's Way to Stay Safe from Heatwaves
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni tell their wives about Kalpana's condition. Amma suggests a way to stay safe from heatwaves. Happu blackmails Kamlesh and asks him to do a task, putting Kamlesh in trouble.

episodesList.title: Shakal Sends a Heater to Shakal's House
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni go to the jungle to bring Kamlesh, who goes to gather firewood. Reshampal takes the firewood from Happu. Happu curses Shakal and he sends him a heater. A piece of news shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Happu Expresses His Anger
episodesList.summary: Happu scolds the kids and Rajesh. Later, he lashes out unnecessarily at Beni and beats up Reshampal's brother-in-law. Rajesh sings a song to pacify him. Soon, Happu beats up the paan vendor.

episodesList.title: The Family Devises a Plan to Control Happu's Anger
episodesList.summary: The family devises a plan to control Happu's anger. Masterji completes the children's duties. Pitaji takes pride in Happu's anger, and Happu resolves never to reduce his anger.

episodesList.title: Can Mukti Anand Calm Happu's Anger?
episodesList.summary: Ranbir pretends to point a gun at Hrithik in front of Happu. However, Happu takes pride in Ranbir's anger. Reshampal seeks the help of Guru Mukti Anand to control Happu's anger.

episodesList.title: Happu's Children Kill Masterji
episodesList.summary: The children inform Happu that they have killed Masterji. Beni refuses to help Happu. Masterji's wife complains about his disappearance, and Reshampal asks Happu to find him.

episodesList.title: Happu Faces Punishment for Getting Angry
episodesList.summary: Masterji's ghost scares Happu and Reshampal arrests Happu's kids for Masterji's murder. Happu realises the impact of teaching wrong lessons to his kids, and the family tells him about their act.

episodesList.title: Happu Keeps an Eye on His Children
episodesList.summary: Amma and the kids plan a party for Happu on his birthday. Upon hearing the news, Happu keeps an eye on his kids and informs Rajesh about Hrithik's actions. Kat tells Kamlesh about getting a job.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh Blame Each Other
episodesList.summary: Rajesh notices a whiskey bottle with Hrithik and Ranbir. Kat informs Rajesh that she wants to stay away from the family to work. Later, Happu and Rajesh blame each other for the children's misconduct.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh Worry about Children
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh worry about the children. Kat seeks a favour from Kamlesh, but Rajesh catches Kat's lie. Happu and Rajesh seek help from Beni and Vimlesh to keep an eye on the children.

episodesList.title: Happu Learns about His Children's Actions
episodesList.summary: Happu, Beni and Rajesh try to teach the children. Beni sees Chamchi accepting a flower from a boy. Manohar sees Hrithik, and Ranbir playing cards. Later, they both inform Happu about his children.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets a Birthday Surprise
episodesList.summary: Happu is unhappy about not providing a proper upbringing to the children. He beats up the boys who give a flower to Chamchi and offer alcohol to Hrithik. The children give Happu a birthday surprise.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan to Surprise the Children
episodesList.summary: The children get upset with Happu, and he comes up with a plan to resolve their grievances. Amma informs the children about Happu's plan. Happu requests Manohar to bring a Santa Claus costume for him.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Becomes a Thief to Fulfil Kat's Wishes
episodesList.summary: Happu's kids prepare their wishlist. Kat hands her wishlist to Kamlesh, who then steals a stranger's chain to fulfil her wishes. Happu asks a tailor to stitch a Santa Claus dress.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh Performs a Theft at Beni's House
episodesList.summary: The kids make a Christmas tree. Kamlesh, disguised as Santa, performs a theft at Beni's house. Resham Pal asks Happu to find the thief. Manohar gives Happu a suggestion to arrange Santa's dress.

episodesList.title: Happu Fails to Get a Santa Claus Costume
episodesList.summary: Happu buys gifts for the children for Christmas but fails to get a Santa Claus costume. Amma informs the children about this, and they get upset. At night, a dream leaves Happu scared.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes the Santa for His Children
episodesList.summary: Happu's children feel sad when they don't find gifts near the Christmas tree. Kamlesh gives gifts to Kat. When Happu fails to get Santa's costume, he devises a plan and gives gifts to the children.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni's Plan for the New Year
episodesList.summary: Happu's family prepares to celebrate the New Year at home. Later, Beni suggests Happu to go to a club for the New Year's party. Kat promises to help Kamlesh find a job.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni's Photos Are Printed in the Newspaper
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni return home late after the party. Kat asks Happu to help Kamlesh secure a job in the police force. Happu and Beni's photos are printed in the newspaper. Gabbar informs Amma about this.

episodesList.title: Amma Punishes Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: When Happu's lie is exposed, the family becomes upset with him. Vimlesh, enraged at Beni, ousts him from the house, and Rajesh beats up Happu. Amma punishes Happu and Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Get Punished
episodesList.summary: Due to his punishment, Happu fails to reject any demands from his family. Reshampal promotes Manohar, and Happu asks Reshampal to fulfil his promise. Even Beni has to suffer the punishment.

episodesList.title: Happu Apologises for His Mistake
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh argue, and they decide to send each other to their respective maternal homes. Reshampal fires Manohar and gives his position to Kamlesh. Happu apologises to Rajesh and Amma.

episodesList.title: Beni Loses Happu's Father's Old Case
episodesList.summary: Beni loses an old case related to Happu's father. The court orders Happu to deposit INR 2 crore. Later, Beni suggests a trick to Happu's family to avoid depositing the money.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Pretends to Be Poor
episodesList.summary: Manohar is made the observer of Happu's case. Happu's family pretends to be poor. Happu asks a man for a bribe and Resham Pal suspends him. Beni gives a news to Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Hides His Black Money
episodesList.summary: Happu buries his black money in a pit to hide it, but Manohar sees it. Reshampal arrives to seize Happu's black money. Later, everyone gets startled on finding the money and jewellery missing.

episodesList.title: Beni Ousts Happu's Family from His House
episodesList.summary: Everyone rejoices as the kids bring money and jewellery in front of Happu. Beni ousts Happu’s family, and the kids work on the streets. Manohar records a video of them. Gabbar arrives to meet Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Beni Shares Good News
episodesList.summary: Happu falls into Reshampal's trap and is arrested. Meanwhile, Beni shares good news with Happu's family. The family members apologise to Pitaji and celebrate Makar Sankranti.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes ACP
episodesList.summary: Due to a lack of progress in the job, Happu loses faith in God. Rajesh arranges 'Bhajan' in the house for Happu's progress. Happu becomes ACP but gives credit to himself instead of giving it to God.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes Arrogant on Becoming the ACP
episodesList.summary: Happu becomes arrogant on becoming the ACP and doesn’t take Beni along to the party. On his way to the party, Happu meets a boy, Keshav. Later, Happu’s behaviour upsets Rajesh.

episodesList.title: An Egoistic Happu Talks Rudely with His Family
episodesList.summary: Reshampal recommends his nephew to Happu for a job. Beni talks to Rajesh about Happu's egoistic nature. Later, Happu talks rudely to his family members, which upsets Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu's Children Bring Keshav Home
episodesList.summary: Happu punishes Manohar. Rajesh prays to Lord Krishna to give wisdom to Happu. Happu's children meet Keshav, and they bring him home. Rajesh hires Keshav for work.

episodesList.title: Keshav Wins Everyone's Hearts
episodesList.summary: Keshav resolves the problems of Happu's family and wins their hearts. Amma's health deteriorates, but Happu ignores her. Rajesh prays to Lord Krishna to prevent Happu from displaying arrogance.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Kamlesh to Leave the House
episodesList.summary: Hapu warns Kamlesh to leave his house within two days. Kamlesh shares this information with Kat. Gabbar seeks financial help from Happu to expand his business, but Hapu humiliates him.

episodesList.title: Keshav Tries to Reason with Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Keshav about Happu's actions and he tries to reason with Happu. Later, Rajesh prays to God to teach Happu a lesson. Kat gives Kamlesh a suggestion to stay in her house.

episodesList.title: Happu Ousts Amma from the House
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh fails to please Happu. Keshav gives Kat a suggestion to ensure that Happu is unable to oust Kamlesh from the house. Later, Happu ousts Amma from the house and Beni takes her to his house.

episodesList.title: Happu Ousts Kamlesh From the House
episodesList.summary: Amma narrates Beni a story, and it reminds her of Happu. Kamlesh unknowingly makes a mistake and Happu ousts him from the house. Rajesh asks Amma to come back home, but she refuses.

episodesList.title: Kat Marries Kamlesh and Brings Him Home
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tries to convince Amma to return home. On Keshav's advice, Kat marries Kamlesh and brings him to her house. Later, Amma asks Happu to accept their relationship.

episodesList.title: Happu Doesn't Go to Rajesh's House
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Kamlesh the rules of the house. Later, he makes up a story about having important work and doesn't go to Rajesh's house. Rajesh finds out Happu lied to her by reading a newspaper article.

episodesList.title: Kat Tries to Make Breakfast for Kamlesh
episodesList.summary: Kat tries to make tea and parathas for Kamlesh. The Paan shop owner humiliates Beni in front of Happu. At the police station, Happu tells Reshampal and Manohar about his party with the minister.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Defamed by a News Article
episodesList.summary: Happu does a favour for Shakal's sister Guddi, and she thanks him by kissing him. Gabbar requests Happu to inaugurate his shop. Later, Happu gets defamed by a news article in the newspaper.

episodesList.title: Happu Worries about His Defamation
episodesList.summary: Happu resolves to prove himself innocent. He goes to seek Guddi's help but ends up getting defamed. Gabbar cancels his plan to let Happu inaugurate his shop. Upset, Happu then goes to Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu Learns the Consequences of His Bad Attitude
episodesList.summary: Happu learns the consequences of his bad attitude and seeks forgiveness from God for his mistake. Guddi clarifies the matter in a media interview. The family also forgives Happu for his actions.

episodesList.title: The Kids Give Happu a Challenge
episodesList.summary: At night, Happu dresses up as a ghost and scares the kids and Rajesh. The kids challenge Happu to spend a night in the crematorium. Reshampal asks Bhalla to hold onto his INR 50 lakhs of black money.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Possessed by Bhalla's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni spend the night with Bhalla in jail instead of the crematorium. Happu is possessed by Bhalla's spirit. Manohar hides the truth about Bhalla's death from Reshampal.

episodesList.title: Happu Flirts with Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: Happu flirts with Vimlesh and Beni gets into an argument with Happu. Manohar feels scared when Bhalla dies and lies to Reshampal about Bhalla. Meanwhile, Kamlesh gets a job.

episodesList.title: Pitaji Suspects that Happu Is Possessed
episodesList.summary: Pitaji suspects that Happu is possessed. Happu asks Vimlesh to run away with him. Beni and Vimlesh complain to Amma and Rajesh about Happu. Amma informs Rajesh about Pitaji's suspicion.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Free of Bhalla's Spirit
episodesList.summary: The family members learn that Bhalla has possessed Happu. They follow Keshav's advice, and Bhalla leaves Happu's body. Reshampal and Manohar are surprised to see Bhalla alive.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Valentine's Day Wishes
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh share their Valentine's Day wishes with their husbands. Kat tells Kamlesh to find a job. Hritik and Ranbir see Chamchi talking to a boy in school.

episodesList.title: Beni Couldn't Take Vimlesh to Dinner
episodesList.summary: Happu books a table for dinner with Rajesh. However, Beni is unable to book a table due to a lack of money. Later, on Valentine's night, Benny returns home drunk, which upsets Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Beni Gets a Good Job Opportunity
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gets upset with Happu for not lending money to Beni. Later, Beni seeks help from a prominent lawyer, who offers him a job opportunity in Chennai. Beni and Vimlesh prepare to shift to Chennai.

episodesList.title: Amma's Act to Prevent Beni from Leaving
episodesList.summary: Happu considers Manohar his friend and spends time with him. Amma pretends to be sick to stop Beni from leaving, but Beni realises her act. Later, Amma refuses to let Beni go away.

episodesList.title: Happu Plans to Prevent Beni from Going to Chennai
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh packs his belongings for his trip to Chennai. Happu plans to prevent Beni from going to Chennai. When Vimlesh and Beni bid goodbye to everyone, Sundaram Nayar accuses Beni of being dishonest.

episodesList.title: Ranbir Brags about Being the Son of an ACP
episodesList.summary: Happu discourages Malaika from joining the police force. Kamlesh gets a job interview call. Ranbir brags about being the son of an ACP, and Chamchi complains to Happu about him.

episodesList.title: Ranbir Is Not Happu's Son
episodesList.summary: A man tells Ranbir that he is not Happu's son. An upset Ranbir shares this news with his family, and Happu decides to find out the truth. Ranbir accuses Happu and Rajesh of discriminating against him.

episodesList.title: Happu is Unaware of Ranbir's Favourite Colour
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Manohar to find the person who told Ranbir the truth. Later, he brings clothes of their favourite colours for the kids. Happu not knowing his favourite colour upsets the Ranbir.

episodesList.title: Ranbir's Name Is Struck Off from School
episodesList.summary: Ranbir's name is struck off from school for unpaid fees. Kamlesh wears a stolen shirt for an interview but gets into trouble. Happu beats up the man who tells the truth to Ranbir.

episodesList.title: Ranbir Discovers the Truth
episodesList.summary: Ranbir leaves the house. Keshav convinces him to return home, and later, Ranbir learns the truth. After receiving her exam results, Malaika bids goodbye to everyone and leaves for training.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Happu's Argument
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Happu have an argument. Chamchi strikes a deal with Ranbir. Rajesh gets upset with Happu over him not knowing her likes-dislikes. Chamchi plans to go for a movie with Sanket.

episodesList.title: Happu Upsets Rajesh by Pleasing Amma
episodesList.summary: Happu is able to read Amma's mind and pleases Amma by scolding Rajesh who, in turn, gets angry. Happu apologises to Rajesh on Amma's behalf. Later, Happu catches Ranbir's lie.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu's Device
episodesList.summary: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. episodesList.title: The Family Teaches Happu a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Rajesh prevents Ranbir and Chamchi from fighting with each other and tells them the truth. The family teaches Happu a lesson by pretending to plot to kill him. Happu tries to pacify an upset Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes a Police Inspector Again
episodesList.summary: Malaika informs Rajesh over the phone that she has completed her training. While Kat gets a job, Keshav bids farewell to Happu's family. Happu becomes a police inspector again after being demoted.

episodesList.title: Malaika Becomes an IPS Officer
episodesList.summary: Malaika comes home as an IPS officer. Later, Malaika saves Reshampal from the escaped criminal Maglu, and Reshampal feels proud of her. The family hosts a party for Malaika who becomes an IPS officer.

episodesList.title: Happu Argues with Malaika over a Case
episodesList.summary: At the police station, Kusum complains to Malaika about a street poet. Malaika summons the poet to the police station, where he explains his side of the story. Happu argues with Malaika over the case.

episodesList.title: Malaika Seeks Vimlesh's Help
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tries to resolve the argument between Happu and Malaika. Happu attempts to learn Urdu to solve the case of the poet. Meanwhile, Malaika seeks help from Vimlesh to solve the case.

episodesList.title: Malaika Resolves the Case of the Poet
episodesList.summary: Beni feels that Vimlesh is betraying him. Malaika resolves the case of the poet on the way, and Reshampal praises her. Later, she clears Beni's misunderstanding by telling him the truth.

episodesList.title: Malaika Threatens to Demote Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu refuses to fulfil the family's demands and becomes angry at their unnecessary expenses. Later, he demands a bribe from an ice cream vendor. Malaika threatens to demote Happu to discipline him.

episodesList.title: The Money Is Stolen from Happu's Safe
episodesList.summary: Happu suspects Ranbir to have stolen money from the safe. Pran files a complaint against Pappu Nath, and Malaika assigns this case to Happu. Later, someone again steals money from Happu's safe.

episodesList.title: Happu Frisks Rajesh on Suspicion of Theft
episodesList.summary: Happu calls Pran's wife Anju to the police station. He then frisks Rajesh on suspicion of theft. Rajesh complains to Amma about Happu. Pran comes to the police station to complain about Pappu.

episodesList.title: Happu Suspects Amma of Stealing
episodesList.summary: Despite keeping watch over Happu's safe, money is stolen from it. Happu suspects Amma and asks Rajesh to frisk her. To resolve Pran's case, Happu asks Pran to divorce Anju as a solution.

episodesList.title: Malaika Catches the Thief
episodesList.summary: Malaika catches a thief stealing money at night. The ice-cream vendor tells Happu the reason for seeking revenge. As Pran's case is solved, Happu is saved from demotion and apologises to the family.

episodesList.title: The Minister's Son Develops Animosity towards Malaika
episodesList.summary: The minister's son, Bantu, develops animosity towards Malaika. Ranbir plans to celebrate Holi with Simran at school. To take revenge on Malaika, Bantu applies colours to Rajesh and Amma and flees.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Becomes Desperate for Water
episodesList.summary: Due to Bantu, Happu's family becomes desperate for water. Happu's children plead with Masterji to keep the school open on Holi. Rajesh suspects a conspiracy behind the water shortage at home.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh Bathe in Alcohol
episodesList.summary: Beni arranges for water, but Bantu spills it. Unable to find water, Amma and Rajesh bathe in alcohol, but Bantu again applies colour to them. Ranbir tricks Simran into calling her to school on Holi.

episodesList.title: Malaika Catches Hold of Bantu and Beats Him
episodesList.summary: Beni arranges water for Amma and Rajesh. Happu's children convince Masterji to keep the school open on Holi. Later, Malaika beats Bantu who was trying to smear colour on Amma and Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Enjoy the Colours of Holi
episodesList.summary: Malaika forgives Bantu when he apologises to her. She later solves the case and celebrates Holi with her family. At school, Masterji catches Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi playing Holi with Simreet.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Plan for Amma's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Rajesh plans something for Amma's birthday and stops her from going shopping. Tinku goes to the police station to complain about his neighbour. Amma is surprised to see Rajesh in the jewellery shop.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Lie to Amma
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh return from the bazaar and lie to Amma. After seeing Jang Bahadur, Tinku's neighbour, Happu feels that he is not capable of hitting Tinku. Happu seeks Beni's help for his problem.

episodesList.title: Amma Complains to Happu about Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Amma complains to Happu that Rajesh has cut down her expenses, and Happu talks to her. Tinku again comes to lodge a police complaint against Jung Bahadur. Beni talks to Malaika about Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Interrogates Jung Bahadur's Mother
episodesList.summary: Reshampal and Malaika stop Happu from interrogating Jung Bahadur strictly. After hearing Rajesh, Amma devises a plan. Happu sees Jung Bahadur running in the bazaar and interrogates his mother.

episodesList.title: Malaika Solves Jang Bahadur's Case
episodesList.summary: Amma follows Rajesh and Vimlesh. Malaika tells Happu that Jang Bahadur hates the red colour, and that's why he was beating Tinku. Tinku tells Amma that Rajesh has gone shopping for her.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh Get into a Fight
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh get into a fight, but Happu helps them reconcile. Later, a man comes to the police station to complain against his landlord, and Happu suggests a solution to his problem.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan Backfires on Him
episodesList.summary: As Amma and Rajesh get into an argument again, Happu comes up with a plan. However, Happu's strategy backfires on him. In the police station, Malaika warns Happu upon seeing his anger towards Manohar.

episodesList.title: Happu Is fed Up of Rajesh and Amma's Fight
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh argue again. Malaika rebukes Happu for talking rudely to the complainant at the police station. Later, Rajesh and Amma vent their anger on Happu, leaving him frustrated.

episodesList.title: Masterji Vents His Anger at Happu
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh reconcile for the sake of Happu. Masterji gets angry with Chamchi and Ranbir's actions and calls Happu to school to vent his anger. Beni tells Happu the solution to his problem.

episodesList.title: Happu's Advice to All the Husbands
episodesList.summary: Happu instigates Amma and Rajesh against each other. Malaika solves the case between the landlord and the tenant. Rajesh and Amma vent their anger at Happu and Happu gives advice to all the husbands.

episodesList.title: Amma and Rajesh's Plan to Become Famous
episodesList.summary: Amma and Rajesh plan to become famous after seeing Vimal and Beni making videos. In the police station, a man complains about Hakikat Khureshi, a resident of his colony, whose dreams turn true.

episodesList.title: Hakikat's Dream Comes True
episodesList.summary: When Happu's children arrive late to school, Masterji asks them to call their parents. Hakikat has a dream about Happu, and Happu gets worried as his dream comes true. The children lie to Masterji.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Makes a Video of Her Murder
episodesList.summary: Rajesh decides to make a video of her murder at Amma's hands and Ranbir and Chamchi come up with an idea. Hakikat tells Happu a riddle. Happu is shocked to see Amma attacking Rajesh with a knife.

episodesList.title: Happu's Sleep Is Disturbed by Hakikat's Dreams
episodesList.summary: Happu, troubled by Hakikat's dreams, decides not to let Hakikat sleep. However, Hakikat falls asleep in the police station and dreams about Happu again. Happu is scared to see Rajesh attacking Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Free of Hakikat's Dreams
episodesList.summary: Malaika suspends Manohar for torturing Hakikat. Thereafter, Hakikat sees another dream about Happu. Amma and Rajesh concoct a drama of Happu's murder. Later, Happu is free of Hakikat's dreams.

episodesList.title: Masterji's Plan to Get a Home Loan
episodesList.summary: Following Vimlesh's advice, Rajesh sets a rule for Happu. Singer Pintu lodges a complaint against his music teacher, Pakhawaj. Masterji tells Chamchi and Ranbir his plan to get a home loan.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Pintu Beaten Up
episodesList.summary: Masterji uses Happu's name in front of the bank officials for the loan, but Happu does not answer his call. Happu gets Pintu beaten up by Manohar to bring pain in his voice and tells Beni his problem.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes Pinkia for Pintu
episodesList.summary: Happu once again fails to answer Masterji's call. Amma teaches the kids about Rama Navami. Happu devises a plan to inflict pain in Pintu's voice, and he becomes Pinkia to call Pintu.

episodesList.title: Happu's Trick Lands Him in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Happu's trick to solve Pintu's case lands him in trouble. Masterji threatens to fail Chamchi and Ranbir in the exams if he does not get the loan. Later, Rajesh refuses to help Happu.

episodesList.title: Pintu Sings a Heart-Wrenching Song
episodesList.summary: Amma meets Pintu in the guise of Pinkiya to help Happu, but Pintu falls for her. Happu is forced to tell Pintu the truth, which breaks his heart. Later, Pintu sings a heart-wrenching song.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets a Sensitive Case
episodesList.summary: Malaika instructs Happu to solve the case sensitively. Later, Happu comes across a case of a woman attempting suicide. At school, Shreya talks to Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi about her problem.

episodesList.title: Hapus Befriends Pari
episodesList.summary: Amma is surprised to see Happu's growing love for Rajesh. Pari again thinks of committing suicide. Happu, disguised as Hapus, befriends Pari. Amma plans a doubt in Rajesh's mind about Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Grows Suspicious of Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh detects the scent of perfume on Happu's body and grows suspicious. She asks Beni to spy on Happu. Hrithik overhears Happu talking to Pari and relays the information to Chamki and Ranbir.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu's Actions
episodesList.summary: Happu goes to watch a movie with Pari, and Beni takes their photo. Rajesh and Amma are surprised to learn about Happu's affair. Rajesh also informs the children about Happu's actions.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Confronts Pari and Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu brings a bangle for Rajesh, but she doesn't talk to him nicely. Later, she catches Happu with Pari and confronts them. Pari reveals the truth in front of everyone, and they feel proud of Happu.

episodesList.title: KK to Trap Malaika In His Plan
episodesList.summary: The Commissioner informs Malaika and Happu about JK's gang. JK's son, KK, decides to trap Malaika in his plan. Amma reveals her desire to Rajesh. KK deliberately gets himself arrested.

episodesList.title: KK Flirts with Malaika
episodesList.summary: The children ask Happu to increase their pocket money. Malaika sees KK's wounds, and KK flirts with her. Later, Amma meets a person named Sunny in the market, and they become friends.

episodesList.title: Pitaji Assigns Happu a Task
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Happu that Amma is having an affair. Amma informs Pitaji about Sunny. Pitaji assigns Happu the task of keeping Sunny away from Amma. Happu asks Chamchi to keep an eye on Amma.

episodesList.title: Malaika's Wish to Get Married
episodesList.summary: Chamchi informs the family about Amma and Sunny's romance. KK, who is in custody, flirts with Malaika. Malaika tells Rajesh that she wants to get married. At Pitaji's behest, Manohar slaps Happu.

episodesList.title: Malaika Arrests JK
episodesList.summary: Amma tells the truth to Sunny and ends their friendship. Malaika’s plan to nab JK succeeds and Reshampal praises her. Later, Amma pacifies an angry Pitaji.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Happy with Astrologer Pintu's Prediction
episodesList.summary: Manohar doesn't get a half-day leave from the police station. Babbu complains to Happu about astrologer Pintu. Rajesh starts her cooking channel. Happu is pleased with astrologer Pintu's prediction.

episodesList.title: Chef Pintu Tells Happu the Way to Success
episodesList.summary: Happu makes a promise to Rajesh. Chef Pintu tells Happu that he is not getting success because of Rajesh and offers a solution. Happu tells Beni about Chef Pintu, and Vimlesh overhears them.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Parts Ways with Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu urges Rajesh to part ways with him. Upset Rajesh leaves the house and goes to stay with Vimlesh. A criminal, Kamalkant, escapes from jail, and Reshampal threatens to suspend Happu and Manohar.

episodesList.title: Happu's Bad Days Start
episodesList.summary: Happu's fortune takes a turn for the worse and he gets suspended. Rajesh creates a video for her cooking channel, which becomes famous. Amma comes up with an idea to make Happu realise his mistake.

episodesList.title: Amma Persuades Rajesh to Return Home
episodesList.summary: An Astrologer reveals the truth about Pintu to Happu. Chef Ranjeev offers Rajesh to work with him, but she declines. Happu apologises to Rajesh, and Amma persuades Rajesh to return home.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Mocks Happu for Getting Older
episodesList.summary: As Happu's back aches, Rajesh playfully mocks him about getting older. Reshampal arrests Pappu, who is adept at wooing women. Masterji asks Chamchi and Ranbir to bring Happu to school.

episodesList.title: Beni and Happu Tell the Doctor about Their Problem
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh's friend, Urja, mistakes Happu for Rajesh's father-in-law. Chamchi and Ranbir reach school without Happu and lie to the teacher. Beni and Happu go to the doctor with their problem.

episodesList.title: Pappu Gives Happu a Fitness Tip
episodesList.summary: Happu is shocked to learn about Pappu's age. Amma tells Rajesh a secret. Chamchi and Ranbir threaten the ice cream seller to dress up as Happu and come to the school. Pappu gives Happu a fitness tip.

episodesList.title: Happu Starts Following a Diet Plan
episodesList.summary: In the bazaar, the bangle vendor mistakes Beni for Vimlesh's father and Beni gets angry. Happu eats boiled food and pleases Rajesh with Pappu's help. Later, Happu tells Beni about Pappu.

episodesList.title: Malaika Advises Happu and Beni to Stay Fit
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimalesh realise that their husbands are trying to make them happy by learning poetries from Pappu. They teach their husbands a lesson. Malaika advises Happu and Beni to stay fit.

episodesList.title: Whose Maternal Family Is More Powerful?
episodesList.summary: On seeing Happu working in the kitchen, Amma argues with Rajesh. Later, Rajesh and Amma challenge each other to see whose maternal family is powerful. Elsewhere, Chamchi and Ranbir lie to Masterji.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Tells Gabbar about Her Challenge to Amma
episodesList.summary: Gabbar, who comes to Rajesh's house, flaunts his bravery. Happu fails to solve Gyanchakshu's dispute with his landlord. Rajesh tells Gabbar about her challenge to Amma. Tinku arrives at Amma's house.

episodesList.title: Gabbar Is Scared by Tinku's Strength
episodesList.summary: Gabbar, scared by Tinku's strength, asks Rajesh to avoid arranging a fight with him. Reshampal pressures Happu to resolve the Gyanchakshu case and Happu puts his landlord in jail.

episodesList.title: Happu Apprehends Tinku in a False Case
