episodesList.summary: Rajesh's attempt to stop the rivalry between Gabbar and Tinku fails. Later, as per Beni's plan, Happu apprehends Tinku in a false case. Amma visits the police station to secure Tinku's release.

episodesList.title: Gabbar Wins the Fight Due to Happu's Plan
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh tells Happu about Rajesh's threat to go to her maternal home. A fight erupts between Tinku and Gabbar. Gabbar wins the fight due to Happu's plan. Amma learns about Happu and Rajesh's plot.

episodesList.title: Ranbir Is Punished for Writing a Love Letter
episodesList.summary: Happu punishes Ranbir after reading his love letter. Beni shares a secret with Ranbir and Chamchi. Reshampal puts a tantric behind bars. Ranbir decides to summon Bhaddi’s spirit to question her.

episodesList.title: Bhaddi's Spirit Possesses Vimlesh
episodesList.summary: Manohar explains to Happu how to punish Buddha Baba in jail. Chamchi and Ranbir summon Bhaddi's spirit, which later possesses Vimlesh. A frightened Beni then informs Happu about it.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Are Frightened by Bhaddi's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni, frightened by Bhaddi's spirit, inform Rajesh about her. Bhaddi starts haunting Happu, and Amma suggests a solution to get rid of her. Later, Bhaddi plots to kill Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Bhaddi's Spirit Wants to Marry Happu
episodesList.summary: Beni saves Rajesh’s life. At the police station, Happu tries to revive Ujaad Buddhi Baba who had fainted due to Happu’s torture. Later, Bhaddi’s spirit asks Happu to kill Rajesh and marry her.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Saves Happu From Bhaddi
episodesList.summary: Chamchi informs the family that Ranbir has summoned Bhaddi's spirit. Bhaddi's spirit tries to marry Happu forcibly. Rajesh confronts Bhaddi and saves Happu from her.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Gets Irked with Happu Due to the Heat
episodesList.summary: Rajesh, annoyed by the heat, argues with Happu over shutting down the air conditioner to save it from damage. Masterji faints due to the heat. Subhash comes to Happu with his complaint.

episodesList.title: Hindrances in Happu and Rajesh's Romance
episodesList.summary: Rajesh invites Vimlesh over for some buttermilk. Irritated by the heat, Ammaji and the kids stop Happu and Rajesh from getting romantic. Beni and Vimlesh also join them in their room to enjoy the AC.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries to Arrange the AC
episodesList.summary: Happu arranges for AC from the dealer Santram and informs Rajesh. The minister's PA calls Santram for the same. Ranbir and Chamchi try to postpone the exam. Rajesh scolds Happu for not arranging AC.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh Try to Romance
episodesList.summary: Happu tries to appease Rajesh. They try to get romantic, but Amma interrupts them. Happu asks Santaram about an AC. Later, he takes another packet of medicine from Baba and informs Beni about it.

episodesList.title: Happu Shatters Rajesh's Hopes
episodesList.summary: Happu and Rajesh's romance gets disturbed due to Vimalesh. Happu receives an AC from Santaram by framing him in a false case. When Rajesh tries to be romantic, Happu tells her about Baba's medicine.

episodesList.title: Happu Plans to Celebrate Father's Day
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Beni that he plans to celebrate Father's Day and confides his feelings in Rajesh. Amma tells Happu about Khanna's death. Happu and Malaika argue while Sneha gets her work done by Ranbir.

episodesList.title: Is Happu Khanna's Son?
episodesList.summary: Pitaji tells Amma that Khanna has told him that Happu is his son. Rajesh hears Amma's words. Later, Happu gets upset about the children's behaviour. Rajesh tells Happu that he is Khanna's son.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Saddened by the Truth about His Father
episodesList.summary: Malaika slaps a man. Happu argues with Amma after learning the truth about his father. Ranbir confesses his feelings to Sneha. Chamchi asks Rajesh for permission to go camping.

episodesList.title: Happu Saves Chamchi
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Malaika to apologise to the minister's brother-in-law. Amma tells Pitaji that Happu is their own son. Happu saves Chamchi in the jungle. Ranbir tells Malaika the reason for his sorrow.

episodesList.title: Happu's Children Realise Their Mistake
episodesList.summary: At Happu's insistence, Sneha apologises to Ranbir. Later, she also saves Malaika's job. Pitaji's misunderstanding is cleared. Happu's children apologise to him, and they all celebrate Father's Day.

episodesList.title: A Man Curses Happu
episodesList.summary: Amma decides to contest the elections at Modern Colony, but Rajesh stops her. A man curses Happu for not filing his complaint. Rajesh informs everyone about her decision to contest the elections.

episodesList.title: Happu Permits Rajesh to Contest the Election
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gets Happu's permission to contest the election. Happu's friend visits the police station. Rajesh tells the club's women about her decision. Ranbir decides to pass exams through hard work.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns About Happu's Mischief
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni urinate in a public place and a video of it goes viral. Happu gets injured again. KK insists that Happu accompany him to the casino. Soon, Malaika shows Rajesh the video of Happu.

episodesList.title: KK Traps Happu In His Plan
episodesList.summary: Rajesh argues with Happu about his viral video. As advised by Happu, Chamchi and Ranbir buy exam papers. Later, KK comes to meet Happu and once again traps him in his plan.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns About the Conspiracy against Her
episodesList.summary: Malaika informs Rajesh about Chamchi and Ranbir buying exam papers. KK takes Happu to see a courtesan dance and Rajesh watches the video. Later, Rajesh discovers Mrs Khandelwal's conspiracy.

episodesList.title: Happu Decides to Earn Money through Corruption
episodesList.summary: Happu's family complains that he doesn't fulfil their wishes. He decides to earn money through corruption. A man files a complaint about his scooter being stolen, and Happu demands a bribe from him.

episodesList.title: Happu Makes His Family Happy Using Bribe Money
episodesList.summary: Happu brings gifts for Amma and Rajesh, which makes Malaika suspicious. At school, Ranbir and Chamchi belittle Aarav by giving a burger party. Happu solves the case by deceiving the complainant.

episodesList.title: Malaika Learns about Happu's Corruption
episodesList.summary: Happu takes a bribe from a man who brings a thief to the police station. Malaika learns about Happu's actions and keeps an eye on him. A man informs Happu that a senior officer is coming to meet him.

episodesList.title: Happu and Manohar Get Punished for Taking a Bribe
episodesList.summary: The anti-corruption department officer Balveer threatens Happu and Manohar. They seek help from Reshampal and Balveer punishes them. In school, Ranbir and Chamchi flaunt their wealth.

episodesList.title: Happu Promises Never to Take a Bribe Again
episodesList.summary: Happu makes his own children poor and feeds them, but his wrongdoing is revealed. Happu, Beni and Manohar are arrested for corruption. Happu apologises and promises never to take a bribe again.

episodesList.title: The Theft of an Umbrella and Raincoat in the Rain
episodesList.summary: Happu wears Rajesh's grandfather's raincoat. Manohar informs him about the theft of an umbrella and raincoat. The commissioner wears Happu's raincoat and goes out and Rajesh calls Happu home.

episodesList.title: Amma Learns about Rajesh's Treasure
episodesList.summary: Reshampal experiences memory loss, and Happu's raincoat is stolen. Beni gives 5,000 rupees to Chamchi and Ranbir for safekeeping. Amma overhears Rajesh and Gabbar discussing the treasure.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about the Raincoat Theft
episodesList.summary: Happu gets upset when Amma tells him Rajesh's secret. Chamchi and Ranbir start their work with Beni's money, and Beni demands his money back. Happu tells Rajesh about the theft of the raincoat.

episodesList.title: Happu's Plan to Catch the Umbrella Thief Fails
episodesList.summary: Beni doesn't tell Vimlesh that he gave money to Chamchi and Ranbir. Vimlesh suspects Beni and threatens to leave home. When Happu's plan to catch the umbrella thief fails, he seeks help from Malaika.

episodesList.title: The Umbrella Thief Is Caught
episodesList.summary: Chamchi and Ranbir return Beni's money. Due to Malaika, the umbrella thief is caught. Gabbar finds a letter from his father's coat. At the police station, the umbrella thief tells everyone his story.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Photoshoot in the Lock-up
episodesList.summary: Manohar gives Happu a bad news. Rajesh and Vimlesh do a photoshoot in the police station to increase their likes on social media. The new DCP Chaman Chatvar arrives, and Happu lies to him.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Get Stuck in Jail
episodesList.summary: Happu gets scared on learning that DCP Chaman hates lies. Furthermore, Happu fails to bail Rajesh and Vimlesh out. Later at night, Amma and the kids secretly go to meet Rajesh and Vimlesh in jail.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells Rajesh a Plan to Get Out of Jail
episodesList.summary: While trying to release Rajesh and Vimlesh, Malaika gets suspended. During the rehearsal of the play, Chamchi misses Rajesh and starts crying for real. Happu tells Rajesh a plan to get out of jail.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Tells Chaman a Fake Story
episodesList.summary: As per Happu's instructions, Rajesh praises Chaman. Beni visits Vimlesh in jail and gets into trouble. Chaman takes Rajesh out and the latter tells him a fake story about becoming a thief.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Rajesh and Vimlesh Released
episodesList.summary: Chaman wishes to marry Rajesh. Happu tricks Chaman to get Rajesh and Vimlesh released from jail and brings them home, delighting everyone. When Chaman learns about Happu's lie, he asks him to resign.

episodesList.title: A Threat from an Unknown Person
episodesList.summary: Beni gives Happu good news about one of his cases. Sanju teases Chamchi and Ranbir. Everyone is scared due to a threat from an unknown person, and the police receives many complaints about it.

episodesList.title: Happu Receives a Threat from an Unknown Person
episodesList.summary: Rajesh insists on going to Goa with Happu. Happu receives a threat from an unknown person. Reshampal tells Manohar that he also received a threat. Dabbu files a missing complaint for his wife.

episodesList.title: Malaika Vows to Catch the Anonymous Person
episodesList.summary: Chamchi and Ranbir talk ill about Masterji. Malaika vows to catch the anonymous person threatening them and asks Happu to give that person a befitting reply. Meanwhile, Amma talks to Kulbhushan.

episodesList.title: Will Malaika Be Able to Find the Unknown Person?
episodesList.summary: Under Malaika's pressure, Happu responds to the new threat from the unknown person. Masterji expels Chamchi and Ranbir from school. At night, Malaika waits to catch the unknown person.

episodesList.title: Malaika Arrests Chabra
episodesList.summary: Masterji gets irked on seeing Chamchi and Ranbir in school. Malaika responds to the threat from an unknown person and someone kidnaps her. Later, she catches Chabra and he reveals his conspiracy.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets a Chance to Go to Bangkok
episodesList.summary: Happu speaks ill about Bangkok in front of Rajesh. Meanwhile, Malaika gets injured during an encounter. Later, Resham Pal decides to send Happu and Manohar to Bangkok to attend a program.

episodesList.title: Happu Needs to Get an NOC to Go to Bangkok
episodesList.summary: Chaurasia comes with a complaint about the tenant and tries to bribe Happu. Amma and Rajesh argue over taking care of Malaika. Reshampal asks Happu to get an NOC from Rajesh for going to Bangkok.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Is Delighted as Happu Supports Her
episodesList.summary: Chamchi and Ranbir ask Masterji to pay for their school trip. During Amma and Rajesh's argument, Happu supports Rajesh, delighting her. Chaurasia tells Happu to take action against his tenant.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets into Trouble Pleasing Amma
episodesList.summary: Reshampal asks Happu to get an NOC from Amma to go to Bangkok. To please Amma, Happu ends up upsetting Rajesh. Chamchi and Ranbir get upset as they fail to collect money for the trip.

episodesList.title: Will Happu Go to Bangkok?
episodesList.summary: When Amma and Rajesh learn the truth from Manohar's wife, they realise Happu is deceiving them. They agree to let Happu go to Bangkok if he meets their condition. Reshampal gives Happu some news.

episodesList.title: Kanpur's Milkmen Go on a Strike because of Happu
episodesList.summary: Amma pleases Rajesh by praising her tea. Happu slaps Kanpur Milk Union Leader Bhainsa Kumar over a small issue. Angered by this, Bhainsa Kumar announces a strike of the milkmen.

episodesList.title: Everything Goes Haywire Without Milk
episodesList.summary: Masterji gets angry at Chamchi and Ranbir after he is served tea without milk. Happu and Benny go to get milk, but the milkman refuses them. Rajesh gives tea without milk to Amma, leaving her irked.

episodesList.title: Malaika's Plan to Bring Milk
episodesList.summary: Happu promises Rajesh that he will bring milk. The minister tells Happu not to apologise to Bhainsa Kumar. Annoyed by not getting tea, Amma scolds Chamchi. Malaika tells Happu her plan to get milk.

episodesList.title: Happu Makes Beni the Scapegoat
episodesList.summary: Malaika's plan to get milk falls through. Annoyed about not having tea, Amma attempts to commit suicide. Happu steals goat's milk with Beni, and when they get caught, Happu blames Beni.

episodesList.title: Amma Ends the Milk Strike
episodesList.summary: Amma ends the strike by apologising to Bhainsa Kumar. Due to the milkman, Bantu, the minister, gets a promotion and he gives Happu a new order. Happu gets into trouble by raising his hand on Bantu.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Accused of Petticoat Theft
episodesList.summary: A few incidents of petticoat theft occur in the city. Manohar tells Happu a secret and seeks his help. Later, a man accuses Happu of stealing petticoats and the police searches Happu's house.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Arrested for Stealing Petticoats
episodesList.summary: Happu is arrested for petticoat theft, which brings disgrace to the family. He tells the police that Manohar is the thief, but Manohar lands him in trouble. Later, Happu asks Beni to defend his case.

episodesList.title: Beni Fails to Get Happu Released from Jail
episodesList.summary: The prosecution presents witnesses against Happu. Beni asks the judge for two days' extension. Happu scolds Beni for being unable to get him released. Later, Happu's family is hurt by their insult.

episodesList.title: Manohar Confesses His Crime
episodesList.summary: In court, Beni argues in defence of Happu, but the prosecution lawyer proves him wrong. Manohar comes to court and confesses his crime. The prosecution lawyer then proves that Manohar is lying.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Punished in the Petticoat Theft Case
episodesList.summary: Pitaji is an eyewitness to Happu's innocence. He gives his testimony in the court set up at home, but the judge declares Happu guilty and sentences him. Everyone sees Manohar with a petticoat.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Chooses Rajesh for the Dance Performance
episodesList.summary: Reshampal asks Happu to arrange a classical dancer for the Independence Day program. Happu speaks with the courtesan Masakkali. After watching Rajesh's dance, Reshampal asks her to perform.

episodesList.title: Masakkali Blackmails Happu
episodesList.summary: Masakkali blackmails Happu who breaks his promise, and he seeks Beni's advice. Rajesh makes Amma jealous by talking about her classical dance. Happu asks Rajesh to remove her name from the programme.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Sprained Ankle
episodesList.summary: Rajesh misses the chance to dance in the programme because of her sprained ankle. Masakkali blackmails Happu for money. Happu then requests Reshampal to let Masakkali perform instead.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Sees Happu and Beni Meeting Masakkali
episodesList.summary: Reshampal shares a secret with Rajesh, and Rajesh believes that Happu deliberately made him fall. Vimlesh catches Happu and Beni meeting Masakkali. Amma vows to fix Rajesh's leg.

episodesList.title: Happu's Disguise as Hapiya Devi at the Event
episodesList.summary: Beni fools Masakkali. During the Independence Day event, Happu's disguise as Hapiya Devi is exposed, and the minister becomes upset. Chamchi manages the situation and calms the minister down.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Vimlesh Try To Lift Senti's Spirits
episodesList.summary: Malaika tells Amma why Rajesh is upset. On Happu's suggestion, Rajesh and Vimlesh invite Senti home for Raksha Bandhan to lift his spirits. Happu sends Rakhi to jail for breaking Manohar's nose.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Cook Food with Amma
episodesList.summary: When Rajesh and Vimlesh don't return from the market, Amma complains to Happu. Happu and Beni cook food with Amma. Later, Rajesh gets excited about Senti's arrival, which irritates Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Celebrates Raksha Bandhan with Senti
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh tie a rakhi to Senti, but Amma's questions make Senti sad. In jail, Rakhi ties a rakhi to Happu and makes him her brother. Amma requests the children to gather some information.

episodesList.title: Beni's Words Make Senti Cry
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh tell Senti to forget the past. Happu's words enrage Manohar. Senti plays carrom with the children and Happu joins the game. Senti starts crying after hearing Beni's words.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Gulbiya to Marry Senti
episodesList.summary: Rajesh scolds Happu for making Senti cry. Happu helps Rakhi escape from jail. Later, Happu asks Gulbiya to marry Senti, and Senti starts liking Gulbiya.

episodesList.title: Vimlesh Is Amazed by Beni's Hidden Talent
episodesList.summary: Amma lies to Rajesh, saying that Happu plays the flute very well. Happu sends away Bansidhar, the flautist who comes to the police station. Vimlesh is amazed to discover Beni's hidden talent.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries to Learn the Flute
episodesList.summary: Happu tries to learn the flute from Beni, but they end up arguing. Ranbir and Chamchi play a trick to get roles in the play. Happu helps Bansidhar and asks him to teach him the flute.

episodesList.title: Happu Puts on an Act to Avoid Playing the Flute
episodesList.summary: Bansidhar sends away Happu, who comes to learn the flute. Soon, Happu pretends to be injured to avoid playing the flute on Janmashtami. Amma threatens to harm herself to force Happu to play the flute.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Bansidhar to Play the Flute
episodesList.summary: Chamchi and Ranbir’s attempt to participate in the Janmashtami play fails. Happu asks Bansidhar to play the flute at the Janmashtami event and lies to Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Exposed During the Janmashtami Puja
episodesList.summary: Bansidhar refuses to play the flute at Happu's event. During the Janmashtami celebration, Happu pretends to play the flute, but his deception is exposed. Amma blames herself for lying to everyone.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Doesn't Respect Him
episodesList.summary: Happu's family doesn't respect him. The teacher threatens to fail Chamchi and Ranbir. Reshampal advises Happu to improve his reputation in his family, and Happu seeks help from Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu Gains Respect in Everyone's Eyes
episodesList.summary: Happu gains respect in everyone's eyes with Beni's help. Rajesh gets permission from Amma to start a tiffin service. Chamchi and Ranbir try to scare Masterji by showing that Happu knows a minister.

episodesList.title: Happu Faces Trouble Due to the Act about a Minister
episodesList.summary: Beni pretends to be a minister and speaks to Happu's family, arousing Malaika's suspicion about Happu. When Rajesh asks Happu to have the minister inaugurate her tiffin service, he faces a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Beni's Pretence Levels Up Happu's Issues
episodesList.summary: Beni talks to Rajesh on the phone posing as a minister and his wife and levels up his issues. Chamchi and Ranbir get Masterji to talk to the minister and wish him Happy Teacher's Day.

episodesList.title: A Minister Comes to Inaugurate Rajesh's Tiffin Service
episodesList.summary: Malaika saves the minister from falling. Beni disguises as a minister and inaugurates Rajesh's tiffin service. Soon, Malaika brings the real minister and Happu and Beni's pretence is exposed.

episodesList.title: Happu Gives His Family’s Gold Coin to the Jeweller
episodesList.summary: Happu gives his family’s gold coin to the jeweller for cleaning. Amma upsets Rajesh by refusing to give her a Ganesh Chaturthi gift. Actor Pappu Kumar tries to flirt with Malaika.

episodesList.title: Happu's Gold Coin Is Stolen
episodesList.summary: Happu’s gold coin gets stolen in the robbery at the jeweller’s house. Chamchi and Ranbir delight Masterji with some news. Amma reconciles with Rajesh. Happu goes to a church, where the thief arrives.

episodesList.title: The Thief's Condition to Return Happu's Gold Coin
episodesList.summary: Darling thief sets a condition to return Happu's gold coin. Happu calls the thief’s girlfriend’s father, Daulatram, to the police station to talk to him. Pappu Kumar provokes Malaika by showing off.

episodesList.title: Happu Blackmails Reshampal for Money
episodesList.summary: Reshampal tells Happu about his problem. Happu comes up with a plan to get his coin back from the thief and blackmails Reshampal for money. Rajesh tricks Amma into giving him money.

episodesList.title: Darling Returns Happu's Coin
episodesList.summary: Reshampal agrees to help Darling, and Darling returns the coin to Happu. Malaika tells Masterji the solution to his problem. Later, Happu's family celebrates Ganesh Festival together.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Deteriorating Memory
episodesList.summary: Rajesh forgets where she kept Happu's file and Malaika's items. Doctor KB treats Reshampal at the station with his remedies. Happu asks KB for medicine to improve Rajesh's poor memory.

episodesList.title: The Powder Enhances Rajesh's Memory
episodesList.summary: Rajesh takes the powder brought by Happu to improve her memory. When the powder helps her recall an old incident, she asks Happu to apologise to Gabbar. She brings up old issues and argues with Amma.

episodesList.title: Gabbar Does Not Forgive Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh fights with Beni and Vimlesh by reminding them of old issues. Chamchi and Ranbir take advantage of Masterji’s memory loss. Happu calls Gabbar to apologise, but Gabbar threatens to seek revenge.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Recalls an Event from Her Past Life
episodesList.summary: Gabbar takes revenge on Beni and Happu. Happu gets Rajesh drunk, but she recalls an event from her past life. Meanwhile, Chamchi and Ranbir convince Masterji to pass them in school.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Makes Everyone Emotional with Her Words
episodesList.summary: Everyone hides, fearing Rajesh's taunts. Malaika asks Rajesh to list her complaints and Rajesh makes everyone emotional with her words. Masterji learns that a fake report card has been created by him.

episodesList.title: Amma's Liquor Expense Angers Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh finds out how much Amma spends on liquor and argues with Happu. Malaika suggests Vimlesh a trick to force Beni to work. Later, Happu brings cheap liquor for Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu Decides to Turn Honest
episodesList.summary: After Amma tells Happu about an incident related to Pitaji, he decides to turn honest. Vimlesh and Malaika execute their plan. Beni meets Manmauji and finds a way to earn money.

episodesList.title: Beni Becomes a Thief for Quick Money
episodesList.summary: Actress Madhurani visits the police to report a theft. Beni gives Madhurani's saree to Manmauji for money and brings gifts for Vimlesh and Amma. Chamchi and Ranbir plan to give the exam honestly.

episodesList.title: Beni and Vimlesh Change after Getting Rich
episodesList.summary: Reshampal orders Happu to find Madhurani's clothes. After a fight with Rajesh, Amma goes to stay with Beni. When Beni and Vimlesh become rich, Happu suspects them due to the changes in them.

episodesList.title: Beni Confesses to His Crime
episodesList.summary: Happu sees Beni stealing clothes from Madhurani's house, but Beni manages to trick him. Later, at Malaika's suggestion, Beni surrenders. Madhurani forgives Beni and asks him for a favour.

episodesList.title: Gulabiya Plants a Doubt in Rajesh and Vimlesh's Minds
episodesList.summary: Malaika's family talks to her about her marriage. Gulabiya overhears Rajesh and Vimlesh and plants doubts in their minds about their husbands. Later, Beni and Happu talk about their illnesses.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Worry about Their Health
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh discuss their struggle to woo their husbands. Ranbir takes Chamchi's help to befriend Natasha. Beni and Happu worry about their health after overhearing Dr. Udas.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Consider Their Wives Cheaters
episodesList.summary: Dr. Udas advises Happu and Beni to overcome their Vitamin D deficiency. Due to a misunderstanding, Amma instills doubt in Happu's mind about Rajesh. Something makes Beni suspect Vimlesh of cheating.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Chase Their Wives
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni's misunderstanding for their wives levels up. Ranbir, disguised as Inga, goes out with Natasha. Happu and Beni follow their wives to the theatre and see them with someone.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Tell Their Wives the Truth
episodesList.summary: Chamchi exposes Ranbir in front of Natasha. Happu and Beni thrash Rajesh and Vimlesh's detectives and reveal the truth to their wives. Amma tells Malaika about Aryan's decision.

episodesList.title: Amma Wishes to Go to Vaishnodevi with Her Family
episodesList.summary: Amma voices her desire to go to Vaishnodevi with the family, and Happu promises to fulfil it. Chamchi and Ranbir tell Masterji about it. To get leave, Happu asks Malaika to lie to Reshampal.

episodesList.title: Happu Fights with a Railway Employee
episodesList.summary: Malaika lies to Reshampal to go to Jammu. Happu goes for the ticket and fights with a railway employee. Rajesh asks Happu to take a ticket for Gabbar also. The railway employee teaches Happu a lesson.

episodesList.title: Indian Railways Service Blacklists Happu
episodesList.summary: Indian Railways Service blacklists Happu. Later, Happu talks to Rajesh about not taking Gabbar with him to Katra. Angered by this, Rajesh prepares to leave the house, and Vimlesh supports her.

episodesList.title: Lightning Strikes Beni Who Leaves for Vaishno Devi
episodesList.summary: After Happu gets blacklisted, Beni decides to take everyone to Vaishno Devi. Happu doesn't get a flight ticket. Later, lightning strikes Beni, and Malaika talks about taking everyone along.

episodesList.title: Happu Cries Because No One Could Visit Vaishnodevi
episodesList.summary: Happu tries to help Malaika, but she falls down the stairs. Amma is sad about not going to Vaishnodevi, and Happu cries. Later, Happu's family gets the tickets and everyone is happy.

episodesList.title: Beni and Happu Forget Vimlesh's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Beni and Happu forget Vimlesh's birthday and try to avoid the family's anger with a plan. Chamchi discovers the truth and informs the family. Psychologist Santosh goes to lodge a police complaint.

episodesList.title: Happu Sees a Girl Playing the Guitar at Night
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh teach their husbands a lesson. At night, Happu sees a girl playing the guitar outside the window. The next day, at the police station, Happu tells Santosh how to solve his problem.

episodesList.title: A Ghost Haunts Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: A ghost named Chandni seeks justice from Happu and Beni. While watching a film with their wives, they get scared seeing Chandni. At Ranbir's behest, Manohar disguises as a ghost to scare Masterji.

episodesList.title: Happu Finds a Ghost Clinging to His Back
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni refuse to help Chandni get justice, leading her spirit to cling to Happu's back, threatening him. When they tell their family about Chandni, no one believes them.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Get Rid of Chandni
episodesList.summary: Masterji catches Chamchi and Ranbir lying. Happu and Beni, desperate to rid themselves of Chandni, prepare to consume poison. Malaika intervenes just in time, and the family makes a revelation.

episodesList.title: Emily Traps Happu
episodesList.summary: A woman named Emily Chaddha traps Happu. Rajesh observes a fast for Happu and praises his loyalty. Happu shares his issues with Beni, and later Vimlesh tests Beni's loyalty.

episodesList.title: Emily Blackmails Happu
episodesList.summary: Emily blackmails Happu and forces him to get her lover Jackson released from jail. Amma asks Vimlesh to test Beni's loyalty again. A troubled Happu goes to Reshampal to seek his help.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Calls Madanlal to Help Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu blackmails Reshampal for help, leading him to introduce Happu to the cunning criminal, Madanlal. Vimlesh misunderstands the situation and scolds Beni. Beni informs Rajesh about Happu's troubles.

episodesList.title: Happu Enters Jail as a Prisoner
episodesList.summary: Happu explains the matter to Rajesh. Reshampal sends Happu to Kanpur Central Jail in a prisoner's disguise. Masterji learns about this. In jail, Happu meets Jackson and tells him about the tunnel.

episodesList.title: Happu Lands into Trouble by Helping Jackson Flee
episodesList.summary: Happu helps Jackson flee from jail but he himself gets caught. Reshampal slips into a coma after a flower pot hits his head. Malaika arrests Emily and Jackson and requests the jailer to release Happu.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Gives Manohar a Big Responsibility
episodesList.summary: Happu’s family demands costly Diwali gifts. Reshampal puts Manohar in charge of the police station's safe. A woman files a complaint against her husband, and Gabbar brings Diwali gifts for all.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries His Luck at Gambling
episodesList.summary: The complainant woman's husband asks Happu to teach him gambling. To fulfil his family's demands, Happu goes gambling with Beni. However, Happu tries his luck when Beni loses.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Fight because of Gambling
episodesList.summary: Masterji, tempted by a bribe, decides to raise Chamchi and Ranbir’s grades. Beni, trusting Happu, bets money in gambling, but Happu loses their money. This leads to a big fight between them.

episodesList.title: Malaika's Plan to Raid the Gambling Hideout
episodesList.summary: Happu's family is upset with him for his actions. Gabbar, having lost everything in gambling, visits Rajesh and Vimlesh for help. Malaika informs Happu about her plan to raid the gambling hideout.

episodesList.title: Malaika Arrests the Biggest Gambler of the City
episodesList.summary: Happu, Beni and Malaika visit the casino in disguise, and arrests the city's biggest gambler. Malaika informs it to Reshampal. Happu receives a Diwali bonus, and his family celebrates Diwali.

episodesList.title: Happu Loses His Job due to a Missed Target
episodesList.summary: Happu tells his family about his sharpshooting skills. Later, he accidentally shoots the minister's PA, leading to his dismissal. Rajesh decides to become Vimlesh's business partner.

episodesList.title: Reshampal's Attempt to Save Happu's Job
episodesList.summary: Reshampal promises Gulati, the Minister’s PA, that Happu will take a shooting test within a week. Ranbir is disqualified from the shooting competition. Beni shares some good news with Vimlesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Takes Aim at Gabbar
episodesList.summary: Malaika tries to teach Happu how to shoot, but he later accidentally shoots Gabbar, injuring his ear. Happu's family teases him over his poor aim, which makes him angry.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Forced to Improve His Shooting Skills
episodesList.summary: Happu practises shooting in the jungle but accidentally injures Gabbar again. Rajesh suggests an idea to Beni for starting a new business. Happu's kids urge him to improve his shooting skills.

episodesList.title: Happu Passes the Shooting Test
episodesList.summary: Happu misses his target again, causing more tension. Malaika suggests a trick to Reshampal to save Happu's job. Eventually, Happu passes the shooting test, and the minister's PA reinstates his job.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Falls Down the Stairs Due to Mobile Addiction
episodesList.summary: Expelled from boarding school, Hrithik comes home. Rajesh falls down the stairs due to her mobile addiction. A woman comes to file a police complaint, but Happu and Manohar are busy on their phones.

episodesList.title: Malaika's Rule to Break Everyone's Mobile Addiction
episodesList.summary: Amma scolds Rajesh for being negligent with household chores. Due to his mobile addiction, Happu lands in trouble. Fed up with everyone's mobile addiction, Malaika makes a rule for her family.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Struggles to Live without Mobile Phones
episodesList.summary: Malaika threatens to confiscate the phones of her family if they don't follow the rules. However, they struggle to do so. Jyoti brings her husband to the police station, and their argument escalates.

episodesList.title: Brother Healer Comes to Help Mobile Addicts
episodesList.summary: Malaika confiscates Hrithik's mobile. Losing phones gives everyone sleepless night, and they are caught watching TV at night. To help them with their mobile addiction, Beni approaches Brother Healer.

episodesList.title: Happu and Manohar's Attempt to Lie to Reshampal
episodesList.summary: Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi trick Masterji for his phone. Happu and Manohar lie to Reshampal, but the tea seller reveals the truth. Eventually, the family regroups for a meal without their phones.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Realises That She Is Unappreciated
episodesList.summary: Rajesh's lookalike notices her, and due to her family's behaviour, Rajesh feels unappreciated at home. Jitu visits the police station with a complaint and curses Happu. Later, Rajesh gets abducted.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Lookalike Goes to Her House
episodesList.summary: At school, Ritik, Ranbir and Chamchi face humiliation due to their lies. Rajesh is captured by her lookalike, who then impersonates Rajesh and goes to her house. Rajesh's behaviour shocks the family.

episodesList.title: Amma Goes to Stay at Beni's House with the Kids
episodesList.summary: Rajesh's lookalike beats up Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi for asking for money to watch a movie and misbehaves with Amma. Amma takes the kids to Beni's house. An incident occurs at the police station.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Discovers Billo's True Identity
episodesList.summary: Rajesh's lookalike, Billo, stops Happu from coming close to her. The family discovers Billo's true identity. They plan to search for Rajesh, but their plan gets failed because of Ritik.

episodesList.title: Happu and Malaika Bring Rajesh Home
episodesList.summary: Billoo falls into Happu's family's trap. Shetty Anna reveals to Happu the reason for seeking revenge against him. Happu and Malaika bring Rajesh home, making everyone realise Rajesh's value.

episodesList.title: Happu Plans to Start a Business
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu to increase his income. Sonu from the weather department brings a complaint to the police station and shares some news with Happu, who then plans to take a loan to start a business.

episodesList.title: Happu Takes a Loan to Start a Business
episodesList.summary: Happu takes a loan of INR 50 lakhs to start a business. Sonu's fight with his senior Titu intensifies. Happu decides to do business under Rajesh's name, but Pitaji makes him change the name.

episodesList.title: Happu Starts a Business
episodesList.summary: Malaika asks Happu to be cautious and he starts a business to become rich. Later, he asks Sweety to choose between Sonu or Titu. On Malaika's advice, Sweety declares her decision.

episodesList.title: The Loss in Business Lands Happu in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Happu's family awaits the cold wave, but the weather suddenly changes. Consequently, he incurs loss in business. Malaika discloses the secret about the creditors Gappu and Chappu, to Happu and Beni.

episodesList.title: The Cold Wave Brings a Wave of Happiness for Happu
episodesList.summary: Gappu and Chappu bring customers to Happu's house. Amma asks Beni to sell his house to save her own. After Pitaji's advice, she plans to sell her house. The sudden weather change alters the situation.

episodesList.title: Happu Finds a Lamp
episodesList.summary: A man faints in front of Happu. Happu promises to take his family to Turkey. Later, he goes to the unconscious man's house and finds a lamp there. A thief breaks into Happu's house.

episodesList.title: A Thief Meets Happu's Family Disguised as a Genie
episodesList.summary: Happu's family rubs a lamp mistaking it for a magical one, and a thief appears disguised as a genie. They feed him to get their wishes fulfilled. Rajesh tells Vimlesh about it, and Happu informs Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu Releases the Criminal, Zoravar
episodesList.summary: Happu advises Reshampal to help him with promotion. Amma tells the genie her wishes. Gabbar tells Rajesh about a problem, making her summon the genie. Later, Happu releases the criminal, Zoravar.

episodesList.title: Malaika Exposes the Thief's Reality
episodesList.summary: Beni and Happu get the thief drunk, who makes Beni dream of making him a judge. He even promises to get Rajesh a diamond necklace. When Malaika returns home, she exposes the thief, shocking everyone.

episodesList.title: Happu, Reshampal and Manohar's Jobs Are Saved
episodesList.summary: Happu, Reshampal and Manohar land in trouble when Zorawar refuses to return to jail. Happu regrets his mistake, and Malaika reveals the truth. Later, Happu, Reshampal and Manohar's jobs are saved.

episodesList.title: Happu Plans to Go to Ladakh with His Friends
episodesList.summary: Everyone insists Happu take them to Gulmarg. Happu's friend Chiraunji tells him about the Ladakh trip plan. Happu lies to Rajesh and tries to go to Ladakh, but the family finds out the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Hurts His Friend and Family
episodesList.summary: Happu insults Beni and the family, hurting their feelings. Malaika tells Beni about a plan to teach Happu a lesson, and Beni supports her. Later, a sage outside the police station curses Happu.

episodesList.title: The Family's Drama to Teach Happu a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Chironji tells Happu that the plan to go to Ladakh has been cancelled. The family and Beni pretend that they can't see Happu. Later, Happu remembers the curse and brings Manohar to his house.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Finds a Role for Her Play
episodesList.summary: Happu gets a sketch of the sage made by Manohar. Reshampal also pretends that Happu is invisible. Rajesh gets a role for her play. According to the play, Malaika gives Rajesh some advice.

episodesList.title: Happu Realises the Importance of Family
episodesList.summary: Happu feels bad to see Rajesh happy with Atul. Beni badmouths Happu in front of a new friend. When Happu learns of the family's plan, he teaches Rajesh a lesson but realises the importance of family.

episodesList.title: Beni Tests Happu's Friendship
episodesList.summary: Happu's kids, bored with their daily routine, ask God for something. At Vimlesh's behest, Beni tests Happu's friendship. At his family's insistence, Happu decides to test Beni's friendship as well.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells a Lie to Test Beni
episodesList.summary: Happu tells a lie to test Beni's friendship and asks Dr Jatayu to create a fake report for Rajesh. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi use makeup to hide their blackened faces and go to school.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Is Found to Have a Hole in Her Heart
episodesList.summary: Dr Jatayu reveals that Rajesh has a hole in her heart. The family pretends to mourn this news, but Beni remains unaffected. Later, Rajesh's fake illness turns into reality.

episodesList.title: Beni Proves to Be a True Friend
episodesList.summary: Beni, aware of the pretence, initially refuses to give money for Rajesh's treatment. Upon learning that she is ill, he proves his friendship. Dr Jatayu tells the truth to Happu's family.

episodesList.title: Seth Ghanshyamdas's Precious Diamond Is Stolen
episodesList.summary: Seth Ghanshyamdas's precious diamond gets stolen. Rajesh tells Happu about her Christmas wish. Ghanshyamdas forces the police to find the diamond. Rajesh and her kids plan a Christmas party.

episodesList.title: The Plan to Send the Diamonds Out of the City
episodesList.summary: Happu's kids invite the teacher to the Christmas party. Michael's boss tells him the plan to send the stolen diamonds out of the city. After tasting Rajesh's cake, Malaika gives her some advice.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Is Infuriated after Seeing Happu's Dance
episodesList.summary: Michael Baker assigns a task to Pascal, and Malaika comes to place an order. Happu learns ballroom dance from Teacher Sukhwinder, and his dance angers Rajesh. The kids make a promise to Masterji.

episodesList.title: The Thieves Plan to Reclaim the Diamond
episodesList.summary: Pascal informs his boss that the diamond is at Malaika's house. Rosie and Michael work on a plan to get it back. At the parlour, Rosie tells Rajesh something, leading Rajesh to think Happu is a cheat.

episodesList.title: Malaika Arrests the Diamond Thieves
episodesList.summary: A cop visits the parlour and clears Rajesh's misunderstanding. Malaika catches Michael and his boss at the Christmas party, and returns Ghanshyam Das his diamond. Masterji gives bad news to the kids.

episodesList.title: Happu's House Turns Out to Be Unlawful
episodesList.summary: Amma tells Happu that their house is illegal. Mintu's landlord visits Happu with a complaint, but he treats him unjustly. Hrithik and Ranbir invite Masterji to their home's birthday celebration.

episodesList.title: Happu Receives a Legal Notice
episodesList.summary: Rajesh reveals the secret of her home to Vimlesh, which leads Mintu's landlord to plan revenge against Happu. Happu's family celebrates the home's birthday, and a legal notice arrives in his name.

episodesList.title: Happu Bribes Officer Prem Bhullar
episodesList.summary: Happu lashes out at Rajesh and Vimlesh, advising them not to gossip. Later, he offers a bribe to officer Prem Bhullar. The pundit suggests Amma a way to save their house.

episodesList.title: Masterji Agrees to Help Hrithik and Ranbir
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni's attempt to trap Prem fails. The women of the house observe a vow of silence. Meanwhile, Happu and Beni bring liquor for Prem. Later, Hrithik and Ranbir force Masterji to help them.

episodesList.title: Amma's Idea to Save the House
episodesList.summary: Masterji requests Prem not to demolish Happu's house. Happu and Beni's attempts to please Prem backfire on them. Amma breaks her vow of silence and tries a trick to save the house.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes a Poet
episodesList.summary: Rajesh mocks Happu for being talentless. Happu finds a book of poetry and pretends to be a poet. Rajesh organises a 'mushaira' at home, but Beni discovers Happu's trick.

episodesList.title: Huddang Baba's Miraculous Concoction
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Happu her New Year's wishes. Happu goes to Huddang Baba with his problem at Manohar's advice. He gives Happu a concoction, and after drinking it, Happu receives great news.

episodesList.title: Happu and Manohar Plan to Steal a Medicine
episodesList.summary: The family rejoices as the kids clear their exams and Happu becomes the commissioner. Rajesh asks Happu to bring a medicine from Huddang Baba. When Baba refuses, Happu and Manohar plan to steal it.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Behaviour towards Happu Changes
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gives a concoction to the family and drinks it herself too, after which her behaviour towards Happu changes. The kids ask Masterji a tricky question and punish him. Later, Masterji calls Happu.

episodesList.title: The Concoction Brings a Change in Happu's House
episodesList.summary: The children talk back to Happu. Rajesh mistreats him, and Amma slaps her. Vimlesh leaves Beni and elopes with a shopkeeper. Happu goes to Huddang Baba and encounters Manohar.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Welcomes the New Year
episodesList.summary: Huddang Baba gives Happu medicine to fix everything. Later, Happu is disturbed by a dangerous dream. His family celebrates the passing of the year together and welcomes the New Year.

episodesList.title: Will Happu's Negligence Cost Him Dearly?
episodesList.summary: Happu's informer gives him information about JK and KK, but he fails to arrest them. Upset with this, the commissioner calls him to the station, but Happu chooses just killing time at home.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Fined for Arriving Late at the Police Station
episodesList.summary: Happu's children arrive late at school, and the teacher asks them to bring Happu to the school. Happu falls ill due to the new liquor that Beni offers him. He is later fined for arriving late at work.

episodesList.title: Malaika Makes a Timetable for Happu
episodesList.summary: After receiving an ominous sign, Rajesh gets bad news. Malaika creates a timetable for Happu to make him punctual. Everyone follows the timetable with Happu, and he faces difficulties.

episodesList.title: The Timetable Becomes a Nuisance for Happu
episodesList.summary: A girl comes to the police station with a complaint of harassment. Due to the daily timetable, Happu starves all day. He sleeps late at night and gets angry when Malaika wakes him up the next day.

episodesList.title: Happu's Tardiness Benefits Him
episodesList.summary: Happu leaves important work to go to his kids' school and punishes the trustee for being late. Later, he saves Reshampal and Manohar's lives and arrests JK and KK. Reshampal is pleased with Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Asked to Protect Star Chintu Kumar
episodesList.summary: Happu gets the responsibility of protecting the Bhojpuri star Chintu Kumar. Rajesh comes from the parlour, but fails to woo Happu. Happu's family insists that he help them talk to Chintu Kumar.

episodesList.title: Chintu Kumar Comes to Stay at Happu's House
episodesList.summary: Chintu Kumar secretly comes to Happu's house with him. Happu's family is very happy to meet Chintu Kumar. Reshampal thinks that Chintu Kumar has been kidnapped, and Happu gets into trouble.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Seeks Chintu Kumar's Help
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Beni that Chintu Kumar lives at his house. The family members show their talents to Chintu Kumar, and Rajesh seeks his help. The news of Chintu Kumar's abduction spreads in the media.

episodesList.title: Chintu Kumar's Behaviour Shocks Happu
episodesList.summary: Beni tells Happu about Chintu Kumar's character. Happu is shocked by Chintu Kumar's behaviour, and Happu's jealousy pleases Rajesh. Beni advises an upset Happu to seek Malaika's help.

episodesList.title: Happu's Doubt about Chintu Kumar Gets Cleared
episodesList.summary: Chintu Kumar asks Malaika out on a date. Happu accuses Chintu Kumar of harassment, but Rajesh and Malaika clear up the misunderstanding. Chintu Kumar stops Reshampal from suspending Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu's Dream of Getting a Promotion
episodesList.summary: Happu dreams of becoming a DCP, but Reshampal refuses to promote him. Later, Happu's kids plan to cheat to pass their exams. Beni suggests a trick to Happu to get the promotion.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Promises to Promote Happu
episodesList.summary: At night, Happu and Beni steal Reshampal's wife’s necklace from his house. Reshampal promises Happu a promotion in exchange for finding the necklace. Rajesh shows her new sandals to Vimlesh and Amma.

episodesList.title: The Blackmailer Puts Happu in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Beni shows Happu a video, and the man who sent it blackmails Happu. Happu fulfils the blackmailer's demands, angering his family. Reshampal, who is hiding in jail, gets into trouble.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Gives Happu Some Bad News
episodesList.summary: Rajesh punishes Happu to take revenge on him. At Beni's suggestion, Happu keeps Reshampal's necklace back in his wardrobe. He pacifies Rajesh with a gift when Reshampal calls him with some bad news.

episodesList.title: The Blackmailer Tells Happu Why He Wanted Revenge
episodesList.summary: Happu's family throws him out when he fulfils the blackmailer's demands. Beni tells Rajesh and Malaika the truth. The blackmailer reveals why he wanted revenge on Happu, and Malaika catches him.

episodesList.title: Happu Stops Manohar from Betraying His Wife
episodesList.summary: Rajesh is proud of Happu's loyalty. Beni and Happu set an example for the children to be honest like them. Later, Manohar tells Happu something, and Happu advises him not to betray his wife.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Shocked After Reading a Letter
episodesList.summary: The children write a letter to Happu asking for forgiveness. Rajesh and Vimlesh give a surprise to their husbands. A letter arrives for Happu and, on reading it, he gets shocked and seeks Beni's help.

episodesList.title: The Letter Addressed to Happu Causes an Uproar
episodesList.summary: Rajesh learns about Happu's infidelity from a letter. When Happu and Beni don't tell the truth, Amma calls Grover. As Happu fails to stop him, he comes home and reveals Happu and Beni's deeds.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Are Thrown Out of Their Homes
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Vimlesh fight their husbands, doubting their character. Happu and Beni are eventually ousted from their homes. Manohar criticises Happu's character and drives him out of the police station.

episodesList.title: Sweetheart Clears Happu's Family's Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: When Happu and Beni's families stop them from staying outside their houses, they take refuge in a temple. The next day, Darling's son Sweetheart visits Happu's house with Montu and clears the air.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Demands a Diamond Necklace on Valentine's Day
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu for a diamond necklace on Valentine's Day. Amma asks Pitaji for a surprise. The teacher asks the students not to celebrate Valentine's Day at school and Hrithik comes up with a plan.

episodesList.title: Happu Gifts Rajesh a Stolen Necklace
episodesList.summary: Happu extorts an ornate necklace from a thief and gifts it to Rajesh. At school, Hrithik, Ranveer and Chamchi execute their plan. Reshampal orders Happu to find his wife's stolen necklace.

episodesList.title: Happu Hides the Necklace from Reshampal
episodesList.summary: Rajesh walks wearing the necklace given by Happu, and Happu stops Reshampal from seeing it. Malaika praises Vicky's singing and asks him for a coffee date. Happu stops Manohar from catching the thief.

episodesList.title: Reshampal's Wife Sees Her Necklace with Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Reshampal's wife sees her necklace around Rajesh's neck and informs him. To clear Reshampal's doubt, Happu follows Beni's advice, and they visit a goldsmith, Chhaganlal. Manohar gives Happu some news.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Confronts Happu
episodesList.summary: Reshampal and Manohar question the thief about the necklace and Happu threatens him to stay silent. Later, both confront Happu regarding the theft of the necklace, and he returns the necklace.

episodesList.title: Beni Feels Embarrassed upon Receiving the Award
episodesList.summary: Beni tells his family about his award. At the police station, his old junior Bhagirath, who has come to meet Happu, flaunts his wealth. Embarrassed by getting the award, Beni attempts commit suicide.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Come Up with a Business Idea
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni come up with a business idea. They decide to mortgage the house to buy land, but Rajesh and Vimlesh oppose it. Happu talks to Amma about mortgaging the house.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Mortgage Their House to Buy Land
episodesList.summary: Happu's kids steal a laptop from Masterji. Happu and Beni, through deceit, take Rajesh and Vimlesh's fingerprints on the house papers. They then mortgage the house to buy land and feel happy about it.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Suffer a Loss
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni suffer a loss on the land they purchased. The shock affects Beni's condition and Happu tells Rajesh the truth. Beni leaves Vimlesh and a bank employee threatens Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Save Their Homes
episodesList.summary: Beni's disguise is exposed in front of Happu, and the latter scolds him. Happu pretends to be possessed by Pritam's mother's spirit. He and Beni give the bank official a cheque to save their homes.

episodesList.title: Subbu Falls in Love with Malaika
episodesList.summary: Subbu falls in love with Malaika. A notorious criminal, Reddy, is brought to the police station. The family talks about getting Malaika married to Reddy, but she reveals that she likes someone.

episodesList.title: Malaika Introduces Subbu to Her Family
episodesList.summary: In school, Masterji tries to cheer up Chamchi. Malaika introduces Subbu to her family, and he tells them about a problem. Amma suggests a plan to the family to arrange Malaika's marriage.

episodesList.title: Happu's Preparation to Meet Subbu's Family
episodesList.summary: Hrithik and Ranbir ask Chamchi to continue pretending to be sad. Subbu agrees with Happu's suggestion. Happu asks Reddy to teach him Malayalam. Masterji tries to make Chamchi laugh.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Dresses as South Indians
episodesList.summary: Masterji asks Hrithik and Ranbeer to make Chamchi smile. Happu's family dresses as south Indians and meets Subbu's family. Later, the family asks Malaika to lie to Subbu's family.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family's Secret Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Subbu and Malaika's alliance is confirmed. Happu fears being exposed. In front of Subbu's parents, Happu's family's secret is revealed. Meanwhile, the children's secrets at school also come out.

episodesList.title: Happu Beats an Innocent Chemical Engineer
episodesList.summary: Happu beats an innocent chemical engineer and takes a bribe from him. Rajesh decides to hold her cousin sister Lata's engagement ceremony at her home. Happu informs Beni about the Holi event.

episodesList.title: The Chemical Engineer Takes Revenge on Happu
episodesList.summary: At midnight, Rajesh asks Happu to bring herbal colours. The chemical engineer sprinkles chemicals into it to take revenge on Happu. His family plays Holi enthusiastically, but a new trouble arises.

episodesList.title: The Holi Colours Cause Trouble
episodesList.summary: The family is angry when the Holi colours don't come off, and Happu and Beni go to beat up the vendor. Reshampal's order adds to Happu's trouble. Rajesh tries to stop her uncle's visit.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Manohar to Stop the Minister
episodesList.summary: The chemical engineer calls Happu and tells him that he got his revenge. Even the doctor's chemical fails to remove the colours. Happu asks Manohar to stop the minister from coming to the station.

episodesList.title: Happu's Fails to Hide His Face from the Minister
episodesList.summary: Happu makes a failed attempt to hide his face from the minister. Rajesh's uncle comes home, and Happu tells everyone about the chemical engineer. Malaika brings him home and helps clean the colour.

episodesList.title: Happu and Beni Are Punished for Lying to Their Wives
episodesList.summary: Rajesh convinces Happu to go shopping. Poonam tells Rajesh and Amma about her tiffin service. Happu and Beni lie to their wives, making them angry, and Amma punishes them.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Starts a Laundry Service
episodesList.summary: Rajesh decides to become self-reliant, and Amma advises her. At the police station, Happu spills tea on Reshampal's special shirt, which angers him. Later, Rajesh starts a laundry service at home.

episodesList.title: Happu Opposes Rajesh's Laundry Work
episodesList.summary: Happu opposes Rajesh's laundry work, but Beni supports it. Amma throws Happu out, and he sets up a camp at the police station. When the stains on Reshampal's shirt aren't cleaned, he threatens Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries to Get the Laundry Closed
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Kanta, the washerman to remove the stain from Reshampal's shirt. He seeks his children's help to shut down Rajesh's laundry, but they trick him instead. Reshampal's shirt remains stained.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh Get Emotional on Meeting Each Other
episodesList.summary: Reshampal gives Happu a final warning for not having a clean shirt. Beni advises Happu to seek Rajesh's help. Happu meets Rajesh, and they both get emotional. Amma makes a decision.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Assigned Night Duty
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Beni about his sleeplessness. Amma invites a music teacher, Shobhraj. Ramesh Mathur, Happu's neighbour, goes to file a police complaint against him. Reshampal assigns Happu night duty.

episodesList.title: Happu Struggles with Sleep on Night Duty
episodesList.summary: Beni adds a sleeping pill to Happu's drink. Happu feels drowsy during his night shift but can't sleep. Ranveer and Hritik argue over Chamchi's friend, Teri. Vimlesh offers Rajesh a suggestion.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Distressed Due to Lack of Sleep
episodesList.summary: Happu returns home after night duty and tries to sleep, but Amma and the kids disturb him. Exhausted from lack of sleep, Happu reaches his workplace and pleads with Manohar to let him rest.

episodesList.title: Happu Lashes Out at Beni for His Condition
episodesList.summary: Reshampal comes to sleep at the police station and finds Happu sleeping there. The following day, Happu argues with Beni over his condition. Upon returning home, his children do not let him sleep.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Relieved from Night Duty
episodesList.summary: Reshampal installs cameras in the police station to keep an eye on Happu. Amma's guru forces her to swear never to sing. Manohar tries to help Happu. Eventually, Happu is relieved from night duty.

episodesList.title: Will Happu Get into Trouble because of Beni?
episodesList.summary: Happu promises Rajesh to take her out, and Amma learns about it. At the police station, Happu lies to Reshampal and leaves his important work to meet Beni. Later, Beni shares his grief with Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Decides to Divorce Happu
episodesList.summary: Vimlesh and Rajesh return home and catch their husbands' lies. Rajesh decides to divorce Happu. Instead of persuading Rajesh, Gabbar supports her decision. Chamchi gives Happu some advice.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh Meet a Marriage Counsellor
episodesList.summary: A marriage counsellor gives Happu tips on keeping Rajesh happy. Happu tries to pacify Rajesh. Later, he stops Rajesh from leaving the house, and both of them meet the marriage counsellor.

episodesList.title: Happu Falls for the Marriage Counsellor's Trick
episodesList.summary: The marriage counsellor traps Happu and asks him to abduct Reshampal. Beni explains a plan to Happu for abducting Reshampal, but the plan fails due to Reshampal's bodyguard, Birjuli.

episodesList.title: Malaika Saves Reshampal's Life
episodesList.summary: Happu's plan to abduct Reshampal fails again, and Malaika suggests an idea. Later, Happu, along with Rajesh and Vimlesh, successfully abducts Reshampal. Birjuli and Malaika save all four of them.

episodesList.title: Happu's Mother-in-law's Arrival Adds to His Woes
episodesList.summary: Happu's dream comes true, and his mother-in-law, Avadhesh, comes to stay at his house. The kids are happy to meet her, but Amma and she exchange sarcastic remarks. Avadhesh insults Happu too.

episodesList.title: Happu's Trick to Get Rid of Avadhesh's Taunts
episodesList.summary: After witnessing Beni's singing talent, Happu uses a trick to get rid of Avadhesh's taunts. Later, Avadhesh tells Reshampal how well Happu sings. Masterji shares his sorrows with the children.

episodesList.title: The Minister Assigns Happu a Responsibility
episodesList.summary: Reshampal and the minister ask Happu to help woo the minister's lover through his singing. Meanwhile, Amma and Avadhesh continue their bickering. Beni loses his voice, leaving Happu anxious.

episodesList.title: Happu Pretends to Have a Sore Throat
episodesList.summary: Happu shares his issue with Amma to seek her help. Chamchi teaches Masterji how to dance. Rajesh overhears Happu and Beni and advises them. Happu pretends to have a sore throat at the police station.

episodesList.title: Avadhesh Discovers Happu and Beni's Secret
episodesList.summary: With Happu's help, the minister pretends to sing to woo his lover. Avadhesh discovers Happu and Beni's secret. The minister later pretends to sing in front of his lover again, but things go awry.

episodesList.title: Will the Bravery Medal Turn into Trouble?
episodesList.summary: Happu catches a thief, and Reshampal tells him he will get a medal from the minister for it. Happu tells his family about it. Rajesh insists on taking Avadhesh instead of Amma to receive the medal.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Gives Happu Bad News
episodesList.summary: Happu arranges for an extra pass through Reshampal and also invites Avadhesh to attend the event. Later, Reshampal gives Happu some bad news. Amidst this, Hrithik attempts to impress Sweety.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Rajesh to Talk to Avadhesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh keeps insisting to take Avadhesh along, and Happu talks to Amma. Happu asks Gabbar to take Avadhesh away. At Happu's behest, Rajesh talks to Avadhesh about not attending the function.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Himself Suspended
episodesList.summary: Reshampal suspends Happu for misbehaving with him but reinstates him shortly afterward. Amma and Avadhesh prepare to go with Happu. Later, Happu has a bad dream involving both of them.

episodesList.title: Happu's Lies Are Exposed
episodesList.summary: Happu has a bad dream about Rajesh. Hrithik pretends to be sick, and Avadhesh refuses to accompany Happu, but the pretence is soon exposed. Happu's lies are also revealed in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Happu Decides to Build a Secret Chamber
episodesList.summary: Amma argues with Avadhesh, and soon, Happu and Rajesh also fight. Troubled by the chaos at home, Happu asks a contractor to build a secret chamber for him. Happu's kids trick Masterji in a new way.

episodesList.title: Happu Has a Secret Chamber Built in the House
episodesList.summary: Happu sends his family out and secretly has a hidden chamber built in the house by a contractor. He and Beni drink inside it, but when the family returns, Beni scares them from inside the chamber.

episodesList.title: The Ghost in Happu’s House Issues an Order for Avadhesh
episodesList.summary: Beni scares off the exorcist from the secret chamber and orders Avadhesh to do the household chores. Happu's kids prevent Masterji from entering the classroom, while the minister assings Happu a task.

episodesList.title: Beni Is Trapped in the Secret Chamber
episodesList.summary: Amma has Avadhesh massage her feet, while Beni gets stuck in the secret chamber. Happu goes to get help from the contractor, only to find him trapped too. Later, Masterji catches Happu’s kids lying.

episodesList.title: Happu Drives Away Avadhesh and Saves Beni
episodesList.summary: Happu confesses the truth to Gabbar, who takes Avadhesh back home. Later, the contractor rescues Beni through a tunnel. Soon after, Malaika exposes Happu, and Amma overhears everything.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets High on Nakamura’s Liquor
episodesList.summary: Manohar arrests Nakamura, who sells a special type of liqour. Happu makes a mistake after consuming it, and Rajesh learns about it. Meanwhile, Pitaji asks Amma to give Rajesh a special anklet.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Decides to Test Happu
episodesList.summary: Reshampal assigns Happu the task of catching a gang involved in honey traps. Rajesh decides to test Happu's loyalty. Meanwhile, Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi lie to Malaika to visit a water park.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Meets Happu in Disguise
episodesList.summary: Rajesh alters her voice to call Happu, who mistakes it as a honey trap and informs Reshampal. Disguised, Rajesh later meets Happu, and they unknowingly trap each other in their plots.

episodesList.title: Happu Regrets Hiding the Truth from Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Happu feels guilty for hiding the truth from Rajesh, but Beni insists he stay silent. Rajesh modulates her voice to call him for a meeting, while Amma subtly advises Happu during their conversation.

episodesList.title: Happu Resolves the Family's Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Intoxicated, Happu approaches Rajesh in disguise. Later, Amma sobers him up, and he clears everyone's misunderstandings. Malaika hands Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi to Masterji for their mischief.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Request to Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu to cook something for Avadhesh, but his tea fails to impress anyone. Later at the station, Happu enjoys Manohar's barfi and requests him to make more and send it home.

episodesList.title: Manohar's Help Earns Happu the Family's Praise
episodesList.summary: Beni, at Happu's instructions, keeps everyone out of the kitchen. Meanwhile, Manohar secretly gives Happu his home-made barfi. Happu serves it to his family and earns their praise.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Asks Him to Make Barfi Again
episodesList.summary: The family again requests Happu to make barfi. Happu finds Manohar and sobers him up, but Manohar refuses to make barfi for him.

episodesList.title: The Barfi Brings Trouble for Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu saves a person's life by feeding him the barfi, but the kind act comes to bite back when he is kidnapped. Meanwhile, Manohar reveals the truth behind the barfi to a worried Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Comes to Happu's Rescue
episodesList.summary: Happu spills the truth as he fails to replicate the barfi before his kidnappers. On his way to save Happu, Manohar meets with an accident and loses his memory. Finally, Rajesh comes to Happu's rescue.

episodesList.title: Happu Grows Suspicious of Avadhesh’s Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Avadhesh leaves home dressed up, while Happu finds Gabbar drunk. Reshampal claims he’s found himself a companion. An already suspicious Happu tells Rajesh that Avadhesh might be having an affair.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells Rajesh about Avadhesh's Affair
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni spot Avadhesh with Reshampal in the park and inform Rajesh about their affair. When Gabbar arrives to take her, Avadhesh refuses to go with him.

episodesList.title: Happu Obtains Proof of Avadhesh's Affair
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni film Avadhesh meeting Reshampal, but Beni’s phone gets stolen, leading them to reveal everything to Rajesh. They later get Reshampal drunk and record his confession.

episodesList.title: Avadhesh's Actions Leave Gabbar Shattered
episodesList.summary: Happu fails to stop Reshampal from attending Avadhesh's birthday party. Avadhesh surprises everyone by choosing Reshampal over Gabbar, sharing cake and spending time with him in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh's Ploy against Avadhesh
episodesList.summary: To separate Avadhesh and Reshampal, Happu and Rajesh come up with an idea but fail in their goal. After hearing Gabbar's words, Avadhesh gets angry and makes a revelation.

episodesList.title: Happu Buys Second-hand ACs
episodesList.summary: Hrithik, Chamchi and Ranbir celebrate Mother's Day with Rajesh. When the heat takes a toll, Rajesh asks Happu to install ACs in everybody's rooms. Following Beni's advice, Happu buys second-hand ACs.

episodesList.title: The AC in Avadhesh’s Room Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: Reshampal agrees to install an AC in the station due to the heat. Meanwhile, Avadhesh’s AC breaks down, and Happu seeks Beni’s help. With Shukla’s guidance, they try to fix it.

episodesList.title: Will Amma Allow Avadhesh in Her Room?
episodesList.summary: Avadhesh sleeps in Happu and Rajesh’s room. The next day, Happu tries to fix her AC and later asks Rajesh to request Amma to let Avadhesh stay in her room.

episodesList.title: All the ACs in the House Break Down
episodesList.summary: At Happu's urging, Amma lets Avadhesh sleep in her room. Suddenly, all the ACs break down, and Shukla takes them for repairs. Troubled by the heat, Amma calls her brother Atbir.

episodesList.title: Reshampal Falls Prey to Happu's Fraud
episodesList.summary: Beni and the kids start selling all the ACs online. Reshampal, intrigued by the ad, disguises himself and buys them all, only to later demand his money back from Happu.

episodesList.title: Avadhesh Asks Rajesh to Test Happu
episodesList.summary: Amma recalls how Pitaji saved her from goons. Avadhesh asks Rajesh to test Happu, while Reshampal makes Happu beat up Katila and uploads the video on the police website.

episodesList.title: Happu Passes Rajesh's Test
episodesList.summary: Happu passes Rajesh's test and upon his return, Rajesh and Avadhesh reveal the truth. Meanwhile, Nandan Katila watches a video of his brother Kundan Katila and vows revenge on Happu.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Instructs Nandan Katila to Kill Happu
episodesList.summary: Nandan Katila threatens Rajesh over the phone, and she suspects Happu is testing her. Playfully, Rajesh suggests him to kill Happu, leading Nandan's man to attack Happu with a coconut.

episodesList.title: Happu's Misunderstanding Is Cleared
episodesList.summary: Chamchi and Ranbir reveal Hrithik’s actions to Amma. Instead of Happu, Manohar falls prey to Nandan Katila’s scheme. Later, Happu realises Nandan Katila is after his life.

episodesList.title: Malaika Saves Happu from Nandan Katila
episodesList.summary: A pundit arranges a protection ritual for Happu. Nandan Katila sets a trap, but Rajesh uncovers the scheme. Avadhesh seeks Malaika’s help, who ultimately saves Happu.

episodesList.title: Amma Wishes to Watch a Movie
episodesList.summary: Rajesh argues with Happu when he forgets a very important day. Amma asks Happu to arrange tickets for the movie 'Badla Hi Badla' but he fails to do so. Later, a few mechanics laugh at Happu.

episodesList.title: Film Pushpa Has a Deep Impact on Happu
episodesList.summary: Reshampal humiliates Happu at the police station. Upset, Happu scolds his kids, but they retaliate. Bani then shows him the film Pushpa, leaving a deep impact on him.

episodesList.title: Happu's Attitude Leaves Everyone Stunned
episodesList.summary: Happu scolds Malaika for questioning him. He even scolds Amma for demanding a ticket and brings Hrithik to the station for third-degree questioning. Meanwhile, he also beats up the mechanic.

episodesList.title: Happu's Fear Changes the Family's Attitude
episodesList.summary: Avadhesh and Rajesh flatter Happu, and even Amma's tone changes. Happu's kids focus on their studies, and he shares his joy with Beni. Meanwhile, Rajesh vows to uncover the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Makes Him Realise His Mistake
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Avadhesh discuss Happu’s changed behaviour with Beni. When Happu returns, the family talks to him, but he remains stubborn. To reform him, they come up with a clever plan.

episodesList.title: A Film Director Is Impressed by Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu finds actor Sajan Kumar’s photo in Rajesh’s wardrobe and grows upset. Frustrated with his family, he vents his anger on a waiter, unknowingly impressing director Chintu Katoch.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells His Family about Landing a Film Role
episodesList.summary: Chintu updates Happu on the film schedule. Happu dashes Rajesh’s hopes and informs his family about being cast in a movie. Later, Chintu introduces him to the film’s heroine.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Is Shattered to See Happu with Tina
episodesList.summary: Happu brings Chintu and Tina home after Chintu urges him to quit his job for a film. Tina invites Happu to her hotel, unaware that Rajesh is secretly following him there.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells Reshampal about His Intention to Resign
episodesList.summary: Happu considers resigning, but Reshampal doesn't allow it. Masterji tells the kids to invite Happu to the school’s annual event. Later, Chintu informs Happu that they need to go to London for a shoot.

episodesList.title: Chintu Reveals the Truth to Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu insults Rajesh and hides the fact that he is married in front of a journalist. He pretends to drink alcohol at the police station to get suspended. Later, Chintu reveals the truth to Happu.

episodesList.title: Guruji Shows Happu a Way to Change His Fate
episodesList.summary: Happu dreams of his promotion, but Guruji warns him that it won’t happen. At the police station, Happu receives bad news. Guruji then suggests a way to change his fate.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Demoted
episodesList.summary: At Guruji's advice, the kids address Happu as aunty. Ignoring the remedy, Happu catches a criminal but gets demoted instead of promoted. Frustrated, he returns home and follows the remedy.

episodesList.title: A Mob Beats Happu Mistaking Him for a Thief
episodesList.summary: Rajesh mistakes a thief for Happu. The next day, a mob beats Happu mistaking him for a thief. Amidst the chaos, Masterji fumes at the kids, and Happu shows up at the station in his vest and briefs.

episodesList.title: The Guests Mistake Happu for a Servant
episodesList.summary: Reshampal warns Happu to avoid coming to the station without his uniform. At home, the guests mistake Happu for a servant. That night, as he steps out, the thief smitten with Rajesh sneaks in again.

episodesList.title: Guruji Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: A thief impersonates Happu to woo Rajesh, while Happu ropes Reshampal and Manohar into his quirky vest-and-underwear act. Eventually, Amma exposes Guruji’s truth and saves the house.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Sees Happu’s Teeth and Thrashes the Family
episodesList.summary: Avadhesh recalls a childhood tale where criminal Shakal wrecks Happu’s teeth, giving him a rabbit-like look. Mistaking the sight, Rajesh lashes out at the family, until Avadhesh reveals the truth.

episodesList.title: Happu Hides His Face due to His Crooked Teeth
episodesList.summary: Happu visits a dentist for his crooked teeth and hides his face from Reshampal at the station. Rajesh regrets beating Amma and advises her. Later, Happu avoids showing his face to Rajesh too.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Again Beats Happu, Amma and Beni
episodesList.summary: Rajesh sees Happu's crooked teeth again and beats up Beni, Amma and him. Ashamed of her actions, she asks Amma to take her to a psychiatrist.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Condition Does Not Improve
episodesList.summary: Happu tries the psychiatrist's remedy to cure Rajesh, but instead, he and Amma get beaten up. Later, a man's punch unexpectedly fixes Happu's teeth, yet Rajesh's behaviour remains unchanged.

episodesList.title: The Family’s Trick to Avoid a Beating from Rajesh
episodesList.summary: The psychiatrist explains Rajesh’s condition to the family. To avoid her, they use fake teeth. When the psychiatrist tries to cure Rajesh, he ends up getting beaten himself.

episodesList.title: Avadhesh Forbids Rajesh from Making Fritters
episodesList.summary: Bhandari warns Happu to stay out of a case, which leads to tension. On a rainy evening, Amma craves fritters, but Avadhesh makes Rajesh promise not to cook them for anyone.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Demand Angers Rajesh
episodesList.summary: During a romantic moment, Happu angers Rajesh by asking her for fritters. Malaika shares crucial information with Chamchi. Later, Happu vents to Beni and gets upset after overhearing Bhandari’s call.

episodesList.title: Happu Sees Rajesh Giving Fritters to Bhandari
episodesList.summary: After Bhandari saves Rajesh’s purse from being stolen, she thanks him with hot fritters. Meanwhile, Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi prank Masterji, as Happu spots Rajesh offering fritters to Bhandari.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Heart Breaks Seeing Bhandari with Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Bhandari feeds balushahi to Rajesh with affection, leaving Happu disheartened. Happu then pours his heart out to Beni, and together, they hatch a plan against Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh’s Misunderstanding Is Resolved
episodesList.summary: Rajesh suspects Happu is cheating on her and tells Bhandari, who reacts by beating him. Once the truth comes out, Happu clears the air with Rajesh and gets back at Bhandari in his style.

episodesList.title: Will Happu Have a New Name?
episodesList.summary: A grieving Beni mistakes Rajesh for Vimlesh and clings to her. He makes Happu sign an affidavit that if Avadhesh isn’t found, Happu’s name will be changed to Tilchatta. A stunned Happu informs Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu Shares His Plan with Beni and Surili
episodesList.summary: Happu thrashes Surili’s husband, Jugnu, who turns out to be Reshampal’s relative. To help Beni and Surili, Happu shares a plan with them, and the trio puts it into action.

episodesList.title: Happu Shares the Next Plan with Surili
episodesList.summary: Happu, Beni, and Amma celebrate their plan, while Avadhesh and Rajesh pretend to know nothing about the market incident, though Amma sees through them. Later, Happu shares the next step with Surili.

episodesList.title: Beni Threatens to Commit Suicide
episodesList.summary: Beni and Surili pull off another pretence in front of Rajesh and Avadhesh, but after Rajesh's reaction, Beni threatens to commit suicide. Hence, Amma quickly pushes Happu to get them married.

episodesList.title: Beni and Surili Stage a Fake Wedding
episodesList.summary: Happu and Manohar convince Surili to fake a wedding with Beni. Jugnu interrupts them, vows to quit singing, and takes Surili away. Meanwhile, Rajesh thwarts Beni’s plan to rename Happu.

episodesList.title: A Man Addresses Happu as Maharaj Hapendra
episodesList.summary: Rajesh spoils Happu’s romantic plans. While Happu is out with Manohar, a man bows to him, calling him Maharaj Hapendra Singh. Back home, Rajesh shares a secret with Amma.

episodesList.title: A Spirit Enters Happu’s House
