episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni go to meet the man Happu had met at the market. The man shows Happu a portrait of King Hapendra and gives him Queen Bipasha’s perfume bottle. Soon after, a spirit enters Happu’s house.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Beats Masterji
episodesList.summary: Happu gives Queen Bipasha's kohl to Rajesh, who gets romantic after applying it. On learning about it from Happu, Beni too wishes to get that kohl. Later, Rajesh beats Masterji.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Has Amma and Avadhesh Serve Her
episodesList.summary: Happu discovers that Queen Bipasha’s spirit has possessed Rajesh. Later, a possessed Rajesh forces Amma and Avadhesh to serve her. Malaika informs this to Happu, who rushes to confront Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Kills Beni in front of Queen Bipasha
episodesList.summary: Possessed by Queen Bipasha’s spirit, Rajesh reveals that their enemy, Gajendra, has reincarnated as Beni. To free the spirit, Happu stages Beni’s murder.

episodesList.title: Malaika Shortlists a Boy for Marriage
episodesList.summary: Rajesh asks Happu to find a suitable match for Malaika and brings up the matter with her as well. Soon after, Malaika meets a boy named Bholu and tells the family about him.

episodesList.title: Bholu's Family Comes to See Malaika
episodesList.summary: Malaika professes her feelings to Bholu, who discovers Happu’s bribery. When she struggles to walk in a saree, Amma comes up with a fix as the groom’s family arrives.

episodesList.title: Happu's Tough Test Has Begun
episodesList.summary: Before finalising the marriage, Bholu's father challenges Happu with three tests and asks him to walk on a rope in the first test. Despite seeking help, Happu fails and ends up crying before Amma.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrives at the Cemetery for the Test
episodesList.summary: Happu tricks the groom’s family to pass the first test. For the next one, Bholu’s father asks him to spend a night in a cemetery. Happu learns about a ghost there, while Amma hatches a plan.

episodesList.title: Happu Fails in the Tea-making Test
episodesList.summary: Happu practices making tea to pass the third test but fails again. Rajesh steps in to make tea, which Bholu’s father notices. Malaika overhears the suitor’s family’s remarks and flares up in anger.

episodesList.title: Whose Name Will Go on the House Plaque?
episodesList.summary: Panditji suggests naming the house. Avadhesh chooses Rajesh’s name, while Amma gets a plaque made with Happu’s name. To maintain peace, Rajesh speaks to Amma and Happu talks to Avadhesh.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh Compete against Each Other
episodesList.summary: Amma and Avadhesh stay firm on the nameplate issue. Beni helps Happu and Rajesh compete. When a crisis strikes Reshampal, the family keeps Happu from going to the station, caught up in the game.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Rajesh to Lose the Game
episodesList.summary: Rajesh wins the first game, angering Amma and putting Happu in trouble. He asks Rajesh to lose the next round. As their game begins, Happu’s absence at the station raises concern.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries to Cheat in the Competition
episodesList.summary: Rajesh wins the second test, sparking a fight with Happu. Failing to assist Reshampal at the station, Happu seeks Beni’s support, only to have Rajesh confront Beni.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Wins the Competition
episodesList.summary: In the third test, Beni asks for a saree fall to be stitched, and Rajesh wins that competition. Meanwhile, Happu helps Reshampal at the station, and later, the house nameplate is inaugurated.

episodesList.title: Happu Decides to Become a Social Media Celebrity
episodesList.summary: Reshampal tasks Happu with guarding a celebrity, but a slip-up leads to Happu being punished by imitating a rooster. Humiliated, Happu decides to become a social media celebrity himself.

episodesList.title: Happu Becomes a Food Vlogger
episodesList.summary: Beni pushes Happu into food vlogging, and he promotes a few bizzare dishes. Amma overhears Rajesh and Avadhesh discussing Avadhesh's treatment. At the station, Happu faces an unexpected attack.

episodesList.title: Billu Badmaash Is Shocked to See Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu plans to get popular by teaming up with Beni. Rajesh lies to Happu about Avadhesh being sick to ask for money. Billu Badmaash comes to shoot Happu's video and is shocked to see him.

episodesList.title: Happu Dresses Up as a Woman to Go Viral
episodesList.summary: Happu shoots a dance video dressed as a woman and later confronts Rajesh for lying to him for money. Meanwhile, Malaika catches Hrithik and Ranbir red-handed and scolds them for their mischief.

episodesList.title: Happu's Dance Video Goes Viral
episodesList.summary: Malaika shows Happu's dance video to the family and tells them about his suspension. After the video goes viral, Happu dances at a minister's party and asks him for a favour.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Brother Gets Arrested upon Arrival
episodesList.summary: Three years later, Happu's kids start college, and Reshampal alerts him about a gold smuggling operation. Rajesh's brother, Doomar, visits the town and is arrested by Reshampal for smuggling.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about Doomar's Arrest
episodesList.summary: Malaika informs Rajesh about Doomar's arrest. Reshampal learns that Doomar is Happu's brother-in-law and tells him his plan. Meanwhile, the real smuggler asks his men to find the gold.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Brings Food in Jail for Doomar
episodesList.summary: Happu catches Hrithik and Ranbir stealing money from his wallet. Rajesh brings food in jail for Doomar, but Happu refuses to give it to him. Gabbar and Awadhesh ask Beni to take up Doomar's case.

episodesList.title: Happu Furious Over Beni Accepting Doomar's Case
episodesList.summary: Beni comes to the police station to talk about Doomar’s bail, and Happu lashes out at him. Amma asks Happu to release Doomar, and Happu wins her over by mentioning his promotion.

episodesList.title: Happu Tries to Help Doomar Escape from Jail
episodesList.summary: Happu tries to help Doomar escape from jail for Raksha Bandhan, but Reshampal catches them. Malaika proves Doomar's innocence, and they all celebrate Raksha Bandhan together.

episodesList.title: Hrithik and Ranbir's Plan to Go to Manali
episodesList.summary: Pooja and Simran ask Hrithik and Ranbir to accompany them to Manali. Hrithik and Ranbir lie to Rajesh to get permission to go to Manali, but Masterji tells Happu the truth.

episodesList.title: Hrithik and Ranbir Set Off for Manali
episodesList.summary: Happu tells the family about Hrithik and Ranbir's lie but despite that, Amma allows them to go to Manali. Pooja and Simran make Hrithik and Ranbir carry their bags. Beni flees with Masterji's scooter.

episodesList.title: The Family Panics after the News of Manali
episodesList.summary: The family hears about the natural disaster in Manali and worries for Hrithik and Ranbir. While Malaika and Beni reach a terrorist hideout, Chamchi heads out for a facial.

episodesList.title: Beni Is Held Captive by the Terrorists
episodesList.summary: A few terrorists capture and torture Beni. Happu turns to Ashok Bhadauria for help, but he plots revenge instead. Rajesh fumes with anger on seeing Chamchi’s bruised face.

episodesList.title: Ashok Brings Hrithik and Ranbir Home
episodesList.summary: Ashok brings Hrithik and Ranbir home safely, but Happu once again mistakenly mistreats him. Later, Happu’s family takes part in the flag hoisting ceremony, while Masterji asks Beni for his scooter.

episodesList.title: Happu Ousts Hrithik from the House
episodesList.summary: Reshampal tells Happu how his father was strict with him in childhood, which made him a helpless man. Angered by Hrithik’s misbehaviour, Happu throws him out of the house to teach him a lesson.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Is Forced to Work as a Labourer
episodesList.summary: Upon Hrithik's request, Jasmine's father gives him labour work. Meanwhile, Amma scolds Happu for his behaviour. Rajesh comes to Hrithik, feeds him, and asks him to return home.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Clashes with Beni for Jasmine’s Sake
episodesList.summary: Rajesh decides not to celebrate Janmashtami until Hrithik returns. Hrithik stops Beni from taking action against Jasmine’s father. Happu insults Masterji when he comes to talk about Hrithik.

episodesList.title: Happu Punishes Himself for His Actions
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Beni to beat him with a belt as punishment. Ranbir and Chamchi urge Happu to bring Hrithik back. Later, Happu sees Hrithik washing dishes and feels heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Happu Brings Hrithik Back Home
episodesList.summary: Beni tells the children that Happu is punishing himself for sending Hrithik out of the house. Happu brings Hrithik back home after talking to Reshampal, and the family celebrates Janmashtami.

episodesList.title: Happu Misunderstands Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Hansmukh, a washerman, reads out Hritik's love letter to Rajesh, which makes Happu suspect that Rajesh is having an affair with Hansmukh. When Rajesh questions Hritik, he tells her about Jasmine.

episodesList.title: Kamlesh’s Twin Brother Sonu Falls for Malaika
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh’s twin brother Sonu falls for Malaika. Hritik gets into a fight with Reshampal’s son, Sootpal, over Jasmine. Hearing Rajesh’s words, Happu decides to lose weight and win Rajesh back.

episodesList.title: Happu Expresses His Grief to Beni
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Beni that Rajesh is having an affair with Hasmukh. On the other hand, Sonu calls Malaika to befriend her. Later, Hrithik and Sutpal get into a fight over Jasmine.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells Hrithik to Apologise to Sutpal
episodesList.summary: Desperate to save his job, Happu urges Hrithik to apologise to Sutpal. Furious, Amma beats Happu, and Malaika slaps Sonu for his comment. Later, Amma shares a story with Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrives to Stop Rajesh and Hasmukh's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Manohar tells Happu that Rajesh plans to marry Hasmukh at the temple. Happu rushes there, and Rajesh clears the air. Meanwhile, Sonu threatens Malaika with poison if she refuses to be his friend.

episodesList.title: Happu's Growing Interest in the Stock Market
episodesList.summary: A man boasts to Happu about his stock market earnings, sparking his curiosity. Stockbroker PK asks Happu to jail him. Intrigued, Happu asks PK for a stock market tip and boldly invests INR 20,000.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Beni to Invest in the Stock Market
episodesList.summary: Happu shares his plan with Beni and convinces him to invest in the stock market. Amma teaches Bela a lesson at Rajesh’s parlour. Meanwhile, Manohar dances dressed as a woman to entertain PK.

episodesList.title: Will Gabbar Give Happu Money?
episodesList.summary: Happu asks Rajesh to request money from Gabbar for investing in the stock market. Chamchi’s plan brings Bansuri closer to Ranbir, while Happu also discusses investment with PK.

episodesList.title: The Stock Market Makes Happu Rich
episodesList.summary: Happu and his family celebrate as their stock market investment doubles. Sonu comes down to meet Malaika, irritating her. Later, Chamchi and Hrithik console a heartbroken Ranbir.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Is Shocked by the Financial Loss
episodesList.summary: A major stock market loss shocks Happu and his family. PK is stunned when it's revealed that Manohar was pretending to be a woman. Later, a bank employee brings them unexpected good news.

episodesList.title: The Doctor Advises Rajesh to Get Glasses
episodesList.summary: Rajesh consults the doctor for a heavy head, and he advises her to get glasses. While Chamchi declines to be Sutpal’s dance partner, Sonu bets with Malaika and eventually wins.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Decides to Not Get Glasses
episodesList.summary: Rajesh discovers Happu’s strong dislike for glasses and decides against getting them. Meanwhile, Sonu stands up to two goons harassing Malaika.

episodesList.title: Amma Develops a Misunderstanding about Rajesh
episodesList.summary: Rajesh wears contact lenses, and Amma mistakenly believes she’s possessed. While Ranbir and Hrithik plan to help Chamchi, Beni discusses Rajesh with Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Visits an Occultist
episodesList.summary: Beni takes Happu to an occultist, who gives him a special powder to place in the kitchen. Meanwhile, Sutpal speaks with the MLA’s daughter, Shakti, who quickly catches on to Chamchi’s plan.

episodesList.title: Happu Brings the Occultist Home
episodesList.summary: Happu brings an occultist to help Rajesh. When a suitor’s family visits Malaika, Chamchi pretends being possessed and drives them away. Rajesh later admits to having poor eyesight.

episodesList.title: Sky Mocks the Snacks Chamchi Brings
episodesList.summary: Gagan confesses his love to Chamchi, but she rejects him. He joins her college under a new identity, Sky, and mocks the snacks she brings. Chamchi asks her family to pack exotic cuisine in her tiffin.

episodesList.title: Chamchi Demands a Fancy Breakfast
episodesList.summary: At Chamchi’s request, Rajesh makes pizza for breakfast, and Happu and Amma eat it reluctantly. Rajesh asks Happu to bring broccoli from the market. Later, Sonu faints and Malaika grows worried.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Mission Broccoli
episodesList.summary: Happu heads out to buy broccoli, but shopkeeper Sharma, seeking revenge, refuses to sell it to him. Chamchi wins over Sky's heart with a pizza feast. Back home, Amma complains to Happu about the food.

episodesList.title: Chamchi Learns about Happu's Misdeed
episodesList.summary: Chamchi feeds Sky broccoli and realises Happu had swapped it with green-painted cabbage. For her next demand, Happu dons a disguise and heads to Sharma’s shop for zucchini.

episodesList.title: Chamchi Uncovers Sky's Truth
episodesList.summary: Rajesh firmly tells Amma to cook only what Chamchi likes. Chamchi discovers that Gagan is actually Sky and slaps him. She then asks the family to stop making exotic cuisines.

episodesList.title: Beni's Taunts Hurt Happu
episodesList.summary: Beni mocks Happu, claiming he'll never be more than a cop. Meanwhile, Hrithik asks Jasmine to join him for dandiya. Later, Happu and Beni decide to visit the Pahadiwali Mata temple to make a wish.

episodesList.title: Happu's Dream of Becoming a Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Manohar he's going to the Pahadiwali Mata temple to pray for a commissioner's post, and Manohar informs the commissioner. That night, Happu dreams of his promotion and dances in his sleep.

episodesList.title: Will Happu Reach the Pahadiwala Mata Temple?
episodesList.summary: The commissioner plots to stop Happu from reaching the Pahadiwali Mata temple. Happu and Beni crawl their way there, while Rajesh observes a Nirjala fast for his wish to come true.

episodesList.title: Beni and Happu Return Home
episodesList.summary: Manohar criticises the commissioner for interfering with Happu’s devotion. Hrithik and Sutpal join a dandiya competition in front of Jasmine. Later, Beni and Happu return home.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Celebrates Navratri
episodesList.summary: Happu gets a call, warning him of his demotion to constable. Worried, he and Beni revisit the Pahadiwali Mata temple. Later, the family performs aarti and enjoys garba together.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Fond Memories of Pitaji’s Scooter
episodesList.summary: Amma shares fond memories of Pitaji’s scooter with the children. Happu tells Rajesh about Pitaji’s special request. Ranbir talks to Ayesha about the scooter, and she makes a heartfelt request.

episodesList.title: Pitaji's Beloved Scooter Gets Stolen
episodesList.summary: Happu and Beni take Pitaji's scooter to go party, but it gets stolen. Later, the commissioner ends up committing a crime. Meanwhile, Ranbir prepares to fulfil Ayesha’s request to impress her.

episodesList.title: The Scooter Theft Creates Chaos in Happu’s House
episodesList.summary: When Pitaji’s scooter is found stolen, chaos breaks out at Happu’s house. Happu and Beni recall last night’s events. Sonu files a complaint at the station, and the commissioner seeks Malaika’s help.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Under Pressure to Find the Scooter
episodesList.summary: Ranbir is heartbroken as his dreams fall apart. Rajesh and Amma pressure Happu to find Pitaji’s scooter. Caught in a dilemma, Malaika takes Chamchi’s advice and decides to talk to Sonu.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Pitaji's Scooter
episodesList.summary: Amma scolds Happu over Pitaji's stolen scooter. He learns the commissioner was behind it and brings it back. Rajesh, tempted by a necklace, fulfils Pitaji's wish.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets a Bag Full of Gold
episodesList.summary: Happu brings home a bag full of gold. The next day, Tony Rich, the commissioner’s brother-in-law, files a complaint at the police station. After fighting with Malaika, Sonu decides not to meet her.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Gives Gabbar the Bag of Jewellery
episodesList.summary: Rajesh hands Gabbar the jewellery bag. Meanwhile, Manohar, searching for Tony's bag, tips off the Commissioner and Happu. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi threaten Halke for tricks to win someone’s love.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Act is Exposed in front of the Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Malaika discovers the truth about Sonu’s lover, Titu. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi turn to tantra to fulfil their wishes. After the revelation, the Commissioner orders Happu to return Tony’s bag.

episodesList.title: Tony’s Jewellery Bag Is Stolen from Gabbar’s House
episodesList.summary: Pitaji tells Amma about the kids’ mischief, prompting her to confront Hrithik and Ranbir. Meanwhile, the Commissioner fumes over Tony’s stolen bag and gives Happu one last chance to recover it.

episodesList.title: Gabbar Saves Happu from Going to Jail
episodesList.summary: Happu, Beni and Manohar hold Gabbar captive to extract the truth. When the jewellery bag remains missing, Happu prepares to get jailed. Just in time, Gabbar reveals a secret and saves him.

episodesList.title: Happu Sees an Auspicious Dream before Diwali
episodesList.summary: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

episodesList.title: Happu Wins a Lottery, and Rajesh Slips Up
episodesList.summary: Manohar’s uncle, Mungerilal, helps the Commissioner with a task. Happu wins an INR 50 crore lottery but keeps it a secret from Beni. Meanwhile, Rajesh unknowingly makes a huge mistake.

episodesList.title: Beni Asks Happu for a Share in the Lottery Money
episodesList.summary: Rajesh hides the fact that the lottery ticket is damaged. Amma tells Beni about Happu’s win, prompting him to demand a share. Later, Hrithik proudly declares himself a millionaire at college.

episodesList.title: Rajesh’s Mistake Shatters the Family’s Dreams
episodesList.summary: Gabbar gets beaten up by Happu while trying to help Rajesh. Rajesh is forced to confess, shattering the family’s millionaire dreams. But Happu soon comes up with a clever plan to win the lottery.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Family Celebrates Diwali
episodesList.summary: Happu takes help from Manohar’s uncle, and more people claim a share in the lottery money. Bad news shatters everyone’s dream of becoming rich. Amma cheers everyone up, and they celebrate Diwali.

episodesList.title: Happu Learns about Pinky Gang’s Plan
episodesList.summary: After a strange dream, Rajesh worries about Happu and meets Baba Black Sheep. Happu catches Sanjay Singh Singhania from the Pinky Gang but soon uncovers a deeper plan behind their actions.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Casts the Baba Black Sheep Spell on Happu
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tries the Baba Black Sheep spell on Happu. Later, Happu tells Beni about Pinky Gang’s plan, but Rajesh misunderstands. Meanwhile, Malaika joins Sonu’s photoshoot to support him.

episodesList.title: The Family Learns about Malaika and Sonu’s Photo
episodesList.summary: Happu tricks Manohar, while Rajesh tries to woo Happu by wearing a nightie gifted by Baba Black Sheep. Meanwhile, Beni spots Malaika and Sonu’s photo and alerts the family.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns the Truth about Baba Black Sheep
episodesList.summary: Happu forces a confession from Singhania. The recovery agent harassing Beni troubles Happu also. Meanwhile, Rajesh uncovers Baba Black Sheep’s truth and overhears Happu sharing the plan with Beni.

episodesList.title: Happu Nabs Pinky Gang
episodesList.summary: Ranbir and Chamchi overhear Happu’s plan from Rajesh and go to rob the bank as well. To catch Happu red-handed, Amma and Rajesh arrive at the bank with Gabbar, while Happu nabs Pinky Gang.

episodesList.title: Happu's New Woe
episodesList.summary: Happu feels troubled for not understanding others' thoughts. He feeds a hungry baba, who blesses him. Meanwhile, Hrithik and Ranbir assure Kiara of help, while Chamchi gets angry.

episodesList.title: Happu Receives a Unique Power
episodesList.summary: Happu suddenly gains the ability to hear people’s thoughts and eagerly tells Beni about it. Later, he cleverly uses this power to make a smuggler confess where the hidden diamonds are.

episodesList.title: Happu Uses His Powers to Locate the Diamonds
episodesList.summary: Happu uses his powers to locate two diamonds hidden by a smuggler. Malaika sets a condition for accepting Sonu’s friendship, while Happu tries to settle a dispute between Amma and Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Learns about Happu's Power
episodesList.summary: Rajesh learns about Happu’s powers. At the station, Happu retrieves the remaining diamonds, raising the smuggler’s suspicions. Beni brings Sonu to Happu for help.

episodesList.title: Happu's Family Makes Him Reveal His Secret
episodesList.summary: Happu hears Malaika’s thoughts and helps Sonu. Rajesh tells the family about his powers, and they trick Happu into revealing his secret.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Fumes over Happu’s Cold Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Rajesh clashes with Happu over his indifference. Amma finds a way to rekindle their bond. Meanwhile, Beni gets intoxicated as he misses Vimlesh and then fights with the paan seller.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Is Overjoyed to Receive Happu's Love
episodesList.summary: Rajesh gives Happu an occultist’s special juice, which makes him shower her with love, leaving her delighted. Later, at the station, Happu arrests a ghazal singer based on his wife's complaint.

episodesList.title: Happu Embarrasses Himself in front of Masterji
episodesList.summary: Happu tries to cheer up Rajesh with a ghazal singer, but she gets irritated. Later, she visits Masterji at college to discuss Ranbir’s complaint, where Happu shows up and embarrasses himself.

episodesList.title: The Family Comes Up with a Way to Cure Happu
episodesList.summary: Gabbar comes to take Rajesh to her maternal home, but Happu stops her. Still lost in her thoughts, Happu's antics land Manohar in trouble. The family begins looking for a way to help him recover.

episodesList.title: Happu's Love Craze Has Finally Worn Off
episodesList.summary: The family's plan to have Happu cured flops. Rajesh then feeds him Baba's offering, which helps break the love spell. Meanwhile, Beni thrashes the paan seller after discovering his deeds.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Tasked to Find a Missing Dog
episodesList.summary: Happu tries to console an upset Beni. Meanwhile, Gabbar tells Amma and others about Baba Bangali's special herbal powder. The commissioner gives Happu the task of finding his neighbour's dog, Gabaru.

episodesList.title: Beni Holds Gabbar Singh Captive
episodesList.summary: Hrithik and Chamchi plot to extort Ranbir, while Beni holds Gabbar Singh captive and tortures him to locate Vimlesh. Meanwhile, Rajesh looks for Gabbar, leaving Happu deeply distressed.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Reaches Beni while Looking for Gabbar
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi begins to see Thiru everywhere. In Ambika’s absence, Kanchana conductss Parashuraman and Vasundhara’s 'shashtiapthapoorthi' ceremony and makes a heartfelt request.

episodesList.title: Malaika Exposes Beni’s Actions to the Family
episodesList.summary: Malaika follows Happu to Beni’s house and finds Gabbar tied up. She informs everyone, and Happu promises to rescue him. Later, Happu vents his anger on the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Happu Renders Beni Unconscious to Save Gabbar
episodesList.summary: To save Gabbar, Happu injects Beni with the doctor’s sedative, knocking him out. Meanwhile, Ranbir uncovers Hrithik and Chamchi’s prank. Furious over Gabru’s bite, the Commissioner suspends Happu.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Rules the Game of Cricket
episodesList.summary: Masterji tells Happu about Ritik’s fine cricket performance. Happu and Rajesh dream of him on the world stage, while the Commissioner surprises Happu by praising Sutpal.

episodesList.title: Beni Offers Hrithik a Proposal
episodesList.summary: Hrithik finds himself in need of INR 5,000. Recognising his cricket talent, Beni puts forth a proposal. At home, Amma and Rajesh pin their hopes on Hrithik’s victory in the match.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Gets Stuck in a Match Fixing Case
episodesList.summary: Hrithik leads his college team to defeat in the cricket match and bring humiliation upon Masterji. The Commissioner considers Hrithik guilty of match-fixing and pressures Happu to arrest him.

episodesList.title: Hrithik’s Family Tries to Protect Him from Arrest
episodesList.summary: To save Hrithik from arrest, Amma devises a plan, and the family lies to Happu that Hrithik has fled. Under the commissioner’s orders, Happu thrashes Beni to force a confession.

episodesList.title: Hrithik Rectifies His Mistake
episodesList.summary: Malaika unmasks Hrithik hiding in disguise at home, and Happu arrests him. Just then, Masterji arrives with news, prompting Hrithik to redeem himself and rectify his mistake right.

episodesList.title: Tired of His Life, Happu Prays to God
episodesList.summary: Exhausted by his chaotic life, Happu hears from Beni about a mystic in the cemetery. He makes a wish to God, but later, a common man exposes his failing health before the Commissioner.

episodesList.title: Happu Finds a Solution to His Problem
episodesList.summary: Happu’s scientist uncle builds a robot in his likeness, which Happu cleverly uses. Beni, trapped in a graveyard, calls for help, while at home Rajesh mistakes the robot for Happu.

episodesList.title: Happu Wows Everyone with a Robot’s Aid
episodesList.summary: Robot Happu T‑20 romances Rajesh, angering Happu. Later, the robot takes over all his duties, impressing everyone. Happu then reveals the truth about his robot to Beni.

episodesList.title: The Robot Spells Trouble for Happu and Beni
episodesList.summary: Beni’s dream of building a robot drags him into trouble. At the same time, Happu T‑20 turns into a headache for Happu, who finally reveals the truth to Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Rid of the Robot
episodesList.summary: After conducting a test, Rajesh becomes convinced that the person living in the house is not Happu but his robot. Later, Happu tells Rajesh a plan, and with her help, Happu gets rid of the robot.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Memories Tied to Her Favourite Quilt
episodesList.summary: Amma recalls old memories of her favourite quilt to the children. Later, she angers Rajesh by refusing her earrings, prompting her to take a vow. Meanwhile, at college, Ranbir finds a new love!

episodesList.title: Amma Is Shocked by the Quilt Theft
episodesList.summary: The quilt theft leaves Amma shaken and ill. She has her family swear to recover it. Soon, a cold wave grips the city, and everyone shivers in the piercing cold.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Admits to Stealing the Quilt
episodesList.summary: Amma frees the shivering children from their vow. Discovering Rajesh’s mischief, they plot a plan. Fearing Happu’s anger, Rajesh confesses to Amma, but the quilt actually gets stolen.

episodesList.title: Malaika Brings the Quilt Thieves before Amma
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tells Amma about the quilt stolen from the storeroom, leaving Happu shivering on night duty. Later, Malaika drags the quilt thieves to Amma.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Quilt Is in Beni’s Possession
episodesList.summary: Beni steals the quilt from Happu’s children’s room and sets a condition before Amma. Later, the family devises a plan to reclaim it, while Amma fulfils Rajesh’s heartfelt wish.

episodesList.title: Happu Gets Stuck Because of the Property Tax
episodesList.summary: Rajesh becomes an insurance agent and tries to sell policies to everyone. Happu, stuck with pending property tax, hears Rajesh explain the benefits of insurance and comes up with a plan.

episodesList.title: Happu Falls Victim to an Accident
episodesList.summary: Rajesh agrees to help Happu, but because of her own plan, Happu falls victim to an accident. Meanwhile, Ranbir’s quick-money scheme lands him in trouble.

episodesList.title: Happu Falls for Chamkili
episodesList.summary: After the accident, Happu’s memory goes back 20 years. Learning Ranbir’s mischief, Rajesh gets shocked. Meanwhile, thinking himself young, Happu falls for Constable Chamkili at the station.

episodesList.title: Rajesh's Plan to Pull Happu out of a Trap
episodesList.summary: Beni brings an alarming news to Rajesh. Later, with his help, Happu threatens Tax Officer C.K. Sutiya. Meanwhile, Rajesh tries a trick to pull Happu out of Chamkili’s love spell.

episodesList.title: Happu Decides to Marry Pinky
episodesList.summary: Beni cleverly gets Chamkili suspended from the job. Smitten by Pinky, Happu decides to marry her. But Amma's plan helps him regain his memories, and he realises that Pinky is none other than Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Judge Satyaprakash Gives Happu an Unusual Punishment
episodesList.summary: Happu overhears the children plotting to extort money from him. Later, Judge Satyaprakash witnesses Happu assaulting a needy man, punishes him, and instructs Malaika to keep an eye on him.

episodesList.title: Happu Asks Amma for Help to Keep His Job
episodesList.summary: When the sacred flame for Happu’s promotion goes off for the third time, Rajesh gets worried. Happu breaks the troubling news to her and seeks Amma’s support to protect his job.

episodesList.title: Judge Satyaprakash Grants Happu One Last Chance
episodesList.summary: Malaika uncovers Amma and Happu’s act. Later, Judge Satyaprakash catches Happu in another mistake. However, urged by the commissioner, he grants Happu a final chance, driving him to devise a plan.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Plan to Save His Job Fails
episodesList.summary: Happu’s cunning plan to save his job collapses once more, triggering Malaika’s fury. Later, Rajesh’s prayer is interrupted with an ill omen again, and Happu wakes shaken from a nightmare.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Rewarded for His Service
episodesList.summary: Judge Satyaprakash suspends Happu, but he saves a child from abduction and captures the kidnapper. Malaika’s revelation shifts the tide, and the judge prepares a surprising reward for Happu.

episodesList.title: Will Happu Prevent the Police Station from Closing?
episodesList.summary: With no crimes reported in Happu’s area for months, an order is passed for Happu to be honoured. However, MLA Chamanlal decides to shut down the police station since there has been no crime.

episodesList.title: Happu Goes to Apologise to Chintu Parchhai
episodesList.summary: Chamchi devises a plan to save Happu’s job, landing Hrithik and Ranbir in trouble. On Beni’s advice, Happu seeks Chintu Parchhai’s forgiveness, but a daring condition awaits.

episodesList.title: Happu Compels Beni to Steal from the Temple
episodesList.summary: Happu forces Beni to steal from a temple to save his job, but the plan fails. As Manohar secures new work, Happu turns to the Commissioner with a desperate plea.

episodesList.title: Happu Goes from Inspector to Peon
episodesList.summary: Municipal officer Madan assigns peon jobs to Happu and Manohar. When Happu’s truth emerges, the family considers cutting expenses, while Amma is shaken by a disturbing nightmare.

episodesList.title: Can Happu Retain His Job as Inspector?
episodesList.summary: Amma beats Rajesh to protect Happu’s inspector job. Next morning, a newspaper story excites Happu and Manohar, who rush to the station as the Commissioner makes a shocking revelation.

episodesList.title: Riya’s Dream of Marrying Hrithik
episodesList.summary: A baba predicts Rajesh’s future, but she doubts it. Meanwhile, Hrithik’s new love, Riya, dreams of marriage, and then Hrithik requests Rajesh and Happu to meet her father.

episodesList.title: Riya’s Boxer Father Sets a Condition before Happu
episodesList.summary: Riya’s parents visit Hrithik’s family. Her boxer father Jagawar, aka JV, sets a condition before Happu, while Rajesh forces him to agree, landing Happu in deep trouble.

episodesList.title: Boxing Contest Pressure Rises on Happu
episodesList.summary: Despite Amma’s advice, Rajesh insists on a boxing bout between Happu and Jagawar. The commissioner steps in to train Happu for the big fight. Meanwhile, Hrithik’s ex-lover returns to his life.

episodesList.title: A Boxing Competition Puts Happu in a Fix
episodesList.summary: With Jasmine back in his life, Hrithik steps away from marrying Riya. The commissioner pressures Happu to win the bout, while Rajesh urges him to lose, leaving Happu in deep dilemma.

episodesList.title: Who Will Win the Boxing Match?
episodesList.summary: Happu faces family pressure to win, while the minister orders him to lose. In the ring, the tables turn as both Happu and Jagawar try to throw the fight, leaving the referee to deliver his verdict.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh’s Hotel Honeymoon Backfires
episodesList.summary: Masterji scolds Happu about his kids, leading to a promise. Later, Happu takes Rajesh to a hotel for a honeymoon but gets caught in a raid, and Amma storms the station to free them, stunning all.

episodesList.title: Happu and Rajesh's New Year Resolution
episodesList.summary: Amma makes Happu and Rajesh vow to stay apart, while Happu lands in trouble after misbehaving with the Commissioner. Meanwhile, Sonu’s New Year resolution sparks Malaika’s anger.

episodesList.title: Malaika Finds a Way to Break Sonu’s Resolution
episodesList.summary: Rajesh makes Amma vow to quit alcohol and gives Beni some news. Beni and Happu visit a doctor for their problem, while Chamchi guides Malaika to break Sonu’s resolution.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Plan to Romance Rajesh Fails
episodesList.summary: Amma grows restless without liquor, but Rajesh makes her hold back. Later, Happu’s romantic plan with Rajesh fails, while Malaika tries to break Sonu’s resolve!

episodesList.title: Happu Is Freed from Amma's Vow
episodesList.summary: When Happu’s job comes under threat, Pitaji asks Amma to free him from his vow. Sonu also breaks his vow for Malaika’s love. With Chamchi’s help, Hrithik gets rid of Montu’s threats.

episodesList.title: Happu Grows Proud of His Reputation
episodesList.summary: Amma forbids Rajesh from attending a ceremony, citing Happu’s honour. At the station, an arrogant Happu rejects a tea vendor’s sister’s wedding invitation, while Chamchi spurns Amol’s love.

episodesList.title: A Viral Video Disgraces Happu
episodesList.summary: As Happu’s family celebrates Makar Sankranti, Amol schemes to tarnish his reputation. The next day, a viral video ignites outrage at home, leaving everyone furious with Happu.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Asks Happu to Prove His Innocence
episodesList.summary: Happu’s viral video brings public humiliation, yet he denies the allegations against him. The commissioner forces him to bring proof of his innocence, while at home, Rajesh taunts him relentlessly!

episodesList.title: The Fake Video Leaves Happu Struggling
episodesList.summary: Another fake video of Happu goes viral, earning him taunts from his family. The commissioner threatens his job, but Happu resolves to prove his innocence.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrests Amol
episodesList.summary: A fake video of Beni and Happu goes viral, tarnishing Beni’s image. Happu discovers the truth about Amol and arrests him. Later, Amma fulfils one of Rajesh’s wishes.

episodesList.title: Amma Falls Unconscious
episodesList.summary: Amma spends time with her friend Matadin. Pinkesh, who comes to the police station with a complaint against Ranbir, asks Happu to arrest him. Beni takes an unconscious Amma to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Amma Becomes Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Beni break the news to Happu about Amma’s pregnancy, while Pinkesh informs the kids. Later, Rajesh orders another test, but Amma's pregnancy is confirmed!

episodesList.title: Amma’s Pregnancy News Spreads through Town
episodesList.summary: Amma’s family struggles to accept her pregnancy. The news soon hits the papers and spreads across town, and later, Matadeen shocks everyone by offering to give Amma’s child his name.

episodesList.title: Amma's Pregnancy Earns Her Popularity
episodesList.summary: Amma’s family hosts her baby shower, while a leading company names her brand ambassador. Pressured by the minister, the commissioner apologises to Happu and urges him to return to work.

episodesList.title: Happu Is Shocked as Men Claim to be Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Some men come to the police station and shock Happu by telling him that they are pregnant. Later, Malaika and the children expose Pinkesh’s plan, and Amma’s pregnancy turns out to be false.

episodesList.title: An Angry Rajesh Walks Away from Home
episodesList.summary: Rajesh complains to Happu about the children’s misbehaviour, sparking a fight. Upset, she leaves home to stay at Beni’s. The next day, with nothing of hers around, the kids begin to miss Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Happu Finds a Way to Bring Rajesh Home
episodesList.summary: Rajesh tries to belittle Happu in front of the vegetable seller Sanno. Manohar suggests a trick to Happu to bring Rajesh home. Later, Happu asks Sanno for a favour in exchange for helping her.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Takes Revenge on Happu
episodesList.summary: Happu flaunts Sanno as his lover to make Rajesh jealous, but she strikes back. Later, a woman files a report against Gabbar for harassment, and Happu throws him behind bars!

episodesList.title: Happu Does Not Release Gabbar from Jail
episodesList.summary: Beni informs Rajesh of Gabbar’s arrest, and she scolds Happu at the station. Though Beni secures Gabbar’s bail, Happu traps her in another charge and sends her back to jail.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and Happu Reconcile
episodesList.summary: Rajesh fails to free Gabbar from jail and makes peace with Happu. Later, Malaika reveals the truth about the girl’s complaint against Gabbar, leading to his release and return home.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Family Demands a Trip to Manali
episodesList.summary: The family pressures Happu to take them on a Manali trip. As he schemes to escape the expense, the Commissioner approves his leave. A ferocious monkey named Shaakal spreads terror across the city.

episodesList.title: Happu Puts on an Act to Escape the Manali Trip
episodesList.summary: To escape the expense of Manali, Happu pulls off a pretence with Beni’s help. Later, Happu behaves like a monkey to frighten Chamchi, leaving the family in shock and amusement.

episodesList.title: Happu’s Monkey‑like Behaviour Shocks His Family

episodesList.title: The Family Discovers Happu’s Act
episodesList.summary: Malika uncovers Happu’s act to avoid Manali and alerts Amma and Rajesh. Meanwhile, on the Minister’s orders, the Commissioner instructs the forest officials not to arrest Shakal.

episodesList.title: Rajesh and the Kids Teach Happu a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Rajesh lies to Happu, claiming the monkey Shakal bit her and starts behaving like one. Fooled by Rajesh and their kids’ act, Happu calls Beni for help, only to be cornered by them all.

episodesList.title: Happu Saves a Woman from a Few Goons
episodesList.summary: Happu shares his Valentine’s Day plan with Rajesh and later rescues a woman from eve-teasers. Rajesh finds the saree Pitaji once gifted Amma, leading to the revelation of a shocking secret.

episodesList.title: Valentine’s Day Brings Trouble for Happu
episodesList.summary: The Commissioner reveals a truth to Happu and pressures him to dine with Netaji’s sister on Valentine’s Day. Beni advises Happu, who is in a dilemma, to keep it hidden from Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Rajesh Stops Happu from Going on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Suspicious of Happu, Rajesh forbids him from going on a mission on Valentine’s Day. Worried, Happu seeks Beni’s help and spins a new lie, while Malaika’s advice lands Chamchi in trouble.

cast.name: Yogesh Tripathi
cast.role: Daroga (Police Inspector) Happu Singh (2019–2026), a corrupt and incompetent police officer living in Kanpur with his wife, mother, and nine children. He is constantly troubled by the rivalry between his wife and mother and often takes bribes.

cast.name: Kamna Pathak
cast.role: Rajesh Singh (2019–2023), Happu's wife, who is level-headed and often the voice of reason in the household. She shares a strained relationship with her mother-in-law but cares for her. Geetanjali Mishra as Rajesh Singh (2023–2026), replacing Kamna Pathak.

cast.name: Himani Shivpuri
cast.role: Katori Devi Singh (2019–2026), Happu's mother, known for her domineering nature and frequent conflicts with her daughter-in-law.

cast.name: Sanjay Choudhary
cast.role: Kamlesh (2019–2024) and Sonu (2025–2026), with Kamlesh being Katori's husband and Sonu his twin brother with a contrasting personality.

cast.name: Ashna Kishore
cast.role: Katori Singh "Kat" (2019–2022), Happu's eldest daughter. Gazal Sood as Katori Singh "Kat" (2023–2024), replacing Ashna Kishore.

cast.name: Zahara Sethjiwala
cast.role: Malaika Singh (2019–2021), Happu's second daughter. Jasneet Kaur Kant as Malaika Singh (2021–2022), replacing Zahara Sethjiwala. * Sonal Panwar as Malaika Singh (2022–2026), replacing Jasneet Kaur Kant.

cast.name: Vishwanath Chatterjee

title: Hey Prabhu!
summary: Hey Prabhu! is a 2019 Hindi-language comedy web series directed by Shashanka Ghosh for MX Player. The series stars Rajat Barmecha, Parul Gulati, Ritu Raj Singh, Achint Kaur, Sheeba Chaddha and Prynca Talukdar. It is written by Nihit Bhave and produced by Sanket Kunde. The series was premiered on 20 February 2019, on MX Player. The second season of Hey Prabhu! was released on 26 March 2021.
plot: The web series is based on the story of a boy named Tarun Prabhu (played by Rajat Barmecha), who is in his mid-20s with a strong fan following on social media platform, Twitter. Tarun soon realizes that online popularity is not enough to overcome real-life situations. Mita (played by Achint Kaur) and Arunima (played by Parul Gulati) hate Tarun's reckless behaviour and make his life difficult at work. Arunima (played by Parul Gulati), Mita's senior correspondent, who assists Tarun. His social life gets disturbed when everyone gets to know that he is suffering from erectile dysfunction. The title is a pun on Hey Prabhu, (Oh God), a common opening for Hindi prayers and poems.
reception: Sakshma Srivastav of Times Now gave three-and-a-half of five, saying, "What I liked about the show is one, its entertaining plot and two, its natural performances. There is a lot of situational comedy and drama." D.Krishna Prasad, writing for IWMBuzz gave 3.5 out of 5 stars and said, "The overall package, in terms of acting, script, background work, is really good. It is depicted in a natural and powerful way. It features an interesting real life story and a script well written by Nihit Bhave. The main reason why it seemed more realistic was because the series adopted a hilarious and funny way to show Rajat Barmecha's problem in a comical way, even while it touched upon the real aspects of today’s generation." TheDigitalHash.com stated, "Hey Prabhu is one of the rare web series that has an intelligent script and wants to handle the protagonist's personal as well as work-life with crackling speed and laser-sharp precision."

title: Home
summary:
Home is a 2018 Hindi web series  created by Ekta Kapoor for her video on demand platform ALTBalaji. The series stars a stellar cast comprising Annu Kapoor,Supriya Pilgaonkar, Amol Parashar, Parikshit Sahni, and Chetna Pandey and is directed by Habib Faisal. The web series revolves around the bond of a family and their fight against the system due to which they have to empty their 'Home'.
The series is available for streaming on the ALT Balaji App and its associated websites since its release date.
plot: The series revolves around a fictional middle-class Sethi family. The series explores how the family hold on to their values and finds happiness in little things. But their world comes crashing down when they are served an eviction notice by the authorities. The series explores how they fight the authorities, corporations and government to save their home.
reception: Supriya from The Quint writes "Though Home is among the better offerings of Balaji Telefilms, the demolition-themed web series could have done with some trimming of its own."

title: Hriday Haran B.A. Pass
summary: Hriday Haran B.A. Pass is an Indian Bengali-language comedy-drama television series that premiered on 13 August 2018. The series was broadcast on the Bengali television channel Zee Bangla, and streamed on the digital platform ZEE5. Produced by Blues Productions, the show stars, movie star Joey Debroy as the protagonist of the show and for the first time on television show. Roshni Tanwi Bhattacharya in lead roles and Goutam De, Jayant Dutt Barman and Siddhartha Bandyopadhyay in supporting roles. The show is written by Snehasish Chakroborty, known for Khokababu, Jarowar Jhumko, Tumi Robe Nirobe, and Rakhi Bandhan.
plot: The story revolves around a young couple, Hridoy and Pekham. Hriday as he is referred to, is the black sheep of the family - unemployed and uneducated - only interested in music. Hriday then makes the ultimate sacrifice, leaves his career as a lyricist and becomes a driver at Pekham's house. Pekhem is a smart but difficult to manage girl. She happens to be a great fan of singer Sid and later fall in love with him. Pekham's father arranges his daughter's marriage with a man who is simple, traditional and homely. But Pekhem runaway on her wedding day with the help of driver Hriday to marry her long time boyfriend singer Sid. But both Hridoy and Pekham's families think that Hriday enlopes Pekhem to marry her and they disown them for this mistake, the couple is forced to live in a boarding house with bachelors.

title: Hum – I'm Because of Us
summary:
Hum – I'm Because of Us is a 2018 Hindi web series created by Ekta Kapoor for her video on demand platform, ALTBalaji. It stars Kushal Tandon and Ridhima Pandit as protagonists and is directed by Partho Mitra. The series revolves around the bond between three sisters who, despite having different ideas about life, share a strong sisterly bond.
The series is available for streaming on the ALT Balaji app and associated websites.
plot: The series revolves around three sisters Devina, Isha, and Sakshi who make their way to Mumbai to follow their dreams. Devina, the eldest sister, is sweet and simple and wants to hold the family together whereas Isha, the youngest sister, is smart and wants more from life. The series explores how their paths unravel as they develop their bonds as a family.

episodesList.title: The Kapoor Girls
episodesList.summary: Her Royal Highness, Princess of Daulatganj, Rooprani Kapoor marks her 25th wedding anniversary. She is fond of revisiting old memories of her late husband. After all, the marriage gave her three lovely daughters, Devina, Isha, and Sakshi. The three sisters leave for Mumbai when they receive an invitation to Vikram Bedi's 50th Birthday party.

episodesList.title: Big City, Bigger Dreams
episodesList.summary: New to the city, the three sisters set out to explore Mumbai as well as to search for means of livelihood. But Rooprani has one condition - it better be a respectable job. While Isha believes her charm can take her places, Devina emerges stronger after facing several rejections. At the end of a difficult day, the man of Devina's dreams comes to her rescue.

episodesList.title: Trouble in Paradise
episodesList.summary: So far, Mumbai has been treating the Kapoors just fine. While Isha chooses to soak in the city's energies, Devina tries her best to fit into her job as a waitress. But, it also troubles her that she is forced to hide this truth from her mother. At the same time, she is certain that Rahul will keep her secret safe. However, a tense dinner table conversation at the Bedi's threatens to reveal a different side of the Kapoors.

episodesList.title: Dreams do Come True
episodesList.summary: Rooprani Kapoor has always lived life on her own terms. Keeping this in mind, she makes an important announcement. The sisters regale at their mother's decision. It's a promise of a new life - full of hard work, unexpected gifts, and a few skirmishes of the egos, as Pammi is not happy with the sisters' growing closeness to Mr. Bedi.

episodesList.title: Games People Play
episodesList.summary: Rahul's friendly ways impress Devina, as she begins to fall for him. But does Rahul feel the same way for Devina? Whatever be his true intentions, Isha warns him not to play with her sister's feelings. There will be consequences he won't be able to handle. How long will the bond of the three sisters last?

episodesList.title: The Proposal
episodesList.summary: It's time for the girls to let loose. At a party, Devina and Isha drink, shake a leg, and let go. The dance floor witnesses some cool moves and lots of jealousy. Rahul dances with Devina, and Isha enjoys with Mr. Bedi. But when it comes to choosing between a boy and her sisters, Isha is very clear where her loyalties lie. Should Rahul be worried about his intentions?

episodesList.title: A Twist in The Fairy Tale
episodesList.summary: Rahul meets Devina knowing that the only way to get to Isha is through her. Devina's heart is breaking but she promises to talk to Isha on Rahul's behalf. Isha is happy to know what's on Rahul mind. So, when Rahul proposes she accepts. But Mr. Bedi has other plans for her.

episodesList.title: Diamonds are a Girl's Best Friend
episodesList.summary: Isha faces the big decision of choosing a life partner. No matter whom she chooses, her entire family will face the consequences. Both Rahul and Vikram are ready to wait for her answer. Since leaving Mumbai is not an option for Isha, she must make a choice. At a party thrown by Rahul, everyone hopes Isha will take the right step.

episodesList.title: Decisions and Sacrifices
episodesList.summary: Marriages are made in heaven, but choosing a wrong partner can make life a living hell. Devina fails to make Isha understand the consequences of her decision. Devina takes it upon herself to save the two people closest to her from ruining their lives. On the other hand, Pammi can't see her brother Vikram make a grave error in choosing his life partner.

episodesList.title: The Games Must Go On
episodesList.summary: Isha and Vikram start preparations for their wedding. But those around them are not yet ready for this alliance. Even Pammi's calculated attempt is spoiled by Isha's smart counter. But Pammi doesn't give up and invites Rooprani to Mumbai. How long will the sisters manage to keep their mother in the dark about Isha's choice of husband?

episodesList.title: Heart vs Mind
episodesList.summary: Finally, everyone accepts Isha's decision of marrying Vikram. With dance and music, they all gather for the Sangeet ceremony of the couple. But before Isha can tie the knot with Vikram, she must sign some papers. Is Vikram's love for Isha conditional? Meanwhile, Rahul learns the identity of the man who broke Devina's heart.

episodesList.title: The Day of the Wedding
episodesList.summary: The day of Isha and Vikram's wedding finally arrives. Isha is a reluctant bride who gives everyone a scare by running away from the wedding. Rahul and the Kapoors are delighted at the prospect of a cancelled wedding.

episodesList.title: Love and Lies
episodesList.summary: Devina and Rahul go on a dinner date. Isha arrives at the restaurant and walks out with Devina while accusing Rahul of being revengeful.

episodesList.title: Betrayal and Broken Dreams
episodesList.summary: Vikram Bedi announces the new COO of his company. He also sets ground rules for Isha.

episodesList.title: The Separation
episodesList.summary: While Isha questions Rahul’s intentions, Devina maintains a firm stance on her decision. Rahul and Devina decide to get married.

episodesList.title: A Night to Remember
episodesList.summary: Sakshi re-unites Isha and Devina after four long years. Rahul and Vikram too share a drink after a long time.

episodesList.title: Hopes and Dreams
episodesList.summary: Rahul gets a job offer in Kuwait. Devina announces her pregnancy, while Isha too wishes to start her family.

episodesList.title: Money, Love and Broken Relationships
episodesList.summary: In the war-torn Middle-East, Rahul is untraceable in Kuwait. Devina is distressed, and her health deteriorates. She reaches out to Vikram for help.

episodesList.title: A Day We Couldn’t Forget
episodesList.summary: Success and money can’t always buy happiness. An unfortunate event changes the lives of Kapoor sisters forever.

episodesList.title: Guilt And Revenge
episodesList.summary: Rahul accuses Vikram and Isha of ruining their lives. Devina realizes that she’s been living a lie.

The series explores how their paths unravel as they develop their bonds as a family.
tagline: The series revolves around three sisters Devina, Isha, and Sakshi who make their way to Mumbai to follow their dreams.

title: Har Shaakh Pe Ullu Baithaa Hai
wikiTitle: Har Shaakh Pe Ullu Baithaa Hai
summary: Har Shaakh Pe Ullu Baithaa Hai (transl. There's An Owl Sitting On Every Branch) is an Indian sitcom television series, that premiered on 26 February 2018 on StarPlus. The Show stars Rajeev Nigam and Samta Sagar in Lead Roles. The Show is produced by Garima Productions.
plot: "Promise what benefits them and do what benefits us!" has been the mantra of our opportunistic politicians for ages. Still, whenever some shrewd politician shows up with sweet words and a welcoming smile the people vote again, hoping that the solution has arrived. Shri Chaitu Lal is Chief Minister of a fictional state named Ulta Pradesh. This Chief Minister is known for fooling the innocent citizens by making false promises. Chaitu is a fairly manipulative, wise with words and is of an opportunistic kind. His 'thenga party' vouches only for black money by manipulating the system. He promises what benefits the common man but does what benefits him. Supporting him in this comedy show is his wife Imli Devi. She stands by her husband through the thick and thin. Even though Chaitu is the leader of the ruling party when it comes to home, his wife is his biggest support system. Imli hopes to see her brother and CM's enthusiastic brother-in-law, Putan as the Prime Minister of the nation. Putan a youth icon of his state is as shrewd as his Jijaji. He has 13 cases lodged against him and has purchased degrees from all the top colleges of the state. Puttan is no less to Chaitu in any way when it comes to politics and corruption.

title: Haq Se
summary:
Haq Se is an Indian Hindi web series, directed by
Ken Ghosh and produced by Viraj Kapur, and Karan Raj Kohli. The series was released on 2 February 2018 on JioHotstar. The series stars Rajeev Khandelwal, Surveen Chawla and Parul Gulati.
The series is available for streaming on the JioHotstar App and its associated networks since its release date.
plot:
The series revolves around four blood-bound sisters with four passionate dreams, all yearning for one thing: fulfillment. It is a modern-day story of dreams, desires, love, war and the eternal pursuit of happiness, set against the breathtaking beauty and unsettling unrest of Kashmir.
Life changed for Meher, Jannat, Bano, and Amal when their father's medicine factory was burnt in a riot. Their father was forced to leave for Siachen as an Army's doctor to cater to his family's needs. With military, political, and religious tension mounting by the moment, these girls are fighting hard to keep their passions alive.
Meher is a young and sensible woman who is working as a pediatric intern under Dr.Naushad Rizvi, a single father. In the past, she was in love with someone. But for unknown reasons, the relationship failed. Therefore, she is very critical of love. Dr. Naushad Rizvi is a strict doctor who has zero interest in love. His wife left him for another man and since then he has been single-handedly raising his daughter Aliya. Jannat is a passionate and aggressive feminist, who writes for a newspaper by day and is an anonymous blogger by night. Bano is a calm and sensitive musician, who aspires to break the restrictions placed upon her by the society. Amal is a beautiful but hyperactive and rude girl who aspires to become an actress.

episodesList.title: The Mirza Girls
episodesList.summary: Meet the Mirza sisters, Meher, Jannat, Bahira, and Amal, as they give you a peek into Kashmir, beyond its beautiful valleys, politics, and curfew.

episodesList.title: The Imperfect Affair
episodesList.summary: When you love alone, the consequences are far too many. The Mirza family will learn this the hard way.

episodesList.title: Blogs for Dogs
episodesList.summary: Jannat Mirza writes a blog. She thinks her writing is helping Kashmiri society, but her family doesn’t think so, as a lot of people are unhappy. How will the family survive this storm?

episodesList.title: Jashn!
episodesList.summary: It is Tabish’s birthday and he throws a party. The Mirzas are invited. Bahira Mirza debuts as a singer and enthralls the guests.

episodesList.title: Gone Viral
episodesList.summary: Bahira’s music is a ray of happiness for the Mirza family. It’s the beginning of a new journey for Jashn.

episodesList.title: Fans and Fanatics
episodesList.summary: Many in Kashmir find the sounds of Bahira’s band, Jashn, intolerable. How will Jashn survive his opposition?

episodesList.title: Stuck Between Heaven And Hell
episodesList.summary: Jashn is set for their first-ever concert. But they are forced to flee even before they begin.

episodesList.title: Main Kashmir Hoon
episodesList.summary: The turmoil is rising all around the Mirzas. The unrest has significantly touched the lives of Bahira and Jannat.

episodesList.title: Conflict Zones
episodesList.summary: Journalism that offends gets it right. Jannat Mirza’s blog finds support as well as opposition all over Kashmir. There is a new guest in town, what will he bring with him? Trouble or hope?

episodesList.title: Of Hope And Fatwas
episodesList.summary: The new guest in town impresses everyone except Tabish. Dr. Naushad does everything to save his daughter.

episodesList.title: Surgical Strike
episodesList.summary: Maulwi Mohammad Altaaf agrees to speak to Jannat and Raghu. How will he justify his declaration of Fatwa on Bano?

episodesList.title: Accidental Coincidences
episodesList.summary: Jannat is lovesick, but Amal is jealous. Bahira is hopeful and so is Tabish.  On the other hand, rumours and gossip surround Meher and Dr. Naushad.

episodesList.title: Waqt-e-Sehar
episodesList.summary: At the Iftar gathering, an ugly confrontation takes place between Jannat, Tabish, and Raghu. Is this the end of Jannat and Tabish’s friendship?

episodesList.title: Too Close For Comfort
episodesList.summary: An invitation, an unfortunate incident, and few broken hearts. This Iftar will be remembered for all the right reasons, but also for a few wrong ones.

episodesList.title: Straight To Hell
episodesList.summary: In her pursuit of truth, Jannat fears losing Raghu, who doesn’t want to be in Kashmir anymore. With a hopeful eye on the future, Meher struggles to handle her past.

episodesList.title: Hide and Seek
episodesList.summary: Meher is not alone, as her sisters stand by her. Whatever happened to Meher has a deep impact on Amal. What does the future hold for Mirza sisters?

episodesList.title: Aakhri Aafreen
episodesList.summary: The Mirza sisters choose silence over justice. It’s suffocating but brings a semblance of peace. But for how long?

episodesList.title: Breathless
episodesList.summary: Some new ties are formed while the old ones break apart. A scandal breaks and divides Naushad and Meher even before they could come any closer.

episodesList.title: Alvida
episodesList.summary: With the declaration of a curfew, Amal and Bahira go missing. What ensues is a desperate search for lost hopes and dreams.

episodesList.title: Season Finale: End Of The Beginning
episodesList.summary: The Mirzas lose a part of themselves to Kashmir and its complications. What remain are just memories of a serene past. For the Mirzas, life in Kashmir will never be the same again.

title: Hum To Tere Aashiq Hai
summary: Hum To Tere Aashiq Hai (Devanagari: हम तो तेरे आशिक हैं; translation: We Are Your Lovers) is an Indian Marathi television-language comedy television series which aired on Zee Marathi from 8 November 2017 to 12 September 2018 in a total of 156 episodes. It is directed by Ajay Mayekar and produced by Shaurya Creations. The series stars Pushkar Shrotri, Madhavi Nimkar, Prasad Oak, and Dipti Samel Ketkar in lead roles. The story is heavily inspired by the premise of the popular Hindi series Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!.
plot:
The plot of Hum To Tere Aashiq Hai is a light-hearted situational comedy which revolves around the lives of two neighbouring couples residing in "Tanak Was" (originally "Patankar Niwas"), a fictional housing society in Thane. The husbands, Pushkar "Pushki" Gupte (Pushkar Shrotri) and Sangram Waghmare (Prasad Oak), are both polar opposites in personality and have long been married to Shalini "Shalu" (Madhavi Nimkar) and Kaveri (Dipti Samel Ketkar), respectively. The central hook of the series is that Pushki and Sangram are both bored with their respective domestic lives and thus harbour a secret infatuation with each other's wives. In their endeavour to follow the "love thy neighbour" concept, Pushki is constantly making every effort possible to impress Kaveri, while Sangram is always searching for ways to grow close to Shalu.
In the hilarious character dynamics, Sangram is a successful businessman for fruits and vegetables. He is often portrayed as a bit more boisterous, short-tempered, greedy, and "desi" young man. Often referred to as "Bhajivikya" (a slang term for someone who sells vegetables), Sangram spends most of his time managing his business. In contrast, Kaveri is a simple, traditional, gullible, and grounded young housewife. On the other hand, Pushki is the successful, sophisticated vice president of a cosmetics company. He is a significant breadwinner of the family, but is generally a more idle, soft-spoken, and egoistic young man. Often referred to as "Nalya" (a slang term for being idle), Pushki spends most of his time performing household chores. In contrast, Shalu is a glamorous, headstrong, intelligent, modern, and elegant young woman. She is passionate about running zumba classes and disapproves of her husband's laziness and ego.
The houses of both the couples are located opposite one another, and much of the plot unfolds in their respective homes. The series is filled with comedy of errors, and most episodes follow a similar pattern where one of the husbands hatches a clumsy scheme or tells a lie to either spend time with his neighbour's wife or to look like a "hero" in her eyes. Meanwhile, the other husband usually has a suspicion or tries to undermine his neighbour with his own scheme. Nevertheless, the schemes of both Pushki and Sangram unavoidably backfire, leading to public embarrassment, family misunderstandings, and slapstick humour. Despite the wandering eyes of both the husbands, the series maintains a family-friendly tone, focusing on the harmless, silly nature of Pushki and Sangram's main rivalry rather than anything serious.

title: Haasil
summary:
Haasil (trans Achievement) is an Indian drama television series broadcast by Sony Entertainment Television and produced by Siddhartha P. Malhotra under the banner of Alchemy Productions. The series ran from 30 October 2017 to 23 February 2018.
Actor Zayed Khan makes his television debut with this show. The show also stars Nikita Dutta and Vatsal Sheth.
plot:
Haasil is the story of two brothers Ranvir and Kabir Raichand, whose lives get entwined with the entry of a smart and righteous lawyer, Aanchal Shrivastav.
The Raichands are a rich and influential family where the husband Jatin Raichand is often sidelined by his wife, Sarika. Their sons Ranvir and Kabir mean the world to them. Ranvir—the older brother—is a rational, generous, and selfless tycoon while Kabir is the opposite—protective of his loved ones (especially his brother) but a playboy.
Meanwhile, Aanchal hails from a middle-class background. Her family comprises her mother Rupali and younger brother Aman. She lost her father at a young age. She runs an NGO and takes up a case of a kidnap & murder victim, who turns out to be Ranvir's secretary. She assumes him to be guilty and has him arrested. The Raichands, except Ranvir, develop an instant dislike for Aanchal. As the case proceeds, the victim is murdered. However, Kabir brings evidence into the court, implicating the victim's boyfriend, who teamed up with her to con the Raichands for money. Ranvir is immediately released and Aanchal apologises but Kabir vows revenge on Aanchal.
Initial misunderstandings are cleared up and Ranvir hires Aanchal to work for their company where she rubs off his cousin, Gaurav, the wrong way. Ranvir falls in love with Aanchal but Kabir woos her to exact revenge not knowing that Ranvir loves her. Aman is suspicious of Kabir. Later, it is revealed that Kabir planned to lead Aanchal on and dump her right before their wedding to humiliate her. However, Kabir genuinely falls in love with Aanchal. Aanchal too falls in love after seeing a different hidden, caring side to him. Sarika doesn't approve, because Aanchal's horoscope says that her first husband will die soon. She wants Kabir to marry Naina, his childhood friend but Ranvir is shown taking Kabir's side and supporting Kabir and Anchal's love by going against Sarika.
When Aanchal is shot at, Kabir takes the bullet for her. It is revealed that the bullet was shot by Gaurav, who was acting on the instructions of Sarika. Naina also has an ulterior motive because she wants Kabir's money to repay the debts incurred by her brother Rohan. Meanwhile, Ranvir is diagnosed with a brain tumor. He suggests that Aanchal marry him first so that the prediction of her first husband's death is fulfilled and she and Kabir can live happily ever after.
But Ranvir is the master manipulator—he bribed the family priest (pandit) to make the false prediction, manipulated Gaurav and then killed him, and then faked a brain tumor—all for Aanchal. He even hands over his title as CEO to Kabir. Aanchal and Ranvir, meanwhile, are still married and an upset Kabir blames Aanchal, accusing her of loving a loser and marrying the winner. Jatin reveals to Aanchal that neither Ranvir nor Kabir are Sarika's biological children. Kabir was his son with his first wife who died. He then married Sarika and they adopted Ranvir.
When Ranvir realizes Aanchal and Kabir still love each other, he bribes Naina and Rohan by paying off Rohan's debts. He makes Naina fake a pregnancy so Aanchal and Sarika would insist on Kabir marrying Naina. Kabir knows Naina is lying and since it is too early for a paternity test, he digs into Naina's past and finds David, a musician whose child she aborted because she wanted to trap Kabir. David and Kabir team up.
Ranvir notices Aman is suspicious of the drama surrounding Aanchal (who now trusts Kabir but not Ranvir) and tries to get him out of the way, by secretly helping him land a dream job in Dubai. Aman teams up with Kabir to look for evidence against Naina which reveals nothing, although everybody knows about the fake pregnancy. Ranvir threatens Naina and Rohan to leave the city and they do so. Ranvir confesses his love to Aanchal. Kabir then brings an American surgeon to operate on Ranvir. Ranvir manages to fake his way through the operation and is released from the hospital after an apparently successful surgery. Kabir and Aanchal decide to wait until Ranvir has recovered to get a divorce.
A month later, Ranvir and Aanchal are still married and Kabir is insecure. Aman has left for Dubai. After Kabir asks his brother to let Aanchal go, he finds out that Ranvir is planning to move to Mauritius forever. Upon confrontation, Ranvir remains cryptic. However, he makes sure that Kabir follows him and sees a house which Ranvir has turned into a shrine of Aanchal—her pictures are everywhere and Kabir realizes that Ranvir has always loved her. Kabir decides to sacrifice his love. He forces himself on Aanchal in an attempt to get her to hate him and choose Ranvir. Aanchal is mortified. Kabir's misconduct is shunned by everyone. His father asks him to leave the house, all the while knowing the reasons for Kabir's actions and keeping them hidden from Sarika.
With Kabir and Aman gone, Ranvir goes a step further in his conquest for Aanchal's love. He bribes a worker to add rat poison in the food catered by Aanchal's mother, Rupali. A crowd gathers to confront Rupali since people are critically ill after eating the food. She is publicly shamed. Ranvir is watching all this and decides to enter once they attack Aanchal. But as it turns out Kabir has seen this news and doesn't board his flight to Mauritius but instead goes to rescue Rupali and Aanchal. Despite this the police arrest Rupali and Ranvir takes the blame for her, since her health is deteriorating. He manages to manipulate the situation and put the blame on Rohan. Aanchal is grateful to him.
However, she realizes that Kabir may have intentionally led her to hate him, and confronts him. Aanchal decides to stay on as Ranvir's wife, since Kabir threatens to kill himself otherwise. Sarika is unhappy and it is revealed that she killed Kabir's mother by pushing her off the terrace years ago, in order to become part of the Raichand family. She had been scheming from the beginning. She tries to bring Aanchal and Kabir closer to provoke Ranvir. Ranvir is on the edge and when Jatin learns his truth, Ranvir kills him and makes it look like suicide. When Ranvir doesn't let Aanchal take the body for post-mortem, she investigates and is convinced that he is the murderer. Ranvir threatens her too and she waits for an opportunity. Rohan tries to communicate with Aanchal at Jatin's funeral but Ranvir kills him before they team up. Aanchal then fakes a suicide attempt and Kabir gets to her before Ranvir and takes her to the hospital. Ranvir threatens to endanger Aman (who is back in Mumbai) and Rupali when Aanchal pulls a stunt to make him jealous—resulting in a crowd witnessing Ranvir's madness as he relentlessly beats up Aanchal's comrade. Kabir still refuses to believe Aanchal's claims about Ranvir.
Aanchal poisons Ranvir's drink but he reveals that he has the antidote and instead poisoned Kabir. Ranvir reveals his true colours to Kabir and Aanchal takes him to the hospital when blood comes out of his mouth. Upon reaching the hospital, Aanchal and Kabir are attacked by Ranvir's goons and beat Kabir. Ranvir arrives and locks him up in a hut and burns it in front of Aanchal. Aanchal tempts to commit suicide by smashing her head in a temple. Ranvir prays for Aanchal's recovery but the temple priest reveals that Ranvir never understood the true meaning of love and that Aanchal had prayed to put an end to Ranvir's plans and to kill him. Ranvir realizes his mistakes and finds that Aanchal has gotten herself into deep shock (mistaking Ranvir for Kabir after his apparent death). Ranvir must play along to think that he is Kabir. Ranvir takes Aanchal home and reveals to Sarika that he killed Kabir even though he now regrets it. This shocks Sarika. In a turn of events, it is revealed she was only after money, caring neither about Jatin or Kabir. She scolds Ranvir for killing Kabir, as Jatin had left everything to him in the will. Ranvir is her biological son whom she left at an orphanage so she could come back to get him when she became a Raichand. Ranvir knew the truth all along and claimed that she is responsible for who he is today.
Kabir, who is alive shows up in Aanchal's room and comforts her. He then vows to get revenge on Ranvir. Aanchal, Kabir, Aman and Rupali are all in on the plan. Kabir threatens Dr Agnihotri, bribes everyone working for Ranvir and they all turn to be on his side. Dr Agnihotri informs Sarika that Aanchal (who is faking her mental state) must go to rehab.
It was revealed that Kabir was never poisoned and Aman dug a hole outside the hut and rescued Kabir. Sarika looks up to a man named Roy who her husband orders to kill Aanchal but Roy is actually working with Kabir and Aanchal. Roy holds Aanchal by gunpoint and reveals to Ranvir that he is his biological father. Ranvir kicks Sarika out of the Raichand house because of her wrongdoings over the years and severs ties with her. Kabir asks Sarika to reveal his plan to end Ranvir's game to him. Sarika tells Ranvir that Kabir and Aanchal have played him all along and Aanchal is chased by Ranvir in the forest. Kabir intervenes and goes face to face with Ranvir. They have a fight and Ranvir takes a shot at Kabir but Aanchal takes the bullet and dies in Ranvir's arms. Ranvir goes into shock and Aman brings the police in. Aanchal regains her consciousness and recalls taking help from Dr. Agnihotri to slow down her heartbeat and breathing and replacing the bullets in Ranvir's gun by blanks.
The show takes a one-month leap forward and newly-weds Kabir and Aanchal arrive in front of a Mental Healthcare Centre to see Ranvir who is busy writing 'I love you Aanchal' with his blood. Kabir and Aanchal grow sad upon learning that Ranvir will never improve. As the happy couple leave the centre, the last shot is of Ranvir, looking sinisterly at them, implying that he is pretending to be in a mental state.
reception: Initially, the show was in the news for its larger than life look and a huge budget including the fact that it was the first Indian television show being shot only at outdoor locations. First week reviews were mixed with Zayed Khan's performance 'failing to impress' according to one review that appeared in national daily The Times of India. Another review on Bollywood Life praised actress Nikita Dutta's performance and claimed that in the first episode, she outshone both male leads.
