episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Ranvir Raichand is worshiped by his employees. On his birthday, he is giving a huge bonus to his employees, who are delighted to see Ranvir, a messiah for them. As usual, Kabir is running late. Meanwhile, Aanchal leaves home for work but gets a call from her aunt. How will the lives of these three get intertwined?

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Ranvir is taken into police custody and an interrogation takes place. The medical report proves beyond doubt that the woman, whom Ranvir is accused of molesting, was raped. Sarika Raichand visits Anchal’s house and warns her mother not to against Ranvir. Anchal’s mother does not take this lightly and informs her that Anchal is not the one to give up so easily.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Ananya is shocked that Kabir has brought her miles away from home. Kabir leaves her stranded and leaves. He also makes sure that Neelu never sees the light of the day. Ranvir gets bail and holds a press conference to prove his innocence. At the press conference, Ananya’s mother claims that the Raichand family has kidnapped her daughter.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Anchal is surprised to know that she is being released on bail. She arrives at Raichand house to question Ranvir, who asks her to change her point of view to crack the case. Anchal visits the crime scene and breaks into a coffee shop to check the CCTV footage. With the help of the footage, Anchal believes she can catch Meenu’s murderer. Will Anchal be able to achieve her intended task?

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: The media questions Anchal whether Ranvir is guilty of murder or not. Anchal is still firm on her point that he is the killer. Anchal gets ready to fight the case in the court and gets the support of her mother. Will Anchal win the case against the Raichand’s?

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: Anchal is contemplating about the threat received from Kabir and Ranvir. Then, she runs into Kabir, who informs her that he has filed a defamation case against her. He also gives her the notice of eviction. What will be Anchal’s next step?

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: Kabir attempts to make sure Anchal leaves her house but gets a befitting reply. Then, Anchal arrives at Raichand house. Ranvir offers her a job and asks her to head his company’s legal department. Will Anchal accept his job proposal?

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: Ranvir arrives at Anchal’s house and takes her on a business trip to Mauritius. Kabir is not pleased that his big brother is going along well with Anchal. While Anchal is on a business trip, Dharamchand Malik meets with an accident and breathes his last. Will Anchal be able to uncover the truth now?

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Anchal is contemplating her decision to come on a business trip with Ranvir. She suspects that Ranvir might want to kill her. Later, Kabir too arrives, leaving Anchal bothered. Kabir then informs Anchal that she might want to think of her brother’s safety.

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: Anchal wants Kabir to leave her alone but he refuses to do so. She decides to leave and feels that she has broken Ranvir’s trust. But, as she is driven to the airport, Anchal panics. Will Anchal learn truth that she sought to unravel? Watch and find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: Kabir threatens Anchal and gets into an argument with her. Anchal seeks an apology from Ranvir. Then, when all is well between her and Kabir, she goes scuba diving with him. Due to faulty mechanics, Anchal loses oxygen and passes out. Will Kabir be able to save Anchal?

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Anchal is no longer wary of Kabir and Ranvir. While one is trying to woo her, the other is keeping an eye on her. Ranvir is in two minds as he knows that Kabir will interfere between him and Anchal. When Kabir informs Ranvir that they have shared everything in life, Ranvir is a bit surprised. What happens next watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Anchal breaks down in tears after remembering about her father. She finds solace in Ranvir’s company who pacifies her. But, unknown to Anchal, her brother has been confined by a gang. What happens next watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Anchal informs her mother that she feels that Ranvir was wrongly accused in the molestation case. Then, she decides to go out with Kabir and a few men attack her. She pleads for help from Kabir but he refuses. Who will save Anchal now?

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: Anchal informs her brother about the events that conspired between her and Kabir. Meanwhile, Kabir decides to go to office along with Anchal. At the office, Anchal’s colleague tries to molest her. What happens when Kabir finds out about it?

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: Anchal stops Kabir from beating his brother. Meanwhile, Ranvir has decided to propose to Anchal. But, Kabir too wants to make Anchal fall in love with him in order to exact revenge. What happens next, watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Anchal is contemplating about Kabir’s proposal. Her mother’s words help Anchal to be confident before Kabir. Unknown to Anchal, Ranvir also likes her whereas Kabir is merely playing a game. What happens next, watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: Kabir waits for Aanchal on his said spot and Ranvir waits for her in restaurant eagerly. Aanchal calls Kabir and says she cannot come as she has some important work in the office. He requests her to come but she refuses. Aanchal calls Ranvir and says she is on the way. But later she has a change of heart and diverts her car to Kabir. Kabir proposes to Anchal and she says yes. How will Ranvir react when he finds out that Anchal is the girl Kabir loves. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: Aman storms on Aanchal after hearing she accepted Kabir’s love saying Kabir is a goon and not a nice guy. Aanchal tries to make him understand but Aman continues arguing. Ranvir confronts Kabir about Aanchal and why is he playing with her heart. Kabir says that he actually loves Aanchal and she is different. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: Ranvir scolds Sarika as to why did she walk home barefoot all the way from the temple. Kabir is in a spa with Naina romancing him. She asks him if he felt bad about yesterday’s event. Vikram gives his resignation to Sarika and says he cannot continue anymore as Ranvir and Kabir insulted him a lot for Aanchal. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Aanchal with her family walks into Raichand house on Sarika’s invitation. Sarika asks Rajguru to check Aanchal and Kabir’s kundali and fix marriage date. Guruji checks kundalis and says kundalis are fine, but Aanchal’s first husband will die soon. Anchal is upset with what Guruji said. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Kabir warns Guruji by hanging him on the edge of the mountain. Meanwhile, Aanchal gives an envelop to Ranvir and he throws it thinking it is Aanchal's resignation. Aanchal tells that the envelop was the papers of Mauritius deal. Will Aanchal find out Kabir's real face? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: Aanchal rushes to Kabir’s cabin and searches him. Kabir comes under a table and asks if she was in Marigold Hotel. Sarika with family reaches Aanchal’s house for Kabir and Aanchal’s engagement. Neha’s boyfriend calls Aanchal and asks if she forgave Kabeer so soon. She asks to turn behind. He sees Aanchal, Ranvir, and Kabir surrounding him and attacks them with a knife. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: Anchal confronts Kabir and throws his intimate pictures with Naina. Kabir is shocked and furious at the fact that someone dared to mess with him. He runs behind Anchal to her house. Aman slaps him in the face and Anchal's mom tells him to leave them alone. Kabir watches the news of Anchal dumping him on the TV. He decides to take revenge when his ego is hurt. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: Ranvir arrives in the nick of time and saves Kabir’s life. But, in the process, he gets stabbed by the assailant. As the threat is neutralized by Ranvir he ends up risking his life for his brother. What will be the consequences of this event on Ranvir, Anchal, and Kabir?

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: Kabir, through his heroic act of saving some school children from a school fire, is successful in making a positive image in front of Aanchal. Aanchal is proud of him and says to him that he has the ability to become better than Ranvir to which Kabir is happy to listen to. Aman decides to break the FD of his studies to maintain the expenses of Aanchal's wedding to Kabir to maintain the repo with Raichand family. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: Ranvir falls unconscious. The doctor informs the family embers that he will recover soon. Then, as Anchal gets busy planning her wedding, a new twist comes knocking.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Kabir realized that the thing that started as a revenge on his brother has now turned into true love for Aanchal and tells this to Ranvir who is shocked at the revelation. Kabir goes to Aanchal's house to meet her but she is not there. Aanchal goes to meet someone who shows her a video which shocks her to the core. Later she comes to Kabir's house to confront him. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: Kabir is upset that Anchal has left him. Kabir finds solace in his brother and mother’s company. The next day, he holds a press conference and accuses Anchal of leaving him. What will be Anchal’s reaction?

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: Kabir’s mother decides to bring an end to Anchal’s life. Meanwhile, Kabir meets Anchal in a bid to win her over, unaware of the death that looms over her head. Kabir spots a man trying to shoot at Anchal and averts the tragedy. In the process, he ends up getting shot by the killer.

episodesList.title: Episode 31
episodesList.summary: Ranivr informs the police to follow up any leads informed by Anchal. The doctor informs Ranvir that Kabir’s condition is critical. Anchal visits Kabir and tries to bring him out of sleep. Will Kabir recover?

episodesList.title: Episode 32
episodesList.summary: Anchal and Kabir speak on the phone and during the conversation, Kabir asks Anchal to meet him. But, Anchal insists that Kabir should avoid her. Ranvir is informed by the police that Gaurav is the one who shot Kabir. Then, the police find Gaurav’s dead body. Who has killed Gaurav?

episodesList.title: Episode 33
episodesList.summary: Kabir is taken by the police in the case of Gaurav's murder. Kabir swears to Aanchal that he had nothing to do with Gaurav's murder and even gives his pistol to the police for inspection. Police take him to the police station for further inspection. Ranvir is worried for Kabir and promises him to get the best lawyer to save him. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 34
episodesList.summary: As the priest said after reading Aanchal's kundali that the man who will marry Aanchal will not survive for long, Ranvir proposes Aanchal to marry him so that he dies and his brother Kabir can have a happy life with Aanchal. Kabir tells him that he doesn't need any happiness which will cost him his brother's life. In the midst of all the chaos, Ranvir tries to kill himself. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 35
episodesList.summary: Ranvir tells Sarika that he couldn’t fulfill the promise which he made to them that he will never let tears come in their eyes, and that’s why he wants to fulfill his other promise made to Kabir. He says it was his dream to marry Aanchal for Kabir and asks her to agree. Sarika says I understand your every move and says you are trying to convince me, but I will never be happy and says whenever she will see Aanchal, she will hold her responsible for his death. She says although you all have accepted this, she will find the treatment for this disease. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 36
episodesList.summary: Ranvir thinks about Aanchal and recalls the moments with her. He thinks their destination is same and nobody can separate them now. Kabir says I can’t see you becoming someone else’s wife and can’t attend your wedding tomorrow. Aanchal holds his hand and says your love and Ranvir’s friendship is everything. Will Kabir attend Anchal's wedding?

episodesList.title: Episode 37
episodesList.summary: Ranvir slaps Aanchal and then tells her sorry, says he came to give her car keys. He says someone is stuck on her forehead and wipes it off like applying vermillion. He tells her that he will take her to Kabir. Once they reach there, Ranvir tells Kabir that since childhood he thought to do something for Raichand family and today I got the chance. He says sorry to Aanchal and asks her to go back to her mum’s house, as the dosh is gone and her kundali is getting her first husband’s life. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 38
episodesList.summary: Ranvir thanks Sarika for doing the rituals. Kabir gets upset and goes. Aanchal calls his name. Ranvir asks her to let him go and face the pain. He asks why she is making an upset face and asks if she thinks he masterminds everything to bring her to the room. If she is worried about the wedding night. Aanchal says no. Ranvir says he is shifting to the guest room. Aanchal thanks him. He acts crazily looking at her pics all around in the room. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 39
episodesList.summary: Kabir gets angry at an investor. Aanchal tells Kabir to handle his anger and asks him to see Ranvir and says he handles everything calmly. Kabir says I am not Ranvir. Aanchal says then you have to make yourself as Ranvir. Kabir asks does she think that he is a loser and tells that he can’t do anything being helpless.

episodesList.title: Episode 40
episodesList.summary: Kabir shouts saying Naina is lying. Ranvir tries to control his anger. Aanchal doubts on Kabir and asks him to take responsibility for his actions. She says reports can’t be wrong, you have slept with her. Kabir says this is not possible. Aanchal asks him to find the solution. Ranvir smirks. Rohan shouts Kabir’s name and protests against him. Sarika gets worried about their reputation. Ranvir tells Rohan that he will give the name to the baby. Later he tells Kabir and Aanchal that he can’t let the baby live in an orphanage. Kabir says this baby is not mine. Aanchal tells him that Kabir has to take up the responsibility. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 41
episodesList.summary: The doctor informs Kabir it's his child that Naina is carrying which pisses off Aanchal even more. Kabir asks Aanchal to make some place for Naina in the house and hugs her. Ranvir tells Aanchal that you can’t go anywhere and says this is said by a husband, your husband. Ranvir consoles Aanchal. Aanchal decides to tell Kabir everything about Ranvir's feelings for her. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Ranvir gets intimate with Aanchal. Ranvir comes closer to Aanchal as she is sleeping. Aanchal wakes up and Ranvir acts and tells her that he always loved her. Kabir asks Aanchal what she is hiding from him. Aanchal says I don’t know what to do. Kabir asks her to trust him. The lawyer tells that he will get a court date for marriage. Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 43
episodesList.summary: Aanchal turns, just as Kabir is about to kiss her. She cries and says if this is the proof of love then the love is fake. Kabir says my love wants you, just you. Aanchal says I love you and will always love you, but can’t be with you, you have to marry Naina as she is carrying your baby. Kabir says if you don’t trust me then there is no love. He says he will fall low. Rupali tells Aman that they shall go to Aanchal’s house on dinner.

episodesList.title: Episode 44
episodesList.summary: Sarika asks Kabir that why is he talking sadly. Ranvir tells him to focus on Naina and marriage. Kabir says baby’s image is blurred in ultrasound, but soon it will be clear. Kabir tells Naina that he came to ask her to plan to go on a honeymoon, South America, trekking. Meanwhile, Phone rings and stops. Watch the full episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Episode 45
episodesList.summary: David asks Naina to give his baby. Naina tells him that she cannot give his baby at the moment as he has to stay for nine months which is impossible. David tells that if he cannot have his baby then Naina should die. Naina confesses that she is not pregnant and it was just a plan to marry Kabir.

episodesList.title: Episode 46
episodesList.summary: Anchal is relived that Kabir is alive. Kabir suspects that Anchal’s secret admirer is trying to kill him in a bid to get close to her. He is unaware that his own brother, Ranvir, is the one who is behind this. Meanwhile, Ranvir is rushed to the hospital, as he once again fakes illness. What happens next, watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 47
episodesList.summary: Ranvir is afraid that the web of lies he has weaved will be known by Anchal and Kabir. He makes another attempt to further his motives by plotting a fake operation. During the operation, Ranvir is pronounced dead. His family members and Anchal break down in tears. Is Ranvir dead?

episodesList.title: Episode 48
episodesList.summary: Ranveer is brought home after his surgery. But Aanchal wants to divorce him. Will she? Find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 49
episodesList.summary: Aanchal is fasting for Ranveer during Karva Chauth. Kabir is not happy.

episodesList.title: Episode 50
episodesList.summary: Kabir follows Ranveer to a house. He follows Ranveer inside and finds the house plastered with photos of Aanchal.

episodesList.title: Episode 51
episodesList.summary: Aanchal is worried about Kabir. Kabir has a cryptic conversation with Ranveer. Ranveer isn't able to figure out what Kabir is planning.

episodesList.title: Episode 52
episodesList.summary: Kabir insults Aanchal. Which infuriates Ranveer. Kabir and Ranveer get in a fight. While Aanchal thinks that Kabir has betrayed her.

episodesList.title: Episode 53
episodesList.summary: Aanchal comes to know that the delivery boy was an impostor. She is afraid that if anyone eats the food, they could die. Will she be able to warn those at the party? Find out.

episodesList.title: Episode 54
episodesList.summary: Aanchal goes to see Mrs. Raichand. Aanchal implores her to release her mother. Aanchals mother needs to be taken to a hospital.

episodesList.title: Episode 55
episodesList.summary: Aanchal invites Kabir to a secluded spot. Where she tries to seduce him into having his way with her. But he stops her. Aanchal tells him that as long as she is alive, she will only love him.

episodesList.title: Episode 56
episodesList.summary: Ranveer is going mad over Aanchal. Aanchal arrives as his bride, but she is stil lhesitant. It is revealed how in the past Kabir and Ranveer's mother had commited murder.

episodesList.title: Episode 57
episodesList.summary: Anchal suspects that Ranvir might have come to the temple. When he arrives home, she questions him about it. Ranvir wants Anchal to reciprocate his love but when she does not, he decides to hurt Kabir.

episodesList.title: Episode 58
episodesList.summary: Kabir tells Ranvir that Aanchal stopped him from going to Mauritius as she doesn't want us brothers to separate. Ranvir plans to hurts Kabir as Aanchal witnesses the act.

episodesList.title: Episode 59
episodesList.summary: Ranvir is starting to lose his mind. Jatin confronts the doctor and comes to know about Ranvir faking his tumor to marry Aanchal. Jatin forces Ranvir to tell Aanchal the truth and ask for forgiveness himself before he does.

episodesList.title: Episode 60
episodesList.summary: Ranvir takes Jatin back to the farmhouse. Jatin tells that he has gone mad. Aanchal reads the message and asks Kabir to take her to farmhouse. Ranvir ties Jatin with hope and says that he is his strength. He apologizes to him and asks him to forget everything. He says we will make a fresh start. Jatin says Aanchal will never love you. Ranvir pulls him and says she will love me, needs some time.

episodesList.title: Episode 61
episodesList.summary: Aanchal tries to stop Ranveer from taking dad's body. But his followers restrain her and threaten to burn down the ambulance. She gives him the keys.

episodesList.title: Episode 62
episodesList.summary: Ranvir calls up Anchal and asks her to come to a secluded spot. Anchal meets Ranvir in an under-construction building. Ranvir expresses his undying obsessive love towards Anchal but she does not reciprocate. He informs Anchal that Kabir is missing. Anchal takes a vow to find Kabir at any cost.

episodesList.title: Episode 63
episodesList.summary: Aanchal asks Ranveer to tell her where Kabir is. Ranveer asks her to love him. He tells her that he will giver her the world.

episodesList.title: Episode 64
episodesList.summary: Aanchal tells Kabir that she has proof that Kabir's father was murdered. She calls the police. She tells them to check the car. When the police open the trunk of the car a bomb explodes.

episodesList.title: Episode 65
episodesList.summary: Kabir's father's funeral services are in progress. The security is tight.  A hooded man is seen trying to smuggle in a gun.

episodesList.title: Episode 66
episodesList.summary: Aanchal and Kabir run into each other. They go their separate ways. But Aanchal soon finds herself in darkness. She finds a drawing on a wall that tells her to go to the basement of the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 67
episodesList.summary: Aanchal tries to walk off the top of a building. Kabir sees her and runs to save her. It is revealed that Aanchal is trying to beat Ranveer at his own game.

episodesList.title: Episode 68
episodesList.summary: Kabir cries and asks Aanchal to free him from the promise he made as he can’t see her with Ranvir. Aanchal says she will free him from the promise that night.

episodesList.title: Episode 69
episodesList.summary: Kabir regrets loving Aanchal after Ranvir is successful with his plan of turning Kabir against Aanchal. Kabir is devastated and pushes Aanchal away and storms off. Ranvir comes there and mocks Aanchal that he has finally ruined her relationship with Kabir.

episodesList.title: Episode 70
episodesList.summary: Anchal wants to find some clues which will prove crucial evidence against Ranvir. Later, Ranvir, Anchal, and Kabir attend a party where a stranger tries to dance with Anchal. Seeing this, Ranvir is enraged and beats up the stranger.

episodesList.title: Episode 71
episodesList.summary: Ranvir is humiliated by Aanchal in front of so many people. Aanchal mocks him after coming back from the party. Ranvir wants revenge so he sends goons to kill Aman at his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 72
episodesList.summary: Aanchal decides to take revenge from Ranvir for making her life miserable by killing him. Aanchal thinks that Ranvir wants her so badly that one of them has to die to end the story so she poisons his drink.

episodesList.title: Episode 73
episodesList.summary: Sarika asks Ranvir to give her Rs.10 crores. Anchal makes a drink for Ranvir and adds poison in it which makes Ranvir drunk and falls down and faints.

episodesList.title: Episode 74
episodesList.summary: Ranvir poison's Kabir by adding a tablet in his drink. Blood starts coming out from his mouth and Ranvir confesses everything to him as to how he killed everyone who came in his way. Aanchal asks mercy for Kabir and begs Ranvir to save him.

episodesList.title: Episode 75
episodesList.summary: In a state of shock, Anchal runs away from Ranvir and comes to a temple. She pleads before the gods to bring back Kabir. When Ranvir arrives, Anchal is profusely bleeding and he takes her to the hospital and threatens the doctor to treat her urgently.

episodesList.title: Episode 76
episodesList.summary: After Aanchal saw Kabir burnt alive by Ranvir, she loses her sane. She is admitted to the hospital after she hit her head. Police come to take her statement on the whereabouts of Kabir. She starts saying something and walk towards Ranvir and then faints.

episodesList.title: Episode 77
episodesList.summary: Ranvir brings Aachal home after she lost her memory. Aachal thinks Ranvir is Kabir and tells him not to hate Ranvir as love is blind and can happen to anyone. Ranvir regrets killing his brother as Aachal is still in love with Kabir. Ranvir tells his mother, Sagarika that he killed Kabir and Sagarika is shocked.

episodesList.title: Episode 78
episodesList.summary: Kabir's death was all planned by Kabir and Aanchal themselves to bring out the Ranvir's real face. Kabir comes to meet Aanchal and hugs her. They explain how step by step they made Ranvir believe that everything was going by his plans. Ranvir threatens Sagarika that she will kill her if she ever told anyone about Kabir.

episodesList.title: Episode 79
episodesList.summary: Aanchal acts as if she is losing her mind when she writes a message for Kabir on the wall with paint and talks to herself. When Ranvir walks in and sees her, she acts insane and crazy so that Ranvir believe that she is actually losing her sane and needs a doctor. Kabir adds Dr. Agnihotri in his plans.

episodesList.title: Episode 80
episodesList.summary: Ranvir drops Anchal and informs the guards to keep him informed about Anchal’s every move. Anchal meets Kabir, who is in a disguise. Kabir informs Anchal that they will escape. But, Anchal is not sure as Ranvir knows her every move. Will Anchal be able to escape with Kabir?

episodesList.title: Episode 81
episodesList.summary: Ranvir decides to evict his mother from the house. In a state of shock, Ranvir’s mother leaves the house after being evicted. Then, Kabit meets her and reveals the plan he had to create to bring an end to Ranvir’s obsession. Meanwhile, Anchal decides to run away but Ranvir follows her. At the end of the pursuit, Ranvir comes face to face with Kabir.

episodesList.title: Episode 82
episodesList.summary: Ranvir and Kabir face-off and engage in a duel. By accident, Ranvir ends up shooting Anchal. He believes that he has killed Anchal and loses his mind. Is Anchal dead? Is this the end?

plotHtml:
Haasil is the story of two brothers Ranvir and Kabir Raichand, whose lives get entwined with the entry of a smart and righteous lawyer, Aanchal Shrivastav.
The Raichands are a rich and influential family where the husband Jatin Raichand is often sidelined by his wife, Sarika. Their sons Ranvir and Kabir mean the world to them. Ranvir—the older brother—is a rational, generous, and selfless tycoon while Kabir is the opposite—protective of his loved ones (especially his brother) but a playboy.
Meanwhile, Aanchal hails from a middle-class background. Her family comprises her mother Rupali and younger brother Aman. She lost her father at a young age. She runs an NGO and takes up a case of a kidnap & murder victim, who turns out to be Ranvir's secretary. She assumes him to be guilty and has him arrested. The Raichands, except Ranvir, develop an instant dislike for Aanchal. As the case proceeds, the victim is murdered. However, Kabir brings evidence into the court, implicating the victim's boyfriend, who teamed up with her to con the Raichands for money. Ranvir is immediately released and Aanchal apologises but Kabir vows revenge on Aanchal.
Initial misunderstandings are cleared up and Ranvir hires Aanchal to work for their company where she rubs off his cousin, Gaurav, the wrong way. Ranvir falls in love with Aanchal but Kabir woos her to exact revenge not knowing that Ranvir loves her. Aman is suspicious of Kabir. Later, it is revealed that Kabir planned to lead Aanchal on and dump her right before their wedding to humiliate her. However, Kabir genuinely falls in love with Aanchal. Aanchal too falls in love after seeing a different hidden, caring side to him. Sarika doesn't approve, because Aanchal's horoscope says that her first husband will die soon. She wants Kabir to marry Naina, his childhood friend but Ranvir is shown taking Kabir's side and supporting Kabir and Anchal's love by going against Sarika.
When Aanchal is shot at, Kabir takes the bullet for her. It is revealed that the bullet was shot by Gaurav, who was acting on the instructions of Sarika. Naina also has an ulterior motive because she wants Kabir's money to repay the debts incurred by her brother Rohan. Meanwhile, Ranvir is diagnosed with a brain tumor. He suggests that Aanchal marry him first so that the prediction of her first husband's death is fulfilled and she and Kabir can live happily ever after.
But Ranvir is the master manipulator—he bribed the family priest (pandit) to make the false prediction, manipulated Gaurav and then killed him, and then faked a brain tumor—all for Aanchal. He even hands over his title as CEO to Kabir. Aanchal and Ranvir, meanwhile, are still married and an upset Kabir blames Aanchal, accusing her of loving a loser and marrying the winner. Jatin reveals to Aanchal that neither Ranvir nor Kabir are Sarika's biological children. Kabir was his son with his first wife who died. He then married Sarika and they adopted Ranvir.
When Ranvir realizes Aanchal and Kabir still love each other, he bribes Naina and Rohan by paying off Rohan's debts. He makes Naina fake a pregnancy so Aanchal and Sarika would insist on Kabir marrying Naina. Kabir knows Naina is lying and since it is too early for a paternity test, he digs into Naina's past and finds David, a musician whose child she aborted because she wanted to trap Kabir. David and Kabir team up.
Ranvir notices Aman is suspicious of the drama surrounding Aanchal (who now trusts Kabir but not Ranvir) and tries to get him out of the way, by secretly helping him land a dream job in Dubai. Aman teams up with Kabir to look for evidence against Naina which reveals nothing, although everybody knows about the fake pregnancy. Ranvir threatens Naina and Rohan to leave the city and they do so. Ranvir confesses his love to Aanchal. Kabir then brings an American surgeon to operate on Ranvir. Ranvir manages to fake his way through the operation and is released from the hospital after an apparently successful surgery. Kabir and Aanchal decide to wait until Ranvir has recovered to get a divorce.
A month later, Ranvir and Aanchal are still married and Kabir is insecure. Aman has left for Dubai. After Kabir asks his brother to let Aanchal go, he finds out that Ranvir is planning to move to Mauritius forever. Upon confrontation, Ranvir remains cryptic. However, he makes sure that Kabir follows him and sees a house which Ranvir has turned into a shrine of Aanchal—her pictures are everywhere and Kabir realizes that Ranvir has always loved her. Kabir decides to sacrifice his love. He forces himself on Aanchal in an attempt to get her to hate him and choose Ranvir. Aanchal is mortified. Kabir's misconduct is shunned by everyone. His father asks him to leave the house, all the while knowing the reasons for Kabir's actions and keeping them hidden from Sarika.
With Kabir and Aman gone, Ranvir goes a step further in his conquest for Aanchal's love. He bribes a worker to add rat poison in the food catered by Aanchal's mother, Rupali. A crowd gathers to confront Rupali since people are critically ill after eating the food. She is publicly shamed. Ranvir is watching all this and decides to enter once they attack Aanchal. But as it turns out Kabir has seen this news and doesn't board his flight to Mauritius but instead goes to rescue Rupali and Aanchal. Despite this the police arrest Rupali and Ranvir takes the blame for her, since her health is deteriorating. He manages to manipulate the situation and put the blame on Rohan. Aanchal is grateful to him.
However, she realizes that Kabir may have intentionally led her to hate him, and confronts him. Aanchal decides to stay on as Ranvir's wife, since Kabir threatens to kill himself otherwise. Sarika is unhappy and it is revealed that she killed Kabir's mother by pushing her off the terrace years ago, in order to become part of the Raichand family. She had been scheming from the beginning. She tries to bring Aanchal and Kabir closer to provoke Ranvir. Ranvir is on the edge and when Jatin learns his truth, Ranvir kills him and makes it look like suicide. When Ranvir doesn't let Aanchal take the body for post-mortem, she investigates and is convinced that he is the murderer. Ranvir threatens her too and she waits for an opportunity. Rohan tries to communicate with Aanchal at Jatin's funeral but Ranvir kills him before they team up. Aanchal then fakes a suicide attempt and Kabir gets to her before Ranvir and takes her to the hospital. Ranvir threatens to endanger Aman (who is back in Mumbai) and Rupali when Aanchal pulls a stunt to make him jealous—resulting in a crowd witnessing Ranvir's madness as he relentlessly beats up Aanchal's comrade. Kabir still refuses to believe Aanchal's claims about Ranvir.
Aanchal poisons Ranvir's drink but he reveals that he has the antidote and instead poisoned Kabir. Ranvir reveals his true colours to Kabir and Aanchal takes him to the hospital when blood comes out of his mouth. Upon reaching the hospital, Aanchal and Kabir are attacked by Ranvir's goons and beat Kabir. Ranvir arrives and locks him up in a hut and burns it in front of Aanchal. Aanchal tempts to commit suicide by smashing her head in a temple. Ranvir prays for Aanchal's recovery but the temple priest reveals that Ranvir never understood the true meaning of love and that Aanchal had prayed to put an end to Ranvir's plans and to kill him. Ranvir realizes his mistakes and finds that Aanchal has gotten herself into deep shock (mistaking Ranvir for Kabir after his apparent death). Ranvir must play along to think that he is Kabir. Ranvir takes Aanchal home and reveals to Sarika that he killed Kabir even though he now regrets it. This shocks Sarika. In a turn of events, it is revealed she was only after money, caring neither about Jatin or Kabir. She scolds Ranvir for killing Kabir, as Jatin had left everything to him in the will. Ranvir is her biological son whom she left at an orphanage so she could come back to get him when she became a Raichand. Ranvir knew the truth all along and claimed that she is responsible for who he is today.
Kabir, who is alive shows up in Aanchal's room and comforts her. He then vows to get revenge on Ranvir. Aanchal, Kabir, Aman and Rupali are all in on the plan. Kabir threatens Dr Agnihotri, bribes everyone working for Ranvir and they all turn to be on his side. Dr Agnihotri informs Sarika that Aanchal (who is faking her mental state) must go to rehab.
It was revealed that Kabir was never poisoned and Aman dug a hole outside the hut and rescued Kabir. Sarika looks up to a man named Roy who her husband orders to kill Aanchal but Roy is actually working with Kabir and Aanchal. Roy holds Aanchal by gunpoint and reveals to Ranvir that he is his biological father. Ranvir kicks Sarika out of the Raichand house because of her wrongdoings over the years and severs ties with her. Kabir asks Sarika to reveal his plan to end Ranvir's game to him. Sarika tells Ranvir that Kabir and Aanchal have played him all along and Aanchal is chased by Ranvir in the forest. Kabir intervenes and goes face to face with Ranvir. They have a fight and Ranvir takes a shot at Kabir but Aanchal takes the bullet and dies in Ranvir's arms. Ranvir goes into shock and Aman brings the police in. Aanchal regains her consciousness and recalls taking help from Dr. Agnihotri to slow down her heartbeat and breathing and replacing the bullets in Ranvir's gun by blanks.
The show takes a one-month leap forward and newly-weds Kabir and Aanchal arrive in front of a Mental Healthcare Centre to see Ranvir who is busy writing 'I love you Aanchal' with his blood. Kabir and Aanchal grow sad upon learning that Ranvir will never improve. As the happy couple leave the centre, the last shot is of Ranvir, looking sinisterly at them, implying that he is pretending to be in a mental state.
tagline: Haasil is the story of two brothers Ranvir and Kabir Raichand, whose lives get entwined with the entry of a smart and righteous lawyer, Aanchal Shrivastav.

title: Half Marriage
summary: Half Marriage is an Indian television show which aired on & TV. It premiered on 25 September 2017 and ended on 27 April 2018. It was produced by Kavita Barjatya and Kushik Ghatak of Conscious Dreams. It starred Priyanka Purohit and Tarun Mahilani.
plot:
The show begins with the portrayal of the life of Chandni Kanaujia, the only daughter of Vanraj Kanaujia, a political leader of the Sanskar Sena. Chandni, an innocent and pampered young lady, lives her life in her own terms and is unaware of the reality. On the other hand, we get introduced to Arjun Sharma a hard-working and responsible man. A chance encounter occurs between Chandni and Arjun and they develop a disliking towards each other.
In the meantime, Arjun gets a job in a corporate company. Arjun's company gets involved in a scandal led by no one but Chadni's father. Arjun, being an honest and simple man, makes the news public and it becomes breaking news.
Chandni witnesses everything on the TV and gets heartbroken. However, her evil father deals with the matter calmly and makes Chandni believe that he is innocent. Chandni then decides to seek revenge from Arjun for defaming her father.
Chandni creates for herself a fake life, a fake house, and a fake father and manages to lure Arjun. Chandni fakes to kill herself but is prevented by Arjun who then declares his love for her. Finally, Chandni makes Arjun steal 2 lakh rupees from their office for her. She then gets Arjun arrested and reveals her true identity to him. Arjun begins to hate Chandni from the core of his heart.
Meanwhile, the head of Arjun's company gets rejected by Simmi. He takes the blame upon himself and Simmi and gets them both arrested and Arjun is released.
Arjun makes Simmi admit her and Chandni's treachery and records everything. Vanraj realizes that his political party is at risk and makes Chandni call Arjun and invite him to a park. Arjun reluctantly agrees to come to the park. After their arrival, various members of the Sanskar-sena arrive at the park and drag all the couples to a pavilion to get them married. Arjun is firmly determined to not marry Chandni but sees his younger sister Reva with another guy. He is now forced to either marry Chandni or let his sister get married. He chooses to sacrifice himself to save his sister. Thus, Arjun and Chandni get married.
Then Vanraj fakes his illness and forces Chandni to move to Arjun's house. No one there accepts her but Janki, who is bribed by sahib Ji, wholeheartedly welcomes her. Slowly with time, Arjun and Chandni fall in love with each other. In a trial to take his daughter back, Vanraj ends up burning Sulakshana. This distances Chandni from her in-laws, but Arjun stands by her side.
Reva then falls in love with Surya Prakash but then gets to know about his past affairs and is scattered. She then dies in an accident and Surya Prakash, who tried to save her, is blamed by Arjun's family. Sulakshana decides to throw Chandni out of the house but Arjun leaves with her. They arrive at a hotel, and when they decide to go around the place Chandni shoots Arjun.
2 Years Later
After a 2-year leap, Chandni is shown to be a successful political leader who's supposed to marry Sid her business partner. Arjun returns under the name of Raj Shekhawat, a rich businessman, with his secretary Maya Oberoi who secretly loves him. To make Raj reveal his true identity, Chandni puts his old house at stake. To postpone the breaking of his house, Raj motivates Sid to get engaged to Chandni. Chandni becomes sad to know that Arjun is ready to get her engaged to someone else and agrees to marry Sid. Arjun gets heartbroken and decides to be present during the marriage.
Chandni leaves Sid at the pavilion stating that she cannot marry him. Chandni is put at gunpoint and is forced to marry Sid. Arjun directs the gunpoint towards him and says that he is doing all this just for the benefit of his business. That night, Sampadji calls both Chandni and Arjun and tells them how vanraj had done all this to get rid of Arjun. Arjun and Chandni finally reunite. They also get vanraj and sampadji arrested.
Chandni finally returns home. However, their relationship is not taken into good terms by Arjun's family. Janaki joins hands with Maya to get her married to Arjun and replace Chandni. All the efforts of Maya fail and she is thrown out of the house. She gets Vanraj released and takes him to her side. Vanraj is a changed man who repents for his wrongdoings towards his daughter who loved him so dearly. He decides to become a pawn in Maya's hand to expose her. In the end, Maya is exposed to the press by Vanraj and is thrown out of Chandni and Arjun's lives. Arjun and Chandni finally consummate their marriage.
Later Chandni gives birth to a baby girl. The whole family gathers for a family photograph in the ending scene and the show ends with a happy note.

title: Hello
summary: Hello is a Bengali-language streaming television series streaming on Hoichoi produced by SVF. The series stars Raima Sen, Joy Sengupta and Priyanka Sarkar. In the first scene of this series Raima Sen as Nandita received an MMS from an unknown number showing her husband Ananyo (Joy Sengupta) making love with Nina (Priyanka Sarkar) that turns her life upside down.
plot:
Hello offers a unique blend of drama and psychological thriller. The series revolves around the life of Nina, Nandita, and Anonyo, Nandita's philandering husband. Season 1, of the Hello series, begins when Nandita receives a series of MMS with romantic messages that expose her husband Anonyo's extra-marital affair with Nina. As the mystery thickens, Nandita realizes that the MMS can be aimed at her.
The success of the first installment of the Hello series propels it to Season 2, where all questions get answered, as Anonyo learns that he was manipulated by Nina and that reaching Nandita was Nina's actual aim.
Season 3, of the Hello series, forms to be an excellent conclusive continuation of its past prequels, introducing some new characters. The series will provide new challenges for Nina, Nandita, and Anonyo as they confront their inner demons.

plotHtml:
Hello offers a unique blend of drama and psychological thriller. The series revolves around the life of Nina, Nandita, and Anonyo, Nandita's philandering husband. Season 1, of the Hello series, begins when Nandita receives a series of MMS with romantic messages that expose her husband Anonyo's extra-marital affair with Nina. As the mystery thickens, Nandita realizes that the MMS can be aimed at her.
The success of the first installment of the Hello series propels it to Season 2, where all questions get answered, as Anonyo learns that he was manipulated by Nina and that reaching Nandita was Nina's actual aim.
Season 3, of the Hello series, forms to be an excellent conclusive continuation of its past prequels, introducing some new characters. The series will provide new challenges for Nina, Nandita, and Anonyo as they confront their inner demons.

title: Hara Hara Mahadeva
summary: Hara Hara Mahadeva is a Kannada mythological television series based on legends of Lord Shiva, also known as Mahadeva. It aired on Star Suvarna beginning 25 July 2016. Star Suvarna, the fourth-largest Kannada channel in India, funded the serial with the largest regional market budget of Rs.60 crore (over US$9 million as of August 2017). It is an official remake of the Hindi television series Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev. It has several nominations for the Suvarna Film Awards. Ajay Devgan said it was a "visual treat" and had many untold stories of Lord Mahadeva. This big budget serial is based on the work by Devdutt Pattanaik. It has aired over 300 episodes and Karthik Parak, head of regional branch programming at Star Suvarna planned to extend it to 500 episodes.

title: Humko Tumse Ho Gaya Hai Pyaar Kya Karein?
wikiTitle: Humko Tumse Ho Gaya Hai Pyaar Kya Karein?
summary:
Humko Tumse Ho Gaya Hai Pyaar Kya Karein? (English: I've Fallen In Love With You, What To Do?) is an Indian Hindi drama television series, which used to air on StarPlus. Produced by Suzana Ghai's Panorama Entertainment, the show starred Ishani Sharma and Varun Toorkey.
It showed how true love can change people for the better and when you love someone, only that person matters, and not his wealth or status. The show premiered on 6 June 2016 and ended abruptly after 4-month run in October 2016 due to very low viewership.
plot: Anokhi Mehra is a clever, witty girl who hails from a middle-class family in Chandni Chowk, Delhi. Anokhi dreams of marrying a rich guy and believes that money is the main source of happiness. Her life takes a turn when she gets a job as an accountant in the Mallick house, where lives the wealthy and dysfunctional Mallick family. There she meets the family's soft-spoken heir, Tushar Mallick who falls for her, while she falls for his wealth. The show follows how Anokhi manages to win the Mallick family's hearts with her wit and charm while falling in love with Tushar, thus learning the true meaning of love and marriage. It is later revealed that Tushar's mother Nikita Mallika is not his mother. Nikita hates Tushar but she doesn't show that she hates him. It is then revealed that their house servant who is working there is his biological mother actually she was the daughter in law of the house. This news is given to Tushar by Anokhi. The show ends with him knowing that their servant is his mother and the reason for her becoming the servant of the house and thus Anokhi and Tushar reunites by love.

title: Hello Pratibha
summary: Hello Pratibha (International Title: Hello Pratiba) is an Indian television drama show, which premiered on 27 January 2015 till 27 July 2015. It aired Monday to Saturday on Zee TV. The series is dubbed in English and airs on Zee World from Friday 22 September 2017 on weekdays.
plot:
A woman who forgets her personal interests, goals, and talents while fulfilling the responsibilities of a wife, mother, and daughter-in-law and how she eventually tries to discover herself after 16 years of marriage is the story of Zee TV's forthcoming show "Hello Pratibha", which was launched here with much fanfare.
Pratibha was filled with hope, ambition, and talent of her own, and is now married for 16 years and has devoted her entire life to her husband, kids, and in-laws, thereby facing an identity crisis.
The drama starts off with everyone thinking of Prathiba has a woman meant for the kitchen and nothing else. Her husband doesn't seem interested in her. Her kids look up to the wife of her husband's brother. Her mother is law is never happy with her. She bears all this with a quiet voice. Later she has the courage to speak up and wins everyone heart.

title: Humsafars
summary:
Humsafars (transl. Life Partners) is an Indian television drama show which aired from 22 September 2014 to 27 February 2015. Produced by Gul Khan under 4 Lions Films, it starred Harshad Chopda and  Shivya Pathania.
The show chronicles the love story of Arzoo, who values truthful relationships, and Sahir, who is caught between his affection for Arzoo and nostalgia for his comatose wife.
plot:
Arzoo, a hardworking aspiring fashion designer lives in Lucknow. When the Sheikhs factory burns down, she moves to Mumbai and there finds work at prestigious fashion house Saiyaara where her boss Sahir confronts her. Arzoo heads into his house, staying with them. Sahir gradually falls for her. His wife Zeenat is in coma since 7 years after facing an accident. Sahir is determined to fulfill his promise to her of becoming a happy businessman. Arzoo falls in love with him, but his brother Zaki falls for her. Sahir romances Arzoo, who confesses her feelings too.
But then Sahir breaks her heart by admitting that he was playing her, though he later realises he really loves her. Zaki proposes Arzoo. She accepts to defy Sahir, who blackmails her into marrying him. Zeenat shows signs of recovering from coma. Arzoo suspects her to be out of coma. Inspector Vikram enters to protect the family. It is later revealed Sahir's mother Alvira is in real Zeenat's mother and he is her son-in-law. Someone tries to drown Zeenat; Arzoo is blamed. Sahir rescues her. It turns out that Zeenat is posing to be in coma and working with Vikram who loves her.
Arzoo is kidnapped. Anam blackmails Alvira saying that she has a video showing Alvira was behind Zeenat's accident.
Arzoo confronts Zeenat who knows that her fake coma won't last long. Before Arzoo can tell Sahir, she pretends to come out of the coma and ask Sahir for forgiveness.
Anam tells Arzoo the truth about Zeenat and Vikram but withholds Alvira's secret. Arzoo shares everything with Sahir. Anam goes missing.
But she leaves a file behind which reveals that Alvira is Zeenat's stepmother and she instigated her father against Alvira prompting him to leave all his wealth to Zeenat.
To get a fair share for her own children, Alvira arranges Zeenat's accident and tries to have her killed but fails. She admits she used Sahir so he would get Zeenat's wealth on her death.
Anam escapes. Vikram follows her to the House and asks Zeenat to leave with him. He reveals all the misdeeds for her. They are arrested. Sahir and Arzoo promise they will always love each other.
Sahir signs over Saiyaara to Zaki and makes Anam the VP. Sahir and Arzoo look back at them for the last time and bid them goodbye. The story ends with their happy union.

title: Hum Hain Na
summary:
Hum Hain Na is an Indian television drama show which premiered on 1 September 2014. It was replaced by Dil Ki Baatein Dil Hi Jaane from 23 March 2015.
Hum Hain Na is set in Varanasi and portrays the relationship of main character Shivprasad Mishra, nicknamed "Bunty", with his relatives. Sony Entertainment Television marketed Hum Hain Na as a "man-centric" show. Lead actor Kanwar Dhillon stated that the show was intended to be different from other television dramas which tended to focus on the relationship between mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law. The hundredth episode of the show was broadcast on 2 February 2015.

title: Har Mushkil Ka Hal Akbar Birbal

summary: Har Mushkil Ka Hal Akbar Birbal is an Indian historical comedy television series which aired on BIG Magic. It stars Kiku Sharda and Vishal Kotian. A Bhojpuri language dubbed version aired on Big Ganga.
plot: The show's story is based on the well known folklore characters, Akbar and Birbal have been extremely popular with the kids for their combined wit and wisdom. The show is a fresh, comic take on the relation between Emperor Akbar and his seventh jewel Birbal that not only makes one laugh but also teaches valuable lessons. title: Honar Soon Mi Hya Gharchi
summary: Honar Soon Mi Hya Gharchi (transl. I'll be the daughter-in-law of this house) is an Indian Marathi language television series that aired on Zee Marathi. It starred Tejashri Pradhan and Shashank Ketkar in lead roles. It premiered from 15 July 2013 by replacing Unch Majha Zoka. The story revolves around Shrirang (Shree) who stays with his grandmother and five mothers. When Shree marries Janhavi, then she has trouble dealing with six mothers-in-laws.
plot:
Shrirang lives with his grandmother and five more women whom he equally treats as his mother. He owns a business "Gokhale Gruha Udyog" which his grandmother had established. He falls in love with Janhavi, who lives a modest life with her father, brother and step-mother, and works in a bank. They meet on a bus-stop and develop a beautiful bond. Initially Shri does not let Janhavi know he belongs to a rich family to maintain the simplicity of their relationship. But as they both fall in love, he reveals it to her. Janhavi's stepmother creates several problems in the pair's wedding and extorts the Gokhale family on various occasions. She also arranges her alliance with an aged man called Anil Apte. Before marriage, Shri's grandmother misunderstands Janhavi, especially given her mother's greedy nature. After marriage, Janhavi wins everyone's hearts with her caring nature. She also encourages all women in their home to take up various activities and businesses. She also brings Shri's estranged uncle and father back home.
Janhavi meets a road accident and partially loses her memory, forgetting all about her marriage with Shri. But she still moves back to Shri's home upon knowing the fact. She falls for Shri all over again. Janhavi regains her memory after living with the Gokhale family for a while.
Janhavi's little brother - Rohan, who goes by Pintya - gets in a pandemonium from his boss Kishore. His boss threatens him to do as he says. If he doesn't listen, he would kill his father and Shri. To save his loved ones' lives, he makes Shri's image brutal on social media. Everyone blames Janhavi because of what Pintya did, claiming that she did not take responsibility and stop him. Janhavi, expecting a baby, sobs over and over again, as she is at risk of losing it. No one except Geeta and Janhavi's parents know she is pregnant. Shri is about to give Janhavi a divorce due to misunderstandings created by her stepmother. The women in the house worry about Shri and decide to do his second marriage and leave Janhavi, as they do not know that Janhavi has not done anything, nor that she is pregnant. They find a bride for Shri. Janhavi often tries to stop Shri to tell him the truth, but can't. After some more incidents, Shri's grandmother and uncle also learn of her pregnancy and finally it is revealed to Shri at a function at 'Narmada Yoga Centre', named after Shri's mother who possibly runs the business. Over there Shri and Janhavi reunite, but they have yet to solve Baby Aatya and the five other mothers' misconceptions about Janhavi. As a result, Shri stops talking with his six mothers and then Janhavi overcomes his mothers' misunderstanding by her tricks. Now she must address Pintya's wedding. His mother is trying to hook him up with a rich family, whereas he has fallen for a girl at his office. However, she lives in Dharavi, the biggest slum in Asia. His mother demands him to chuck her out of his life. Shri advises him to run away and get married. On the other hand, Janhavi thinks she can try and explain the situation to her vicious stepmom. Pintya's father agrees with Shri's opinion. Pintya has a little chat with him and comes to a conclusion that he has to take responsibility for his own actions and should leave his pregnant big sister out of his problems.
Pintya marries Sunita against his mother's will. Initially, Kala and Sunita clash, but Sadashiv resolves it forcibly. Saru marries a middle aged man, Pradyumna. Pradyumna's friend is later revealed to be Devendra, Baby Aatya's estranged husband.
On their anniversary, Devendra tries to reconcile with his wife, but Baby insults him and tells him to leave. Devendra explains Baby left him because of an incident which did not happen. Baby apologizes and returns to her husband. The other family members return. With some help from Janhavi, Pintya buys a flat for his family. Janhavi gives birth to a baby girl while Shri adopts another child from an orphanage. The family is delighted by the arrival of two baby girls, as the adopted baby is also a female. The serial ends with the entire family naming the baby "Krushna".

title: Humnasheen
summary:
Humnasheen is a 2013 Pakistani drama television series that premiered on Hum TV on February 24, 2013. Directed by Siraj-ul-Haque and written by Syeda Shahla Shakoor, the series was produced by Momina Duraid. The cast includes Adnan Siddiqui, Faiza Hasan, Arij Fatyma, Rija Ali, Humayun Ashraf, and Raheel Butt.
The series received backlash for depicting homosexuality in an episode of the series.
plot:
The story revolves around the family of Hassan Munir. Munir and Asmat Aara have been married for 15 years and are childless. Asmat Aara desires children and gets her husband married to the much younger Mehrunnisa, hoping that she would bear him the children she could not. Mehrunnisa has been engaged to Shehzad (Humayun Ashraf) and is madly in love, but her fiance is unemployed. Seeing that, Mehrunnisa's family forcefully wed her away with Hassan Munir. Mehrunnisa accepts this as fate and devotes herself to being a dutiful wife of Hassan and gives birth to his twins. Asmat Ara initially gets jealous of Mehrunnisa, but later she chooses to mother the twins and trades off her companionship with Hassan, which Mehrunnisa fills perfectly. Mehrunnisa completes her studies and gives birth to another child, whom she chooses to raise herself.
After a lapse of years, the children are grown up, and the twins Aaliya and Safeer are copies of Asmat Ara in personalities. Safeer is proud and bossy, whereas Aaliya is a classy girl. Safeer is in love with Alishba, the daughter of Najm-Uz-Zaman, a cold enemy of Hassan. Najm-uz-Zaman has left no stone unturned to beat Hassan Munir in the construction business. Asmat approves of the marriage, despite Hassan's disapproval, and after the death of Hassan, she gets Aaliya married to Saqib and Safeer married to Alishba. Things take a worse route as Safeer, under his father-in-law's influence, sells off the construction business, and starts a new business which proves to be a huge loss. Alishba also treats her in-laws in a bad manner. Meanwhile, Aaliya has to get a divorce from her husband as her husband, turns out to be gay.
Mehrunnisa and Asmat Ara are left together to pick up the shattered pieces of their life together after Hassan Munir. Asmat apologizes for all the wrongdoings she did with Mehrunnisa over the years. Shehzad reenters their lives as an ex-accomplice of Hassan and an established businessman and helps Safeer in the loss and uncovering the real culprit of the failure, who turns out to be Najam-uz-Zaman. Alishba tries to turn Safeer against Shahzad by revealing that Shahzad is Mehrunnisa's ex-fiance. But Asmat Ara takes a stand for Mehrunnisa and clarifies her position. Mehrunnisa's brother is keen on getting her married to Shahzad, as Shahzad did not get married after the failed love affair with Mehrunnisa. Mehrunnisa strongly opposes and declares her eternal love for her dead husband and vows to live with the memories of Hassan till her last breath.

articleSections.text: The show was telecast on Indian channel Zindagi from 13 April 2015 under the title Kabhi Aashna Kabhi Ajnabi.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text: A reviewer from the Firstpost panned the series for its implausible plot, where a childless woman arranges for her husband to marry a younger woman to produce an heir.

title: Hongey Judaa Na Hum
summary: Hongey Judaa Na Hum (transl. We won't be separated) is an Indian television drama series that premiered on Sony TV on 10 September 2012. The story depicts the tempestuous love story of a young married couple, rediscovering love after meeting with a car crash, erasing their memory. The show stars Raqesh Vashisth and Aamna Sharif in the lead roles and marks the return of Aamna Sharif to television after five years. Hongey Judaa Na Hum ended on 20 March 2013 due to low TRP's.
plot: Rohan (Raqesh Vashisth) and Muskaan (Aamna Sharif) are a young couple who have been married for five years. They love each other deeply but continuously bicker and fight. However, Muskaan's mother, Tara (Deepshikha), does not like Muskaan's marriage with Rohan as they fight a lot, while Rohan's family loves Muskaan a lot. One day, the two of them meet with a tragic car accident and lose their memory of their past with each other. Dr. Anirudh (Aamir Ali) a good friend and doctor of Muskaan, asks them to stay separate for their own well being. Thus, they start life afresh with their families, separated from each other. A year passes, and life gives Rohan and Muskaan another chance. Rohan has a good friend, Anushka (Pavitra Punia) who is his paying guest, but Rohan ultimately falls for Muskaan, unknowing his past. title: Hitler Didi
summary: Hitler Didi (transl. Hitler Sister but figuratively Auntie Hitler) is an Indian soap opera that aired on Zee TV. It premiered on 7 November 2011. The story is set in Delhi.
plot: Indira Sharma, who is the sole breadwinner in her family, falls in love with Rishi Kumar. They both marry after facing a lot of obstacles. Indira was diagnosed with brain tumor and has 30 days to live. So she tried her best to make her family members settle without her help in the less span of time. She also fulfilled her remaining wishes within those days. She forces Rishi to marry Shweta and while their marriage her tumor bursts. It was revealed that Indira was pregnant and Shweta hid Indira's pregnancy from everyone under the scolding of Rishi's mother. To repent her mistake, Shweta becomes a surrogate mother of Indira's child. She gives birth to Indira and Rishi's daughter, Indu.
reception:
Kshama Rao of The Indian Express gave the film two out of five, writing, "While it's nice to see a primetime heroine crack the whip, the joy is short-lived as a large part of the show is unappealing. It looks half-baked in places — for instance, there was a scene between Rishi and an old woman who he sees on the neighbouring barsaati which we still haven't figured out!"
In the United States, the Anti-Defamation League, a civil rights group, asked Zee TV's executives to remove "Hitler" from the show's title and to rename it with something "less offensive." A Zee TV spokesperson confirmed that the channel received the letter from the group but has yet to respond. She stated that the show's title has nothing to do with Hitler himself, but is intended to portray the girl's temperament. The spokeswoman claimed the show has not received any complaints from India over its name and declined to comment on whether they are considering changing it. It was later renamed as General Didi in North America and Europe. When the series started airing in the Arab world in 2014, the Anti-Defamation League again voiced their disappointment in a press release on the reemergence of Hitler's name in the series title.

articleSections.title: 8 years later
articleSections.text: Indira is shown to have died. Rishi takes care of Indu as a single father, living in Indira's house. Indu is just like Indira. Zara Khan, Indira's look-alike police officer enters. Indira's family forces Rishi to marry Zara. However, Indira is shown to be alive in mental asylum losing her mind as well as memory. Indu meets Indira and brings her back with Rishi's help. Zara kidnaps Indira. Rishi saves her and sends Zara to a mental asylum. After that a new character Kabir enters and it turns out he has a connection with Indira in some way. Indira constantly calls out to someone named Saheb it turns out Saheb is Kabir who has a connection with Indira from Pakistan in the past. But After some twists, Indira regains her memory and reunites with Rishi, Indu, and Her family. Zara returns and tries to create problems, but in vain. Finally, Indira gives birth to a son and Indu settles every Sharma men in their professions.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Indira, the daughter of Kutumbh and Inder Sharma, asks her nephew, Ishaan, and sister, Mandira, to complete their morning chores. She even scolds her brother, Munna, and his wife, Sunaina of being irresponsible. Kutumbh gives Indira the municipal corporation’s notice regarding an overdue water connection bill, but Indira snaps at her. Indira's ruthlessness stems from the hatred she feels for her father. Later, an estate agent, Radhe, brings tenants, whom Indira rejects for a petty reason.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Radhe takes Rishi, a man who is looking for a place to rent, to Indira’s house. They encounter Munna, who charges a high rent for the room, which makes Rishi leave. Moreover, Kutumbh and Sunaina also remain skeptical of him. Radhe informs the incident to Indira and she leaves the office to meet him. On the way, she encounters him in an auto-rickshaw, but immediately has a fallout. Later, she gets off the vehicle and leaves.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Indira asks Munna to deposit the cheque for the water bill. Later at her office, she meets a new recruit, Manoj, who hits on her. She takes him to her boss, Gurpreet. Meanwhile, Rishi arrives at Indira’s house. He comes across Mandira and Sunaina, both of whom refuse to clean his room, so he gets to work himself. Later, he opens a box and gets startled to find a rat inside. He then throws his shoe at it, to shoo it away.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Rishi gives the security deposit to Indira. She then explains to him the rules of her house and asks him to fill up a form. Meanwhile, Munna argues with her for letting him stay, and leaves the house himself. Later in the market, Indira sees Mandira with an unknown boy. Back at home, she comes across Rishi again. He tells her that he is waiting for his pizza to arrive and invites Ishaan to join him. Meanwhile, Munna visits Inder.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: Inder refuses to give money to Munna, while his second wife, Jhumpa, insults him. The next morning, Rishi gives Indira an old box as a birthday gift. Later at her office, Indira receives flowers that her brother, Vidhit, sent her. The same evening, Munna comes home with a lot of money and gifts for everyone, and informs them that he has started a new business. However, Inder and Jhumpa arrive with the police, leaving everyone shocked.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: Inder scolds Munna for misbehaving with Jhumpa. The police arrest him while, Kutumbh falls sick. Jhumpa has a fall out with Indira and she leaves. Later, Rishi speaks to Inder about the incident, but Indira intervenes. She reveals her relation with Inder to him and asks him to stay away from her personal problems. Later, she visits Munna to post his bail. However, she decides against it because of what he said to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: Munna comes back home and reveals that Rishi gave his bail. However, Indira gets angry and asks Rishi to leave. Munna comes in support of him, but himself leaves. Meanwhile, Rishi puts forth such a condition that makes it difficult for Indira to evict him. The next morning, Ishaan refuses to go to school with her. Just then, Munna arrives and offers to take him. Later, Indira, fed up with Rishi’s antics, calls up Radhe for a new tenant.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: Mandira and her boyfriend, Ashish, shoplift and later get caught. Inder pays their due and asks Kutumbh to not speak of it to Indira. Meanwhile, Jhumpa sees him interacting with her and confronts him. However, he tells her something interesting that silences her. Meanwhile, Indira’s boss, Gurpreet, asks her and Manoj to find an Uzbek translator for their visiting delegates. Later, Manoj pays a visit to Indira house, little to everyone's expectation, looking for Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Manoj asks Rishi to be his Uzbek translator, but he refuses because Indira is also involved in the project. The next day, Ishaan asks Munna to take him to school, but Rishi offers to take him instead. On the way, he convinces Ishaan to apologise to Indira. Ishaan and Indira reconcile, but she scolds Rishi for aggravating her problems. Later, he comes to her office and starts talking to the delegates. Will Indira accept his help or refuse it?

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: Indira accepts Rishi’s help and they leave with the delegates for a business meeting. However, he insists that she thank him for all his help. Elsewhere, Munna takes his friend Montu’s money and gives it to Kutumbh and Sunaina. Later, he sees Montu looking for him and escapes. Ishaan comes to Montu in search of Munna. Montu asks him to wait for his father. However, he locks the garage and leaves, with Ishaan still inside in it.

episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: Rishi and Manoj drink together. Manoj passes out, but Rishi stays conscious using a trick. Meanwhile, Indira receives a call from Sunaina telling her that Ishaan is missing. She scolds everyone in her family for being irresponsible. She also calls Munna, but he hangs up. Later, she and Rishi go look for Ishaan. They both ask Radhe’s friend, Kasim, about Ishaan’s whereabouts, but he answers in the negative.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Rishi takes Indira to Montu’s garage and rescues Ishaan. Later, she scolds Munna for being irresponsible. Afterwards, when Rishi offers her a snack, she rejects it. Furthermore, she scolds him for being too intrusive in her personal life. Meanwhile, Sunaina informs her that Ishaan has fever. She takes care of him the whole night. The next morning, she searches for Rishi, but Mandira gives her a shocking news.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Rishi takes the Uzbek delegates site-seeing and leaves a letter for Indira. She then looks for him all around the city. Elsewhere, Munna distributes the pamphlets for a religious festival and asks people to turn up at the event with money. Meanwhile, Inder comes to visit Ishaan with a doctor. He also brings the property papers of his house and tries to trick Kutumbh into signing it. Munna arrives with another doctor and comes face-to-face with Inder.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Inder decides to stay as long as the doctor attends to Ishaan. Later, Indira arrives, and Inder hides. Meanwhile, Manoj sees Indira at her home and informs Gurpreet about it. Later, when Rishi and the delegates arrive at her house, she splashes water on them. She asks Kutumbh to take them to her room for a change of clothes. However, Sunaina offers her clothes to the delegates instead of Kutumbh’s. Meanwhile, Inder’s phone starts to ring.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: Munna takes Rishi and the delegates to a ‘Jagrata’, a hindu religious festival where the devotees spend a night singing praises for a deity. Meanwhile, Jhumpa comes to Indira’s house in search of Inder. Later, he comes out of hiding and faces Indira. She begins to confront him, but Kutumbh takes his side. She tells her that he has the right to visit her house and that she is no one to stop him. She also belittles Indira’s contribution to the family, after which Indira takes a drastic step.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: Ishaan tries to stop Indira from leaving, but she remains adamant. Later, he tells Munna about it, who does not take it seriously. However, Rishi decides to find her. Later, at the ‘Jagrata’, a man identifies him as Ricky, but he dismisses him. Elsewhere, Indira calls up Vidhit to ask for help, but he does not pick up the phone. Later, some men start harassing her, and Rishi arrives. However, she ends up scolding him.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Indira forbids Rishi from following her and leaves. However, he tracks her phone with the help of his friend. Meanwhile, Indira gets on a bus to Rishikesh, but the police stops it. Later, she is taken under arrest and brought to the police station. Elsewhere, one of the delegates gets robbed, and she calls up Gurpreet to inform of the incident. Meanwhile, Ashish beats up Manoj for talking to Mandira, and taking her pictures.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: Rishi tells the police that Indira stole from him. Meanwhile, Gurpreet arrives at the police station and informs her that the delegates have been robbed. Incidentally, Manoj and Mandira also arrive, and a remarkable turn of events lead Indira to the real thief. Later, she returns the stolen items to the delegates. Meanwhile, Gurpreet offers her a raise, but she refuses. Rishi tries his best to convince her not to leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: Indira returns home, which makes everyone unhappy except Ishaan. However, she asks Rishi to vacate his room the next day, but Ishaan asks him not to go. Later, he speaks to Indira about it as well, but she dismisses him. Elsewhere, Inder informs Jhumpa that he has tricked Kutumbh into signing the property documents, and now she is the owner of Indira’s house, Sharma Niwas. Later, she comes up with a plan for the

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: Rishi refuses to leave the house until Indira returns his security deposit. She goes to look for her jewellery in Kutumbh’s closet and comes across an interesting item. She confronts Kutumbh about it. Later, she asks Munna to find a job to sustain his family, and threatens to throw him out if he fails to do so. She also tells Mandira that she will stop her education and marry her off. She goes so far as to lock her up, and warns everyone not to set her free.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Rishi offers Ishaan and Indira a ride to the school. However, upon reaching her office, Manoj gives her a devastating news. Meanwhile, Kutumbh confronts Inder for tricking her into signing the property papers, but he discloses his plans to her. She also informs him that Indira burned the papers, which prompts him to come up with another idea. Later, Munna visits his house to confront him, but will Inder invite him in?

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Inder and Jhumpa try to convince Munna to get Kutumbh to sign the property papers. Meanwhile, Gurpreet informs Indira that he did not terminate her from work and also gives her a holiday voucher. Back at Sharma Niwas, Mandira threatens to commit suicide because no one is handing her the mobile phone charger. Kutumbh informs the incident to Indira, who doesn’t give much importance to it. However, she gives her a shocking news regarding Mandira.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: Munna asks Indira to transfer the property in his name. Later, she meets Rishi and asks him about his livelihood. However, he tells her that she is making a mistake by forcing Mandira to get married. Back at Sharma Niwas, Mandira threatens to commit suicide by jumping off the roof. She even pens a note blaming Indira for her death. However, seeing that no one is taking her threat seriously, she attempts to jump. Will anyone be able to save her?

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: Mandira’s suitor, Manish, and his family visit Sharma Niwas. Mandira asks him about his bank balance and possessions. However, unimpressed by him, she lies that she is in a live-in relationship with Rishi. This makes Manish angry and he leaves. Later, Ashish sees Mandira and Rishi speaking alone and informs Indira regarding it. Meanwhile, a police constable arrives at her house and reveals a shocking news about Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: Rishi scolds the constable for misreading his address. Meanwhile, Manoj calls Mandira and criticises Indira to her. Later, Indira calls Munna to inform about a job interview she has arranged for him. Munna tells his friends that Indira has agreed to transfer the property on his name if he works diligently for a month. However, his conversation was eavesdropped. Back at Sharma Niwas, Mandira overhears Rishi talking about the police over the phone. Later, she asks him for a favour.

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: Munna gets a job at a car dealership after impressing the owner, Dheeraj. Meanwhile, Mandira decides to elope with Rishi’s help. On the way, they encounter Munna, who is roaming around in one of the test-drive cars. He drops her off at the restaurant, where Indira is waiting for her to meet the new suitor, Prateek. Later, he takes Sunaina and Ishaan for a ride around the city. Meanwhile, Mandira texts Rishi asking for help.

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: Mandira escapes from the restaurant with Rishi’s help. Later, Indira and Prateek go looking for her. In the meantime, she finds out that Rishi is helping Mandira elope. Elsewhere, Rishi and Mandira stop by her house, and she comes across something interesting. Meanwhile, Munna accidentally hits Jhumpa with his car, who has a fallout with Sunaina. Elsewhere, Inder meets Kutumbh and talks about the property again. On her way back home, she sees something shocking.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Indira calls Rishi and demands him to come back with Mandira. However, Mandira hangs up the call. Later, she finds out the letter Mandira wrote her, explaining the reason for eloping. She also figures out the place they have fled to and decides to pursue them. Her neighbour, whom Rishi affectionately calls Amma, also gives her money for her travel expenses. Munna offers to come along with her, but she refuses his

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: Indira asks Kutumbh to sign the property papers that she has prepared, making her the owner of Sharma Niwas. However, she hides a devastating truth from her. Later, she leaves for Macau and upon reaching, confronts Rishi. However, he gives her a shocking news regarding Mandira. Indira disbelieves him and does not let him leave his room. However, he tricks her and escapes. Meanwhile, Inder learns that Mandira has eloped.

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: Manoj takes Mandira shopping, while Rishi and Indira follow them. During their pursuit, Rishi talks to the taxi-driver in Mandarin, which surprises Indira. He tells her that he is a linguist. Later, he brings food for Indira, which she refuses initially, but later accepts. Meanwhile, Manoj buys a new dress for Mandira and asks her to wear it. He then drugs Mandira’s drink. However, she gets the wind of his plan, but can she

episodesList.title: Episode 31
episodesList.summary: Munna is enraged to find out that Indira has transferred the property on her name. Meanwhile, Rishi and Indira come across a priest, who mistakes them for a couple. Elsewhere, Manoj tricks Mandira into committing a fraud. She is taken to the police station, where she meets Rishi and Indira. Rishi comes up with an excuse to get Mandira released from the police custody. However, the police officer does not buy it, and asks for proof.

Indira falls in love with Rishi but faces challenges even in her love life.
