episodesList.title: Episode 67
episodesList.summary: Jhumpa demands Inder’s store’s keys. Munna refuses to give it and gets into a fight with her. Amidst this, Inder again falls sick and he takes him to the hospital. Meanwhile, Rishi goes to the airport to receive Vidhit. However, he takes him to the same hospital, where Inder has been admitted. Later, Indira arrives with the admission fees. Munna asks her how she got the money, to which she gives him a shocking reply.

episodesList.title: Episode 68
episodesList.summary: Vidhit sees Indira but is unable to speak to her. Later, she goes to buy medicines for Inder and encounters Rishi. She confronts him for not returning home the night before, and also asks the reason for him to be present in the hospital. However, he comes up with a clever excuse. She also visits Inder, who asks her to keep the keys to his store with her until he gets better. Later, she meets Rishi again and their conversation takes an interesting turn.

episodesList.title: Episode 69
episodesList.summary: Rishi talks to Indira about his feelings for her. Later, he stops her from going towards one of the hospital rooms. Elsewhere, Inder is shifted to the Intensive Care Unit, while Munna and the others eat at the canteen. Later, they create a ruckus in Inder’s room, for which the doctor scolds them. Meanwhile, Rishi promises that he will stay with Inder and asks Indira to go home, to which she agrees. However, on her way out, she encounters a surprising situation.

episodesList.title: Episode 70
episodesList.summary: Sameer says offensive things about Rishi and Indira, for which Rishi scolds him and tells him that he will marry Indira. Meanwhile, Amma tells Indira to meet Rishi’s parents. Later, Indira tries to apply makeup, but fails miserably. Indira employs Mandira to help with the situation, but Rishi prefers Indira without makeup. Indira tells Rishi that she wants to meet his parents but Rishi stops her and comes up with an excuse. However, Indira catches his lie and confronts him.

episodesList.title: Episode 71
episodesList.summary: Indira calls Vidhit and tells him that she has fallen in love with Rishi. Unbeknownst to her, Rishi answers from the other end as Vidhit and says that she should give him a chance. Later, Rishi comes up with an excuse to not take Indira to his parents, but she remains adamant. The next day, he tells her that he is ready to take her to his parents, but she puts forth a condition that surprises him. Meanwhile, Sameer’s mother, Simi, has an accident.

episodesList.title: Episode 72
episodesList.summary: Indira and Simi have a war of words regarding the accident. Later, Sameer gives Simi a shocking news. She immediately decides to act upon it. Meanwhile, Rishi comes up with a clever plan regarding Indira’s insistence on meeting his parents. Back at Sharma Niwas, Indira announces that she is marrying Rishi, to everyone’s displeasure. She asks the ladies to lend her a new dress, but no one obliges. Later, Amma comes to her

episodesList.title: Episode 73
episodesList.summary: Rishi introduces Indira to the hired actors as his parents but Munna exposes them. Indira confronts him for lying to her. Later, Simi arrives to meet Rishi and discloses a shocking revelation about him. However, Indira believes that she is another one of Rishi’s actors and argues with her. Simi scolds her for misbehaving, but Rishi stands up for Indira. Later, Indira asks him a question that he struggles to answer. Just then, Sameer arrives.

episodesList.title: Episode 74
episodesList.summary: Sameer exposes Rishi’s true identity to Indira. He also gives her a devastating news regarding Rishi’s intentions. Later, Rishi tries to explain himself to Indira, but she refuses to listen. Rishi tells her that he has no cordial relationship with his family. He also tells her about his childhood and how his family wronged him. He talks about his childhood passions as well. However, she has none of it and ends up taking a drastic step.

episodesList.title: Episode 75
episodesList.summary: Indira throws Rishi out of the house, while her family opposes the decision. Later, he confronts Sameer for telling Indira the truth. However, Simi intervenes and ends up scolding Rishi. Later, Rishi visits Vidhit and breaks down while confessing his love for Indira. Just then, his friend, Sanjay, gives him some news that lifts his spirit. Meanwhile, Indira grieves for being deceived by Rishi, while Ishaan asks her to bring him back.

episodesList.title: Episode 76
episodesList.summary: Rishi publishes a bizarre piece of content in the newspaper that embarrasses Indira. Later, he meets her on the bus to apologise, but she remains adamant. He follows her to her office, but she asks him to leave. She also scolds everyone for reading the same newspaper. After coming back home, she finds Sameer in Rishi’s room. He ends up behaving in an offensive way and proposes an idea that she finds preposterous. However, soon enough, both of them come across a surprise.

episodesList.title: Episode 77
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Rishi get into a spat. Indira tries to stop them but gets into an accident. She scolds both of them for it. Later, Rishi saves her before she is hurt again. Meanwhile, Ishaan tells her that his school fees are due. However, she later learns from the school authorities that someone has already paid the fees. She also receives an even more surprising news from her bank manager, for which she suspects Sameer.

episodesList.title: Episode 78
episodesList.summary: Indira confronts Sameer for paying her bills. She also humiliates him in front of his own staff. Simi tries to punish her for misbehaving with Sameer, but she stops her. Back at Sharma Niwas, Jhumpa comes to Inder and requests him to come with her. Later, she reveals her true intentions for visiting. However, when Indira refuses to entertain her needs, she takes a drastic measure. Rishi arrives and decides to tackle the situation.

episodesList.title: Episode 79
episodesList.summary: Indira tells her family that she has rented her house to host weddings. She also gives Rishi money to give to Sameer. Later, Rishi gives the money to Simi. They have a verbal spat, and she ends up telling him something devastating. Back at Sharma Niwas, Indira sees Jhumpa’s goons in a gruesome situation. Upon asking, they give her a shocking information that terrifies her. She also retrieves a letter from them, the contents of which are equally

episodesList.title: Episode 80
episodesList.summary: Sameer sneaks into Indira’s room and carries out his plan. However, his activities are not as secretive as he thought. Meanwhile, Jhumpa comes with the police to get Indira arrested. They inform her that Jhumpa has filed a complaint against her for keeping Inder at Sharma Niwas against his will. Indira asks Inder to make a choice between Jhumpa and her family, and his decision shocks everyone. Later, Manoj comes to the house and announces an interesting news.

episodesList.title: Episode 81
episodesList.summary: Vidhit accidentally calls Indira but is unable to speak. Later, Rishi talks to her as Vidhit. He then asks the doctor about Vidhit’s improvement in health. Meanwhile, Munna beats up Manoj when he sees him at his house. Indira intervenes and talks some sense into Munna. Elsewhere, Rishi and Ishaan find out the hidden camera that Sameer had installed in Indira’s room. However, Indira believes that Rishi had installed the camera. Rishi then decides to prove his innocence.

episodesList.title: Episode 82
episodesList.summary: Indira decides to call the police to turn Sameer in, but Rishi stops her. Later, Gurpreet arrives with his relatives, but his sister expresses her concerns regarding the arrangements. Later, Gurpreet gives Indira some valuable items for safe-keeping. Meanwhile, Mandira talks to Rishi about her plans for the night, which surprise him. Elsewhere, Inder tells Kutumbh that he wants to borrow money from Indira for his business. Kutumbh decides to take a call on

episodesList.title: Episode 83
episodesList.summary: Indira scolds Inder for asking for money. Later that night, Inder secretly meets Jhumpa and sneaks into Indira’s room to carry out his plan with the aid of an item that Jhumpa provides him with. However, his actions do not go unnoticed. The next morning, Indira gives Inder the money he asked for. However, Gurpreet’s sister announces a shocking piece of news to everyone. Elsewhere, Amma and Rishi discuss his marriage plans with Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 84
episodesList.summary: Indira accuses Munna of stealing the necklace but he denies it. Meanwhile, Inder learns that his crime was not as secretive as he thought. Later, Manoj calls the police. Indira tries to defend herself but only Rishi believes her. Later, Jhumpa insults her in front of the neighbours while Rishi wonders how Jhumpa knows about the theft. Meanwhile, Munna and Kutumbh come up with excuses to continue the celebration. Rishi scolds them for being careless towards Indira, while the police torture her.

episodesList.title: Episode 85
episodesList.summary: The police beat Indira and lock her up in jail. Further, the other inmates say things that humiliate her even more. Meanwhile, Rishi suspects Inder of stealing the necklace, and later, the events take an interesting turn. He then convinces Gurpreet to bail Indira out, to which he finally agrees. However, Rishi keeps a secret from him. Later, he meets Indira and discloses the truth about the necklace to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 86
episodesList.summary: Indira throws Inder out of her house. Meanwhile, Simi notices Sameer’s obsession with Indira. She also has a conversation with him regarding Rishi’s interference in the matter. Later, she visits Rishi and puts forth an outrageous idea. However, Rishi denies agreeing to it, which results in a spat between the two. Meanwhile, Indira stands up for him and insults her for being a careless mother. Later, Rishi and Indira share a romantic moment.

episodesList.title: Episode 87
episodesList.summary: Rishi and Indira take a call on their future. Later, he convinces her to behave politely with Kutumbh. Consequently, she comforts Kutumbh by explaining her the reason she ousted Inder from the house and reveals for whose benefit. She also apologises to Munna for accusing him of stealing the necklace. Elsewhere, Rishi sees encouraging signs regarding Vidhit’s condition. Meanwhile, Mandira devices a plan to seduce Rishi and tries to act on it when she meets him.

episodesList.title: Episode 88
episodesList.summary: Rishi writes a note to Indira which does not reach her. Meanwhile, Manoj gets Mandira intoxicated and she leaves their company. Elsewhere, Sameer enters the house, but what happens next puts him in a compromising situation. Indira plans her future with Rishi, who discusses the names of their children. Later, Indira runs into Sameer. He tells her that he wishes to marry her, but her reply comes as a shock to him.

episodesList.title: Episode 89
episodesList.summary: Manoj's sister has her 'vidai' ceremony, giving away the bride to her groom. Later, Indira’s family agree to her marriage with Rishi. Munna tries to have a serious talk to Rishi, but Rishi wins him over. Meanwhile, Rishi receives a call from his friend, who invites him for his bachelor’s party. Munna decides to join him. Later, Rishi takes Indira shopping. There, she chooses an expensive dress, but later, an unexpected turn of events makes her reconsider her decision.

episodesList.title: Episode 90
episodesList.summary: Amidst the celebrations of ‘Holi’, a Hindu festival of colours, Rishi comes to Sharma Niwas drunk from his bachelor party and faces Indira. Elsewhere, Mandira tries to frame Sameer by threatening to disclose their secret. Later, Simi gives Indira’s family an unpleasant piece of news about Rishi’s financial status, which upsets them. However, Rishi convinces them to attend his wedding. Elsewhere, Sameer finds out about the secret that Rishi has been hiding from him and decides to surprise

episodesList.title: Episode 91
episodesList.summary: Indira waits for Vidhit to come home before the wedding ceremony commences. Later, she is shocked to see Sameer bring in a handicapped Vidhit to the ceremony and demands an explanation from him. However, he accuses Rishi for Vidhit's condition. Rishi then confesses to making Vidhit a disabled person. Later, things take a turn for the worse when Sameer narrates Rishi’s past. Later, Sameer and Munna beat up Rishi, while Indira attends to Vidhit.

episodesList.title: Episode 92
episodesList.summary: Indira learns a devastating truth about Rishi regarding his accident with Vidhit. Kutumbh punishes Rishi, while Sameer and Munna beat him up and throw him out of the house. Meanwhile, Indira has a hard time dealing with the betrayal of her trust. Later, Kutumbh tries to comfort her but ends up saying something that aggravates her pain. Meanwhile, Mandira asks Sameer to marry her but he tells her to not bother him. Later, Sameer tries to console Indira, but Ishaan intervenes.

episodesList.title: Episode 93
episodesList.summary: Ishaan tries to speak to Indira but she remains silent. Meanwhile, Munna and the others worry about taking care of Vidhit. Amidst all this, Kutumbh comes up with an outrageous idea regarding Vidhit’s finances. Soon enough, they all start to put Vidhit through extreme inconvenience. However, Ishaan bears witness to this and asks Indira to intervene. Later, she confesses her deepest regrets to him. Meanwhile, Rishi confronts Sameer regarding Vidhit’s

episodesList.title: Episode 94
episodesList.summary: Sameer confesses to Rishi about tampering with Vidhit’s medical records. He also tells him a disturbing fact about Vidhit's sudden deterioration in health. Rishi then pays Vidhit a visit. Later, Indira questions Sunaina’s presence in Vidhit’s room, to which Sunaina comes up with a clever excuse. The next day, Munna resorts to his antics to raise funds for Vidhit’s treatment, while Indira takes him to a doctor. There, he asks her a question that puts her in a difficult spot.

episodesList.title: Episode 95
episodesList.summary: Sameer introduces Indira to Dr. Mukul, who gives her medicines for Vidhit. However, the events take an unexpected turn and Indira ends up insulting Sameer. Meanwhile, Mandira tries to communicate with him but fails. Later, she gets in his car but his reaction takes her by surprise. Elsewhere, Munna bothers Vidhit and ends up having a heated argument with Indira. She then prepares to give Vidhit the medicine.

episodesList.title: Episode 96
episodesList.summary: Rishi asks Indira for a second chance but she scolds him. He promises her that he will prove his innocence. Later, she receives a call from Mandira, who gives her some devastating news. Indira decides to act on it but gets into trouble herself. Later, Rishi comes to her house looking for her and scolds everyone for being careless. However, Munna throws him out. Meanwhile, Indira finds herself in an extremely challenging situation.

episodesList.title: Episode 97
episodesList.summary: Indira comes to terms with the truth regarding her kidnapper, who tells her something that takes her by surprise. She tries to threaten the kidnapper and attempts to escape. Meanwhile, Munna and the others file a police complaint. Later, Kutumbh gets a call from an unknown person who asks her for the property papers as ransom. She informs Inder about this, who refuses to comply. Meanwhile, Mandira informs Sameer about the whole situation.

episodesList.title: Episode 98
episodesList.summary: Inder is shocked to find Vidhit in the condition that he is in. Meanwhile, Mandira begs Sameer to marry her but he scolds her. She ends up threatening him with an extremely outrageous accusation. Elsewhere, Rishi initiates the wedding ceremony and also finds a way to inform Sameer about his intentions. However, he halts the ceremony mid-way. He reveals to Indira the actual reason he kidnapped her and even provides her with proof behind his reasoning.

episodesList.title: Episode 99
episodesList.summary: Rishi shares his drawings with Indira and decides to leave. Later, he exposes Munna to Kutumbh as the person who asked her for ransom. Meanwhile, Indira sees Mandira walking on the street in an unmindful manner and asks her about the reason. Her reactions confuse Indira. Later, she takes Mandira to a doctor, who gives Indira some devastating news. Indira insists Mandira to speak the truth. What Mandira says next horrifies her.

episodesList.title: Episode 100
episodesList.summary: Indira confronts Sameer for raping Mandira, but he dismisses her. She vows to bring him to justice. Later, she goes to the police, but the reaction of the police officer takes her by surprise. Indira brings her back home, where everyone asks about their whereabouts. Afterwards, Indira tells Munna that Mandira has been raped. Meanwhile, Mandira, unable to bear the humiliation, decides to take a drastic step. What unfolds later horrifies everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 101
episodesList.summary: Kutumbh asks Indira not to talk about Mandira’s rape in public. However, she refuses to do so and presents a strong argument in favour of her decision. Later, she goes to the room where Mandira was raped and breaks down, while Rishi tries to comfort her. Later, she comes across a suspicious item in the room. Meanwhile, Inder informs Jhumpa about the rape. Later, Indira comes to his house, and a dramatic turn of events follow.

episodesList.title: Episode 102
episodesList.summary: Indira begs Inder to be a witness in Mandira’s case, but he remains silent. However, Jhumpa insults her for seeking his help. Meanwhile, Munna punishes Mandira for dishonouring her family and Kutumbh does something even more dramatic. However, Indira stands up for Mandira and threatens Munna with some harsh words, by which he is surprised. Later, she tries to comfort Mandira, who asks her to make a difficult promise.

episodesList.title: Episode 103
episodesList.summary: Indira meets a lawyer to fight Mandira’s case but faces disappointment. Meanwhile, Rishi tries to instigate Inder by resorting to ways that anger him to no end. Inder ends up physically assaulting him. Rishi then reveals the real reason he instigated Inder but is asked to leave. Later, Kutumbh finds Mandira’s rape incident being discussed in public and confronts Indira. However, things take a surprising turn when Rishi arrives.

episodesList.title: Episode 104
episodesList.summary: Rishi scolds Kutumbh for reproaching Indira, but Indira rebukes him instead. He then takes Mandira and Indira to the police station to lodge a complaint against Sameer. However, Kutumbh vehemently opposes this move. Meanwhile, Simi learns that Rishi published the news about Mandira’s rape and scolds him. Meanwhile, Inder arrives at the police station and a dramatic turn of events occur. Later, Sameer finds himself behind bars, but something unexpected happens.

episodesList.title: Episode 105
episodesList.summary: Sameer gets out on bail, while Indira and Simi engage in a war of words. Later, Sameer meets Inder, which quickly turns into an ordeal for Inder. Meanwhile, Munna arrives and things take an ugly turn. Jhumpa confronts Inder for appearing as a witness in Mandira’s case. However, the events take a turn for the unexpected when Indira joins the conversation. Later, the reporters ask her questions about Mandira, but her reply silences them. Elsewhere, Sunaina informs Kutumbh about what Inder did.

episodesList.title: Episode 106
episodesList.summary: Indira worries about finding a lawyer, but help comes to her from unexpected sources. Later, Rishi tells her about a lawyer by the name of Rani. He also mentions his relationship with her, which takes Indira by surprise. Later, they visit her, and she asks Rishi some difficult questions. However, she assures Indira about bringing Sameer to justice. Elsewhere, Inder recalls Sameer and Simi’s threats to him. The next day, Indira takes her family to the court, but the events that follow, shock her.

episodesList.title: Episode 107
episodesList.summary: Rishi confronts Rani for betraying him. Later, he declares himself as Mandira’s lawyer. Afterwards, he asks Rani for her blessings and an interesting conversation ensues. However, Simi scolds him for his decision. Later, Indira asks him some embarrassing questions. She even questions his loyalty, but his reply silences her. Later, Radhe joins their company. Elsewhere, Kutumbh and Simi have a spat, and Jhumpa arrives. After a while, Rishi and Rani begin their arguments.

episodesList.title: Episode 108
episodesList.summary: Rishi questions Mandira regarding the events of that fateful day. However, soon, the events take an unexpected turn when Rani asks a question that silences Mandira. Indira takes her back home, but not before Sameer mocks her. Meanwhile, Rani observes Inder secretly and indirectly threatens him by nearly missing hitting him by her car. Back at Sharma Niwas, Indira confronts Mandira with Rani’s allegations. Later, Rishi joins the conversation.

episodesList.title: Episode 109
episodesList.summary: Mandira confesses that she mistook Sameer for Rishi and the news takes Indira by surprise. Later, Mandira begs Indira to punish her. Meanwhile, Rishi tells them their plan of action for the next hearing. Elsewhere, Jhumpa and Kutumbh scold Inder for going against Sameer. Later, Rani shows pictures of Sameer and Mandira to prove their relationship to the court, but Rishi comes up with a brilliant rebuttal. Later, he summons Inder to testify. However, the situation takes an unexpected turn.

episodesList.title: Episode 110
episodesList.summary: Rani and Rishi challenge each other regarding the case. Sunaina misplaces Vidhit’s prescription and informs Indira. Indira asks Inder’s doctor for help who informs her to discontinue one of Vidhit's medicines. Meanwhile, Rishi discusses the case with Radhe. Indira forces Rishi to eat but he remains adamant. Later, Rishi expresses his feelings for Indira to Vidhit. Meanwhile, Kutumbh and Jhumpa attend to Inder, but Indira fends them off and goes on to ask Inder some tough questions.

episodesList.title: Episode 111
episodesList.summary: Indira finds Jhumpa in Vidhit’s room and asks her to leave. Later, she scolds Sameer for giving her the wrong medicines. Meanwhile, Rani and Rishi engage in an argument. Elsewhere, Inder goes to the toilet, but does not return. This makes Indira think that he has escaped. Later, the judge warns Rishi to produce a witness or risk losing the case. Meanwhile, Radhe also bears some bad news. Indira receives a call that takes her by surprise. Elsewhere, Jhumpa is seen meeting Simi and Sameer.

episodesList.title: Episode 112
episodesList.summary: Indira and Sunaina take Vidhit to the court in an ambulance, but the driver and his companion attack Vidhit mid-way. However, Indira and Sunaina fight them to save Vidhit. Meanwhile, Rishi asks Radhe to stall the court and takes Munna to the hospital. There, Munna flirts with the doctor, while Rishi executes his plan. Meanwhile, Radhe resorts to his antics, which annoys Rani. Things take an interesting turn when Rishi arrives.

episodesList.title: Episode 113
episodesList.summary: Vidhit tells the court that he saw Sameer coming out of Mandira’s room. However, Rani argues that he did not witness the rape directly. This triggers an argument between Rani and Rishi. The judge gives Rishi one last chance. Rishi’s next move surprises Rani as he turns the case around. Later, she declares that Sameer is ready to marry Mandira to save her honour. The proposal interests Mandira’s family, except for Indira, who try to persuade her to not accept it.

episodesList.title: Episode 114
episodesList.summary: Sameer gets convicted. Later, Inder comes to the court and reveals that Simi got him kidnapped, owing to which Simi gets convicted. Afterwards, Rishi shares parting words with Rani and then goes on to speak to the media and credits Indira for his success. Later, Vidhit tells Indira how Rishi took care of him. Afterwards, she gets praised for her courage by the local politicians. While Munna and Sunaina boast about their contribution, Indira takes a few unexpected names.

episodesList.title: Episode 115
episodesList.summary: Indira tells Rishi that she has forgiven him and apologises for not believing when he tried to expose Sameer's intentions. Later, Rishi approaches her to share a moment, but she remains hesitant. He comes up with the idea to visualise their future together. They see their wedding with all the hilarious details. They also see their journey towards parenthood. However, Indira struggles to smile even in their imagined future, although she is being cajoled by their daughters Antara and Mantara.

episodesList.title: Episode 116
episodesList.summary: Rishi and Indira visualise their daughters' wedding. However, Indira sees something that terrifies her, and she stops imagining. Later, Rishi asks her to marry him, but she wants to delay it. The next day, she finds Rishi’s drawings and sees how he imagines her. She decides to dress exactly the same way. Later, Kutumbh and Munna come to Indira with their daily problems but get stunned to see her new look. Meanwhile, Rishi asks her to announce their wedding plans to her family.

episodesList.title: Episode 117
episodesList.summary: Rishi announces his wedding plans to a few local boys who later encounter Mandira and tease her with the news. Meanwhile, Ishaan informs Indira about the ugly things he hears about her at school. Later, Mandira announces the news of Indira’s wedding and heavily criticises her. She is joined by Munna and Kutumbh in the act. However, things take a turn for the worse when Rishi arrives and hears a heart-breaking piece of news from Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 118
episodesList.summary: Indira clarifies that she cannot marry Rishi until she makes Mandira self-reliant and nurses Vidhit back to health. However, Rishi refuses to listen to it. After much convincing, he decides to go back with her. On their way out, they circle the fire that he lit earlier, and he realises a surprising fact. They both get elated because of what has transpired and give in to their passion. Later, he apologises to her and tries to ease the tension. However, her reaction takes him by complete surprise.

episodesList.title: Episode 119
episodesList.summary: Rishi suggests that he and Indira tell everyone about their wedding, but Indira stops him and reasons with him. He understands her and removes her ‘sindoor’, vermilion worn by married Hindu women on their forehead. Later, Munna sees them returning home separately and suspects them of hiding something. When Kutumbh asks Indira about her decision to marry, she gives a surprising reply. The whole family is astonished to see her laugh. Munna ends up saying something that worries Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 120
episodesList.summary: Indira promises Mandira to find a suitable groom for her. Meanwhile, Indira informs Vidhit of her marriage, his reaction to which takes her by surprise. Later, Rishi and Indira upload Mandira’s profile on a matrimonial site. Indira also dances with Mandira to cheer her up. Soon, Rishi comes with the news of a prospective groom. While Kutumbh scolds Sunaina for not wearing 'sindoor’, Indira takes note of it and applies it on herself.

episodesList.title: Episode 121
episodesList.summary: Mandira’s prospective groom arrives with his family and they accept the marriage proposal. However, Indira confronts Rishi for not telling them about Mandira’s rape and tells them the truth herself. The groom’s mother accepts the marriage proposal but gives a condition that shocks Indira. A dramatic series of events follow and Indira finds herself being criticised by everyone in her family except Inder. Kutumbh scolds Indira for breaking her trust, but Inder’s reaction takes her by surprise.

episodesList.title: Episode 122
episodesList.summary: Inder scolds Kutumbh for misbehaving with Indira all her life. Later, Kutumbh scolds Rishi and asks him to leave. Indira tells Rishi that she is scared, but he allays her fears. Inder declares that he will arrange for Indira’s wedding and sneaks into Jhumpa’s house, while Munna distracts her. However, in an interesting turn of events when Munna finds money under Jhumpa’s bedsheet, Inder also gets shocked and scolds her. Later, Jhumpa attacks Inder for stealing her money, but Indira intervenes.

episodesList.title: Episode 123
episodesList.summary: Radhe fixes the date for Rishi’s wedding. However, Rishi says it is too early, but Inder approves of Radhe’s decision. Meanwhile, Vidhit gets a call but does not pick it up. Later, Inder gives Indira the ownership papers of his store and they share an emotional moment. Meanwhile, Rishi goes to apologise to Kutumbh and begs for her acceptance and is later joined by Inder. Elsewhere, Jhumpa goes to Lallan, a local goon, and shows him Indira’s picture.

episodesList.title: Episode 124
episodesList.summary: Kutumbh reconciles with Indira, who realises that Rishi convinced Kutumbh and thanks him. Later, she visits Vidhit, who talks to her about his problems at the office. The next day, Radhe comes to take them to the court. However, the events take an unexpected turn when Sunaina experiences labour pain. Meanwhile, Rishi sees Lallan and his men lurking around but gets distracted when he hears a loud cry. He goes back to the house and what he sees, terrifies him.

episodesList.title: Episode 125
episodesList.summary: Rishi tries to contact Indira regarding Vidhit, but she does not pick up. At the hospital, the doctor says that Sunaina did not go into labour. Meanwhile, Lallan and his men follow Rishi to the hospital. When Lallan sees Indira, he prepares to execute his plan, but stops upon seeing Rishi. Rishi confronts him and interrogates him about Vidhit’s whereabouts, but he escapes. He then tells Indira about the whole incident. Later, they are shocked to see Vidhit outside the hospital with Jhumpa.

episodesList.title: Episode 126
episodesList.summary: Vidhit arranges a car for Rishi and Indira to reach the court and also gives Rishi the wedding rings. Later, Indira and Rishi visit a temple, where she thanks the deity for bringing joy in her life. The priest gives her a container of ‘sindoor’, but Rishi drops it. Meanwhile, he bumps into a goon chased by Inspector Sumer. Sumer catches the goon, but his next move surprises Indira. Meanwhile, Rishi realises something shocking. Elsewhere, Jhumpa scolds Lallan for failing to kill Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 127
episodesList.summary: Sumer returns the rings to Rishi and gives the money taken from the goon to beggars. Meanwhile, Rishi buys Indira some bangles from a bangle-seller, and a photographer named Joy asks to click the couple's picture. Later, Rishi goes to fetch the wedding rings that he forgets in the taxi. When he does not return, Indira asks the adjacent taxi driver about her taxi’s whereabouts, but he says that he is her taxi driver. She questions the bangle-seller and Joy, but their answers shock her even more.

episodesList.title: Episode 128
episodesList.summary: Indira waits for Rishi at the court while Kutumbh leaves with Mandira and Ishaan. Later, Inder convinces Indira to go home but she notices something that terrifies her. Elsewhere, Vidhit overhears Munna talking on the phone and questions him about it. Meanwhile, Indira and Inder go to the police station where Sumer refuses to lodge a complaint. However, he agrees after Indira scolds him. She takes Sumer to the court to show what she found. Elsewhere, Lallan tells Jhumpa that he kept his promise.

episodesList.title: Episode 129
episodesList.summary: Indira fails to show Rishi’s bloodstains to Sumer. Later, she and Inder make futile efforts to find Rishi. Meanwhile, Kutumbh and the others badmouth Rishi, but Indira dismisses them. Later, she complains to God for snatching her happiness away. Just then, her phone rings and the caller’s name surprises her. Later, Lallan tries to kill her, but Inder intervenes. Lallan reveals a shocking news about Rishi’s whereabouts. However, the situation becomes interesting when they take Lallan to

episodesList.title: Episode 130
episodesList.summary: Sumer intimidates Lallan to reveal the person behind Indira's attempted murder, and he names Jhumpa. Later, Sumer locks both of them up. Afterwards, Indira meets a sage who predicts more hardships in her future. Later, Kutumbh tries to rub Indira’s ‘sindoor’ off, but she stops her. Afterwards, Indira distributes Rishi’s posters. She later receives a call from someone demanding a ransom for Rishi. She then quarrels with Kutumbh for money. Elsewhere, Munna goes to a club to meet someone.

episodesList.title: Episode 131
episodesList.summary: Radhe gives Indira money and they reach the place mentioned by the kidnapper. There, they follow the kidnapper’s instructions and reach the house where Rishi is trapped. However, some goons stop Indira from entering but she intimidates them. Meanwhile, Rishi struggles to call out Indira’s name. The events take a dramatic turn when Munna arrives and Indira enters the room. Later, Munna takes her back home, where Kutumbh scolds her. However, she gets shocked when she gets another call.

episodesList.title: Episode 132
episodesList.summary: Indira tells everyone that the kidnapper has asked for a huge ransom. Later, Gurpreet arrives with his employees to congratulate Indira on her wedding. He suggests Inder that he should redevelop Sharma Niwas. Indira asks for Kutumbh’s help to arrange the ransom, but she declines. However, Inder decides to help her, which triggers an emotional moment between them. Elsewhere, Rishi escapes to a construction site while the kidnappers chase him. Meanwhile, Inder and Indira reach the same site.

episodesList.title: Episode 133
episodesList.summary: Indira tries to save Rishi but fails and goes on to inform Sumer about it. However, his lacklustre attitude upsets her, and she scolds him when she sees his attention wavering. Meanwhile, she accidentally switches her phone with his. Later, Indira goes to return Sumer's phone and sees Sumer taking a bribe. Later, Sumer receives a call that takes him by surprise. Back at Sharma Niwas, Munna’s mother-in-law, Naina, visits, while Kutumbh finds out about Inder’s property deal.

episodesList.title: Episode 134
episodesList.summary: Sumer listens to Kutumbh and Sunaina’s rants when he gets a call on Indira’s phone. Meanwhile, Indira distributes a picture of Sumer taking a bribe. The situation intensifies when his senior, the Deputy Inspector General, arrives. He gives Sumer a deadline regarding Indira’s case, for which Sumer confronts her. Meanwhile, Kutumbh asks Radhe to bring a new tenant. Later, he brings children into their house and presents a clever idea. Elsewhere, Rishi eavesdrops on his kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Episode 135
episodesList.summary: Gurpreet calls up Indira to attend to his client. She agrees reluctantly. Later, she meets the client and Rishi calls her. The events take a turn for worse when she sees Rishi. Later, Gurpreet fires Indira. Elsewhere, Kutumbh and the rest struggle to control the children. Meanwhile, Sumer visits Radhe and interrogates him about Indira’s family. Radhe introduces him to Kutumbh as Parimal, a teacher. Meanwhile, Indira gets shocked when she comes home from the police station.

episodesList.title: Episode 136
episodesList.summary: Indira scolds Kutumbh for keeping a tutor without asking her. Later, when Indira’s office boy comes with her belongings, Kutumbh learns that she has lost her job, and scolds Indira. Later, Indira finds Sumer in Rishi’s room, wearing his clothes. They have a heated argument and she forces him to take the clothes off. Sumer tells her that he is staying in her house to solve Rishi's case and believes that one of her family members is behind Rishi's abduction.

episodesList.title: Episode 137
episodesList.summary: Sumer asks Indira about the family members she suspects to be behind Rishi’s abduction. However, she does not come up with any names and argues with him instead. Later, she ponders over the equation each member of her family shared with Rishi. Meanwhile, Sumer pushes Inder to reveal his true identity to others. Later, he finds Munna’s mother-in-law possessing Munna’s wallet. One item in the wallet particularly interests him. Afterwards, he challenges Munna to a wrestling match.

episodesList.title: Episode 138
episodesList.summary: Munna tries to wrestle Sumer but fails. Later, Sumer’s subordinate comes with Sumer's suitcases, in which Kutumbh accidentally sees money. Later, she prepares breakfast for Sumer and asks him about his marital status. Meanwhile, the kids arrive, and a hilarious series of events follow. Afterwards, Sumer goes to a photographer and collects the negatives of Rishi and Indira's wedding day. Later, Sumer has a spat with Vidhit and shows Indira what he got from the photographer.

episodesList.title: Episode 139
episodesList.summary: Indira and Sumer develop the negatives, and Sumer sees Rishi being abducted in one of the pictures. Kutumbh sneakily locks them inside the room and leaves with her family. Later, Sunaina goes into labour and Sumer and Indira help her deliver her baby. Meanwhile, Sumer goes through Munna’s closet and finds a similar shirt that the abductor wore in the picture. He plans to arrest Munna, but Indira stops him. She tries to reason with him, but Sumer remains adamant.

episodesList.title: Episode 140
episodesList.summary: Naina shows Munna the gun that she found in Sumer’s room. Munna then goes to Sumer’s room armed with it. Later, Sumer asks Sunaina and Indira regarding Munna’s whereabouts. Meanwhile, Indira asks Vidhit for some moral advice. Vidhit defends her when Kutumbh asks her to find another job. Elsewhere, Sumer gets into an embarrassing situation with the kids. Meanwhile, Munna visits the police station regarding Sumer but gets jailed. Indira shows Sumer a video of Rishi that she

episodesList.title: Episode 141
episodesList.summary: Indira warns Sumer not to harm Munna. Meanwhile, Sunaina plans a party for her baby and spends Indira’s salary on it. Later, Sumer questions Munna about the shirt he found in his closet but Munna’s answer baffles him. Afterwards, Sumer lets Munna go. Later, Indira and Inder share an emotional moment. Munna tells everyone about his sufferings in jail because of Indira after which she apologises to him. While Vidhit and Inder sympathise with Indira, Kutumbh locks her up in a room as a punishment.

episodesList.title: Episode 142
episodesList.summary: Indira tells Kutumbh that she is looking for a new job. Later, Indira receives a letter from the kidnappers. Inder convinces Indira to sign the property documents. Later, Sumer argues with Indira for trusting Inder and points his gun at her. Meanwhile, Inder and Jhumpa take the papers to a forger. Elsewhere, Sunaina discusses her baby’s name with the family, while Indira attends to the baby and calls her Seher. Sumer tells Indira that he will soon find

episodesList.title: Episode 143
episodesList.summary: Sumer takes Indira to the store-owner whom Inder and Jhumpa visited. Later, Vidhit asks Sumer the reason for his visit to the store. Elsewhere, Munna asks Naina to arrange the money for his baby’s 'Namkaran', Hindu naming ceremony. Meanwhile, Sumer searches Inder’s room but hides when he sees Naina come in. Later, Kutumbh mistakes Sumer for Inder and tells him that she wants to dance in the 'Namkaran' ceremony. Afterwards, Indira asks Sumer to leave the house, but he stays adamant.

episodesList.title: Episode 144
episodesList.summary: Munna praises Naina for arranging his baby’s 'Namkaran' ceremony. She then steals Kutumbh’s money by tricking her. Later, Munna dances with his family. Meanwhile, Inder gets a call and Sumer taps it, while Indira listens to Inder telling the kidnappers to do as they please with Rishi. Later, Sunaina asks Sumer to name her baby and he suggests the name Seher. Sumer and Indira leave to find Rishi. However, he notices that he has lost his gun.

episodesList.title: Episode 145
episodesList.summary: Sumer and Indira run back to Sharma Niwas. Meanwhile, a kid points Sumer's gun at Kutumbh and later at Vidhit. Later, Radhe tells everyone about Sumer's true identity. Kutumbh asks Sumer to marry one of her daughters. Indira scolds Kutumbh while Munna freezes in his chair. Meanwhile, Sumer’s subordinates fail to find Inder. Indira finds a note and figures out Inder’s location. She informs the same to Sumer and they decide to leave. Little do they know that someone is eavesdropping.

episodesList.title: Episode 146
episodesList.summary: Indira and Sumer arrive at Mumbai, where Indira sees a familiar face much to her surprise. Later, Sumer and Indira see Inder giving the property papers to the buyer, Mr. Kukreja’s assistant. He gives Inder a large sum of money that spellbinds Inder. Later, Indira scolds Inder for repeatedly breaking her trust and asks him Rishi’s whereabouts, but he denies having any knowledge of it. Later, Indira sees Rishi and runs to him. The events take an unexpected turn when Indira sees the real culprit.

episodesList.title: Episode 147
episodesList.summary: Vidhit confesses to Indira that he got Rishi kidnapped. Indira confronts him for breaking her trust. He then tries to hurt Rishi but wounds Indira accidentally and escapes with the money while Sumer follows him. Elsewhere, Munna comes to Mumbai along with his mother-in-law, Kutumbh, Sunaina, and his baby. Meanwhile, Inder escapes and Rishi attends to Indira’s wound. Later, Rishi catches Vidhit and threatens him to stay away from Indira. Afterwards, Rishi and Indira share an emotional moment.

episodesList.title: Episode 148
episodesList.summary: Kutumbh sits on a cart and the pedestrians mistake her for a beggar. Munna then capitalises on the situation. Later, Indira finds Sunaina begging on the street and confronts her family. Afterwards, they come back home and find Inder, who announces that he sold the house to Kukreja. All except Rishi and Indira get elated. Rishi confronts Sumer about the money Vidhit escaped with. Sumer gives the money to Indira to start a new life. Later, Inder lays down some rules for Rishi, Indira and Sumer.

episodesList.title: Episode 149
episodesList.summary: Indira meets Ranjit, who refuses to cancel his deal with Inder without making some profit. Indira agrees to his terms. Later, Indira sees Inder rebuke Ishaan. Meanwhile, Rishi and Sumer argue over a petty issue. Later, Rishi devices a plan to save Sharma Niwas. Afterwards, Sumer takes Rishi and Indira to an abandoned house that Rishi intends to sell to Ranjit. Indira hesitates to go forward with the plan, but Rishi convinces her. Elsewhere, Ranjit calls Inder to inform him about Indira’s visit.

episodesList.title: Episode 150
episodesList.summary: Indira looks for food in the house when she hears a shout. Inder asks her about his money and crosses words with her. Later, Sumer decides to leave but Indira stops him. Afterwards, Rishi and Sumer again fight over a petty issue, but Indira intervenes and asks them to concentrate on their plan. They decide that Sumer will pose as a seller of a property to Ranjit while Rishi will pose as Sumer’s servant. Later, Rishi asks Indira if she still loves him, but she allays his fears.

episodesList.title: Episode 151
episodesList.summary: Radhe tells Ranjit that he has a client interested to buy a property. Elsewhere, Rishi helps Sumer learn English and later, tricks Sumer into complimenting Mandira. Later, Rishi and Sumer introduce themselves to Ranjit as Sardar Zorawar Singh and Akshat Kapoor respectively. Sumer as Akshat tells Ranjit that he wishes to buy a property for his grandmother. Ranjit suggests visiting Akshat's family himself. Later, Indira tells Rishi that she would blame him if she does not get her property back.

episodesList.title: Episode 152
episodesList.summary: Rishi plans to trick Indira’s family to act as Sumer’s family in a fake movie but Indira worries about paying them. Later, Ranjit visits the abandoned house. Elsewhere, Mandira and the others try to impress Inder while Rishi loudly reads a newspaper advertisement for a movie audition. Later, Rishi takes money from Indira’s room and gives it to Indira but not before she crosses words with Inder. Later, the family goes to the audition and makes excuses to Inder, when he asks their whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Episode 153
episodesList.summary: Inder asks Ranjit to visit him but he declines. Meanwhile, Rishi, Indira and Radhe decorate the abandoned house. Rishi creates Sumer's family picture but is unable to add the grandmother’s face. Munna and the others arrive and the director assigns them their character names. Later, Sumer introduces Ranjit to the family but he asks to meet the grandmother. Indira introduces herself as Dadi Kapoor, the grandmother. Ranjit promises to get Indira the property she desires but she slaps him.

episodesList.title: Episode 154
episodesList.summary: Indira scolds Ranjit for belittling the Sharma family. Later, Munna takes Ranjit to a messy room and calls it the drawing room. Ranjit asks Munna to direct him to the bathroom, but he shows him a door to the garden. Ranjit walks towards another room that has a police signboard, but Rishi creates a distraction. Ranjit offers to show Indira the Sharma Niwas. Later, Kutumbh and Naina arrive. While Rishi takes Kutumbh out of Ranjit’s sight, Sumer introduces Naina to Ranjit as his maid, Laxmi.

episodesList.title: Episode 155
episodesList.summary: Ranjit enquires about the Kapoors to their neighbour, but Rishi sends Kutumbh to manage the situation. Meanwhile, Munna fails to recognise Indira and badmouths Indira to herself. Ranjit calls Inder regarding his visit but Rishi answers mimicking Inder’s voice. Later, Kutumbh convinces Inder to go on a shooting with her. Meanwhile, Indira and Rishi share light-hearted moments. The next day, Kutumbh and Inder leave, and Rishi convinces Munna to decorate Sharma Niwas. Meanwhile, Ranjit arrives.

episodesList.title: Episode 156
episodesList.summary: Ranjit arrives at Sharma Niwas to find Sumer and the others already present. Meanwhile, Kutumbh and Inder reach the shooting location and wait for the director to come. Elsewhere, Rishi hides a picture of Munna and Sunaina from Ranjit. Sunaina serves Ranjit tea, which he finds odd. Meanwhile, Inder learns about Ranjit’s visit and hurries back home. Rishi calls Inder as an Income Tax officer and asks him to come to the office. Later, Ranjit assures Indira that she will get Sharma Niwas.

episodesList.title: Episode 157
episodesList.summary: Ranjit prepares to leave, but Sunaina’s pizza delivery boy comes to ask her for money. Later, Munna’s friend praises his clothes, but Munna dismisses him. Afterwards, Ranjit offers Indira a ride and Rishi comes along. Indira tells Ranjit that she wants INR 50 lakhs and not INR 1 crore that Ranjit promised her. Later, Ranjit tells Inder that he intends to meet Indira. Inder takes him to Sharma Niwas, where Indira crosses words with Ranjit while Rishi and Sumer hide the rest of the family.

episodesList.title: Episode 158
episodesList.summary: Rishi narrates stories about his childhood to Munna and the others. Later, Munna finds Indira’s wig and confronts her. Sumer tells Indira that Ranjit wants to meet everyone, but Munna refuses to go. Indira locks Munna and the others up and leaves. Rishi makes them listen to his call with Inder, who says that he will share his money with Jhumpa. Later, Munna goes to a local shop where Ranjit sees him. Ranjit asks for Munna to Indira, who makes an excuse but then, Munna arrives.

episodesList.title: Episode 159
episodesList.summary: Ranjit finds Munna wearing a sandal along with a suit and questions him. Later, Ranjit stops Indira from signing the documents saying that his stars are not favourable for the deal, and takes her to his office. Meanwhile, Inder retrieves money from his landlord. Kutumbh confronts Inder for lying about his plans. Inder physically assaults her to tell him about Indira’s plan. He calls Ranjit to inform him about it, but Indira hides Ranjit’s phone. Inder then tells Shashi about Indira’s plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 160
episodesList.summary: Indira scolds Inder for deceiving his family. Later, Rishi and Sumer lock Inder up in a room. Sumer finds INR 50,000 missing from the total amount that Indira will be paying to Ranjit. Rishi tells Indira that he took the money. Kutumbh gives Indira the money that Inder gave her. Later, Inder escapes while Indira meets Ranjit, who refuses to sell the property. However, Shashi informs Ranjit that the Kapoors' property is in dispute. Indira convinces Ranjit to sign the papers while Inder arrives.

episodesList.title: Episode 161
episodesList.summary: Inder tells Ranjit that Indira duped him. Ranjit points his gun at Indira, but Munna intervenes. Later, Rishi and Sumer come along with the rest of Indira’s family. While the others fight Ranjit and his guards, Indira escapes with the papers. Inder catches Indira and assaults her, but Rishi and Sumer intervene. Later, Munna asks Indira for the money that Rishi promised him. Indira confronts Rishi for making false promises to her family, but he says that it was the only way to save her house.

episodesList.title: Episode 162
episodesList.summary: Munna scolds Indira, but she warns him. Later, Inder asks Kutumbh to let him stay, but Indira throws him out of the house. The next day, Indira goes to look for a job and meets Rishi on the way. Rishi says that he is also looking for a job and they make a wager. While Indira spends the day finding a job, Rishi sleeps in a park. Rishi lies to her about being in an interview when Indira calls him. Meanwhile, Ishaan comes home with damaged shoes and later, Inder’s sister, Dulari, arrives.

episodesList.title: Episode 163
episodesList.summary: Dulari asks Inder’s whereabouts, but no one answers. Meanwhile, Indira buys new shoes and a birthday cake for Ishaan. Later, Indira sees that Dulari has arranged a birthday party for Ishaan and has given gifts to all the family members including Ishaan. Indira recalls the day Dulari got Inder married to Jhumpa and tells her to leave. Rishi arrives with a gift for Ishaan and later meets Indira, who scolds him. However, Indira apologises to him while Dulari asks her to behave with Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 164
episodesList.summary: Dulari meets Rishi and gives him money. Rishi asks Indira to forgive Dulari for her past wrongdoings. Later, Indira slaps Ishaan for not returning Dulari her gift. Meanwhile, Dulari tells Kutumbh that as Indira has no job, she does not have any right to boss over the family. Later, Dulari takes Seher into the rain. The next day, Seher runs a fever and Dulari comes with a doctor, who says that Seher has pneumonia. Dulari offers to pay for the medicines. Munna asks her to stay and insults Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 165
episodesList.summary: Dulari tells Indira that she will not leave the house. Dulari badmouths Indira and Sunaina to Munna. Naina scolds Munna for being irresponsible towards his family, and he asks her and Sunaina to leave. Indira scolds Munna, but he remains adamant. Sunaina and Naina leave with Seher while Ishaan stays back. Later, Indira scolds Dulari, but she dismisses her. Rishi asks Indira why she scolded Dulari, to which she answers that Dulari is responsible for Munna’s spat with Sunaina.

episodesList.title: Episode 166
episodesList.summary: Kutumbh asks Ishaan to fetch her asthma pump, but he is unable to find it. Later, Ishaan interrogates Dulari about getting drenched the night before, to which she makes an excuse. Meanwhile, Kutumbh suffers an asthma attack, but Inder saves her. Kutumbh insists Indira to let Inder stay. Indira gets angry and blames Dulari for causing Kutumbh’s asthma attack, which Rishi finds absurd. Munna calls Sunaina, but Naina scolds him. Later, Indira confronts Dulari for orchestrating Inder’s return.

episodesList.title: Episode 167
episodesList.summary: Munna asks Indira to live with her in-laws. Indira tells Rishi that she is convinced of Dulari being the reason behind Seher and Kutumbh’s health problems. The next day, Dulari gives Ishaan some lunch money. Later, Indira asks Kutumbh and Mandira to find another house to live. Indira also says that she will return the money that Dulari spent on her family. Dulari convinces Munna to get married to a rich girl. However, Munna has a change of heart when he calls Sunaina to ask for her forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Episode 168
episodesList.summary: Indira gets a job at a garment store. She catches Rishi lying about his interview and later, argues with him. Meanwhile, Inder convinces Munna to remarry. Rishi gets drunk with Munna, who tells him about his plans of remarriage. Later, Rishi struggles to remember what Munna said while Dulari tells Munna about the benefits of his remarriage. Dulari and Inder take Munna to meet his prospective wife, Naina, and her parents. Naina asks Munna if he will do her household chores, to which he agrees.

episodesList.title: Episode 169
episodesList.summary: Indira arrives at Naina’s home to sell clothes, while Munna and Inder hide. Later, Indira asks Kutumbh and Mandira to bring back Sunaina. Indira gets an interview call that Dulari had secretly arranged. However, upon being called by Naina, Indira goes to her house. Meanwhile, Inder lies to Ishaan and Dulari locks him up in a room, after he sees Munna in a wedding suit. When Munna's wedding ceremony commences, Rishi walks in with Inspector Pratap, who announces that Munna is already married.

episodesList.title: Episode 170
episodesList.summary: Munna realises that instead of Naina, he got married to Sunaina, who scolds him. Later, Indira and Rishi get married in public. Indira urges Sunaina to file a case against Munna.

episodesList.title: Episode 171
episodesList.summary: Munna asks Sunaina to forgive him. Dulari gives her explanation for getting Munna remarried, and Indira notices that everyone is buying it. Later, Indira and Rishi leave the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 172
episodesList.summary: Ishaan informs Indira that her family is celebrating. Rishi and Indira go to an under-construction building to spend the night. Later, Radhe takes them to Amma’s house.

episodesList.title: Episode 173
episodesList.summary: Dulari asks Mandira to vacate her room for the guests. Mandira gets teased by some of the guests, and Indira beats one of them up secretly. Dulari scolds Sunaina and Mandira.

episodesList.title: Episode 174
episodesList.summary: Indira bumps into a drug dealer, Girish. Girish hides the drugs in Indira’s room, but Ishaan finds them. Later, Girish agrees to share his profit from the drug sale with Dulari.

episodesList.title: Episode 175
episodesList.summary: Dulari mixes water in Seher’s milk. Indira secretly leaves a can of milk powder for Seher. The next day, Dulari gives Ishaan a bag full of drugs, which later, Munna carries.

episodesList.title: Episode 176
episodesList.summary: Chatwal tries to shoot Munna but stops. Meanwhile, Munna leaves the bag at a store where Rishi finds it. Indira insists Rishi open the bag, but Rishi loses it to Radhe.

episodesList.title: Episode 177
episodesList.summary: Indira scolds Ishaan for stealing money from his friend. Later, Ishaan goes missing, and Girish threatens Indira with killing Ishaan if he does not get the bag of drugs.

episodesList.title: Episode 178
episodesList.summary: Indira and her family save Ishaan from Girish. Dulari tries to escape, but Indira catches her. Later, Dulari fakes her death while Indira takes her to the cremation ground.

episodesList.title: Episode 179
episodesList.summary: Rishi urges to accompany Indira to collect her test reports, but Indira goes alone. The doctor asks Indira to take some tests. Indira receives her reports and is caught in turmoil.

episodesList.title: Episode 180
episodesList.summary: Indira learns she has 30 days to live but lies to her family. Indira brings Inder back home and vows to teach her family to lead a respectable life before she dies.

episodesList.title: Episode 181
episodesList.summary: Indira stops Rishi from buying an insurance policy. Indira individually tells Munna, Mandira and Inder that she will transfer her property in their names but on a condition.

episodesList.title: Episode 182
episodesList.summary: Indira scolds Rishi when he says that he will take care of their child. Munna comes home drunk, and Indira scolds him. Indira reprimands Inder for tampering with the grocery bill.

episodesList.title: Episode 183
episodesList.summary: Jhumpa gets furious to see Sharma family celebrating. Later, she fights with Kutumbh over Inder. Indira and her family go to see Munna perform in ‘Ramlila’, but he messes it up.

episodesList.title: Episode 184
episodesList.summary: Indira chooses a lottery ticket for Radhe. Inder beats up Jhumpa for contaminating the food in his shop. Meanwhile, Indira learns that Mandira cheated in her examination.

episodesList.title: Episode 185
episodesList.summary: Mandira tells everyone that Indira had promised her the property. Inder and Munna get upset, but Rishi scolds them. Later, Indira visits her doctor to talk about her chemotherapy.

episodesList.title: Episode 186
episodesList.summary: Rishi tells that he is keeping a fast on ‘Karwachauth’. Munna and Inder also keep a fast. Later, Rishi prays for Indira’s long life. Indira learns that she can donate her kidney.

episodesList.title: Episode 187
episodesList.summary: Rishi tells Indira his desire of living in a big family with kids and grandkids. Indira asks a matchmaker to find a bride for Rishi. Munna tells Rocky that Indira is dead.

episodesList.title: Episode 188
episodesList.summary: Indira meets her kidney recipient, a boy, and his mother. The boy’s father gives Indira a cheque but later takes it back. Later, Indira gets drunk and insults her family.

episodesList.title: Episode 189
episodesList.summary: Rishi scolds Indira for putting her unborn at risk. Indira’s family holds her commemoration, where they realise her worth in their lives while Indira secretly watches them.

episodesList.title: Episode 190
episodesList.summary: Indira ties a ‘rakhi’ on Munna. Rishi tells Indira about participating in a dance contest. Indira decides to repair her house after Seher has a near miss with a chunk of ceiling.

episodesList.title: Episode 191
episodesList.summary: Indira secretly practices for the dance competition, but Rishi scolds her. A family comes to see Rishi but Indira fends them off. Rishi finds Indira performing at the competition.

episodesList.title: Episode 192
episodesList.summary: Rishi wonders why Indira lied to him about her pregnancy. Indira asks her doctor to write a fitness certificate but he declines. Later, Rishi dances with Indira at the competition.

episodesList.title: Episode 193
episodesList.summary: Rishi meets the doctor from whom he believes Indira gets checked-up. The doctor assures him that Indira is fine. Later, she shows Indira a report with her name and address on it.

episodesList.title: Episode 194
episodesList.summary: Indira stops Kutumbh and Munna from aborting Mandira’s baby. Indira learns that Rishi got her disqualified from the competition and badmouths him to the competition manager.

episodesList.title: Episode 195
episodesList.summary: Shweta insists Rishi to take her to Indira. Rishi eavesdrops on Indira and Munna’s conversation and misunderstands it. Later, he finds out about Indira’s abortion and slaps her.

episodesList.title: Episode 196
episodesList.summary: Rishi confronts Indira for aborting their child. Later, Rishi informs Indira’s family about her abortion and leaves. Indira tells them that she lied about her pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Episode 197
episodesList.summary: Munna and Inder tie Rishi to a chair. Indira tells Rishi that he is free to go, but he stays. Munna and Inder buy a cow to sell its milk while Sunaina starts sewing clothes.

episodesList.title: Episode 198
episodesList.summary: Indira steals her medical file from Shweta’s desk. Sunaina shows Indira her first earnings. Meanwhile, Shweta learns about Indira’s illness and subsequently, so does Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 199
episodesList.summary: Amma gives Rishi a holy cloth. Rishi ties the cloth on Indira’s wrist and tends to her injury. Shweta advises Rishi against revealing to Indira about being privy to her illness.

episodesList.title: Episode 200
episodesList.summary: Shweta promises Rishi that she will help Indira. Later, Indira learns that Jazzy C has forfeited and that she can re-enter the competition. Indira tries to practice her dance but fails. Rishi arrives and dances with her. Munna confronts Manoj Chadda for following Mandira. Manoj explains that he needs Mandira’s help to thwart his parents’ efforts for his arranged marriage. Meanwhile, Shweta forbids Indira from participating in the competition and admits her in the hospital against her will.

episodesList.title: Episode 201
episodesList.summary: Hitler Didi is a Hindi drama television series starring Rati Pandey, Sumit Vats, Shruti Bisht and Rituraj Singh. At a very young age Indira Sharma becomes the bread winner of her family and takes up all the responsibilities. She comes across as a strict disciplinarian but is kind hearted. Indira falls in love with Rishi but faces challenges even in her love life.

episodesList.title: Episode 230
episodesList.summary: Indu gets excited to learn that Malik will stay at Sharma Niwas. Zaara calls Indu to tell her that her life is in danger. Zaara hears the sound of an explosion from Indu’s end and gets scared. Munna finds out that a gas cylinder has exploded. Indu finds a masked man ransacking her room but fails to catch him. It is revealed that Zaara’s suspension was fake, and she is tasked to go to Chandni Chowk to find a terrorist and protect Indu. Zaara leaves for Delhi, while Rishi clears Indira’s room.

episodesList.title: Episode 231
episodesList.summary: Indu suspects that Rishi is having an extra-marital affair. Shweta asks Rishi to hang a garland around Indira’s picture frame. Rishi hesitantly does so, but a blow of wind drops the garland. Later, Rishi sees Malik teaching Indu to ride a bicycle. Shweta wears Indira’s clothes and assures Rishi that she will try to take Indira’s place in his life. Rishi sees Indira in Shweta and was about to get intimate with her, but snaps out of it when he gets a call from Zaara, who has arrived in Delhi.

episodesList.title: Episode 232
episodesList.summary: Radhe sees Zaara and believes her to be Indira’s ghost. She asks Radhe the direction to Sharma Niwas, but he is unable to answer. Inder dresses up as a watchman and parades outside his house. Zaara meets Inder, who asks her to come home with him. Seher tells Zaara that Rishi took Indu to Bhopal for Indu’s cycle race. Inder tries to convince Kutumbh that he saw Indira. Indu, who is being watched by someone, asks Rishi to wish her luck, but Rishi hesitates. Later, Zaara arrives and calls Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 233
episodesList.summary: Zaara directs Rishi to spot her in the crowd, but he fails. The race commences, and Zaara chases after the cyclists. Some goons mingle with the race monitors and surround Indu to slow her down. Zaara tries to catch up with Indu. Rishi spots Zaara and goes after her. Meanwhile, a goon kicks Indu’s bike, and she lands on the edge of a bridge. Failing to hang for long, Indu falls, but Zaara catches her. Zaara carries Indu to Rishi and scolds him for being irresponsible, but he keeps looking at her.

episodesList.title: Episode 234
episodesList.summary: Rishi informs Shweta that Indira is alive. Shweta tries to reason with Rishi, but he remains adamant. Radhe tells Shweta that he saw Indira’s ghost. At the hospital, Rishi hugs Indu, which surprises her. Zaara arrives searching for Indu. Inder brings ‘kulfi’ for Zaara, but Shweta snaps at him. Later, Indu comes back home and suddenly faints. Shweta takes Indu to her clinic. Rishi tries to procure O-negative blood for Indu, while Zaara arrives at the clinic and offers to donate her

episodesList.title: Episode 235
episodesList.summary: Shweta is shocked to see Zaara, who offers to donate her blood to Indu. Shweta asks her to leave, but Zaara convinces Shweta and tells her that she is here to protect Indu. Shweta refuses Zaara’s help, while Zaara secretly hides Indu’s ‘Ganesh’ idol under her pillow. Inder spots Zaara and tries his best to convince her to come to his house. Zaara asks Inder to promise that he will protect Indu. Rishi confronts Shweta with the identity of the donor, to which she lies, but Inder mentions Zaara.

episodesList.title: Episode 236
episodesList.summary: Shweta tries to convince Inder that he did not see Indira, but Inder remains adamant. Rishi spots the ‘Ganesh’ idol that Zaara had hidden earlier under Indu’s pillow, and confronts Shweta. Later, Shweta finds Malik in Indu’s room and informs him that she is arranging a ‘Satyanarayan Puja’, a puja for the Hindu God, Vishnu. The next day, when Zaara walks towards Sharma Niwas, people in the neighbourhood stare at her. Rishi and the others are stunned to see Zaara once she enters the

episodesList.title: Episode 237
episodesList.summary: Munna gets excited to see Zaara, while Kutumbh embraces her, and Ishaan begs her not to leave again. When Rishi hugs Zaara, she pushes him away. Later, Shweta reveals Zaara’s true identity. Zaara says that she came to meet her husband, Malik. When Malik tries to take Zaara to his room, the others stop her. Inder gets emotional, and Zaara tries to console him. Meanwhile, Shweta learns that Indu has gained her consciousness back. Shweta asks everyone to sit for the ‘puja’, but they hesitate.

episodesList.title: Episode 238
episodesList.summary: Malik insists Zaara to reveal her mission, but she dismisses him. Malik tries to get intimate with Zaara but is interrupted when she receives a text from Rishi. Munna decides to tell Indu that Indira has returned. Shweta reasons with Munna and the others to accept the fact that Indira is dead and Zaara only resembles her. Later, Rishi tries to talk to Zaara but is interrupted by Indu, who is surprised to see Zaara. However, Shweta takes Indu away, while Rishi tries to get intimate with

episodesList.title: Episode 239
episodesList.summary: Malik is about slap Rishi, but Zaara stops him. Malik shows Rishi a video of his wedding ceremony. Rishi also shows Malik and Zaara a video of Indira, which shocks both of them. Later, Malik returns Indira’s photograph to Rishi. Rishi realises that Zaara is not Indira, while Shweta tells Rishi that Zaara’s presence in the house is not in Indu’s best interest. Later, Rishi apologises to Zaara and asks her to leave. Rishi also mentions that Indira died eight years ago, which shocks

episodesList.title: Episode 240
episodesList.summary: Zaara, who lost her memory in an accident at the same time as Indira’s death, wonders if there is any connection between the two, but Malik allays her doubts. Indu and Zaara come across Ishaan, who lost his Kabaddi trophy to some teenagers. Indu challenges the teenagers, but they throw mud in her eyes, and she faints. Zaara gives Indu blood. Rishi suggests a DNA test of Zaara and Indu. The next day, Indu wins the Kabaddi challenge, while Rishi learns that Zaara and Indu’s DNA reports

episodesList.title: Episode 241
episodesList.summary: Rishi, who was imagining that Zaara and Indu’s DNA reports matched, gets interrupted when the doctor hands him the reports. Shweta decides to leave when she sees Indu calling Zaara ‘Badi Hitler’ and joining her in ‘Namaaz’, an Islamic prayer. However, Shweta has a change of heart when Rishi reveals that the DNA reports did not match. Shweta apologises to Zaara for her past conduct and requests her to stay. Meanwhile, Munna advises Rishi to move on with his life, which he finally

episodesList.title: Episode 242
episodesList.summary: Rishi surprisingly jokes with Shweta in the morning. Later, Rishi and Zaara get drenched when Rishi tries to fix a leaking tap. Malik laughs it off, but Shweta warns Rishi to stay within his limits. At the breakfast table, Seher gives Munna Indu’s toy, while Rishi notices that Zaara likes the same food that Indira used to like. When a ‘Ramleela’ programme is announced in the locality, Rishi informs Indu that a performer, Vanraj, will be staying at Sharma Niwas. Elsewhere, Vanraj is

episodesList.title: Episode 243
episodesList.summary: Zaara goes to meet an undercover agent, but he does not show up. Zaara encounters Rishi, who insists her to come home with him, and she agrees. Malik questions about Zaara’s whereabouts, but Rishi lies to him. Indu finds a chip in her toy, but before Zaara could download its information on Ishaan’s laptop, the power supply goes out, and the laptop dies. Amidst the dark, a certain someone steals the chip. Meanwhile, an impostor of Vanraj comes to Sharma Niwas, and Zaara starts to question

episodesList.title: Episode 244
episodesList.summary: Vanraj’s impostor’s identity is confirmed on the internet, but Zaara remains suspicious. Zaara takes Ishaan’s laptop to Malik and notices an icon blink, but Malik dismisses it. Malik scolds Zaara for her growing closeness with Rishi. Later, upon Rishi’s insistence, Zaara closes her eyes to see whom she loves, and anxiously runs back to Malik to tell him that she is ready to move forward in their marital life. However, when Malik advances towards Zaara, she closes her eyes and sees Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 245
episodesList.summary: Zaara pushes Malik away when he tries to embrace her. Zaara receives a call and is threatened by an anonymous person. Later, Zaara finds out about a terror plot on ‘Dussera’, a Hindu festival, when she borrows Ishaan’s laptop. While Radhe and Inder fail to land a role in ‘Ramleela’, Indu gets the part of ‘Hanuman’, a Hindu God. Rishi persuades Zaara to reveal who she saw with her eyes closed, but she slaps him. Elsewhere, terrorists insert explosives inside a ‘Gada’, a mace.

episodesList.title: Episode 246
episodesList.summary: Rishi imagines himself and Zaara playing Ram and Sita, characters of Hindu epic 'Ramayan', respectively. Zaara asks everyone not to organise ‘Ramleela’. Munna narrates the script he has written for ‘Ramleela’ to Vanraj’s impostor. Meanwhile, Zaara gets an anonymous call for a rendezvous. Although Zaara infers it is a trap, she decides to go. Later, Rishi finds Zaara on the street and continuously insists on giving her a lift. Amidst this, Rishi gets shot, while Shweta encounters a bad omen.

episodesList.title: Episode 247
episodesList.summary: Zaara tends to a wounded Rishi, while Vanraj’s impostor arrives and introduces himself as Inspector Rudra. Meanwhile, Shweta and Indu pray for Rishi’s safety. Rudra has a shoot-out with other goons, while Zaara brings Rishi to an abandoned cottage, and takes out the bullet from Rishi’s chest. Rishi, believing that Zaara is Indira, asks her to confess her love for him. When Rishi’s body temperature drops, Zaara embraces him to transfer her body heat, while Malik arrives and misunderstands Zaara.

episodesList.title: Episode 248
episodesList.summary: Malik gets enraged to see Zaara and Rishi together and runs back to Sharma Niwas. Shweta asks Malik if he suspects their spouses are cheating on them, but he dismisses her. Zaara informs Rishi about the impending terror attacks and asks him to promise to keep it a secret, to which he agrees. Malik calls Meher to complain about Zaara. When Zaara comes back home, Malik beats her with a belt to force out a confession regarding her whereabouts. Rishi intervenes saying Zaara was with him.

episodesList.title: Episode 249
episodesList.summary: Rishi reveals to Malik that Zaara was with him, and argues that Zaara is innocent of any wrongdoing. Zaara scolds Rishi for interfering in her personal life. Zaara reveals to Malik that she is in Delhi on a secret mission. Later, Zaara interrogates the terrorist that Rudra captured, and learns that the mastermind of the terror plot goes by the code name of Commander Sarfarosh. Elsewhere, Commander Sarfarosh is seen confronting one of his men for failing to kill Zaara.

episodesList.title: Episode 250
episodesList.summary: Malik narrates how he orchestrated his entry into Sharma Niwas to retrieve the chip from Indu, and vows that he will make his mission successful no matter the cost. Later, a man switches Indu’s ‘Gada’ with another one, in which Zaara suspects that there is a bomb. Zaara tells everyone to stop the ‘Ramleela’, much to everyone’s displeasure. The bomb squad arrives and confirms that there is no bomb inside the ‘Gada’. Shweta insults Zaara for being insensitive towards her religious feelings.

episodesList.title: Episode 251
episodesList.summary: The ‘Ramleela’ committee forbids Zaara from entering the premises. Zaara reveals to Malik about the threat of a terror attack and also the name of its mastermind. Malik tells Zaara that he wants to help her. Later, Indu tells Zaara that she believes her, and wants to help. Meanwhile, Rishi decides to play Ram to keep an eye on anything suspicious, and Shweta agrees to play Sita. While Zaara wonders about the location of the bomb, the terrorists plant the bomb in a garland.

episodesList.title: Episode 252
episodesList.summary: Zaara, accompanied by Indu, wonders how she will get into ‘Ramleela’. Rishi joins them and points towards Radhe, who is wearing a costume of 'Jambavan', a bear in Ramayan. Meanwhile, Shweta arrives and takes Indu away from Rishi and Zaara. Later at Shweta’s clinic, Zaara tends to Rishi’s wound, while Shweta arrives and badmouths Zaara. When Rishi scolds Shweta, Zaara snaps at him. Later, Malik enters the ‘Ramleela’ premises dressed up as Valmiki, a sage in Ramayan, with a bag of garlands.

episodesList.title: Episode 253
episodesList.summary: Zaara, wearing Radhe’s 'Jambavan' costume, enters the ‘Ramilia’ premises. Zaara and Rishi search for the bomb in different rooms. Meanwhile, Malik, dressed as Valmiki, enters the room that Zaara is in, and hangs a garland. When Zaara chases Malik, Shweta and her companions capture Zaara and lock her up in a room. Inder and Meher start to entertain the audience when they accidentally get on the stage. Later, Munna and Savita take the stage, while Malik arrives holding a remote control.

episodesList.title: Episode 254
episodesList.summary: When Munna and Savita try to recreate Raavan’s wife, Mandodari’s ‘Swayamvar’, an ancient Indian tradition of choosing a groom among many suitors, Savita’s father, Kanhayialal, interrupts the show. Later, Rishi and Shweta, as Ram and Sita, take the stage, while Zaara escapes with Indu’s help. Zaara tries to stop Shweta from putting a garland on Rishi but fails. She finds a bomb in the garland and shares the garland with Rishi. Malik remotely activates the bomb, while Zaara tries to defuse it.

episodesList.title: Episode 255
episodesList.summary: When Zaara fails to defuse the bomb, the bomb disposal squad takes Zaara and Rishi near a cliff. A squad officer declares that Rishi is safe to go, but he refuses to leave Zaara. When Indu insists Rishi to come with her, he agrees. However, Rishi runs back to Zaara when it becomes imminent that the bomb would explode. To make Rishi go away, Zaara accepts that she saw Rishi’s face when she closed her eyes, but Rishi takes Zaara’s hand and jumps off the cliff, and the bomb explodes.

episodesList.title: Episode 256
episodesList.summary: The police inform Shweta that they cannot find Rishi, which makes Shweta anxious, and she faints. Elsewhere, Rishi tells Zaara how they survived the explosion. Rishi sees a masked man shooting at Zaara, and manages to save her. Zaara chases the masked man and ultimately shoots at his leg, but the man escapes. When Rishi and Zaara come back to Sharma Niwas, Indu confronts Rishi for giving Zaara more importance than her. Later, Rishi figures out that Malik was the masked

episodesList.title: Episode 257
episodesList.summary: Rishi informs Zaara that Malik is the masked man whom she shot, but she disbelieves Rishi. When Malik arrives, Zaara checks both of his legs but finds no sign of a wound on either of his legs. Later, when Rishi notices red-coloured water coming out of the bathroom, where Malik is drawing a bath, he shows it to Zaara. Zaara asks Malik about it, but he points towards Shweta, who has seen washing plates with red dye. Later, Rishi and Malik tell their respective spouses that they are divorcing

episodesList.title: Episode 258
episodesList.summary: Zaara begs Malik to reconsider his decision to divorce her, to which Malik presents two conditions. When Rishi sees Zaara dropping to Malik’s feet, he asks her to divorce Malik. Zaara insults Rishi for trying to create a wedge in her marriage, but Shweta scolds Zaara for misbehaving with Rishi. Zaara decides to leave Sharma Niwas, but Malik demands that she stays and remains loyal to him. Shweta asks Rishi to forget Zaara to honour Indira’s memory, but he refutes Shweta’s logic.

episodesList.title: Episode 259
episodesList.summary: Zaara secretly watches a drunk Rishi and Munna talk about women. When Rishi catches Zaara alone and kisses her, she does not resist. Rishi challenges Zaara that she will confess her love for him within 24 hours. The next day, Zaara gets jealous when Rishi puts bangles on Shweta’s wrist. Later, Zaara buys a dress of Rishi’s choice. The same evening, Zaara frets on seeing Shweta and Rishi perform the rituals of ‘Karwachauth’, an Indian tradition where a wife prays for her husband’s long

episodesList.title: Episode 260
episodesList.summary: Zaara imagines interrupting Rishi and Shweta’s ‘Karwachauth’ ceremony but snaps out of it. Upon learning Rishi’s challenge to Zaara, Munna and Rudra go to Shweta’s clinic to fetch sleeping pills. Unbeknownst to them, Malik, who was nursing his wound in the clinic, gets locked in when they leave. Munna mixes the pills in his family members’ milk, while Zaara saves Rishi from shooting himself with a gun that he thought was empty. Zaara runs to a ‘Dargah’ and confesses that she loves Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 261
episodesList.summary: Rishi and Zaara share a moment when Rishi arrives at the ‘Dargah’, and they tie holy threads on each other’s wrists. While having tea, Rishi and Zaara share how agonising the past eight years have been for them. Zaara worries about explaining themselves to their families, especially Indu. She fears that Indu will reject her, but Rishi, confident that Zaara is Indira, asks her to promise that she will try to win over Indu. Later, Rishi mistakes Shweta for Zaara, and confesses his love for

episodesList.title: Episode 262
episodesList.summary: Shweta crosses words with Rishi, when he accidentally confesses his love for Zaara. Later, Munna, Rishi and Inder go to Savita’s house with Munna’s marriage proposal, but they are shocked to learn Kanhayia Lal is Savita’s husband.
