Malik secretly watches Shweta consuming sleeping pills, while Indu cuts up Zaara’s clothes. Shweta faints and when Indu wakes her up, she confesses to consuming the pills. Rishi is not convinced and accuses her of emotional blackmail. Indu confronts Rishi about

episodesList.title: Episode 263
episodesList.summary: Rishi suggests taking Shweta to a hospital, while Malik comes with a doctor, who knows Shweta did not consume the sleeping pills, but tells everyone to take care of her anyway. Shweta thanks Malik for his help, who gives her the pills she dropped in her clinic. Rishi searches for the sleeping pills in Shweta’s clinic, while Zaara arrives and finds a button and a dead skin on the floor. Indu hits Zaara with a pebble, when she finds Zaara and Rishi getting intimate, and tells everyone about

episodesList.title: Episode 264
episodesList.summary: Rishi confronts Shweta when she accidentally drops the sleeping pills, but Malik gives an excuse. Zaara promises Indu that no one will come between her and Shweta. Malik embraces Zaara, who notices that Malik’s ‘Kurta’, an Indian attire, is missing a button exactly like the one she found in Shweta’s clinic. Zaara starts to suspect Malik to be the masked man. Later, Malik tries to confront Rishi for calling Zaara, but she stops Malik and intentionally squeezes his leg, which starts to bleed.

episodesList.title: Episode 265
episodesList.summary: Zaara notices Rishi approaching her room, and tells him to leave, while Malik wipes off the blood that had trickled onto the floor. Zaara sees Malik treating his wounded leg in the bathroom, and asks him to open the door, but Malik pours acid on his wound. A drunk Munna and Rishi kidnap Savita, while Radhe and Rudra kidnap Kanhaiya Lal. Later, the four of them meet, and leave Kanhaiya Lal on the street, while taking Savita with them. Zaara and Meher take Malik to Shweta for his dressing.

episodesList.title: Episode 266
episodesList.summary: Munna, Rishi, Rudra and Radhe sneak Savita into Sharma Niwas in a bag. Later, Zaara tells Rishi that he was right about Malik being a terrorist. Zaara finds that her clothes have been cut and infers it to be Indu’s doing. Zaara stitches the dress she bought upon Rishi’s choice. The next day, Indu crosses words with Zaara, and later, Kanhayialal arrives with the police to find Savita. Zaara vouches for Rishi and the others of any wrongdoing, but Indu emerges with

episodesList.title: Episode 267
episodesList.summary: Zaara asks Rishi and Munna if they kidnapped Savita, but they deny it. When Indu starts misbehaving with Rishi, Zaara slaps her. Rishi stops Shweta from slapping Zaara and blames Shweta for poisoning Indu’s mind against him. Savita admits that Rishi and Munna abducted her, and the police take them away along with Radhe. Later, Kutumbh, Meher and Inder also get arrested. Zaara finds Indu meeting a lawyer, Satyam, whom Indu asks to file a petition in court, severing her ties with Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 268
episodesList.summary: The police van that was taking Munna and his family to the jail crashes, and the driver escapes. Rishi and Munna drive the van to the police station. Meanwhile, Satyam asks Indu about her mother’s name, to which Zaara accidentally names Indira. Indu gets enraged and breaks Satyam’s name plate on her way out. Inder creates a ruckus in the jail, when he brings explosives mistaking them for firecrackers. Later, Indu asks Shweta about Indira’s identity, to which Shweta says that Indira was a

episodesList.title: Episode 269
episodesList.summary: Zaara bails out Rishi and the others. Savita reveals that she is not the real wife of Kanhaiya Lal. Kutumbh and Inder agree to get Munna married to Savita. Meanwhile, Malik and Shweta celebrate ‘Diwali’, the Hindu festival of lights, with Seher and Indu. When a rocket firecracker accidentally burns Indira’s wardrobe, Indira’s picture frame gets damaged. Rishi demands an explanation from Shweta, while Indu asks why Shweta is referring to Zaara’s picture as Indira’s.

episodesList.title: Episode 270
episodesList.summary: When Rishi is about to reveal the true identity of Indira to Indu, Zaara intervenes saying that Indira was a tenant of Sharma Niwas. Later, Zaara checks Malik’s laptop for any data on his terror activities, but finds none, while Malik is seen holding a CD. The next day, Ishaan remains upset about Munna getting remarried, while Zaara asks Seher to give Savita a chance. Elsewhere, Indu learns that Indira was the owner of Sharma Niwas, while Satyam asks Indu to acquire Zaara’s

episodesList.title: Episode 271
episodesList.summary: Indu recalls the time Rishi misbehaved with her, while Rishi buys a dress for Indu. Rishi shows the dress to Zaara, who appreciates it. Indu bumps into Zaara and wonders if Zaara is Indira, but eventually snaps out of it. Rudra asks Zaara to get Malik’s calls tracked. Munna requests Zaara to apply turmeric on him, as a part of the wedding ritual, to which Zaara obliges. Indu offers Zaara a glass of cold drink and smartly gets her fingerprints on it. Later, Indu takes the glass to Satyam.

episodesList.title: Episode 272
episodesList.summary: Indu receives a divine sign indicating that Zaara is not her mother. Back at Sharma Niwas, Inder and Munna are elated as they encounter an omen that confirms that Zaara is Indira. Malik calls his aide to meet him and collect his CD, while Rudra informs Zaara something in secret. Afterwards, Munna mixes alcohol in soft drinks and asks Inder to distribute it amongst Kutumbh’s friends, but Inder makes Savita drink all of it. Meanwhile, Indu asks Shweta to braid her hair, but Shweta refuses.

episodesList.title: Episode 273
episodesList.summary: Zaara secretly helps Rishi braid Indu’s hair. Later, Zaara meets her senior officer, who rebukes her for delaying Malik’s arrest. Meher asks Inder to play some entertaining songs, and Inder fetches Malik’s CD. Everyone gets confused when they start to hear Commander Sarfarosh’s fiery speeches on the stereo. Malik tries to get the CD but becomes alert when he sees Zaara. Later, Malik threatens Inder to hand the CD to him. Inder finds the CD and announces it to Malik in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 274
episodesList.summary: Inder plays a song, to which Seher dances. Later, Savita pushes Seher and dances with Inder and other guests. Seher intentionally drops Savita, who has a fall out with Ishaan. Shweta manages the situation and arranges ‘Antakshari’, an Indian musical game, where Zaara sings and dances. Afterwards, Rishi dances with Zaara, which upsets Shweta. Meanwhile, Malik’s superior instructs him to blow up Sharma Niwas, after Malik tells him that he cannot find the CD, to which Malik

episodesList.title: Episode 275
episodesList.summary: Malik starts to beat Zaara when he finds Rishi kissing Zaara’s forehead. However, Zaara beats Malik for being a traitor to his country and divorces him. Zaara fails to stop Malik from leaving, as she does not have a warrant against him. Meanwhile, Munna secretly meets Savita in a room, while Kutumbh knocks at the door. Shweta confronts Zaara when she sees Rishi holding Zaara’s hand, but Rishi defends himself. Later, Zaara tells Rishi that she fears Malik will find the CD before she does.

episodesList.title: Episode 276
episodesList.summary: Zaara asks Rudra to be alert of Malik’s movements. Inder is about to reveal to Zaara where Malik’s CD is but decides against it when Malik threatens him. Zaara calls her senior to send the police to Sharma Niwas. Later, Munna arrives with the wedding procession, but the ceremony is intervened by a cleric, who compels Zaara to reveal why she is divorcing Malik, but Zaara does not give a straight answer. Meanwhile, Inder finds Malik’s CD and plays it on the stereo.

episodesList.title: Episode 277
episodesList.summary: Malik points a gun at Zaara, but Rishi manages to surprise Malik. However, Malik flees, and Rishi makes a futile attempt to stop him. Later, Zaara prepares to kill Malik, but Malik argues that he alone knows Zaara’s past. Zaara remains adamant, but her senior intervenes, while Malik again escapes. Rishi confidently tells Zaara that she is Indira, while Satyam tells Indu that Zaara and Indira’s thumb impressions do not match. Elsewhere in Pakistan, Indira’s look-alike is seen in a mental asylum.

episodesList.title: Episode 278
episodesList.summary: Indu learns that Indira died eight years ago. Zaara finds that Munna and the others nabbed Malik’s goons. Indu asks Shweta to swear that Indira is not her mother, so Shweta obliges. Later, Indu and Seher tie Savita and lock her up in a bathroom. The next day, a minister arrives to congratulate Munna and his family. The minister talks about a programme at India-Pakistan border and agrees to let Indu participate in it. Meanwhile, Indira’s look-alike learns that she will be released.

episodesList.title: Episode 279
episodesList.summary: Shweta scolds Rishi for allowing Indu to go to Attari for the peace programme, but Rishi defends his decision. Zaara pays the water bill for Sharma Niwas, which makes Shweta jealous. Shweta asks Zaara questions about Indira’s life that disturb Zaara. Zaara asks Rishi if he can love her if it turns out that she is not Indira, to which Rishi fails to answer. Indu eavesdrops on Munna and Savita’s conversation and learns that Indira is her biological mother. Indu confronts Shweta for lying to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 280
episodesList.summary: Rishi lies to Indu saying that he asked Shweta not to reveal Indira’s identity to her. Indu apologises to Shweta after Zaara coaxes her. Indu’s family wishes her luck for the journey, while Zaara gives Indu a gift. Later, Shweta and Rishi take Indu to the bus-stop, where Shweta asks Rishi why he lied to Indu. He replies that he does not want Indu to hate Shweta. Shweta hides a note inside Indu’s copy, while Indira’s look-alike is seen travelling to Wagah border.

episodesList.title: Episode 281
episodesList.summary: Zaara’s senior instructs her to come to Mumbai to file her report. Zaara reads a letter from Shweta, where Shweta reveals that she is leaving Sharma Niwas and also challenges Zaara to take Indira’s place. Rishi finds the letter Shweta wrote for him, and learns that she has signed the divorce papers. Meanwhile, Indu and Indira’s look-alike reaches Attari. During her performance, Indu reads Shweta’s letter and learns that Shweta has left. Indu sings an emotional song, while Rishi proposes to Zaara.

episodesList.title: Episode 282
episodesList.summary: Indira’s look-alike starts to clap at the end of Indu’s performance, but Indu fails to notice her. Meanwhile, Zaara asks Rishi for some time to think about her future, and leaves for Mumbai. Savita overhears Zaara and Rishi’s conversation and tells Munna that Zaara may be interested in acquiring Sharma Niwas. Later, Savita convinces Kutumbh that Zaara has nefarious intentions regarding the Sharma family, and Indu may especially get affected. Elsewhere, Indu finally meets Indira’s look-alike.

episodesList.title: Episode 283
episodesList.summary: Indu chases the bus that Indira’s look-alike is in but fails to stop it. Kutumbh confronts Rishi for not informing her about his decision to marry Zaara. Rishi argues that Zaara will prove to be as responsible as Indira was towards her family, to which Kutumbh agrees, and decides to support Rishi’s decision. Rishi calls Indu, who asks him if Indira is really dead. Later, after several futile attempts, Indu manages to surprise her teacher, and gets on the bus that Indira’s look-alike is in.

episodesList.title: Episode 284
episodesList.summary: Rishi and the others learn from Kutumbh that Indu is missing. Savita insults Rishi for prioritising Zaara over Indu. Seher crosses words with Savita, for which Savita tries to slap Seher, but Ishaan stops her. Later, Munna slaps Ishaan, but Rishi intervenes. Ishaan requests Rishi to inform Indu before marrying Zaara. Meanwhile, Indu goes to a women’s shelter in Bhatinda, where Indu hopes to find Indira’s look-alike but learns that she has been transferred to a women’s shelter in Delhi.

episodesList.title: Episode 285
episodesList.summary: Indu’s teacher finds her in Bhatinda, and just then Rishi calls and asks Indu for a second chance to prove himself as a good father. Rishi convinces Munna to apologise to Ishaan and Seher, but Savita smartly distracts Munna. Indu returns to Delhi and learns from Savita that Rishi intends to marry Zaara. Rishi shows Indu video recordings of Indira and tells her that Zaara is worthy of taking Indira’s place. Indu refuses to accept Zaara as her mother and also reveals that Indira is alive.

episodesList.title: Episode 286
episodesList.summary: Rishi and the others watch Zaara on the television being felicitated by the government. However, a bomb explodes at the ceremony, and Rishi decides to leave for Mumbai. Meanwhile, Indu takes Satyam to the women’s shelter and learns that Indira’s look-alike and Indira are the same people. Later, Indu takes Indira to Chandni Chowk, and Indira gets into Sharma Niwas while trying to catch a chicken. Meanwhile, Rishi reaches Mumbai and is relieved to find Zaara alive. Rishi asks Zaara to marry him.

episodesList.title: Episode 287
episodesList.summary: Indira runs around Sharma Niwas trying to catch the chicken. Kutumbh and the others, thinking that a thief has entered the house, try to catch Indira, but are surprised to see her. Kutumbh declares Indira an impostor and throws her out of the house, while Indu tries to defend Indira. Kutumbh tells her family that to get their hands on Zaara’s prize money, the woman (Indira) cannot be allowed to enter the house. Meanwhile, Zaara avoids answering to Rishi’s marriage proposal.

episodesList.title: Episode 288
episodesList.summary: Munna remains doubtful that the woman Kutumbh threw out of the house may be Indira. Indu secretly steals food and the chicken and brings it to Indira. Later, Indu arranges a place for Indira to sleep. The next morning, Indu calls Rishi from a telephone booth. Meanwhile, Rishi and Zaara marry at a registrar’s office. Indu makes Indira speak to Rishi, but Indira struggles to take Rishi’s name. Later, Rishi calls at Sharma Niwas, where Kutumbh stops Munna from revealing about

episodesList.title: Episode 289
episodesList.summary: When Indira creates a ruckus in her neighbourhood, the neighbours demand Kutumbh to compensate for the damages, but Kutumbh refuses and calls a mental asylum to take Indira away. Indu tries to defend Indira, but Savita locks Indu in a room. Later, as Indira is forcefully taken into a van, she accidentally drops her bag. Meanwhile, Rishi returns to Delhi with Zaara and buys her a ‘saree’, an Indian attire. Indira sees Rishi on the street and runs towards him, but he fails to see her face.

episodesList.title: Episode 290
episodesList.summary: Zaara goes to Radhe’s house to dress up and waits for Rishi and Indu to take her to Sharma Niwas. Meanwhile, Rishi finds Indira’s bag in which he sees Indira’s ‘saree’ and her bangles and asks Kutumbh about it. Later, Rishi speaks to Indu, who narrates to him how she found Indira and also shows him Indira’s thumb impression. Rishi reaches the mental hospital, where Indira is about to receive shock therapy. Meanwhile, Rudra comes to Zaara and compliments her upon seeing her in a ‘saree’.

episodesList.title: Episode 291
episodesList.summary: Rishi finds Indira ready to undergo shock therapy. However, the doctors halt the treatment when they discover that Indira has a brain tumour. Indira sees Rishi and faints. Later, Rishi confesses to Indira that he has fallen in love with Zaara. When Indira wakes up, she shares a joyous moment with Rishi. Savita informs Indu that Rishi has married Zaara, while Rishi brings Indira to Sharma Niwas. Rishi scolds Kutumbh for refusing to recognise Indira, while Zaara watches them from afar.

episodesList.title: Episode 292
episodesList.summary: Zaara lies to Kutumbh that she and Rishi did not marry. Savita questions Indira's survival, to which Inder reveals that Munna may know, as he was the last one to leave the cremation ground the day Indira died. Later, Munna reveals to Zaara that on that fateful day, Rishi fainted, and was taken to the hospital, while he went for a drink when it started to rain and did not return to collect Indira’s ashes. Zaara tells Rishi that she wants to confirm Indira’s identity.

episodesList.title: Episode 293
episodesList.summary: Kutumbh is disgusted to see Indira urinate on the staircase, but Rishi cleans it up. Zaara tells everyone that she solved the mystery of Indira's survival. Zaara explains that Shweta declared Indira dead when Indira temporarily stopped breathing. Later, Indira escaped to a village from the cremation ground with burns on her arm, where she was treated along with another man who was also wounded and afterwards, they went missing. Zaara asks everyone to rejoice but she herself breaks down.

episodesList.title: Episode 294
episodesList.summary: Indira drags Rishi away when he goes to console a weeping Zaara. Kutumbh comforts Zaara, and later, shares her fear of losing Zaara with Munna and Savita. Meanwhile, Zaara sees Indu and Indira sleeping in Rishi’s bedroom and gets upset. Zaara accuses Rishi of loving her only because he saw Indira in her. However, Rishi confesses to Zaara that he loves her, and Indira is solely his responsibility now. Rishi begs Zaara not to leave him and asks for a chance to prove his love to

episodesList.title: Episode 295
episodesList.summary: Zaara sees Indira toying with her ‘mangalsutra’, a nuptial chain worn by Indian women, and snatches it from her. Zaara demands that Rishi take Indira to a mental hospital. Rishi opposes the idea at first, but later gives in when Zaara gives him an ultimatum. Rishi asks Munna and Kutumbh not to disclose his decision to Indu. The next day, Kutumbh sends Indu and Seher with Rudra to dance classes, while Rishi tells Indira that he is taking her to a circus.

episodesList.title: Episode 296
episodesList.summary: Rishi rebukes Indira for asking for his help to draw a bath. Munna insists on depositing Zaara’s cheque at the bank, to which Zaara agrees. Indira playfully opens the bathroom tap and ends up flooding the house. Kutumbh demands that Rishi take Indira to the mental hospital, to which Rishi obliges. Later, Kutumbh lies to Indu about Indira's whereabouts. Rishi brings Indira back when he sees the ward boy intimidate Indira. Zaara accepts Rishi's challenge of taking Indira to the hospital herself.

episodesList.title: Episode 297
episodesList.summary: Munna asks Rishi to jump with him to vent out Rishi’s frustration with life. Zaara gets a call to catch a group of smugglers when Indira playfully throws Zaara’s phone out of the auto-rickshaw. Rishi feels guilty when Indu asks him Indira’s whereabouts. Zaara takes Indira to the police station, where Rudra and the others are surprised to see Indira. Indira notices Zaara keeping her ‘mangalsutra’ in her pocket. Later, Zaara takes Indira along with the rest of the force to apprehend the

episodesList.title: Episode 298
episodesList.summary: Zaara and the police engage in a shootout with the smugglers. Amidst the commotion, Zaara loses her ‘mangalsutra’ which Indira notices and runs to fetch it. A goon holds a gun to Indira to leverage his escape, but Zaara employs a clever idea and manages to save Indira. Later, Zaara takes Indira to the mental hospital where incidentally, Rishi calls and requests Zaara to do right with Indira. Indu learns from Savita about Zaara taking Indira to the mental hospital and confronts Rishi about

episodesList.title: Episode 299
episodesList.summary: Indu forces Rishi to promise her that he will not marry Zaara, to which he agrees. Zaara gives her cheque to a doctor at the mental hospital to use it for Indira’s treatment. Indira’s childish antics make Zaara emotional, and she apologises to Indira for leaving her at the hospital. Indira returns Zaara’s ‘mangalsutra’, which further aggravates Zaara's guilt. When Zaara arrives at Sharma Niwas without Indira, Indu scolds her and faints, while Indira also faints after hitting her head on a

episodesList.title: Episode 300
episodesList.summary: Rishi sarcastically insults Zaara for admitting Indira at the mental hospital. Zaara goes to a ‘Dargah’, where the cleric advises her to rectify her mistake. At the hospital, Indira’s doctor takes blood from Indira to sell it and plans to send her to an illegal research centre. Inder arrives at the hospital and is taken into a van along with Indira and other patients. After Zaara informs Rishi that she will bring Indira back, Zaara arrives at the hospital, while Indu’s condition deteriorates.

episodesList.title: Episode 301
episodesList.summary: After forcing the doctor to reveal Indira's whereabouts, Zaara chases after the van which has Indira. Rishi informs Zaara about Indu’s deteriorating health and manages to get a lift to the hospital. Later, Savita calls Zaara to inform her about the police commissioner's party. Meanwhile, the van driver and his companions attempt to rape Indira, but Inder, Indira, and the other patients beat up the miscreants. Later, Zaara arrives at the spot and panics upon learning that Indira has escaped.

episodesList.title: Episode 302
episodesList.summary: Zaara arrives at the hospital dressed as Indira and tries to wake Indu up. Meanwhile, Inder, Indira, and the other patients sneak into the police commissioner’s New Year party dressed as policemen and eat the cake. Munna and Savita arrive at the party, where Munna unknowingly insults the police commissioner. Elsewhere, Zaara hugs Indu when she wakes up, while Rishi, mistaking Zaara for Indira, confides in her that he will choose his responsibility over love if given a choice.

episodesList.title: Episode 303
episodesList.summary: Rishi, who figures out that Zaara is posing as Indira, confronts Zaara regarding Indira’s whereabouts and slaps her. Indu, who still mistakes Zaara for Indira, makes Rishi apologise to Zaara. Rudra informs Rishi that Indira is at the police commissioner’s party who wants to send Indira to the mental hospital. Indu brings Indira (Zaara) to Sharma Niwas, where Kutumbh badmouths Indira, but Indu stands up for her. Later, Indu goes to Indira’s room, where Zaara is talking to Indira’s

episodesList.title: Episode 304
episodesList.summary: Zaara (dressed as Indira) stops Indu from eating the food that Kutumbh intentionally served knowing it had a lizard in it. Later, Indira comes into the room, and Rishi explains to Indu that Zaara had to pose as Indira to save her life. However, Indu vehemently insults Zaara, after which Zaara discloses that she is married to Rishi. Rishi denies it for Indu’s sake but accepts Zaara’s argument that Indira is legally not his wife anymore as she's been gone for more than seven

episodesList.title: Episode 305
episodesList.summary: Zaara is heartbroken that Rishi denied his marriage with her. Kutumbh argues that Zaara made a mistake by bringing Indira back to Sharma Niwas, but Zaara dismisses Kutumbh. The next day, Savita intentionally puts Indira’s hand in hot water, for which Rishi warns her. Indu expresses to Rishi her desire to get him married to Indira, while Rishi tries to stop Zaara from leaving. Kutumbh also tries to stop Zaara, after Savita shows her Rishi and Zaara’s marriage certificate, but Zaara leaves.

episodesList.title: Episode 306
episodesList.summary: The Sharma family partakes in the welcoming ceremony of a married Rishi and Zaara. Kutumbh asks Zaara to kick a pot full of rice as a ritual before entering the house. Indira playfully kicks the pot before Zaara does, which annoys Kutumbh and Meher. When Indira steps on Zaara’s dress while dancing, Rishi asks Indu to take Indira away. Later, Rishi lets Zaara win a ritualistic post-wedding game, after which Zaara goes to Rishi’s room, but is surprised to find Indu and Indira on the bed.

episodesList.title: Episode 307
episodesList.summary: Indu reminds Zaara that she agreed to Zaara's marriage with Rishi on the condition that Zaara will help her revive Indira’s memory. The next day, Indira is frantic seeing Zaara dressed up the way she used to. Later, when Indira ends up annoying Kutumbh, she chases after Indira with a knife, but Indira manages to snatch it. Zaara intervenes and sustains a cut. Later, a doctor advises Rishi to establish physical relations with Indira in order to revive Indira's

episodesList.title: Episode 308
episodesList.summary: Kutumbh asks Inder to massage her legs, while Indu overhears the doctor’s advice to Rishi about establishing physical relations with Indira. Later, Kutumbh dreams of killing Indira and unknowingly assaults Inder, but Rishi snaps her out of it. Meanwhile, after a futile attempt to learn the meaning of a physical relationship from Munna and Savita, Indu asks Rishi about it. Rishi, in Zaara’s presence, promises Indu that he will go to any extent to revive Indira’s memory.

episodesList.title: Episode 309
episodesList.summary: Indira is scared to see Rishi lying on the parapet. When Rishi falls, Indira starts to hit Savita. Rishi emerges unscathed, while Kutumbh, Munna, Savita, and Meher demand Rishi to throw Indira out. On Radhe’s suggestion, Munna, Savita, and Kutumbh go to a godwoman Guru Ma to seek help for Indira, but Munna and Kutumbh are stunned to see Guru Ma’s resemblance with Sunaina. Indira gets frightened when Indu lights a candle, while Rishi gets an idea when Inder gives him some unsolicited

episodesList.title: Episode 310
episodesList.summary: Savita, Kutumbh and Munna bring Guru Ma to Sharma Niwas. Indira is excited to see Guru Ma who in turn is stunned to see Zaara. Later, Kutumbh and Munna force Indira to sit for a ‘Yajna’, a fire sacrifice, but she gets petrified after seeing the fire. Zaara and Indu try to stop the ‘Yajna’, but Savita and Meher convince Zaara otherwise. In the meantime, Indira faints while Rishi arrives and scolds everyone. He announces that everyone has to take care of Indira as she is the owner of the

episodesList.title: Episode 311
episodesList.summary: Indira’s family gets shocked to learn that Rishi has transferred the property to Indira. Indira panics upon seeing Guru Ma and pushes Seher. Kutumbh snaps at Rishi saying that he should leave Sharma Niwas, but Rishi argues that he will stay until Indira recovers from her illness. Savita challenges Rishi to establish physical relations with Indira, to which Rishi agrees while Zaara is devastated to hear it. Later, Savita and Kutumbh consider killing Indira while Munna is appalled at the

episodesList.title: Episode 312
episodesList.summary: Meher tries to convince Zaara not to trust Rishi, but Zaara dismisses her. However, Zaara is devastated to find Rishi and Indira in a compromising position. Zaara threatens that she will kill anyone who tries to come between her and Rishi. Meanwhile, Indu brings flowers, and Zaara misunderstands that Rishi is preparing for his wedding night with Indira. Zaara tells Rishi that she will look forward to celebrating her wedding night with him, while Kutumbh and Savita plot a strategy to kill

episodesList.title: Episode 313
episodesList.summary: Zaara prepares to celebrate her wedding night with Rishi, while Indu and Seher dress up Indira as well. Indu tricks Rishi into mistaking Indira for Zaara, while Zaara is devastated to see Rishi taking Indira to her room. Later, a goon dressed in black hits Rishi on the head and kidnaps Indira. When Rishi wakes up, Indu reveals to him her trick, while Inder informs Rishi about his futile attempt to catch the goon. Inder further adds to the mystery when he reveals that he saw Zaara at the scene.

episodesList.title: Episode 314
episodesList.summary: Zaara vehemently defends herself and blames Indira’s family, when Inder indicates that Zaara maybe Indira’s kidnapper. Later, Kutumbh and Savita exchange words with each other, while Rishi asks Zaara if she had any involvement in Indira’s abduction. When the police search Zaara’s room for clues, Rishi finds a pair of white shoes, similar to the ones Inder saw the kidnapper wear. Rishi infers Zaara to be the kidnapper and forces her to reveal Indira’s whereabouts, but the police take Zaara away.

episodesList.title: Episode 315
episodesList.summary: Indira is kept in a secret room. Later, Rishi receives a letter from the kidnapper, demanding the property papers of Sharma Niwas as ransom. Rishi realises that Zaara is innocent, while Guru Ma reveals Savita to be the real culprit. However, Savita escapes before Rishi could confront her. Later, Rishi posts Zaara’s bail, while she promises to find Indira. Meanwhile, Savita is seen intimidating Indira but shuts Indira’s mouth when she hears Rishi’s voice.

episodesList.title: Episode 316
episodesList.summary: Rishi tries to convince Zaara that he can feebly hear Indira’s cries, but Zaara dismisses his claim. Later, Zaara kills Savita, who was struggling to keep Indira from screaming. Zaara reveals to Indira that she wants to kill her, and narrates how she colluded with Savita to plan Indira’s kidnapping. Zaara justifies her intention of killing Indira by stating that she cannot have a life with Rishi as long as Indira lives, while Indira is petrified to hear Zaara’s

episodesList.title: Episode 317
episodesList.summary: Zaara ties Indira to a chair and hides Savita’s body inside a masonry cubicle. Meanwhile, Rishi decides to give the property papers of Sharma Niwas to Savita. Rishi also makes Inder and Munna sign a ‘No Objection Certificate’, and forcefully takes Kutumbh’s impression on it. Later, when Zaara arrives, Guru Ma, using her divine powers, reveals that Savita is dead, but Indira is alive and is in a store room. Inder decides to take Rishi and the others to an old store room at Sharma Niwas.

episodesList.title: Episode 318
episodesList.summary: Inder thinks that Savita is hiding from Munna when he sees her dead body through an opening on a wall. Adhering to Zaara’s plan, Rishi reaches the spot where he is supposed to meet Savita, while Zaara, wearing a mask, also arrives in a car with Indira by her side. Later, Rishi sees a burning body, when the car goes up in flames. Zaara tries to convince Rishi that it is Indira’s body, but Rishi refuses to believe it. Rishi tries to reach Indira when he suddenly sees her unscathed but

episodesList.title: Episode 319
episodesList.summary: Munna finds no one inside the cubicle, where Inder previously saw Savita. Elsewhere, Rudra takes an unconscious Rishi to Sharma Niwas, while Zaara scolds Indira for spoiling her plan to fake Indira’s death. Zaara also discloses to Indira her desire to take Rishi away from Delhi. Back at Sharma Niwas, Guru Ma watches Seher comforting Indu, who mourns Indira’s demise. After Rishi wakes up, he calls Zaara, who lies to him about being in a morgue for Indira’s post-

episodesList.title: Episode 320
episodesList.summary: Zaara replaces the original post-mortem report with a fake one and puts an unconscious Indira into the ambulance which is carrying Savita’s dead body. Later, Zaara brings the ambulance to Sharma Niwas, and hands Rishi the fake report, confirming the body to be Indira’s. Meanwhile, Indira manages to escape and later, walks into the house, but no one notices her, except for Zaara. While Kutumbh talks to a lawyer to transfer the property in her name, Zaara takes Indira to a deserted

episodesList.title: Episode 321
episodesList.summary: When Indu looks for Indira, Zaara renders Indira unconscious. Meanwhile, Kutumbh’s lawyer suggests that Sharma Niwas should be put up for auction, to which Kutumbh and Munna agree. When Kutumbh demands that Rishi leave Sharma Niwas with Indu, Zaara announces that she will take them to Mumbai. The same night, Zaara pays a truck driver to take Indira away from Delhi. The next day, Rishi, Zaara, Indu, and Meher leave for the railway station, but on their way, Indira coincidentally sees Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 322
episodesList.summary: Kutumbh and Munna rejoice as the auctioning of Sharma Niwas is about commence. Meanwhile, Rishi misses a chance to encounter Indira, who is later forced to beg at a railway station. Coincidentally, Rishi along with Indu, Zaara, and Meher arrive at the same venue, where Indu notices Indira’s doll. After boarding a train, Rishi notices Indira and gets off, while Meher insults Zaara for failing to control Rishi. Zaara attempts to push Indira in front of an oncoming train, but Rishi saves her.

episodesList.title: Episode 323
episodesList.summary: Zaara explains to an angry Rishi that she was trying to save Indira and not kill her. However, Zaara secretly warns Indira to keep mum when Rishi asks Indira about her perpetrator’s identity. Elsewhere, Guru Ma buys Sharma Niwas but refuses to pay Kutumbh the money. Everyone is shocked when Guru Ma reveals herself to be Sunaina. Rishi returns to Sharma Niwas with Indira, while Indu throws Kutumbh and Munna out of the house. Later, Rishi wonders about whose body he burnt at the cremation ground.

episodesList.title: Episode 324
episodesList.summary: Munna and Kutumbh lament about being forced to live on the street. After Indira indicates that her kidnapper is a family member, Rishi makes everyone stand in line and asks her to identify the miscreant. Indu hints Zaara to be the culprit, who starts to cry to gain Rishi’s sympathy. Meanwhile, Rudra hands Rishi the original post-mortem report, and Munna realises that the dead body was of Savita’s. Sunaina informs Rishi of overhearing Savita's conversation with someone regarding Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 325
episodesList.summary: When Rishi asks Zaara about the fake post-mortem report, Zaara holds Rudra accountable. Rishi hints to Indira that he has realised Zaara to be the culprit and makes a futile attempt to file a police complaint against Zaara. Later, with Indira’s help, Rishi finds his way to the storeroom, where Zaara was cleaning Savita’s bloodstains. Unbeknownst to Zaara, Rishi finds a broken piece of handcuff in the room. Later, Rishi accepts Zaara’s suggestion of taking Indira to a ‘dargah’ to cure her illness.

episodesList.title: Episode 326
episodesList.summary: Rishi learns about Zaara’s plan to detonate a bomb at the ‘dargah’ in order to kill Indu and Indira. Rishi pretends to get mad at Indu when she insults Zaara. However, Rishi secretly informs Indu that he knows the truth about Zaara, while Zaara buys explosives from her aide. Munna and Kutumbh catch Zaara but end up joining hands with her. Meanwhile, Indira dreams of an explosion but fails to make Indu understand it. The next day, Zaara takes Rishi, Indu, and Indira to the ‘dargah’.

episodesList.title: Episode 327
episodesList.summary: Munna informs Zaara that he kept the explosives on a tray full of spiritual offerings. Zaara gladly watches Indu carrying the tray but drops it when Rishi walks by Indu’s side. Zaara gets surprised to find the bomb missing from the tray and confronts Munna. Later, Zaara puts the bomb back on the tray but gets petrified to see Rishi carrying it. Rishi confronts Zaara for plotting to kill Indira and Indu. After the bomb explodes, Zaara tries to kill Indira, while Rishi emerges unharmed.

episodesList.title: Episode 328
episodesList.summary: Munna and Kutumbh reveal to Zaara that they were supporting Rishi. Zaara becomes mentally ill and is sent to a mental asylum before she serves her prison sentence. Later, Munna and Kutumbh join Sunaina in a purification ceremony to atone for their sins. Sunaina gets elated to see Ishaan, but he insults her. Munna comforts Sunaina, and later, they decorate Rishi’s bedroom for his wedding night with Indira. However, when Indira hears a particular song, she runs to the singer and hugs him.

episodesList.title: Episode 329
episodesList.summary: Indira faints after learning that the person she mistook for Saheb is Imran, a Pakistani singer. Munna brings Imran home, and when he sings the song again, Indira gains consciousness. Later, Rishi takes Indira to Dr. Tejaswini, who makes Indira undergo hypnosis therapy. Indira draws a picture of a fair, but quickly goes into shock. Ishaan plays a recording of Imran’s song, and Indira wakes up. Meanwhile, in Pakistan, an Army Major Kabir learns about Indira’s look-alike, Husna’s whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Episode 330
episodesList.summary: During a hypnosis session, Indira recalls how she was separated from Kabir. After waking up, Indira acts hysterical and pushes Rishi away when he tries to calm her down while asking for Saheb. When Ishaan finds Saheb's email address, Rishi sends him a message. Meanwhile, Kabir fails to get a visa for India, while Kabir’s subordinate Sarfaraz shows Kabir’s wife, Noor, Rishi’s email. Noor threatens Sarfaraz not to speak of it to Kabir, who crosses words with Noor and vows to bring Husna back.

episodesList.title: Episode 331
episodesList.summary: When Rishi asks Indira what she inscribed in Urdu, she becomes defensive. Meanwhile, Noor’s father Mukhtar comes to Kabir’s house with military personnel to arrest Kabir. Despite Kabir’s best efforts, he is arrested. Back at Sharma Niwas, Meher translates Indira’s inscription as Husna and Saheb, while Indu brings a holy cow in the house, which signals Saheb as Indira’s cure. Rishi resolves to go to Pakistan to bring Saheb to India. Radhe makes arrangements to send Rishi across the border.

episodesList.title: Episode 332
episodesList.summary: Indira recalls Kabir’s performance in her sleep. Later, Indira writes Saheb’s name on her hand with ‘mehendi’, a dye, which angers Rishi. Meanwhile, Sarfaraz arranges for Kabir’s way into India but is killed by Mukhtar before he can reveal Husna’s location to Kabir. Kabir and Bubbly travel to India-Pakistan border, while Rishi meets Radhe’s contact, and is surprised to find Indu, who sneaked into Rishi’s car. Rishi decides to travel to Pakistan with Indu against his better judgement.

episodesList.title: Episode 333
episodesList.summary: While approaching the border, Indu and Rishi are instructed to hide inside the bags, while Kabir and Bubbly also hide inside the bags. Later, Mukhtar arrives and orders his men to check the bags thoroughly. Bubbly exposes herself to Mukhtar, who threatens to kill her to compel Kabir to surrender. Kabir yields, but Rishi throws a grenade to create a distraction. However, Mukhtar manages to capture Bubbly again, while Indu teases him. Back at Sharma Niwas, Indira senses Saheb coming for her.

episodesList.title: Episode 334
episodesList.summary: When Mukhtar captures Indu and Bubbly, Rishi becomes anxious to save Indu, but Kabir restrains him. Rishi asks Kabir his reason for sneaking into India, but Kabir refuses to answer. Later, Rishi employs a clever trick and escapes to India with Kabir, Indu, and Bubbly. However, when Rishi threatens Kabir with a knife, he informs Rishi that he came to India to find Husna. Meanwhile, Indira slaps Kutumbh for calling her Noor and for taking the baby away from her that Inder brought.

episodesList.title: Episode 335
episodesList.summary: Rishi interrogates Kabir about Husna, while Indu and Bubbly try to calm the situation. Later, Indu tells Kabir that she and Rishi were going to Pakistan to look for Saheb. Back at Sharma Niwas, Ishaan scolds Sunaina for stealing Indira’s food. Munna promises Ishaan to help Indira recover from her illness. Meanwhile, Kabir tells Rishi that Husna is in Delhi, while Rishi sketches Indira. Rishi decides to show Kabir Indira’s photograph when Kabir accidentally ruins the sketch.

episodesList.title: Episode 336
episodesList.summary: Rishi convinces a circus manager to take Kabir and Bubbly to Delhi with his group. During the conversation, Rishi accidentally drops his passport. Later, Noor calls Rishi and informs him that Saheb is dead. The next day, Munna secretly takes Indira to the same circus group. The manager ties Indira to a giant wheel, while Kabir is made to throw knives at her blindfolded. Kabir hesitates but throws a knife when Munna provokes him. Meanwhile, Rishi and Indu return to Sharma Niwas.

episodesList.title: Episode 337
episodesList.summary: Rishi asks Kutumbh Indira’s whereabouts, while Kabir entertains the audience at the circus. Rishi arrives and catches a knife that is about to hit Indira. Indu creates a distraction and Rishi carries Indira home. Rishi scolds Munna, who asks for Indira’s forgiveness. Everyone is astounded to see Indira comforting Munna when he was crying inconsolably. Later, Indu puts Indira to sleep, while Kabir and Bubbly come to Sharma Niwas to return Rishi’s passport. Rishi and Indu request Kabir to stay.

episodesList.title: Episode 338
episodesList.summary: Kabir starts to sing the song that trigger’s Indira’s memory, and Rishi runs to his room. Rishi realises that Kabir is Saheb, and when Rishi sees Indira approaching, he stops her. Later, Rishi calls Rudra and the next day, Rudra arrests Kabir and Bubbly. However, Indira spots Kabir and Bubbly in the police car and calls for Kabir. Kabir manages to escape the police and meet Indira, who faints. Later, Indira gains consciousness and recognises Kabir but fails to recognise Rishi and the others.

episodesList.title: Episode 339
episodesList.summary: Indira is elated to see Bubbly but does not recognise anyone from the Sharma family. Rishi tries to trigger Indira’s memory but fails. Later, Tejaswini arrives and informs that Indira is suffering from partial amnesia. Meanwhile, Indu adamantly calls Indira her mother, which disturbs Kabir and Bubbly. Rishi scolds Indu saying that Husna (Indira) is not her mother. Rishi explains to Kabir that Indu and Husna have developed a bond after Indu found her and that Indu has never seen her birth

episodesList.title: Episode 340
episodesList.summary: Indu gets angry as Indira did not recognise her. Rishi tries to calm Indu down, but she remains adamant. Indira politely tells Indu that she is not her mother. Kutumbh and Inder get excited about the possibility that Kabir may take Indira to Lahore, leaving Sharma Niwas for themselves, while Munna and Sunaina also think along similar lines. Later, Rishi gets mesmerised to see Indira in traditional clothes. When ‘Hijras’, people from the transgender community, arrive, one of them identifies Indira as Rishi’s wife.

episodesList.title: Episode 341
episodesList.summary: When Rishi sees Kabir dancing with Indira, he breaks a glass that cuts his hand. Later, Indira announces that she intends to leave for Lahore and thanks everyone for their help, especially Rishi. When Rishi’s blood accidentally spills onto Indira’s forehead, she notices Rishi’s wound and tends to it. The same night, Indira cooks for the Sharma family, and Munna accidentally calls Husna (Indira) Indira. Rishi refuses to eat but playfully tells Indira to wipe the bloodstain off her

episodesList.title: Episode 342
episodesList.summary: Kabir tries to get intimate with Husna, but she hesitates. Meanwhile, Indu intentionally burns red chillies, and the smoke chokes Kabir, Indira, and Bubbly. Rishi stops Indira when she is about to slap Indu, and he crosses words with Kabir. Later, Indu faints when she and Bubbly roll down from the stairs. Indira scolds Rishi for failing to discipline Indu, while Kabir tries to calm the situation. Rishi asks Kabir why he named his daughter Bubbly, to which he says that it was Husna’s

episodesList.title: Episode 343
episodesList.summary: Indira shouts at Bubbly while getting upset about Rishi. Later, Indira secretly tends to Indu. Rishi arrives, and they both apologise to each other for their earlier remarks. Indira informs Rishi that she will be leaving for Lahore the next day while Indu gains consciousness. Later, Rishi shows Indu Kabir’s passport that he stole. Meanwhile, when Inder returns Indira’s bag to her, she recognises her ‘saree’, bangles, and ‘mangalsutra’, but fails to recall her marriage with Kabir.

episodesList.title: Episode 344
episodesList.summary: A drunk Kabir finds a drunk Rishi trying to sing his song. Rishi asks Kabir about his marriage to Husna while recording their conversation on his mobile phone. Kabir tells Rishi how he met Husna and also that he is not married to her. Rishi decides to tell Husna (Indira) about it, but Kabir manages to stop him. Later, Husna informs Kabir that she wishes to leave for Lahore at the earliest. Meanwhile, on Women’s Day, Inder and Munna get the idea of helping their wives with the daily

episodesList.title: Episode 345
episodesList.summary: Kabir asks Rishi if he remembers their conversation from the previous night, but he denies. Indu plays the recording, but Kabir takes the phone away when he sees Indira approaching. Later, Indu has a spat with Bubbly when she asks Bubbly to leave Indira with her. Kabir finds his passport when Rishi accidentally drops it while Indu drags Bubbly to Indira’s room to show her Indira’s picture. Rishi and the others smartly hide the picture, but Indira coincidentally sees it and is

episodesList.title: Episode 346
episodesList.summary: Indira faints seeing her own picture. Later, Tejaswini scolds Rishi for putting pressure on Indira’s mind. When Indira wakes up, she frantically looks for the picture frame. However, Munna changes Indira’s photograph with that of another woman named Sajni and Rishi confirms it to be Indira’s picture. Indira refuses to leave for Lahore and continues her treatment until she meets Sajni. Later, Kutumbh asks Rishi to bring Sajni home while Inder advises Rishi to tell Indira the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 347
episodesList.summary: Inder suggests Rishi show Indira their photo album. However, when Rishi hears Indira badmouthing him to Kabir, he changes his mind. Later, Kabir confronts Rishi for stealing his passport and ends up beating Rishi when he says that Husna is his wife. However, Rishi manages to calm the situation when he sees Indira overhearing their conversation. Later at a dance bar, Munna and Rishi meet Sajni. When the police conduct a raid, Munna and Rishi get arrested, while Sajni bumps into Kabir and Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 348
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Indira bring an unconscious Sajni to Sharma Niwas, while Rudra releases Munna and Rishi from jail. When Sajni wakes up, she refuses to recognise any of the family members, which surprises Indira and Kabir. Rishi and Munna arrive with Rudra, who signals to Sajni to act as Indira. Indira asks Sajni to take her family members’ blessings and tries to reconcile her with Rishi. Kabir suggests that Rishi call Husna ‘bhabhi’, sister-in-law, and thank her for reuniting him with Indira (

episodesList.title: Episode 349
episodesList.summary: Munna employs a clever trick to spare Rishi from calling Indira his sister-in-law. Kabir buys flowers for Indira, and unbeknownst to him, the packaging has Sajni’s picture and contact number on it. When Indira is about to give one of her dresses to Sajni to wear, Rishi stops her. Afterwards, Rishi gives Indira her medicines, while Indu announces that she is hungry. When Indira asks Sajni to feed Indu, she refuses. Later, Indira is surprised to see Indu dance with Sajni and Munna.

episodesList.title: Episode 350
episodesList.summary: Seeing Munna and Sajni dancing, Indira throws her shoe at Munna and slaps Sajni. Later, Rishi hears the recording where Kabir confesses to never marrying Husna, while Kabir also discovers the truth about Sajni’s identity. Meanwhile, Indira overhears Munna calling her 'Hitler', and later, Ishaan accidentally calls her 'Indira Bua’. Indira starts to doubt her identity as Husna, while Rishi and Kabir confront each other about their respective lies. Rishi reveals to Kabir that Husna is his wife.

episodesList.title: Episode 351
episodesList.summary: Rishi takes the wrapper from Kabir that had Sajni's details on it. Later, Rishi decides to tell Indira the truth about her identity but finds her unconscious in her room. When Indira wakes up, she asks Kabir to make Rishi leave. Rishi hatches a plan to stop Kabir from taking Indira to Lahore, while Kabir secretly tries to leave the house with Indira and Babli. When Inder stops Indira, Kabir misbehaves with him. Meher scolds Kabir, which reminds Indira of a similar situation with Jhumpa.

episodesList.title: Episode 352
episodesList.summary: Inder gladly tells everyone that Indira called him by his name. Later, when Kabir and Babli leave Indira to get an auto-rickshaw, Rishi tries to trigger Indira’s memory. Munna, Radhe and Rudra distribute Kabir’s posters, and Munna manages to throw one poster inside Kabir’s auto-rickshaw. Indira sees the poster and panics, while Munna convinces her to come back home. Later, Kabir loses an arm-wrestling challenge with Rishi, who claims that he will bring back Indira’s memory in 24 hours.

episodesList.title: Episode 353
episodesList.summary: Indira sees Sajni with an unknown person and calls her Mandira. When Rishi asks Indira about it, she fails to recall the incident. Rishi forcefully takes Indira to the venue where they got married, while Munna and the others hold Kabir and Babli captive. Rishi tries to trigger Indira’s memory by recreating their wedding ceremony, while Kabir bribes Kutumbh and escapes. Later, Kabir reaches the venue and fights Rishi. Indira begs Rishi not to hurt Kabir and later, leaves with Kabir and Babli.

episodesList.title: Episode 354
episodesList.summary: A disappointed Rishi tells Indu that he failed to revive Indira’s memory. Meanwhile, Kabir reaches the railway station with Indira and Babli. Indu plays old video recordings of Indira on the platform screens, which Indira, Kabir and Babli watch with utter surprise. Later, Indu begs Indira to stay, but Rishi asks Indu to let her go. While Rishi leaves with Indu, Indira begins to recover her memory. Indira runs to save Rishi when she sees Rishi and Indu in danger, while Kabir leaves with

episodesList.title: Episode 355
episodesList.summary: Indira is surprised to find herself in a railway station and fails to recognise Indu. Later, Indira laments to Rishi that she missed watching Indu’s childhood, but Rishi finds a way for Indira to live those moments. When Indu asks Indira to go inside a temple, she refuses. Indira notices that Indu calls Rishi by his name, and objects to it. Back at Sharma Niwas, Sunaina indicates that Kutumbh let Kabir escape and later, everyone starts fighting. Indira returns to find her family in chaos.

episodesList.title: Episode 356
episodesList.summary: Indira orders everyone to clean up the house. Later, Indira behaves harshly with Munna, Kutumbh and Sunaina but gets emotional on seeing Ishaan. Later, Indu introduces Indira to Seher, and Indira hugs her. When Inder tries to touch Indira’s feet to ask for her forgiveness, Meher stops Inder. Munna gives Meher’s introduction to Indira, who starts to scold Inder. However, Indu confronts Indira for calling Inder by his name as Indira had earlier objected to Indu calling Rishi by his name.

episodesList.title: Episode 357
episodesList.summary: Radhe comes to Sharma Niwas with some neighbours to cheer Indira’s return, but Indira asks Radhe to accredit Rishi. Indira gets emotional to see that Rishi had kept all her belongings with care. When Indira finds Zaara’s jacket in her closet, Munna informs Indira about Rishi’s affairs. Indira playfully interrogates Rishi about his affair with Zaara. Later, Indira wears her old clothes and finds her way to Indu’s room. Indira dresses Indu up in her fashion, and they share a moment.

episodesList.title: Episode 358
episodesList.summary: While celebrating ‘Holi’, Kutumbh has an asthma attack. Indu steals an asthma pump from a medical store and brings it to Indira. However, when Indira learns that Indu stole the pump, Indira rebukes her. Later, Indira punishes Indu for her misdeed, and when an intoxicated Rishi mistakes Indira for Zaara, Indira punishes him as well. To pacify the situation, Munna and the others make Indira drink ‘thandai’, an intoxicating drink, and they play ‘Holi’. Rishi tries to get intimate with

episodesList.title: Episode 359
episodesList.summary: Rishi takes Indu and Seher to school. Munna and the others lie to Indira that Indu is a good student, while Indu’s principal expels her due to poor performance. Kutumbh lies to Indira about Rishi being the breadwinner of the family during her absence, but Meher reveals that she was the one taking care of the household expenses. Later, Indira goes to find a job and ends up at a ‘langar’, a Sikh community kitchen serving free meals, where unbeknownst to Indira, Indu is also present.

episodesList.title: Episode 360
episodesList.summary: Rishi arrives at the ‘langar’ and finds Indu and Indira. When a group of policemen, dressed as civilians, threatens the ‘langar’ organiser to shut down the ‘langar’, Indira scolds the policemen, and Rishi also joins her. Indira asks Rishi about the reason for being at the ‘langar’, but he avoids answering. Later, Indira overhears Seher informing Munna that Indu got expelled from school, but Indu makes a clever excuse. Indu emotionally blackmails Rishi when he asks her the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 361
episodesList.summary: Indu takes Sajni to her Principal and introduces her as Indira. Meanwhile, when Indira finds Indu’s Principal’s letter, she goes to Indu’s school and confronts her. Indira slaps Indu and asks the Principal to demote Indu to a lower grade. Later, Indira scolds Rishi for being irresponsible towards Indu, while Indu gets bullied by her classmates. Rishi warns Indira that her strict attitude may make Indu despise her, while Indu beats up one of her bullies and announces that she hates Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 362
episodesList.summary: Indira goes to meet Sajni to apologise to her. Meanwhile, Sajni saves a group of girls, who are forced to work for Raj Rani, the owner of a dance bar. Later, Indira encounters a dying Sajni, who asks Indira to save the girls from Raj Rani, who had recaptured the girls saved by Sajni. Sajni gives Indira her phone that has a video recording of Raj Rani’s nefarious activities. Indira shows the recording to the police, while Rishi coincidentally meets Raj Rani and agrees to fight her

episodesList.title: Episode 363
episodesList.summary: When Indira understands that the police inspector is supportive of Raj Rani, she takes back the chip from him that contains the video recording of Raj Rani. Later, Indira finds Indu wounded, and scolds her thinking that she fought in school. Indu argues that she is innocent while Seher defends Indu. Rishi gives money to Indira and asks her to donate it to Indu’s school so that she can be promoted to a higher grade. However, Indira opposes the decision, which upsets Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 364
episodesList.summary: When Indu says that she is running a fever, Indira refuses to believe Indu, but Rishi confirms it. Later, Indira goes to Raj Rani’s house with the police to conduct a raid. Indira finds a group of young girls locked up in a room, but the police refuse to arrest Raj Rani. Indira gets surprised to find Rishi as Raj Rani’s lawyer and demands that he drops the case, but Rishi refuses. When Indira asks the girls to tell the truth, they vouch for Raj Rani’s innocence.

episodesList.title: Episode 365
episodesList.summary: When Indu intentionally spills ink on Seher’s notebook, Indira locks her up in a room. After much persuasion from Rishi, Indira shows the video recording of Raj Rani’s crime on her phone. Indira has a spat with Rishi when he forcefully takes the phone away. However, when Raj Rani’s goons attack Rishi and Indira, they fight them off. Rishi tells Indira that he wants to help her, while Raj Rani learns of Rishi’s betrayal. Meanwhile, Indu escapes from the room, but Raj Rani’s goons abduct her.

episodesList.title: Episode 366
episodesList.summary: Rajrani kidnaps Indu. Rajrani further informs about the same to Rishi,  after he join hands with Indira to fight a case against Rajrani. Rishi  and Indira hence withdraw the case they filed against Rajrani. Rishi  receives Indu's clothes soaked with blood splats on them, in a parcel.

episodesList.title: Episode 367
episodesList.summary: Rajrani warns Indira and Rishi to provide her the evidence that revealed  her crime. Rishi and Indira hence visits Rajrani's locality in order to  allot her the chip and rescue Indu. Indira smartly rescues the other  girl kids from Rajrani's arrests but, fails to rescue Indu and Rishi.  Indira further showcases the evidence to the media persons.

episodesList.title: Episode 368
episodesList.summary: Indira mentions about the chip, the evidence that would reveal Rajrani's  crime. She presents the evidence during the live tv coverage by the  media. Rajrani warns Indira to not display the video footage in media's  presence in order to save Indu. Indira however plays the footage but, it  happens to be duplicate evidence. Rishi possess the original chip that  he decides to allot to Rajrani only after getting Indu from him.

episodesList.title: Episode 369
episodesList.summary: Rishi forcefully takes the evidence from Indira in order to rescue Indu  from Rajrani's arrest. Rajrani on the other hand, takes the chip from  Rishi and also, kidnaps Rishi alog with Indu. Indira gets the support of  police to fight against Rajrani. The Sharma family urges Indira to  accompany her, to rescue Indu from Rajrani's arrest. Rajrani slaps  Indira, after she visits Rajrani's house. Rajrani however stays unaware  about a small video camera attached on Indira's sleeves that records  Rajrani's confession of her illegal activities.

episodesList.title: Episode 370
episodesList.summary: Meera and her family manages to rescue Rishi and Indu from Rajrani's  arrest. Rajrani however mentions his victory to Indira, as he manages to  plant the seed of hatred in Indu's mind for her mother. Indu breaks  into tears, as she recollects Indira's confession to the media of  sacrificing Indu to Rajrani, in order to protect the lives of the other  kids. Indira realizes her mistake and hence, decides to fulfil Indu by  providing her the essence of motherhood.

episodesList.title: Episode 371
episodesList.summary: both Indira and Rishi bring a surprise gift for Indu to cheer her mood.  Indu however gets annoyed after Indira tries to gift her. The Sharma's  family together tries to cheer Indu, but they fail. Ishaan and Seher  convince Indu to have her meal. Sunaina suggests Indira to plan for a  baby, with view to help Indu have an accompaniment to share her joys and  sorrows.

episodesList.title: Episode 372
episodesList.summary: Rishi urges his liking to Indira of having a baby from Indira in a  drunken state. Few people from Indira's locality reach her doorstep, to  gain Indira's help to solve their judicial matters. They consider her  wise and strong enough after they witness her attitude in Rajrani's  case. Indira watches a woman getting burnt on a road. She prevents the  female from getting burnt. The woman, informs Indira about her  relationship with a guy she shows in the newspaper. Rishi on the other  hand, informs Indira about Indu's road accident.

episodesList.title: Episode 373
episodesList.summary: Jaswant Rai Singhania a doctor by profession, brings Indu to his home  after she meets an accident. Indira and Rishi reach Dr Singhania's  house. Indira gets stunned after meeting Dr Singhania who happens to be  Shweta's husband. And also, Dr Singhania happens to be person who sent  his hired men, to kill Shweta. Dr Singhania realizes Indira's pleasing  behaviour to be diplomatic and rather fake, while he interacts with her  and Rishi. Indira decides to bring Shweta to the Sharma house, in order  to protect her from her husband

episodesList.title: Episode 374
episodesList.summary: Indu weeps while missing Shweta. Indira gets annoyed on Bhim and Indu  after Bhim accidently hurts a stranger on the road. Inder's love  interest informs Indu about Shweta, to be Indu's real mother. The  inspector brings Shweta to the Sharma residence. Rishi and Munna get  annoyed watching Shweta. Indu however feels delighted after watching  Shweta.

episodesList.title: Episode 375
episodesList.summary: Rishi gets furious on Indira for bringing in Shweta, in the Sharma  house. Indu gets delighted after watching Shweta. Shweta accidently  informs Indu, about her pregnancy, hence, cherishing Indu as she needed a  brother for accompaniment. Dr Singhania learns about Shweta's rescue by  a female from the hospital. He hence, decides to take an action against  the female. Rishi on the other hand, gets furious on Indira after  watching Indu's attachment with Shweta. He hence warns Indira to get rid  of Shweta, in order to create further barriers in her relationship with  her daughter.

episodesList.title: Episode 376
episodesList.summary: Vanraj informs Indira about Dr Singhania's investigation to find his  wife. Dr Singhania watches Shweta at the Sharma house, after he drops  Indu at her home. Inder and Kutumbh try to gain monetary advantage from  Shweta. Indu gets annoyed, after the Pandit addresses Indira as her  mother during the havan that is organised by Shweta for Indu. Indira  hence, gets disturbed by watching Indu and Shweta's bond. Indira hence,  pleasingly requests Shweta to leave the house after organising a secured  accommodation for Shweta.

episodesList.title: Episode 377
episodesList.summary: Shweta leaves the Sharma house after Indira urges her to do so. Indira  and Indu rushes out of the house on hearing Shweta's screams. The  Sharmas realize Shweta to be in danger. Soon, a bunch of men start  attacking Indu and Shweta. Rishi and Munna come to their rescue. Shweta  however gets hurt after a goon hits her on her stomach. Indira and the  other female members of the family, treat Shweta medically. They manage  to protect Shweta and her baby. Rishi and Kutumbh admire Indira for  treating Shweta with immense care.

episodesList.title: Episode 378
episodesList.summary: Indira challenges Indu to take responsibility of the family entirely by  herself. Indu, however, accepts the challenge. Indira pretends to be  Shweta over a call with Dr Singhania and informs him, about her  miscarriage. She further schedules a meeting with him for the next day.  Dr Singhania feels delighted after learning about Shweta's miscarriage.  Indira shows Dr Singhania, his DNA report that revealed his relationship  with Shweta's baby. He refuses to agree with Indira at first, but,  later panics after watching his wife's support with Indira. The police  appears at the scene when, he tries to shoot Shweta. The police hence  arrests Dr Singhania.

episodesList.title: Episode 379
episodesList.summary: Indu orders Rishi, Munna and Inder to resume to their duties and earn  for the family. The trio makes several attempts, but fails to earn a  penny. A small explosion takes place in the Sharma house. A huge amount  of smoke spreads in the house. Apart from Indira, Rishi and Indu,  Kutumbh and the other family members turn blind after facing the dense  smoke. The doctor hence, informs Indira about their blindness to be  temporary. Indu refuses to receive cash from Indira, to purchase the  medicines for the family. Indu asks Rishi for the money instead. Indira  however, tries to hand him some money, but accidently teases him on his  bankruptcy.

episodesList.title: Episode 380
episodesList.summary: Rishi gets annoyed after Indira unknowingly shows her superiority over  him, by handing him the cash to buy the medicines for the Sharma family.  The people from Indira's neighbourhood, starts placing their request to  Indira, for helping them to fight their legal battle with a motive to  gain justice. Indira, however decides to support them and combines their  application to fight the consumer court. With a view to provide medical  treatment to her family, Indu sells her precious jewellery, given to  her by Shweta. Indira notices Indu while doing so. Indira arranges  medicines for her family and also returns the jewellery to Indu. Rishi  apologises to Indira for behaving rudely. He also accepts the file of  applications from Indira, to help the people gain justice.

episodesList.title: Episode 381
episodesList.summary: Inder and other family members create a messy situation at the house due  to their blindness. Rishi sends Munna and Inder as fake executives,  from the petroleum industry to the company headquarters to conduct a  check. The manager at the shop gets scared after learning about the  news. He hence asks the consumers to withdraw their case and allots them  a handsome amount of cash as an added benefit. Rishi and Munna  celebrate, using this amount of cash. Dr Singhania's wife commits  suicide. Her son Bhim gives a letter to Indira from his mother, who  allots the responsibility of Bhim to her. Munna and Rishi decide to make  money from Indira's deed. They place a board outside the Sharma house  that asks the audience to gain justice in return of money. Indira hence,  damages the board.

episodesList.title: Episode 382
episodesList.summary: Indira decides to give justice to all the needy that seek for jusice at  her doorsteps. She decides to do this deed for free. Indira gets furious  on Indu as Indu, takes the money from Inder's love interest, to order  the food and also lie about the same to Indira. A mother and daughter in  law duo, visits Indira's house. One of whom, gives some advance cash to  Indira that Rishi accepts. Rishi reasons it for accepting the money as a  token of his fees, on which Indira calmly nods. Indira however, stays  ignorant to Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 383
episodesList.summary: Indira and her supporters come up with Hitler Ki Adaalat in the Sharma  house, wherein, Rishi and Indira stand against eachother. Rishi accepts  the case of the daughter in law from the duo, while, Indira supports her  mother in law. Allegations and quarrels takes place in the Sharma  house. Rishi learns about a hen, around which the case revolved. The hen  happens to be the motive of both the females fighting against  eachother. Rishi hence, presents a different hen, by giving it a look  similar to the one that is lost. Indira however, figures out his ploy  and hence, the quarrel continues.

episodesList.title: Episode 384
episodesList.summary: Indira uncovers Rishi's attempt of presenting a fake hen in her  courtroom and claiming it to be Praanaath. The onlookers present in her  courtroom starts mentioning Rishi, as a useless lawyer. In order to  divert people's attention from Rishi, Indira proceeds with her case and  later, figures out the pandit to be guilty for killing the hen. Munna  accidently informs Indira, about Rishi's investment in the betting  business. Indira however, gets furious on Rishi, as he invested the  money they received by the general public that gave the money with a  view to gain justice. Indira anger crosses its bar and she asks Rishi to  leave the Sharma house.

episodesList.title: Episode 385
episodesList.summary: after knowing about Rishi's mistake, of investing the money given by the  public in the betting business, Indira gets furious on Rishi. She asks  him to leave at once. Rishi and Indira indulge in a serious argument.  Indira later, parts the Sharma house into two halfs, by drawing a line.  The Sharma family supports Rishi, leaving Indira alone on the other  side. Indira challenges Rishi to manage the Sharma household on his own.  Rishi however, claims Indira of managing the family solely.

episodesList.title: Episode 386
episodesList.summary: Rishi feels delighted watching the rains while, recollecting his  memories that he spent with Indira. Munna and other family members  requests Indira, to let them use the washroom that is in the other side  of the house. Indira however, refuses them. A married couple arrives in  the Sharma house. Indira and Rishi individually interact with the couple  that are on their verge of separation. Rishi and Indira decide to fight  the case against eachother, as they could empathise with their  individual clients. Hitler Ki Adaalat takes place. Rishi and Indira  stand against eachother, by defending for their clients. Arguments and  quarrels take place between Rishi and Indira. Indira however, gets  unconscious during an argument.

episodesList.title: Episode 387
episodesList.summary: Indira refuses to do a medical check by the doctor, after she gets  unconscious. Rishi however, gets an indication of her pregnancy from the  females present at the venue. He hence, urges her to get a medical  check done in order to get a confirmation. Indira on the other hand,  stay firm with her decision. After Rishi requests her to get the check  up done in front of the family, Meher and Indu interrupt at once. They  comment Indira, on her inability to undergo motherhood. The family  members on the other hand, feel curious to know about Indira's  pregnancy. Indira however, refuses them to answer. The family further,  wears a disguise and continue with their efforts to investigate about  her pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Episode 388
episodesList.summary: Rishi, Munna and Inder follow Indira, to an organization that dealt with  woman welfare. Inder on his way meets a drunken young girl that awaits  the arrival of her friend to drop her back home. The girl falls  unconscious in Inder's arms. Inders starts misbehaving with the girl,  taking undue advantage of her drowsy state. Rishi catches Inder at the  moment and bursts upon him. The authorities from the woman welfare  organization offer a job to Indira that she sincerely accepts. On  regaining consciousness, the girl considers Rishi to be at fault, for  misbehaving with her. Later, the next day, a couple visits the Sharma  house, with a motive to get justice for their daughter. The couple  explain the entire issue to Indira, regarding their daughter. The  daughter arrives, who happens to be the female, Inder misbehaved with.  The girl points out Rishi to be the culprit. Rishi and Indira get  stunned by receiving the girl's accusation.

episodesList.title: Episode 389
episodesList.summary: Rishi decides to reveal the truth to Indira, after he watches the girl  pleading for justice from Indira. Inder stops Rishi at first and  requests him to stay mum. Rishi appears in front of Indira and accepts  the girl's accusation. Indira hands a leather belt to the female and  tells her to punish Rishi, by beating him up. Indira stops the girl, the  next moment and tells her to beat Indira herself, with a view to hurt  Rishi. Rishi gets annoyed after Indira starts hurting herself. He asks  Inder to confess the truth to Indira. Inder however, refuses to accept  his mistake and behaves innocently. Seeing this, Rishi briskly tells him  to confess the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 390
episodesList.summary: the police arrests Rishi for misusing the money he was allotted by the  gas commission officials, for the consumers that suffered losses. While  leaving in the police van, Rishi urges Indira to take good care of their  baby. Indira however annoyed and disturbed, informs him of aborting his  baby. Rishi gets stunned by Indira's decision. On his journey towards  the police station, Rishi pleads Vanraj to give him a chance, to prove  his innocence. Vanraj hence, helps Rishi to rescue from the police's  grip. Indira on the other hand, gets saddened after considering the  vicious circle of fate that created a barrier between Indu and Rishi's  father-daughter relationship, the one that also created a rift, between  Indira and her father in the past.

episodesList.title: Episode 391
episodesList.summary: though depressed and disheartened by Rishi's act, Indira feels  responsible towards her family in order to fulfil their basic  requirements. Indira's family that considers her baby to be a burden,  plan a strategy to support Indira in her decision of abortion. Indu  witnesses her family's plotting. She objects her family and Indira on  their decision. She calls for justice in Hitler Ki Adaalat and awaits  the arrival of her father.

episodesList.title: Episode 392
episodesList.summary: a judgement is taken in Indu's favour, after she requests the court at  Hitler Ki Adaalat, to grant her father an ultimatum of twenty-four hours  to prove his innocence. Rishi on the other hand, assures Indu of his  return within the given ultimatum. Indira feeds her family watching them  at misery. However, she gets furious seeing their greediness and  irrelevant behaviour. Indira receives a court order that asks Rishi to  pay the money; he was obliged to pay to the court. Annoyed and  frustrated, Indira decides to abort her baby while, Indu tries to stop  her.

episodesList.title: Episode 393
episodesList.summary: while proceeding with her abortion at the hospital, Indira watches a  reflection of a kid that pleads her mother, to not kill him. Indira gets  stunned after watching the reflection. She realises her mistake and  hence, cease her decision of abortion. Further, she notices Rishi  bribing the same kid, to act near Indira's ward. She gets annoyed on  Rishi and tries to get him arrested. Rishi however, manages to vanish  from the premises.

episodesList.title: Episode 394
episodesList.summary: Rishi performs at an event wearing an female attire, for his friend,  whom he was obliged to pay an amount of two lakh rupees. His friend  offers him to work with him. Indu informs Rishi about Indira's  advertisement in the newspaper, for the adoption of her baby. Rishi  arrives at the Sharma house and tries to influence Indira's decision  while, Indira refuses him at first. Later in the day, Indira saves the  life of a female that tries to commit suicide near a street. The female  informs Indira about her want to have a baby. Unaware of the female to  be Rishi, Indira gives a close look to the female's request.

episodesList.title: Episode 395
episodesList.summary: Indira takes the Pappi, the female to her house that tries to commits  suicide near the streets. She stays unaware of the female to be Rishi. A  couple visits the Sharma house to finish the paper work regarding the  adoption of Indira's baby. Inder gets attracted towards Rishi's disguise  of a female.  Indira warns Inder to maintain distance with the Pappi.  She further announces Pappi's stay in the Sharma house.

episodesList.title: Episode 396
episodesList.summary: Pappi (Rishi) bothers Indira at regular intervals, with a view to  influence her decision of giving away her baby for adoption. The other  day, the couple arrive with the adoption papers with them. Pappi indulge  in an argument with the couple, wherein, the couple mentions their  expectation of the baby to be a boy child. Indu also tries to get rid of  the couple, by showering crackers on them. Indu gets hurt during the  incident. Seeing, the couple's carelessness, Indira asks the couple to  leave. Pappi show her affection and care towards Indu, hence reliving  Indira.

episodesList.title: Episode 397
episodesList.summary: Pappi (Rishi) makes Indu realise her responsibilities towards her mother  in her pregnant condition.  Indu however, showers her concern and  bother for her mother. Indira, Indu and Pappi make a visit to the  hospital for a routine check up. The doctor informs Indira to take  certain precaution for her baby's wellbeing. Indira later spends time  with Pappi in her room. Indira's conversation with Pappi, makes Pappi  realise her bother for him. Rishi hence, decides to prove his innocence  to his family.

episodesList.title: Episode 398
episodesList.summary: Pappi (Rishi) attracts Inder, using her captivating moves. Inder's  temptation makes him irresistible and he starts misbehaving with Pappi.  His curiosity makes him mention the incident that took place with Neha,  the girl he misbehaved with. Pappi smartly enquire him about the  incident, on which he reveals the entire truth. Indira starts bashing  Inder in front of her family after witnessing the scenario. Later, she  regrets for her behaviour towards Rishi. Pappi asks Indira to apologise  to Rishi over the call to which she feels guilty.

episodesList.title: Episode 399
episodesList.summary: after Pappi advices Indira to have a conversation with Rishi and sought  their differences, Indira makes a call to Rishi. Rishi and Indira  interact over the call in the different corners of the house. Indira  however manages to catch Rishi in the other half of the house and they  sought their differences. Mehek provokes Inder against Indira, as Indira  slammed her father mercilessly by putting him to shame in their  locality. Inder however, snobs a knife in Indira's back on her visit to  meet Rishi.

episodesList.title: Episode 400
episodesList.summary: Inder regrets for stabbing a knife in Indira's back. However badly  injured, Indira manages to meet Rishi. Rishi get stunned after watching  Indira in an injured condition. He enrols her in a hospital but, fails  to submit the entire amount for her treatment. In order to gain the  money for her treatment, he decides to commit suicide, with an  intention, to receive the money from the insurance company. Inder on the  other hand, feels ashamed for his mistake and pleads Kutumbh to help  him out. Rishi gets clueless after Indu admires him, for arranging the  money for Indira's treatment.

episodesList.title: Episode 401
episodesList.summary: Rishi asks the doctor about the person who gave money for Indira's  treatment. The doctor hesitates at first, but later, points out towards a  moving car. Rishi sees the car and realizes that the person was none  other than Tauji. Rishi visits Tauji's house to find out the reason  behind his gesture. Tauji reveals to him about his motive in private.  Indira returns home safely with Rishi after getting discharged from the  hospital. The Sharmas are shocked to see Tauji enter their house.

episodesList.title: Episode 402
episodesList.summary: Indira insults Tauji on his arrival at the Sharma house. Rishi stops  Indira at the moment and introduces his uncle, Tauji to the Sharma  family. Tauji mentions Indira's ailing condition at the hospital and  Rishi's attempt of dying, as his reason to give money for Indira's  treatment. Tauji also tells Indira to leave her maiden home and stay  with Rishi, at the Jwala Nivaas.  He further adds Rishi in his strategy  to convince Indira and bring her to the Jwala Nivaas.

episodesList.title: Episode 403
episodesList.summary: Inder gets shocked after he accidently meets Tauji, his lookalike  outside the Sharma house. Indira gets irritated after she meets Tauji,  who asks her to stay with Rishi's family at the Jwala Nivaas. Rishi  teases Indira on her inability to be a housewife and pertain to the  responsibilities of being a housewife. Indira gets defensive and  challenges Rishi, by confirming her stay at Jwala Nivaas for a good  hundred days. Indira tries to charm her family, by preparing a sweet  dish in order to celebrate her last few days in the Sharma house. But,  she receives dejection and insult in return.

episodesList.title: Episode 404
episodesList.summary: Indira listens to Kutumbh and Inder's conversation wherein, Inder  confesses about stabbing a knife in Indira's back. Rishi tries to hurt  Inder at first, but later, calls the police to get him arrested. Indira  regrets for showing her concern towards her family.
