articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The series was Balaji Telefilms' first, back when its office was in a garage. The script of the first season was written by Imtiaz Patel. According to Ashok Saraf, who played the lead role of Anand Mathur in the series, "He has written the characters so well, people got hooked with each of them. Imtiaz's work was the height of improvisation. Imtiaz Patel was so talented that he could write one episode on a single line that he read in a newspaper." The show was mainly shot in Mumbai, with huge crowds assembling whenever there were scenes shot on the streets.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: The series was the debut for many of the actors, including Vandana Pathak, Vidya Balan, The show was the first comedy role of Shoma Anand.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: It was aired on Zee TV every Tuesdays 8pm, leading to its success as a series loved by the whole family. The first season ran from 1995 to 1999, while the second from 2005 to 2006.

articleSections.title: Reboot
articleSections.text:
A reboot, Hum Paanch Phir Se, aired on Big Magic from 19 June 2017 to 1 March 2018 with a new cast and produced by Essel Vision Productions.
The cast includes: * Sooraj Thapar as Anand Mathur * Seema Pandey as Bina Mathur * Vaishnavi Mahant as Priya * Jayashree Venketaramanan as Kajal * Ambalika Sapra as Radhika * Sylvia Chadha as Sweety * Ruchi Tripathi as Meeenakshi * Rimmi Srivastava as Chhoti

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Anand Mathur goes on a hunger strike until Kajal, the fourth daughter, apologise for her behaviour. But both of them agree to compromise on a deal worth INR 1500.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Beena is not at home. Meenakshi has to run the house. As the maid Sakkhu Bai's husband has beaten her, Meenakshi calls the Mahila Mukti Morcha to help her.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Chhoti's gossip makes the Mathurs buy a lottery ticket. Anand daydreams about their win and their lack of safety in such a situation. However, his family wins a paltry INR 100.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Radhika reads an article about warring couples loving each other a lot. She and her sisters try to create rifts between Anand and Beena. The matter soon goes out of hand.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: Meenakshi is in Nagpur and her sisters are picnicking. Anand and Beena's alone time is interrupted by Beena's mother Durga's surprise visit. The girls plan to get rid of her.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: Durga and Rama, Anand's first wife's mother, gossip about the bad image of the Mathurs. The girls make fun of Rama. Rama swears to take revenge and bring the girls on track.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: Radhika decides not to wear the hearing aid, because of which Anil misunderstands that she loves him. He gives a love letter to Kajal and Choti and asks them to hand it to Radhika.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: Anand's friend Pankaj comes to his home. Anand gets to know his love story. Radhika, Sweety, Chhoti and Beena return home. Beena is delighted to see Pankaj, her long-lost friend.

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Anand is jealous of the way Beena is treating Pankaj. Anand's first wife backbites about Beena and Pankaj's closeness. Beena and her daughters get angry with Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: Chhoti informs her family that Pandey Uncle has been promoted. Anand invites his boss Popatlal for dinner, to which Popatlal agrees. A major misunderstanding is in store for them.

episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: Chhoti tells Pooja about her husband Sunil buying a gajra. Pooja is in the Mathur house. Sunil searches for her everywhere. Sunil locks himself up in his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Sweety gets a bouquet and gift from a stranger on her birthday. Someone calls her up and imitates Shahrukh. The stranger wishes Sweety in the dark in her house and vanishes.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Meenakshi suggests sending Sweety to her maternal grandmother's home. Sweety goes to meet the stranger, thinking that he is Shahrukh Khan, a Bollywood actor.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Durga finds a prospective groom for Meenakshi. Radhika, Sweety and Kajal ask her to see the man. Mr Kapoor comes with his son Mohan, who mistakes Beena for the prospective bride.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: Sweety signs a modelling contract and gets INR 5000 for endorsing a brand linked to nighties. Her family members accompany her for a photo shoot. But trouble is in store for her.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: Chetan, Pooja's brother, is upset as Sunil is in Khandala. The Mathurs give him shelter but doubt his identity. Popatlal visits the Mathur house to check if Anand is ill.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: The families of Beena's brother Mohan and Anand's sister Sarita visit the Mathurs. Anand and Beena find it hard to manage them. The gossip at night alters their plan to stay there.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: Chhoti tells her kin about a raid in their area. ACP Kaatre searches for Taklya, a deadly shooter. The police interrogate the Mathurs and arrest Anand. But they release him later.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: Radhika suggests making an Ouija board to call the spirits. Durga sends a letter complaining about Chhoti. Anand's first wife reminds him about their 25th wedding anniversary.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: Anand's first wife's spirit is summoned by the Mathur girls. She complains that Anand does not love her. Kajal has a plan to recreate the love story. The girls boycott Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Radhika passes her exams but has to get a job in order to support her family. She starts a coaching class and earns INR 3000. An argument starts between Radhika and Kajal.

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Kajal collects funds for the Ganesh Chaturthi celebration. A man from the municipal corporation comes for demolishing an illegally erected mandap.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: Anand's first wife reminds him of his and Beena's 17th wedding anniversary. His daughters plan a surprise party. Someone interrupts the celebration.

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: The pandit, Bhootnath's father, who got Beena and Anand married, was an actor. Anand is heartbroken and asks everyone to leave. Anand's first wife asks him to remarry Beena.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: Anand and Beena are shocked as Sweety behaves like Meenakshi, Meenakshi behaves like Chhoti, Chhoti behaves like Radhika, Radhika behaves like Kajal and Kajal behaves like Sweety.

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: Kajal is in love with Govinda, a Bollywood actor. Anand gets a call from Govinda's brother to ask if they can come and talk about Govinda's wedding with Kajal.

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: The doorbell rings and there stands Anand in a new avatar. Later, they come to know that he is Raju, Anand's twin brother. The Mathurs have another unexpected visitor.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls are surprised to see Anand's uncle Dadaji, who is a lookalike of him and Raju. Anand's Chacha wants to bring the family on track. The guests annoy the girls.

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: When Gopi, Beena's dance teacher, is harassed by a few men in the park, Kajal saves her. Gopi is smitten with Kajal. Meenakshi and Sweety discuss Gopi and Kajal's marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls plan to buy gifts for their parents on the occasion of Diwali. They collect money in their own way and gift their parents a suit, sari and gold bangles.

episodesList.title: Episode 31
episodesList.summary: Radhika gets her salary and gives INR 1000 to Anand. Anand taunts the girls. Beena, Radhika and Anand's first wife get angry with Anand. The Mathur girls start searching for jobs.

episodesList.title: Episode 32
episodesList.summary: Minakshi goes for a job as a gym supervisor. Sweety goes to the feminist's office for an interview. Kajal goes for the interview of a news reader at a TV station. Anand has the last laugh as the girls lose their jobs on the first day.

episodesList.title: Episode 33
episodesList.summary: The girls plan to hold an awards ceremony. They inform Anand that they are starting a new company, AMCL. The girls rope in Sattar Bhai as a financier for the show.

episodesList.title: Episode 34
episodesList.summary: Anand and Beena get to know that the venue of the awards ceremony is their house. Beena and Anand confront the girls. On the day of the ceremony, chaos reigns.

episodesList.title: Episode 35
episodesList.summary: Popatlal waits for Anand to take his daughter Babli to his home. Babli wants to elope with her boyfriend and marry him. The Mathur girls plan to let her escape and wed her beau.

episodesList.title: Episode 36
episodesList.summary: Kajal assures her sisters that they will own a car and a bungalow soon. Anand hears Kajal talking to Kadar Bhai, a gangster, on the phone. Beena assures Anand about Kajal's safety.

episodesList.title: Episode 37
episodesList.summary: Anand wins a contest and gets to go on a dinner date with Rekha, a Bollywood actress. Beena faints, and everyone is in shock. A fight starts between Beena and Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 38
episodesList.summary: Anand tries to convince a sulking Beena to talk to him. But Kajal and Meenakshi interrupt. Sweety introduces Gopi, who has come from Pune to search for his father Anand Mathur.

episodesList.title: Episode 39
episodesList.summary: Chhoti summons Khushwant Singh Chaddha to decorate the new house bought by the Mathurs. As Chaddha starts decorating the house, he throws Anand's first wife's photo frame.

episodesList.title: Episode 40
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls plan a house-warming party. Chhoti suggests commercialising the party. Anand is happy with the idea. Anand calls Beena and then Chhoti to ask about his socks.

episodesList.title: Episode 41
episodesList.summary: Chhoti behaves differently after returning home from school. Everyone is worried about her and decides to consult a psychiatrist. The Mathurs plan to send Chhoti to Ballia.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Chhoti is in Ballia, where she recalls that she was Meena Kumari, a Bollywood actress in her previous birth. The people of Ballia are worshipping her. Mathurs go to Ballia.

episodesList.title: Episode 43
episodesList.summary: Chhoti reads about a man hanging himself to death. Anand tells his daughters that he will give INR 1000 to anyone who proves that he is not a fearless person.

episodesList.title: Episode 44
episodesList.summary: Anand asks Beena to give the names of their daughters to a marriage bureau. Later, they come to know that the bureau is run by their daughter Sweety and Popatlal's daughter Babli.

episodesList.title: Episode 45
episodesList.summary: Sweety plans to open a clinic, which will provide laughter therapy to the patients. The Mathur girls ask Anand to give INR 2000 to open the clinic.

episodesList.title: Episode 46
episodesList.summary: Sweety is searching for Bollywood actress Shahrukh Khan's address in the telephone directory. Kajal suggests that she contact a magazine's editor.

episodesList.title: Episode 47
episodesList.summary: The girls propose a weight-control plan for their parents, which includes a strict and bland diet. Anand vainly tries to cheat by ordering food from the canteen.

episodesList.title: Episode 48
episodesList.summary: Sweety returns with MF Haantain instead of MF Hussain. The girls plan to use him to become rich and famous. They ask the man to make paintings, which they plan to sell.

episodesList.title: Episode 49
episodesList.summary: Anand brings Suresh Sippy, his childhood friend to his home, who is in search of a fresh subject for his next movie. The Mathurs get to know that Sippy doesn't have a producer.

episodesList.title: Episode 50
episodesList.summary: Chhoti talks about a three-headed witch, who is roaming on the streets of Mumbai. Anand is asked not to open the door at night. But he says that he fears no one.

episodesList.title: Episode 53
episodesList.summary: Anand's first wife tries to fool him. Beena enters, and Anand informs her that it is April Fool's Day. Anand decides to protect himself from getting fooled by his daughters.

episodesList.title: Episode 54
episodesList.summary: Sweety tells Anand about a man, whom she has selected as her prospective groom. She asks Anand and Beena to take the marriage proposal to his parents.

episodesList.title: Episode 55
episodesList.summary: The Mathur sisters try to figure out the reason, which makes their plans unsuccessful. Radhika concludes that the plans have failed because they thought only about themselves.

episodesList.title: Episode 56
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls decide to leak the board exam question papers, for earning money and to help the students. Sweety tells the plan to her parents after Anand starts doubting Kajal.

episodesList.title: Episode 57
episodesList.summary: Anand is happy until his first wife starts talking to him. When the Mathur girls come up with the news of actress of Rekha's affair, he becomes sad.

episodesList.title: Episode 58
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls, along with Kadar Bhai, kidnap Akshay Kumar, a Bollywood actor. Beena and Anand faint on seeing Akshay in their house. Anand asks the reason behind the kidnapping.

episodesList.title: Episode 59
episodesList.summary: Amidst the ongoing chaos in the Mathur household, Anand's first wife's sister Rajni visits them. Tension brews in the family due to the closeness between Anand and Rajni.

episodesList.title: Episode 60
episodesList.summary: Beena is worried about Anand and Rajni. The girls plot to send Rajni back. After receiving a fake telegram for Rajni, Anand and Rajni laugh and reveal their plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 61
episodesList.summary: Pooja is worried for her sister who has been admitted to a hospital after being abused by her in-laws and husband. The girls agree to help her and plan to teach her husband a lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 62
episodesList.summary: With Mamta in the house, the girls decide to send Meenakshi to Anil’s house to teach him a lesson. Anil and his mother try to intimidate her, but Meenakshi responds accordingly.

episodesList.title: Episode 63
episodesList.summary: Anil and his mother are exhausted due to the trouble created by the Mathur family. They pray for Mamta to come back home. She finally arrives after they ask for her forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Episode 64
episodesList.summary: As the Mathur girls lead a boring life, they plot a quarrel between Pooja and Sunil. Meanwhile, Chaudhary Ji and his wife visit them, bringing news for Chhoti, Meena Kumari's incarnation.

episodesList.title: Episode 65
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs and their neighbours arrive for the inauguration. The temple gets ruined when Ganga and the priest are caught eloping. Seeing this, the Mathurs also flee the site.

episodesList.title: Episode 66
episodesList.summary: Babli tells Sweety about a sage who can help her get married quickly. Sweety invites him home. The sage senses Anand's first wife's spirit and suggests getting rid of it.

episodesList.title: Episode 67
episodesList.summary: The spirit-removing ritual is held at 7 pm. Anand tries helping his first wife but he can't. After the ritual, Sweety accidentally sets the spirit free.

episodesList.title: Episode 68
episodesList.summary: As Beena and Anand quarrel, Manorama comes to Meenakshi for help against her husband. The girls make a plan and trick Murli into fleeing from Manorama's house for good.

episodesList.title: Episode 69
episodesList.summary: Anand doesn't agree with the girls' decision to launch a political party of ruffians. Their first political meeting is interrupted when someone knocks at their door.

episodesList.title: Episode 70
episodesList.summary: The members decide the party's name and the logo, and make Anand their representative, regardless of his lack of interest. On the day of the election, Anand tricks them.

episodesList.title: Episode 71
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls visit Anand's boss Batliwaala to convince him to grant leave to Anand for bringing Meenakshi home from the jungle. Sweety impresses Batliwaala.

episodesList.title: Episode 72
episodesList.summary: Batliwaala adopts Sweety in spite of the Mathurs' hesitation. But she misses her old family and annoys him to such an extent that he decides to return her to the Mathur family.

episodesList.title: Episode 73
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls plan a monsoon budget. Anand doesn't give them money, which troubles him. Later, he gets a message from God, who announces the day of his death.

episodesList.title: Episode 74
episodesList.summary: Anand is doubtful whether the revelation was a dream or real and informs his family about it. They try to complete his last wishes. Two days later, he gets shot in the shoulder.

episodesList.title: Episode 75
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls complain about not having a brother and demand one. Though Anand disagrees, Beena backs them. They go to an orphanage to adopt one.

episodesList.title: Episode 76
episodesList.summary: There is a new competitor, Chanda, for Kajal in town. They plan a duel to know who is stronger. It is a tough fight. One of them loses and leaves that area for good.

episodesList.title: Episode 77
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs look for a maid to help Beena in her work. While Urmila refuses to work at their place, Narayan lays down certain conditions that the Mathurs have to agree to.

episodesList.title: Episode 78
episodesList.summary: Narayan is hired as the servant for the Mathur household to reduce Beena's workload. But he annoys everyone in the family. They try different ways to get rid of him.

episodesList.title: Episode 79
episodesList.summary: A runaway from the mental hospital is staying with the Mathur family. No one knows he is dangerous, except Chhoti. Finding the right moment, she calls the police.

episodesList.title: Episode 80
episodesList.summary: Anand reminds his daughters of poor kids, who don't get a chance to celebrate Diwali. So, the girls make a plan to collect money for such kids and make them celebrate the festival.

episodesList.title: Episode 81
episodesList.summary: A time machine transports the Mathurs to the past. They get caught for trespassing and face trial in Akbar's court. They win against Birbal. Sweety demands that Salim marry her.

episodesList.title: Episode 82
episodesList.summary: Sweety is transformed into a pigeon due to a curse. The Mathurs come back to the present time with Chhoti's help. Anand's dead wife helps convert Sweety back into the human form.

episodesList.title: Episode 83
episodesList.summary: Anand consumes alcohol to get a contract signed for his hospital. Inebriated, he walks into Pooja's house, creating havoc for everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 84
episodesList.summary: Anand's drunken behaviour creates havoc. The next morning, his first wife's spirit makes him realise his mistake. Anand begs for forgiveness and vows never to touch alcohol again.

episodesList.title: Episode 85
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls set up a low-priced stall of sweets for Diwali for the poor people. Subsequently, the girls expose a fraud and decide to sell the sweets for free.

episodesList.title: Episode 86
episodesList.summary: Sweety's application to participate in a beauty pageant gets rejected. So, the Mathur girls plan to hold another pageant, Miss Galaxy, to cheer an upset Sweety.

episodesList.title: Episode 87
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls implement a new parliamentary proposal at home that declares Sunday as a day for men to do domestic chores. Anand's behaviour compel them to change their decision.

episodesList.title: Episode 88
episodesList.summary: Anand slaps Chhoti on her back because of which she stumbles and claims that she cannot see anything. The worried Mathurs consult a doctor who is not of much help.

episodesList.title: Episode 89
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls challenge Pooja that Anand notices everything about Beena's appearance. They give Beena a makeover to test their claim.

episodesList.title: Episode 90
episodesList.summary: Kajal dreams of Sweety getting married. Beena's father, her brother, Anand's boss and a marriage bureau's owner choose prospective grooms for Sweety.

episodesList.title: Episode 91
episodesList.summary: Sweety grapples with the reality of having to choose one out of the four prospective grooms. However, Raman Kumar, Anand's friend, also wants his son to marry Sweety.

episodesList.title: Episode 92
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls mess with a dangerous goon. He breaks into their house to take his revenge on the girls. He gets murdered in the process. The police come to know about it.

episodesList.title: Episode 93
episodesList.summary: Beena quarrels with Anand for not buying her gifts. But they panic when Pooja's expensive necklace, which she leaves with Beena, gets stolen from the Mathur house at night.

episodesList.title: Episode 94
episodesList.summary: Sweety steals the necklace from Beena's cupboard but loses it again. The Mathurs decide to pay back Sunil the cost of the necklace, but are shocked when he reveals its truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 95
episodesList.summary: Beena, backed by the Mathur girls, goes on a hunger strike to protest Anand's refusal to declare his assets. He tries to convince her to end the strike, but she doesn't agree.

episodesList.title: Episode 96
episodesList.summary: A gang of robbers kidnaps Anand after he declares his assets. The Mathurs also go through an income tax inspection. Finally, he reveals his original assets.

episodesList.title: Episode 97
episodesList.summary: Mathur girls start a new show called Baap Ki Adalat, where Anand is the judge. During the first case of the court, a fight breaks out between Laalwani and Hazare.

episodesList.title: Episode 98
episodesList.summary: During a cleanliness drive started by the municipality, Anand gets fined by an officer for no reason. The girls hear about it and decide to teach the corrupt officer a lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 99
episodesList.summary: On Anand and Beena's wedding anniversary, they plan to go to the disco. But they aren't allowed to enter. The girls hear about this and decide to teach the disco manager a lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 100
episodesList.summary: After Anand refuses to give them extra pocket money, the girls decide to earn for themselves. They start an advice centre, which runs well at first, but problems arise later.

episodesList.title: Episode 101
episodesList.summary: Anand fears hair loss and asks the girls to help him prevent baldness. The girls suggest an ayurvedic oil, but the results turn out to be different from what Anand expected.

episodesList.title: Episode 102
episodesList.summary: Raj visits the Mathurs and claims that Beena is his wife. The girls and Anand get worried and plan to make Raj admit his claim is fake. The plan works, and he tells them the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 103
episodesList.summary: In the 21st century, the Mathur girls are married. They visit Anand on his 75th birthday. Kajal gets a call from Kadar Bhai, who is plotting to take revenge on her for jailing him.

episodesList.title: Episode 104
episodesList.summary: With her X-ray vision glasses, Lolo sees the bomb which Kadar Bhai has planted in Anand's 75th birthday cake. The Mathurs panic. Anand's first wife urges him to give her the bomb.

episodesList.title: Episode 105
episodesList.summary: Rekha Vartak, the MD of Vartak Pharmaceuticals, asks Anand to marry her. But he refuses and says that his family wouldn't let go of him for money.

episodesList.title: Episode 106
episodesList.summary: Rekha visits the Mathur family with her offer to buy Anand as her husband. The girls and Beena accept the offer. However, the next morning, Rekha's plan backfires on her.

episodesList.title: Episode 107
episodesList.summary: The girls plan to change their surname to Kapoor to become famous. Anand tries to convince them not to do so after being reprimanded by his dead father. But they do not relent.

episodesList.title: Episode 108
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs are now 'Kapoors'. This creates trouble for Anand later as the enforcement department interrogates him over the issue of illegal transactions.

episodesList.title: Episode 109
episodesList.summary: The girls plan a trip to Kashmir. But Anand meets with an accident at the last moment, which leaves him bedridden. The girls wonder whether they would be able to go to Kashmir.

episodesList.title: Episode 110
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls participate in a talk show, which debates whether girls or boys are more important. They teach Mr Jaitley, a patriarchal participant, a lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 111
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls fix a wrestling match between Anand and Gajraj. Anand is anxious about it. As he gets thrashed by the wrestler, Anand's first wife helps him.

episodesList.title: Episode 112
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls start a new magazine, which mainly prints gossip. Though all the copies are sold, some lawyers want to meet Anand as the magazine contains incorrect news.

episodesList.title: Episode 113
episodesList.summary: The girls are angry with Anand for not respecting their decision and leave his house to stay at Raju Bhai's house to help him deal with his annoying neighbour and boss, Mr Sahni.

episodesList.title: Episode 114
episodesList.summary: The girls teach each member of the Sahni family a lesson for troubling Raju's family. They also agree to go back to their house when Anand acknowledges their good deeds.

episodesList.title: Episode 115
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls start a bank for poor people. But the bank is unable to pay its customers. Due to a fake piece of news published by the Mathurs, a robber tries to rob it.

episodesList.title: Episode 116
episodesList.summary: With a telescope, the Mathur girls set up a business of sending people's shoes to the moon. But the Exports Department levies a fine on the girls for operating without a licence.

episodesList.title: Episode 117
episodesList.summary: Kajal gets a fighter cock, Chhote Miyan, to spite Kadar Bhai. As a result, Anand is forced to sleep in the living room. He wants the cock to disappear.

episodesList.title: Episode 118
episodesList.summary: The girls write to a human rights organisation against their father for not backing them against Pooja and always scolding them. The officers visit them and pity Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 119
episodesList.summary: Against Anand's wishes, the girls start an insurance company for people who are fined while travelling without a ticket. A lottery saves them when their company becomes bankrupt.

episodesList.title: Episode 120
episodesList.summary: Sweety is in love with a pandit and wants to marry him. Anand is sceptical about it and calls the pandit home, only to realise the bitter truth about him.

episodesList.title: Episode 121
episodesList.summary: Kajal is all ready to go to Dubai for work and help Anand by reducing the financial burden on him. But her travel agent turns out to be a fraud. She has to cancel her plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 122
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls decide to produce a music album with Kadar Bhai and his gang members. Anand raises a false alarm about the police's arrival, and the gang members flee.

episodesList.title: Episode 123
episodesList.summary: Anand's first wife wants to spend their wedding anniversary together. She transfers her spirit to Pooja's body. Anand dreams of being caught by Beena and their daughters.

episodesList.title: Episode 124
episodesList.summary: Anand's wallet is stolen by a goon who wants to take revenge on Kajal. Anand is arrested in the process. The Mathur girls get Anand released from jail and teach the goons a lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 125
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs have a disagreement with the society members regarding the selection of the person to hoist the flag on the Independence Day. They expose Sevakramji's fraud.

episodesList.title: Episode 126
episodesList.summary: To win a challenge, the Mathur girls frame Anand for Beena's murder. But things get serious when Beena doesn't arrive on time. Kajal confesses the truth to the police.

episodesList.title: Episode 127
episodesList.summary: The girls start a TV repair business. While repairing a TV set, Sweety experiences an electric shock and becomes unconscious. She causes everyone to worry about her memory loss.

episodesList.title: Episode 128
episodesList.summary: Sweety places an advertisement for her marriage in the newspaper. Sweety selects a prince as her prospective groom. The Mathurs don't like him, so they thrash him.

episodesList.title: Episode 129
episodesList.summary: Anand refuses to give his daughters money to watch a magic show. They learn the magic of making objects disappear. They try it on Anand, and he disappears.

episodesList.title: Episode 130
episodesList.summary: Radhika casts a spell on Anand and he is transported to a warehouse, where gangsters plan to kill someone. His daughters look vainly for the magic book to get him back.

episodesList.title: Episode 131
episodesList.summary: The girls want to make Anand a world-record holder. He is stressed about living in a glass box with scorpions to achieve the record. Anand's first wife tells him a trick to escape.

episodesList.title: Episode 132
episodesList.summary: Kadar Bhai asks Kajal to help Rocky. The girls send Meenakshi to deal with Sridevi. Instead of being intimidated, Sridevi is impressed by her and accepts her as Rocky's wife.

episodesList.title: Episode 133
episodesList.summary: Sridevi refuses to let Meenakshi go back home. She opposes Rocky marrying his girlfriend. The girls trick Sridevi and Makhan Singh to let their children marry each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 134
episodesList.summary: Pooja brings Gogi to live with the Mathurs for a couple of days. She wants to hide him from some dangerous men. Both Radhika and Sweety fall in love with Gogi.

episodesList.title: Episode 135
episodesList.summary: Kajal gives Radhika and Sweety time to decide about their feelings for Gogi. While they plot against each other, the goons arrive at the Mathur house to kill Gogi.

episodesList.title: Episode 136
episodesList.summary: Gogi's parents meet Anand to seek Gogi's marriage with one of the Mathur girls. But Gogi surprises everyone with his choice. An angry Kajal scares Gogi and his parents away.

episodesList.title: Episode 137
episodesList.summary: The girls stage Anand and Sunaina's affair to revive Beena and Anand's romance. Beena gets suspicious due to the phone calls. Beena is angry with Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 138
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls' plan works. Anand and Beena behave lovingly with each other. The girls are happy to see the change in their parents. They commence stage two of their plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 139
episodesList.summary: Anand is heartbroken after Sunaina says that she doesn't want him to come back to her. The girls and Beena try to cheer him up and eventually plan on getting Anand married to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 140
episodesList.summary: Chhoti doesn't win the 'Best Student' award. The girls organise another award for the worst teacher. They change their view when they realise the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 141
episodesList.summary: Sweety decides to write her own novel based on her life after being inspired by Arundhati Roy. The publishers, however, refuse to publish a book that has plagiarised content.

episodesList.title: Episode 142
episodesList.summary: The girls create trouble in the society and for Mr Pange, its secretary. When they refuse to apologise, an annoyed Anand threatens to give up his family and live like a hermit.

episodesList.title: Episode 143
episodesList.summary: Anand wanders into a cave as a hermit and stays with a goon in the garb of a hermit. On locating him, his daughters, Beena and his first wife try to bring him home by irking him.

episodesList.title: Episode 144
episodesList.summary: Chhoti gets Mr D'Souza home to help him get his stolen wallet back. When they hear about the kids not celebrating Christmas, the girls plan to collect money for the kids to enjoy.

episodesList.title: Episode 145
episodesList.summary: Radhika mishears Anand's instructions. The girls end up receiving a goon instead of Anand's colleague. Anand and the girls get kidnapped due to this, but Beena rescues everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 146
episodesList.summary: The girls, along with Kadar Bhai, start a security agency to offer people protection. Their company runs well until Kadar Bhai brings actress Anarkali, who requires a bodyguard.

episodesList.title: Episode 147
episodesList.summary: Anand is appointed as Anarkali's bodyguard against his wishes. Kadar Bhai tells the Mathur girls about an impending attack on Anarkali. Anand's first wife saves them from a bomb.

episodesList.title: Episode 148
episodesList.summary: Anand walks out of the house after challenging his daughters that they cannot live without him. But he misses them. Pandhari Dada gives him an idea to return to his house.

episodesList.title: Episode 149
episodesList.summary: Anand returns home as Gangubai, the new maid. Kadar Bhai and Pange are mesmerised by her. Anand gets worried after overhearing a conversation between Beena and Pappu.

episodesList.title: Episode 150
episodesList.summary: While Anand tackles Kadar Bhai and Pange as Gangubai, Beena considers divorcing him. When the girls ask him to sign the divorce papers, Anand gives up his act.

episodesList.title: Episode 151
episodesList.summary: Sweety finds a correspondence course to attain a doctor's degree and is adamant on becoming one. She starts studying for the course with Babli's help in spite of Anand's refusal.

episodesList.title: Episode 152
episodesList.summary: Sweety becomes a doctor and sets up her clinic to treat patients. But the police come to know about these fake medical degrees and arrive at the Mathur house to arrest her.

episodesList.title: Episode 153
episodesList.summary: The girls hear about Baba Baal Brahmachari and the negative views he spreads about women from Pooja. They are enraged and plan to make him change his views and respect women.

episodesList.title: Episode 154
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls start an acting school under Anand's name in their house. But the school shuts down the very day it starts when a student slaps Meenakshi as she explains acting.

episodesList.title: Episode 155
episodesList.summary: Martians have landed on Earth to congratulate 'Hum Paanch' on their success. But scientists and countries globally get this news. A raid is planned on the Mathur house.

episodesList.title: Episode 156
episodesList.summary: The baby Martian stays back on Earth. His parents are on their way to take him back while the Mathurs and Kadar Bhai struggle to keep him safe tackling the doctors and police.

episodesList.title: Episode 157
episodesList.summary: It is April Fool's Day. The girls go around the town fooling people. But Sweety gets dejected when they reject princely marital proposals, thinking them to be a prank.

episodesList.title: Episode 158
episodesList.summary: A robber disguised as a salesman hears about Sinha's wealth from the Mathur girls and robs Sinha. He sends a stolen necklace to the Mathurs to thank them. Anand gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Episode 159
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls decide to help Abhijeet get married to Beena's sister, Rajni. They let him stay at their house and make plans so that he can impress Rajni.

episodesList.title: Episode 160
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls try different ways to help Abhijeet win Rajni, but Mithilesh interferes and spoils their plans. Abhijeet finally pretends to be dead and wins Rajni's heart.

episodesList.title: Episode 161
episodesList.summary: Anand gets a complaint from the society about the misbehaviour of his daughters. The girls show him the reality, and he realises the truth that his girls are well-behaved.

episodesList.title: Episode 162
episodesList.summary: Anand is annoyed with Chhoti for starting a fight between Mr and Mrs Chhadha. He is shocked by the marriage proposal of Viren and Sonu for Chhoti. Whom will Chhoti choose?

episodesList.title: Episode 163
episodesList.summary: The girls organise a poetry contest to help Riyaaz Bhai select a writer for his music company. Anand wins the contest. Riyaaz Bhai gets arrested by the police.

episodesList.title: Episode 164
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls are shocked to know the expensive rates of mangoes. They plan to loot a fruit godown with Kadar Bhai and provide mangoes to the people who cannot afford them.

episodesList.title: Episode 165
episodesList.summary: The girls, along with Kadar Bhai, Beena, and Anand plan to loot. But the police arrive at the godown and thwart their plan. Anand's first wife helps them escape.

episodesList.title: Episode 166
episodesList.summary: Anand's first wife wishes to leave the house because neither he nor the girls remember her birthday. She stays back when Beena remembers it and organises a pooja for her.

episodesList.title: Episode 167
episodesList.summary: Anand scolds his daughters without any reason. The girls feel that Anand is getting cranky with old age. As a solution, they decide to make a pill. Sweety tests the pill on Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 168
episodesList.summary: The girls prepare for the press conference. Beena is annoyed with Anand's antics. The effects of the pill wear off and he arrives at the conference, looking old and tired.

episodesList.title: Episode 169
episodesList.summary: To become famous, the girls spread a rumour of owning the formula to create an atom bomb with aluminium. This news reaches terrorist Razaak Rabdi who plans to kidnap them.

episodesList.title: Episode 170
episodesList.summary: Razaak Rabdi arrives at the Mathur house as Kammo Banarsi to kidnap Radhika. Anand's first wife saves the girls from his attack and knocks him down. He becomes unconscious.

episodesList.title: Episode 171
episodesList.summary: Sweety hears about Pyaremohan, the new member, in their society and wishes to marry his son. Kajal and Kadar Bhai force the son to marry Sweety. Babli lodges a police complaint.

episodesList.title: Episode 172
episodesList.summary: Manohar, one of her admirers, meets Sweety the night before the wedding and convinces her to elope with him. But he gets tired of her stupidity and brings her back to Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 173
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls go to record a dog's wedding under the name of their new video recording company. The dog owners fight among themselves and the Mathur girls flee from the venue.

episodesList.title: Episode 174
episodesList.summary: The girls plan to remake 'Titanic' with Sattar Bhai's funding. But, before they can even begin, he gets a call from Hollywood not to remake the movie without prior permissions.

episodesList.title: Episode 175
episodesList.summary: Pooja's success in getting a TV anchoring assignment motivates the Mathur girls to try it too. When they are rejected by the director, they plan to sabotage Pooja's act.

episodesList.title: Episode 176
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls are enraged with the current education system and the corruption prevalent in the college management. Beena suggests that they start a college of their own.

episodesList.title: Episode 177
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls start their college. But, the authorities from the education department send them a notice to shut it down. The girls fight back putting Anand's life at stake.

episodesList.title: Episode 178
episodesList.summary: Anand gets beaten up by some people on his way back home from work. The girls and Beena get him a martial arts trainer against his wishes so that he can defend himself.

episodesList.title: Episode 179
episodesList.summary: Sweety is taciturn and quiet from the morning. This worries the Mathurs and they try different ways to cheer her up but in vain. Babli, however, visits Sweety and cheers her up.

episodesList.title: Episode 180
episodesList.summary: Pooja comes to the Mathurs asking for a poster designer and boasts about her dance shows across the world. The girls get enraged and organise a face-off between Pooja and Beena.

episodesList.title: Episode 181
episodesList.summary: As Beena gets better at dancing, the girls try to make Pooja nervous about her dance. Pooja and the girls try to fool each other, but they get caught. Anand cancels the face-off.

episodesList.title: Episode 182
episodesList.summary: The girls plan a 'dandiya' event. The girls share their idea with Sattar Bhai, who funds their event. Pakya Bhai inaugurates the event. He tries to extort money from Sattar Bhai.

episodesList.title: Episode 183
episodesList.summary: Anand falls sick with food poisoning and is rushed to the hospital. The doctor prescribes him medicines. Beena and the girls are worried as the druggists are on strike.

episodesList.title: Episode 184
episodesList.summary: Mad at Shyamlal for not selling them medicines, the girls kidnap Chutki. Shyamlal gets worried and approaches the police. He learns a lesson when the police refuse to help him.

episodesList.title: Episode 185
episodesList.summary: Chhoti refuses to help the girls market their aerobics centre. So, they take the onus upon themselves. They do not stand a chance against Chhoti's tactics and applaud her efforts.

episodesList.title: Episode 186
episodesList.summary: The girls are annoyed at Pange for not letting them play poker at his house and have him arrested. A terrified Pange and his wife ask the girls for forgiveness.

episodesList.title: Episode 187
episodesList.summary: The Mathur women are diagnosed with malaria and are rushed to the hospital. Anand has a tough time taking care of them and gets stressed when he hears the bill amount.

episodesList.title: Episode 188
episodesList.summary: Anand is worried about his daughters' marriage and convinces Meenakshi to get married to Sanjay. But, Anand himself drives Sanjay away when he behaves arrogantly with Meenakshi.

episodesList.title: Episode 189
episodesList.summary: Anand acts rudely with Baba Samshuddin, and he curses Anand with an unwanted guest creating trouble for him. Beena falls sick, and the nurse informs Anand of Beena's pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Episode 190
episodesList.summary: The society members make fun of Anand about Beena's pregnancy, but the girls prepare to welcome the baby. Later, Beena is unhappy to learn from the doctor that she is not pregnant.

episodesList.title: Episode 191
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls try to get Gattu married. He likes Gautami and wants to get married to her. But Kajal starts liking Gattu, and her sisters plan her wedding with him.

episodesList.title: Episode 192
episodesList.summary: Anand Mathur lives with his wife and five wild and troublesome daughters. The sisters are poles apart from each other and a normal day in their life is filled with loads of adventures and laughter. Though Anand is often annoyed with his daughters but is also proud of their feats.

episodesList.title: Episode 193
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls' new show about criminals in Mumbai puts all of them in grave danger due to Kalua. But, Anand's first wife locks them up and saves the Mathurs from the bomb.

episodesList.title: Episode 194
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls start a new lie detecting business with a dog gifted to them by Babli. The customers get enraged at them and walk away when they realise the truth about the dog.

episodesList.title: Episode 195
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls throw a New Year's party to make people happy. But Babli and Sweety spike the cake and distribute it amongst their guests. This leads to chaos in the event.

episodesList.title: Episode 196
episodesList.summary: Anand is alone at home and has to host Hariya, a criminal that the police are looking for. When the police arrive both Anand and Hariya fool the inspector and help Hariya escape.

episodesList.title: Episode 197
episodesList.summary: A rat in the Mathur house creates chaos and trouble for Anand. While chasing the rat, Beena finds his collection of Rekha's photos. She gets mad at him, but Anand makes up for it.

episodesList.title: Episode 198
episodesList.summary: Gautam scolds Meenakshi for separating a husband and a wife. Instead of getting angry with Gautam, she falls in love with him and confesses it to her sisters.

episodesList.title: Episode 199
episodesList.summary: The Mathur girls help Meenakshi impress Gautam. They ask her to apologise to him, take her to his house, make blank calls and ask Meenakshi to write him a love letter.

episodesList.title: Episode 200
episodesList.summary: Anand hears the truth about Meenakshi and Gautam. Impressed with Meenakshi, Gautam's parents agree to the marriage. Kadar Bhai and Sattar Bhai fight over funding the wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 201
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs prepare for Meenakshi's wedding lavishly. Anand and Meenakshi get emotional. The wedding gets cancelled as Gautam runs away from home the previous night.

episodesList.title: Episode 202
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs are annoyed with the guests in their house. They find ways to drive them away but in vain. Finally, the girls create an argument between them and the guests leave.

episodesList.title: Episode 203
episodesList.summary: Radhika complaints to Anand about Sweety and Jassi troubling other people. When they start getting blank calls, the Mathur family get annoyed and go to the police.

episodesList.title: Episode 204
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs get excited with a Holi invitation from Amitabh Bachchan's house. They select Babli to go with them on their extra invitation, but they miss their chance.

episodesList.title: Episode 205
episodesList.summary: Anand is angry with Beena for being idle all day. The girls look for ways to keep Beena engaged. Babli brings Vignesh, a movie producer, who offers Beena to act in his film.

episodesList.title: Episode 206
episodesList.summary: Anand is unhappy with Beena's acting job. His first wife tells him a way out. Beena's movie gets cancelled. When she tells him that she knows he did it, Anand accepts his mistake.

episodesList.title: Episode 207
episodesList.summary: The girls help Mansukh Makkhi to plan an award ceremony and appoint Anand as the judge. Anand is unhappy with this, but the show gets cancelled as Mansukh gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Episode 208
episodesList.summary: The girls go around fooling everyone. Babli plays a prank on her husband. She picks up a fight with him and asks for a divorce. Amit fakes his suicide and fools Babli instead.

episodesList.title: Episode 209
episodesList.summary: Pange complains to Anand about the girls troubling him. The girls get a horse to get back at him. Pange then apologises to the girls, and the girls take the horse back.

episodesList.title: Episode 210
episodesList.summary: Bored with the telecast of the same type of TV shows, the girls plan to start a new TV show. Funded by Sattar Bhai, they finalise the plot for a mythological show based on Raavan.

episodesList.title: Episode 211
episodesList.summary: The girls decide on the theme of the show and the plot of the first episode and the title track. After finalising, they conduct auditions for the main role.

episodesList.title: Episode 212
episodesList.summary: The girls do not find an actor to play the lead role of Raavan. Pooja and Sattar Bhai both demand the lead role. But, Anand ends up being selected for the lead role of Raavan.

episodesList.title: Episode 213
episodesList.summary: Anand is unhappy about playing Raavan's role, but girls do not listen to him. Sattar Bhai's wife interrupts the rehearsal and scares Sattar Bhai. He flees from the set.

episodesList.title: Episode 214
episodesList.summary: Amit asks the girls and Babli to save his life from Lotiya Pathan. The girls plan to kidnap Babli and Anand is killed in the encounter.

episodesList.title: Episode 215
episodesList.summary: The girls plan Babli's kidnapping. But, Anand gets arrested, and Babli gets kidnapped by Pathan in the process. The girls and Popatlal make plans to rescue her from Pathan.

episodesList.title: Episode 216
episodesList.summary: The Mathur women and Babli are at Hira Singh's house. They help him become the Prime Minister by establishing his political party. But, he loses the election because of Babli.

episodesList.title: Episode 217
episodesList.summary: Hira Singh and the girls plan to remove the people away from the city. So, they dress Hira Singh as Baba Dev Anand to scare the people, but the plan fails due to Babli.

episodesList.title: Episode 218
episodesList.summary: When the Mathur girls try black magic on Balbeet, Leena wants them to go back home. Beena dreams of the girls starting an airline company and has a nightmare about the plane crash.

episodesList.title: Episode 219
episodesList.summary: While playing a prank, the girls dial Chhotu's number. Thinking that they have seen him commit Totaram's murder, he tries to kill the Mathurs in their house, but in vain.

episodesList.title: Episode 220
episodesList.summary: Against Anand's wishes, the girls start a school for beggars. After a successful first day of training, the girls get a notice from the education department to shut it down.

episodesList.title: Episode 221
episodesList.summary: All gangsters come together on Kajal's birthday in the Mathur house to hear Kadar Bhai's news. The police try to arrest them all but end up getting blackmailed by the girls.

episodesList.title: Episode 222
episodesList.summary: All gangsters come together on Kajal's birthday in the Mathur house to hear Kadar Bhai's news. The police try to arrest them all but end up getting blackmailed by the girls.

episodesList.title: Episode 223
episodesList.summary: Beena is upset about Anand's affair with Sushmita. The girls confront Anand about it, but he refuses to stop and leaves for Sushmita's house. The girls plan to teach them a lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 224
episodesList.summary: The girls trouble Sushmita at her house. Anand gets upset with the news of Beena becoming an actress. The girls teach them a lesson and Anand and Sushmita apologise.

episodesList.title: Episode 225
episodesList.summary: Motivated by Anand's scolding, Kajal decides to fight the Kargil war to help the soldiers. Everyone bids her an emotional farewell. Kajal returns home after India wins the war.

episodesList.title: Episode 226
episodesList.summary: Enraged by Pooja's boasting, the girls make Beena a model. They find a way around Mr Jaitley's condition of having one of the Khans in the ad, by arranging for fake actors.

episodesList.title: Episode 227
episodesList.summary: Babli suggests her cousin, Vivek as a prospective groom for Sweety. In an attempt to impress him, Sweety behaves arrogantly. But Nirmala, Vivek's mother, approves of Sweety.

episodesList.title: Episode 228
episodesList.summary: The girls make Pooja their fake aunt. But a problem arises when Joginder falls for Pooja, and she refuses his proposal. The girls' plan fails when Anand tells the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 229
episodesList.summary: Anand gets an offer to be the lead singer of Sippy and Sony's band. He refuses initially, thinking it's the girls' plan but accepts the offer when the girls and Beena laugh at him.

episodesList.title: Episode 230
episodesList.summary: Anand is the lead singer of the band. He, Sippy and Sony convince Pange and Kadar Bhai to join them. The band falls apart when Sony and Sippy are taken back to the mental hospital.

episodesList.title: Episode 231
episodesList.summary: Anand is troubled with the girls' constant arguments. A peon suggests a way to solve the fights. With a change in his behaviour, Anand causes an argument between the girls.

episodesList.title: Episode 232
episodesList.summary: The girls argue with each other and ask Anand to split everything in two. He tries to tell them the truth, but they don't listen to him. Later, seeing Beena upset, they apologise.

episodesList.title: Episode 233
episodesList.summary: Incited by a news article, Sweety pesters Anand to get her married. Babli gets Victor to marry Sweety. But, Anand thwarts the girls' plan by telling Victor the truth.

episodesList.title: Episode 234
episodesList.summary: The girls agree to help Jhakaas Bhai in his movie production. The cast is decided, the story is written, and the filming starts. But, a girl walks into the set asking them to stop.

episodesList.title: Episode 235
episodesList.summary: The girls plan ways to publicise the movie by plotting stunts and refuse the funding. The movie is ready for release and everyone goes to watch it. But it turns out to be a flop.

episodesList.title: Episode 236
episodesList.summary: Anand fears that Popatal will fire him. The girls start a detective agency making Anand the head detective. The entire family is kidnapped when they investigate their first case.

episodesList.title: Episode 237
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs try escaping the bungalow but in vain. They fail to alert the minister too. Finally, Anand's first wife comes to their rescue, stopping the minister from getting shot.

episodesList.title: Episode 238
episodesList.summary: Anand scolds the girls for being careless. He returns home after having lost INR 50,000 in an auto. The girls help him save the money. The auto driver also brings his money back.

episodesList.title: Episode 239
episodesList.summary: Beena keeps a fast for Anand and asks him to come home early. Anand has to leave for Bangalore, but due to his first wife, he doesn't board the flight. Anand thanks his first wife.

episodesList.title: Episode 240
episodesList.summary: Anand reminds his daughters of the poor kids who don't get a chance to celebrate Diwali. So, the girls make a plan to collect money for such kids and help them enjoy the festival.

episodesList.title: Episode 241
episodesList.summary: Beena's uncle, Sushil, visits the Mathurs. He annoys them with his questions. They ask Kadar Bhai to scare him but in vain. Finally, Chhoti's plan, to get rid of him, works.

episodesList.title: Episode 242
episodesList.summary: ACP Kuldev Singh visits the Mathurs asking for help against a criminal, who kills people on the footpath. Anand is forced to sleep on the footpath to trap the criminal.

episodesList.title: Episode 243
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs move to a new house after Anand's promotion. However, there is a ghost living in the new house who tries to scare them. The girls and Beena manage to drive him away.

episodesList.title: Episode 244
episodesList.summary: Anand is upset about not being able to watch TV. The girls get an idea to start their own TV channel, and they organise interviews at their house. Anand agrees to support them.

episodesList.title: Episode 245
episodesList.summary: The Mathurs start their TV channel, and the story for a show is ready. The satellite they build to telecast their show crashes and their plan of a TV channel fails.

episodesList.title: Episode 246
episodesList.summary: The girls help Chhoti plan a smashing party in her school by bluffing. Anand pretends to be Amitabh Bachchan. Chhoti tells everyone the truth and apologises to the Principal.

episodesList.title: Episode 247
episodesList.summary: Hum Paanch is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Ashok Saraf, Shoma Anand, Vidya Balan, Priya Tendulkar and Rakhee Tandon. The series is considered as one of the all-time favourite comedies on television.Anand Mathur lives with his wife and five wild and troublesome daughters. The sisters are poles apart from each other and a normal day in their life is filled with loads of adventures and laughter. Though Anand is often annoyed with his daughters but is also proud of their feats.

episodesList.title: Episode 248
episodesList.summary: The girls start a fight between Kadar Bhai, Sattar Bhai and Pange. To sort things out, the Mathurs and Pange fast. Kadar Bhai, Sattar Bhai and Pange apologise to each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 249
episodesList.summary: Chhoti uses Radhika's computer to chat online. She finds a guy online and falls in love with. The Mathur women are shocked to hear this, but she calms them down.

episodesList.title: Episode 250
episodesList.summary: Chhoti invites her online boyfriend, Kittu, home but instantly rejects him when she sees him. The Mathurs try to convince her to accept him, but she finds a way to get rid of him.

episodesList.title: Episode 251
episodesList.summary: Chhoti helps Anand to stop Beena from leaving. In return, she seeks his help to organise her school's Republic Day party. The girls decide on a play based on their parents' life.

episodesList.title: Episode 252
episodesList.summary: The doctor is called home as Beena faints and he asks her to do some tests. Beena comes to know about her intestinal cancer. She plans on getting Anand married before she dies.

episodesList.title: Episode 253
episodesList.summary: The girls agree to Beena's plan of getting Anand married and select Kamini as his new wife. Anand is mad at Beena, but she helps Kamini woo Anand by making her write him a letter.

episodesList.title: Episode 254
episodesList.summary: Anand agrees to go out with Kamini after he gets to know of Beena's plan. Beena realises the truth about her reports. She pretends to die when Anand refuses to cancel the wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 255
episodesList.summary: After mourning the Indian Cricket Team's loss, the girls form a cricket team with Beena as the captain. During the match, Beena gets hit by a ball which makes Kajal furious.

episodesList.title: Episode 256
episodesList.summary: The girls take up the task of popularising Mr Honda's TV channel. They plan to telecast a cow, Rekha's wedding on the channel. The public thrash Honda for cheating them.

episodesList.title: Episode 257
episodesList.summary: Hum Paanch is a Hindi comedy drama television series starring Ashok Saraf, Shoma Anand, Vidya Balan, Priya Tendulkar and Rakhee Tandon. The series is considered as one of the all-time favourite comedies on television.Anand Mathur lives with his wife and five wild and troublesome daughters. The sisters are poles apart from each other and a normal day in their life is filled with loads of adventures and laughter. Though Anand is often annoyed with his daughters but is also proud of their feats.

episodesList.title: Episode 258
episodesList.summary: Having been refused money by Anand, Appu Tappu sends his men to shoot him but in vain. Appu Tappu himself visits Anand and turns out to be his school friend.

episodesList.title: Episode 259
episodesList.summary: The girls organise a Holi event at their house to help Pooja find the truth about Sunil and Malini. Sweety spikes everyone's drinks. Malini wins the event and wins the fake prize.

episodesList.title: Episode 260
episodesList.summary: The girls decide to take admission in a college after Anand tells them the importance of education. In the college, they challenge Billu Bhai's gang and win against them.

episodesList.title: Episode 261
episodesList.summary: To fool the Billu gang members, the girls put up fake posters under their names and lie to the principal. The principal asks the gang members to bring their fathers to the college.

episodesList.title: Episode 262
episodesList.summary: The girls vow to bring Ruhi Khan, an actress, home by saying that Kadar Bhai is their ill uncle and asking her to meet him. But a photographer recognises Kadar Bhai.

episodesList.title: Episode 263
episodesList.summary: Ruhi Khan is trained by the Mathurs at their home for her new role. But Beena gets worried seeing Anand's behaviour around her and plans to send her back.

episodesList.title: Episode 264
episodesList.summary: The girls are annoyed with Anand and Beena's arguments. The situation worsens when Beena fails to wake up Anand early in the morning for an important task. Beena leaves the house.

episodesList.title: Episode 265
episodesList.summary: The girls look for ways to help Anand and Beena get back together. Chhoti finally suggests a solution, which makes Anand and Beena meet and apologise to each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 266
episodesList.summary: The Mathur women participate in the Best Family award competition after Pooja challenges them. The panel is impressed by them, but Beena tells them the truth about Dhurinder ji.

episodesList.title: Episode 267
episodesList.summary: Everyone arrives at a resort, but the gardener scares them by telling them about a ghost. Pooja is found dead, and her body disappears, with a warning for the others.

episodesList.title: Episode 268
episodesList.summary: Kadar Bhai is suspected of murdering Pooja. Everyone keeps disappearing before him. Eventually, he faints. Who is responsible for this?

episodesList.title: Episode 269
episodesList.summary: The Mathur women get an invitation to visit America from Natarajan for attending a conference as the Best Family award winners. They leave but return a month later.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Anand Mathur Has Returned With His Family From The Usa. Kajal Throws A Party To Inform People Of Their Return, But It Flops. The Five Sisters Devise A Plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Purushottam Is Conducting A Fake Sting Operation To Boost His Channel’s Trp. They Stage Anand As A South Indian Movie Producer. Unaware Of The Plan, Bina Feels Betrayed By Anand.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Mumbai Has A Kidnapper Who Abducts Girls And Shaves Off Their Heads. Kajal Gets An Image Makeover To Act As A Honey Trap To Catch The Kidnapper, While Radhika Doubts Daljeet.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Radhika’s Suspicion Grows Stronger. Meanwhile, The Kidnapper Gets Kajal, His 8th Victim. Will He Sacrifice Her Or Will A Miracle Save Kajal From His Clutches?

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: The Sisters Want To Get Back Their Glory Days When Everybody Feared Them. Anand's First Wife Decides To Help. They Even Prepare To Murder. What Is The Master Plan? Will It Work?

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: Sweety And Babli Decide To Prove Their Smartness By Trapping A Wealthy Groom. Chhoti Plans The Modus Operandi And A Gullible Family Gets Lured. Will She Be Successful?

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: The Sisters Learn About Share Markets And Get Impressed With The Possibility To Make Money. They Borrow Money And Invest Through A Broker. Will They Get Their Money’s Worth?

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: Kajal Bhai Becomes An Rj On A New Radio Channel Named 'chup Chaap Sun Be 99.9 Fm'. She Speaks To Her Guest Satish Samosewalla, Who Falls In Love With Her And Decides To Marry Her.

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Purushottam Finds A Way To Overpower Meenakshi When Daljeet Gives Him A Strength Tonic. He Worries About The Side Effects And Tries It On Anand, Who Starts Acting Womanish.

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: The Sisters Start A Tarot Card Reading Service. Chhoti Plans The Modus Operandi And Demands 50% Share. On Being Denied, She Tries To Derail The Business With A Fake Client.

episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: News In Town Is That There Is A Millionaire Bar Dancer Who Is Gathering A Lot Of Attention. The Mathur Sisters To Come Up With An Idea Of A Reality Tv Show As A Business Model.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Tarannum Talent Takkar Is Ready To Kickstart. The Police Captures The Instigator Of The Bomb Threat And Chhoti Unveils The Controversy. The Show Goes On But Ends Up As A Flop.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: After Anand Scolds Bina, He Goes Into Self-retrospection. While He Makes Up For His Rudeness With Sweet Gestures, Sweety And Choti Spy On Him, Suspicious Of Him Having An Affair.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Upon Finding An Unknown Woman’s Number On Anand’s Phone, Bina Decides To Win Back His Heart. While Doing So, Anand Gets Suspicious Of Bina’s Whereabouts And Decides To Spy On Her.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: After Sweety Begins Hallucinating About Snakes, Babli Suggests That She Get Married To A Mystical Snake From Her Previous Life. The Media Is Tipped To Gather Publicity.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: The Mathur Sisters Come Up With The Idea Of Starting A Production House. They Interview Cast And Crew Members And Hire A Production Team To Shoot A Tv Soap At The Mathur Residence.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Anand Mathur’s Decision Of Going On A Pilgrimage Does Not Affect Anyone At Home. However, Upon Realising The Possible Consequences, Daljeet And Purshottam Plan To Stop Him.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: After Anand Decides To Follow Decency As A New Year's Resolution, He Faces Maltreatment Throughout The Day. The Mathur Sisters Make Him Realise That Decency Is Outdated.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: When Nandabai Is Fired By A Neighbour, Meenakshi Leads The House-helpers To A Strike. Kajal, Chhoti And Sweety Launch A Housekeeping Competition.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: To Avoid The Demolition Of Kadar Bhai’s Unauthorised Property, The Mathur Sisters Pretend To Be Doctors. When Daljeet Is Rushed To The Hospital, The Sisters Manage To Save Him.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Mathur Family Decides To Help Their Troubled Radhe Chacha Become Famous. While The Sisters Promote Him As Mirabai, They Face Numerous Challenges That Drive Radhe Back To His Wife.

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Accompanied By Her Sisters, Sweety Decides To Jump In Front Of Shahrukh Khan's Car, In Hope Of Meeting Him. But The Danger Involved Pushes Kajal To Think Of An Alternative.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: When The Wedding Season Passes, Sweety Plans To Marry One Of Bina's Ex-boyfriend's Son. When Bina's Ex Invites Himself For Lunch To The Mathur's, He Is Greeted With A Surprise.

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: After An Arguement, Meenakshi Challenges Purshottam To Become A Superstar. Upon Getting His First Break, Purshottam Faces Multiple Hurdles, However, Meenakshi Saves Him.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: The News Of Daljeet's Parents' Divorce Helps Mathur Family Come Up With The Idea Of A Dance Competition For The Elderly. However, The Couples Back Out Right Before The Competition.

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: With Each Couple Displaying Unique Performances At The Nach Budhiye Competition, The Girls Doubt Their Parent's Victory. Using Various Tricks, The Sisters Try To Turn The Odds.

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: Bina And The Girls Host A Kitty Party And Invite Neighbourhood Ladies. While Gambling, Bina Mortgages Anand And Loses. Upset, Anand's Dignity Is Put At Stake.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Tired Of The Humiliation And Insults, The Goons Gather At The Mathur House To Discuss Alternate Money-making Schemes. To Earn Both Respect And Money, They Come To A Mutual Consent.

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: A New Contest Called The 'kiska Pati Saccha Pati' Sees Husbands Being Challenged On Their Knowledge About Their Wives. Anand Too Is Subjected To The Gruelling Contest!

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: Mathur Family Hosts A Prem Pooja Party To Celebrate Valentine's Day. Receiving This News, A Politician Threatens To Disrupt The Party. However, The Sisters Teach Him A Lesson.

episodesList.title: Episode 31
episodesList.summary: Sweety And Babli Play Subjects To Daljeet's Invention, A Belt That Teleports One To The Moon. Owing To A New Moon Night, The Plan Fails Leading To Everyone's Disappointment.

episodesList.title: Episode 32
episodesList.summary: Anand Pays A Heavy Price For Grounding Chhoti, Owing To A Prank Played By Her. Soon, The Prank Involves The Neighbours And Media. But The Girls Are Able To Control The Situation.

episodesList.title: Episode 33
episodesList.summary: The Girls Deliberately Get Involved In A Kidnapping, In Hope Of Earning A Few Bucks. However, Things Go Down The Other Way, When Their Plan Is Disrupted At The Brim Of Success.

episodesList.title: Episode 34
episodesList.summary: A Small Discussion Results In The Sisters Opening The Pre-marriage Counselling Centre. While They Set Out To Save Marriages, Many Couples Who Visit End Up Arguing And Leaving.

episodesList.title: Episode 35
episodesList.summary: Being Lured By Purshottam To Model, Anand Gets Into Trouble. When Bina And The Girls Start Doubting Him, Anand Faces A Challenge Of Proving Himself Right.

episodesList.title: Episode 36
episodesList.summary: Amidst The Mayhem, Bina And The Girls Are Confused As To Who The Real Raju Red Indian Is. While Anand And Purshottam Try Hard To Not Get Caught, Fate Causes Chaos.

episodesList.title: Episode 37
episodesList.summary: With The Exam Season Nearing, The Mathur's Are Worried About Chhoti, Who Is To Appear For Her Ssc Exams. But Her Lack Of Dedication Is A Cause Of Concern For Everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 38
episodesList.summary: When Anand Finds It Difficult To Manage The Finances Of The Household, Bina And The Girls Decide To Take Charge. Eventually, They Give In To Anand’s Attempts Of Making Them Quit.

episodesList.title: Episode 39
episodesList.summary: Sweety's Quest To Finding A Perfect Groom Ends When She Comes Across A Handsome Young Man In A Park. However, While Helping Sweety, Kajal And Chhoti Also Fall For Him.

episodesList.title: Episode 40
episodesList.summary: The Mathur Girls Have Fallen For The Same Man And Will Do Anything To Please Him. After Their Share Of Arguments, They Find Out That Devendra Is Set To Marry His Childhood Love.

episodesList.title: Episode 41
episodesList.summary: After Getting A Credit Card, Sweety Spends A Lot Of Money With Her Family. Anand Is Shocked To Know Their Actions And Later Receives A Call From Tota, Who Asks For Money From Him.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Bina And Her Daughters Talk About Anand's Changed Behaviour After Meeting Tota. They Come Up With A Solution. Anand Refuses A Drug Dealer's Offer. The Police Later Arrest Anand.

plotHtml:
Anand Mathur is in a white-collar job who always finds himself in trouble because of his five daughters — Meenakshi, Radhika, Sweety, Kajal, and Chhoti. The three elder daughters are by his first wife. The younger two are by his second wife Bina, whom he married upon becoming a widower.
Together, the five girls plan to do something new in every episode. Anand's first wife speaks to him through her portrait on the living room wall; Bina generally supports the daughters' ideas. The show was a runaway success, helping to establish Zee TV.
When the show returned for a second season, Anand had returned from a long stay in the United States. Meenakshi was married to Purush whom she treats like a servant and shouts at. Radhika is married to Daljeet Singh whom her sisters call 'Pape'. He is a scientist and invents many things which get the girls into trouble. He is forgetful — he forgets people's names and basic things. Meenakshi's daughter is Damini, and Radhika's daughter is Gudiya.
tagline: Anand Mathur is in a white-collar job who always finds himself in trouble because of his five daughters — Meenakshi, Radhika, Sweety, Kajal, and Chhoti.

title: Hum Log
summary:
Hum Log (English: We People) is an Indian television soap opera and also the first serial drama series in Hindi. It began telecast on 7 July 1984 on Doordarshan, the only television channel in India at the time. It is the story of an Indian middle-class family of the 1980s and their daily struggles and aspirations. Hum Log is also the first Indian show to be sponsored.
It was created on the lines of a Mexican television series, Ven Conmigo (1975), using the education-entertainment methodology. The idea of the TV series came to then Information and Broadcasting Minister, Vasant Sathe, after a Mexican trip in 1982. Soon the idea for Hum Log was developed in collaboration with writer Manohar Shyam Joshi, who scripted the series, and filmmaker, P. Kumar Vasudev, who went on direct the series. The title score was composed by  music director Anil Biswas.
At the end of every episode, Ashok Kumar discussed the ongoing story and situations with the audience using Hindi couplets and limericks. In later episodes, introduced the actors who played various characters in the serial and end his monologue with the various Indian language versions of the words "Hum Log".
The series was broadcast in the UK on the cable channel Indra Dhnush in 1992.
reception: During its 17-month run, Ashok Kumar received over 400,000 letters from young viewers, asking him to convince their parents in marriage of their choice. The viewership of each episode was more than 50 millions.

articleSections.title: Development and production
articleSections.text:
In 1984, Mexican television writer Miguel Sabido, who had written the Mexican telenovela on educational entertainment, Ven conmigo (Come with Me, 1975) on adult literacy, was invited to India. Working with local writer, he helped created the series which tackled social issues like family planning, caste harmony, empowerment of women, national integration, dowry, alcoholism and drug abuse. Ven conimgo was in turned based on the Peruvian telenovela, Simplemente María (Simply Maria, 1969-1971).
The cast would meet for rehearsals at 3 pm at Himachal Bhavan, near Mandi House in Delhi, and thereafter a van would take them to a studio in suburb Gurgaon where it was shot.

title: Hasratein
summary:
Hasratein (transl. Desires) is an Indian Hindi-language soap opera that originally aired on Zee TV in the mid-1990s. Directed by Ajai Sinha and produced by Sangeeta Sinha and Raakesh Shah, the show was based on the Marathi novel Adhantari by Jaywant Dalvi. The series is currently available for streaming on ZEE5.
The drama became notable for its bold depiction of extra-marital relationships and women’s agency, centering on the character of Savi who leaves her husband to live with another married man while both their spouses are aware of the situation. Its success made it one of the most talked-about Indian television dramas of the decade, sparking discussions on marital discord and the evolving roles of women in Indian society.
plot: Hasratein focuses on the complexities of extra-marital relationships. One of the main storylines follows Savi, a woman who leaves her husband and maintains a relationship with another married man, with both their spouses being aware of the situation. Her actions are partly shaped by her childhood, when her mother left her father for another man. The show emphasizes the societal strain placed on marriages in Indian culture, especially the roles expected of women and the dissatisfaction sometimes felt by men.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Hasratein was one of the most popular television shows of the mid and late 1990s. According to critic Shubhra Gupta, the serial’s popularity "had made it a catalyst for the discussion of issues of marital discord, in spite of the embarrassment the serial generated for many people."
Seema Kapoor played the character of Savi for the first 125 episodes. She was later replaced by Shefali Chhaya (now Shefali Shah), whose performance earned her the Zee Woman of the Year award in 1997.

title: Human
summary:
Human is an Indian 2022 medical thriller television series released on 14 January 2022 on Disney+ Hotstar, which portrays  the underbelly of human drug testing and the world of medical scams and aims to expose the nexus between pharmaceutical companies, large private hospitals, and government officials who exploit the poor in human trials for new drugs.
At the 2022 Filmfare OTT Awards, Human received 3 nominations, including Best Actress in a Drama Series (Shah) and Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series (Jethwa).

episodesList.title: The Saviour
episodesList.summary: In the slums of Bhopal, a failed drug with disastrous side effects, S93R, finds its way into Mangu's family. Dr Saira Sabharwal joins Manthan hospital and challenges the status quo.

episodesList.title: Pain/Killer
episodesList.summary: The drug trials cause adverse effects on Dr Vivek Shekhawat's patients. At Manthan, Dr Shindey and Dr Gauri Nath lock horns over the latter's dream project.

episodesList.title: Secret Lives
episodesList.summary: Saira gets embroiled with the affairs of an S93R victim and confronts Vivek. Meanwhile, Gauri meets the head of Vayu Pharma with an offer.

episodesList.title: The Red Truck
episodesList.summary: Mangu's family meets an activist, OP, who tells them about the drug trials. When all doors close for Vivek, he plans an exit strategy and meets Gauri.

episodesList.title: Not My Baby
episodesList.summary: As Deepali's past and her connection to Roma is revealed, Gauri gets challenged by the Chief Minister and Dr. Shindey. Mangu takes a risky step to save his mother.

episodesList.title: Till Death Do Us Apart
episodesList.summary: While Saira's husband, Neil, begins his assignment on the Bhopal gas tragedy, Gauri decides to topple the CM. Tired of his situation, Mangu involves Deepali in his next move.

episodesList.title: A Lick Of Fire
episodesList.summary: The history between Gauri and Roma is explained, and Saira digs deeper into the S93R trials. Later, Gauri, Pratap, Saira and Neil meet for dinner.

episodesList.title: Victory
episodesList.summary: With Gauri's plans moving closer to fruition, Deepali struggles as the experiment advances to the next stage. Saira's home life takes a hit when Neil questions her.

episodesList.title: Freedom's Price
episodesList.summary: Saira meets Mangu in a tragic turn of events and learns about the trials and the trauma. Meanwhile, Deepali faces the consequences of her rebellion.

episodesList.title: And Justice For All
episodesList.summary: Saira reveals the truth to everyone, which puts Gauri in a bind. Deepali and Mangu decide they have had enough and extract their pound of flesh.
